Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Build with us

**Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

**Your impact

**This is your chance to build Mollie's presence in Denmark from the ground up, as the first person hired with this market as your sole focus. You won't be starting from zero: you'll have the Nordic foundation already built in Sweden to work from, but the Danish playbook is yours to write.

You'll open the market, land our first Danish customers, and turn early learnings into a repeatable approach we can scale. It's a broader, more entrepreneurial scope than a standard sales role. You'll work deals from $100K a month while building toward bigger opportunities of up to $1 million a month, all while shaping how Mollie understands and enters this market for the long run.

What makes this role stand out is the mix: outbound selling, customer discovery, partnerships, and competitive analysis, all rolled into one seat with real ownership. If you want to build something rather than maintain something, this is that opportunity.

**What You'll Ship

**

• Run outbound sales and manage the full sales process, including around 20 cold calls a week

• Build a Danish pipeline and land Mollie's first customers in the market

• Gather market feedback and grow larger opportunities, including deals of up to $1 million a month

• Build relationships with Danish agencies and work on partnerships alongside the partner manager based in Stockholm

• Share what you learn about the Danish marketing landscape with the marketing team to help shape events and go-to-market plans

• Run competitive analysis to sharpen how Mollie positions itself in Denmark

**What You'll Bring

**

• Around 5 years of full-cycle sales experience, with a strong outbound track record and demonstrated success in structured cold outreach

• Value selling capability, with a data-driven approach to activity and pipeline management

• Strong negotiation and contract handling skills, including experience communicating and negotiating with C-level stakeholders

• Creativity in building a pipeline through partnerships or marketing outreach (you don't need to have done this before, just show the potential)

• Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS sales, built across multiple companies

• Comfortable working hands-on in a role with broad scope and real uncertainty

• Fluency in Danish

**Grow your way

**At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

**AI at Mollie

**We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Campaign Design - Store Creative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

What you will do

Drive retail campaign experiences

• 
Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• 
Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• 
Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• 
Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable globally while remaining flexible for local markets.

Lead global campaign toolkits

• 
Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• 
Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• 
Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

Lead and develop creative talent

• 
Inspire, coach and develop a multidisciplinary creative team.

• 
Guide concept development and provide constructive creative feedback.

• 
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation and high creative standards.

Partner across the business

• 
Collaborate with Communications, Operations, Product Design and other key functions to deliver cohesive campaign experiences.

• 
Present concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• 
Work with external agencies, artists and production partners to bring ideas to life.

Deliver from concept to execution

• 
Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

• 
Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and operational realities.

• 
Manage multiple campaign workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Who you are

You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

We imagine you bring

• 
Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• 
Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• 
A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• 
Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• 
Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• 
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• 
Professional fluency in English.

What will make you stand out

A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

WS Audiology, driven by a passion for improving lives, is a leading force in the hearing aid industry. Our goal is to enhance our presence in an underserved market and accelerate business transformation to reach more people effectively.

Reporting to the VP Enterprise Lean of our company, we are seeking an experienced and dynamic Lead of Lean Leadership and Fundamentals to spearhead the implementation and integration of Lean principles across our organization. This role is critical in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of Lean methodologies and have a proven track record in training and mentoring teams to achieve transformative results, across different business functions.

What you will do

• Lean fundamentals deployment: Creating and implementing a strategy for deploying fundamental Lean tools across the enterprise. Collaborating with senior leadership to align lean initiatives with business goals and involves monitoring their effectiveness, adjusting based on feedback and metrics.

• Lean leadership and culture training: Designing training programs centered on lean leadership principles and facilitating workshops to foster a culture of lean thinking. Mentoring leaders to model lean behaviors within their teams.

• Lean onboarding: Establishing a structured lean onboarding program for new employees, ensuring they grasp the importance of lean methodologies in their roles.

• Lean skills development and funnel management: Identifying skill gaps within enterprise and creating targeted training solutions to enhance lean capabilities. Implementing a funnel management system for tracking capability building and collaborating with departments for cohesive skill development.

• Continuous Improvement Advocacy: Promotes a culture of continuous improvement by advocating for lean tools and techniques. Assessments of Lean maturity to provide actionable insights and facilitate the sharing of best practices across organization.

What you bring

Experience

• 7+ years experience in a lean role, with a focus on broad application of lean fundamentals as well as lean leadership development.

• Proven experience in designing and delivering training programs related to lean fundamentals and lean leadership.

• Strong understanding of fundamental lean tools such as A3 Problem Solving, Visual Daily Management, Value Stream Mapping, Transactional/business Process Improvement, 5S and Kaizen Events.

• Proven experience in applying fundamental lean tools to improve process performance and generate real impact in multiple business areas (not only manufacturing).

• Experience with kaizen funnel management and lean capabilities (certification) funnel management.

Personal competencies

• Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, numerical skills, and attention to detail for effective problem-solving

• Strategic mindset that can adapt quickly to tactical needs; forward-thinking and collaborative.

• Proven track record of managing multiple projects and meeting critical deadlines

• Team player with excellent interpersonal skills and a commitment to building relationships internally and externally

• Effective communicator across all organizational levels, from blue collars to executive offices, with strong leadership and organizational abilities.

Who we are

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is looking for a Regulatory CMC Writer to support global marketing applications across our growing portfolio.

In this role, you will author and participate in the review of high-quality CMC documentation, with a primary focus on global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), and New Drug Applications (NDAs). Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will translate complex manufacturing, analytical, and formulation development information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers and collaborate with colleagues and external partners across late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management activities. Your contribution will help ensure that CMC documentation presents a coherent scientific rationale and is delivered within agreed submission timelines. You will also contribute to improving writing quality and efficiency through the thoughtful use of AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your primary focus will be CMC documentation supporting global BLA/MAA/NDA filings and responses to health authority questions during assessment.

**Your Responsibilities Include

**

• Authoring and reviewing Module 3 CTD sections, covering manufacturing processes, process controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facility

• Translating technical reports and source data into clear, scientifically sound regulatory narratives in close collaboration with subject matter experts

• Coordinating document preparation and review with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners, including contract manufacturing organizations

• Consolidating review comments, facilitating their resolution, and ensuring that documents are completed and approved within agreed timelines

• Verifying the accuracy of data presented in CMC documents against source documentation and ensuring consistency across related sections and submissions

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and implementing the resulting updates to CMC submission documents

• Maintaining source document trackers and ensuring traceability of supporting information and regulatory document updates

• Supporting lifecycle maintenance of CMC documentation, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed

• Applying AI and digital tools to improve writing quality, consistency, and efficiency, while critically evaluating outputs and ensuring scientific accuracy and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Following and contributing to the continuous improvement of CMC writing and response principles, templates, internal procedures, and style guides

• Performing CMC writing activities in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable procedures

**Requirements

**You hold a master’s degree in science or related technical discipline. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.

You bring at least four years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience authoring and reviewing CMC regulatory sections or supporting source documents, with the ability to take ownership of defined sections with limited supervision

• Experience participating in global regulatory submissions and/or a strong background in pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing processes. Direct experience supporting BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is a strong advantage

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory requirements across development stages and familiarity with CTD structure

• Knowledge of GxP, regulatory compliance, and documentation requirements relevant to CMC activities

• Excellent written English and the ability to distil complex scientific information into clear, concise, and well-structured text

• Strong attention to detail, with the ability to verify data, identify inconsistencies, and maintain scientific accuracy across documents

• Practical experience using AI tools to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including the ability to formulate effective prompts, critically assess outputs, and verify scientific content

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional reviews and facilitate alignment without direct authority

• A proactive and structured approach to planning, prioritizing, and delivering quality work within demanding submission timelines

• A demonstrated track record of effective collaboration and reliable delivery in previous roles, together with curiosity, openness to feedback, and an interest in improving ways of working

Application deadline: 1. November 2026

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK582.400,00---873.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Are you passionate about product data and the systems that turn it into consistent, high-quality experiences everywhere it's used? Do you enjoy the technical challenge of connecting complex data flows across platforms? Do you thrive on making product information easy to find, understand, and trust—for customers and for AI? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Pandora's team is looking for a Product Manager to own our Product Information Management (PIM) practice. PIM is central to our architecture, syndicating product data to ecommerce, marketplaces, retail, and marketing systems, so you'll work at the intersection of data architecture, content quality, and discoverability.

As our new Product Manager, you'll own the product strategy and delivery for our PIM platform, with InRiver preferred as our PIM technology. You'll work closely with data, engineering, and content teams to define the data model, govern data quality, and ensure product information flows correctly to every downstream channel.

This role is critical to how our products are found and understood—not just by customers on our own site, but increasingly by AI-driven answer engines and generative search. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands-on technical execution, vendor management, and continuous improvement of our data model.

Help Write Our Next Chapter - Job Responsibilities:

• Own the product roadmap and backlog for our PIM platform, ensuring the data model and architecture support both business and technical needs

• Design and optimize data flows between PIM and downstream systems (ecommerce, marketplaces, DAM, ERP), working closely with engineering

• Partner with content, SEO, and marketing teams to structure and enrich product information for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

• Manage vendor relationships, including roadmap alignment, issue escalation, and feature adoption

• Monitor data quality, syndication performance, and platform health, identifying optimization opportunities and driving continuous improvement

• Stay ahead of trends in PIM, product data architecture, and AI-driven discovery, bringing forward strategic recommendations

We would love if you could bring:

• 5+ years of experience in product management, data platforms, or PIM—ideally within ecommerce or product content operations

• Technical understanding of PIM architecture, data modeling, and system integrations (APIs, ETL, syndication)

• Experience with InRiver or similar PIM platforms preferred

• Experience optimizing product information for AEO and GEO—structured data, schema markup, and content formats that AI systems and search engines can parse

• Experience writing clear product requirements and managing backlogs in tools like JIRA

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Clinical Trial Disclosure & Transparency
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Job Description

**Genmab is committed to transparency of clinical trial research. We recognize the scientific and ethical value of sharing clinical trial information in a non-biased and timely manner to benefit patients and other external stakeholders. The Clinical Trial Disclosure & Transparency (CTD&T) team resides within Clinical Trial Delivery, which hosts key functions for ensuring successful conduct and reporting of clinical trials.

We are now looking for a new Senior Manager to join our CTD&T team. The role offers a meaningful blend of operational and strategic tasks in a collaborative environment where quality, shared purpose, and cross-functional support are central to how we work.

In the role as Senior Manager of CTD&T, you will be executing against the global and national disclosure regulations and requirements across the entire Genmab portfolio. This role engages with internal and external stakeholders to ensure consistent and responsible disclosure and transparency practices. The position requires strong expertise in disclosure requirements and regulatory processes, coupled with strong organizational and communication skills, while maintaining a commitment to quality, integrity, and advancing Genmab’s mission.

**Responsibilities

**Your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Manage, track, and maintain overall responsibility for the disclosure of clinical trial protocols and results on ClinicalTrials.gov, EU CTIS, and other applicable registries/platforms.

• Support and provide guidance on redaction activities.

• Ensure development of plain language results summaries.

• Stay updated on industry guidelines to ensure compliance.

• Support in updating SOPs, contribute to process improvements, and maintain adherence to established standards.

• Oversee vendor performance related to transparency deliverables.

• Liaise with clinical CROs to ensure consistent messaging across study registries.

• Deliver training on Genmab’s disclosure processes to internal staff and provide guidance to CROs and vendors as needed.

• Ensure internal teams are informed of updated or new requirements and laws.

• Ensure management of unsolicited requests received via the clinicaltrials@genmab.com mailbox.

**Requirements

**

• 5+ years of clinical trial disclosure experience, including a Bachelor's or Master's degree with relevant specialization

• Strong knowledge of disclosure requirements, technology, and platforms.

• Proven ability to lead projects and facilitate cross-functional collaboration.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, that is effective, respectful, and concise.

• Previous experience as a Medical Writer is advantageous, given the close alignment between the CTD&T and Medical Writing teams.

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$132,800.00---$199,200.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**You ar****e someone who:

**

**What We Offer

**

• A central role in shaping our organization's AI and data strategy.

• Hands-on experience with modern Microsoft technologies, cloud platforms, and AI solutions.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

Do you enjoy keeping a team moving without getting in the way? Are you the kind of producer who loves making work life easier for your team through process? And are you also quite silly?

We're expanding one of our games and looking for a Senior Producer to help drive new content and features for our players. You'll work very closely with the executive producer and game director, supporting them in setting a clear production plan within time and budget constraints, while making sure the team has everything they need to do their best work.

You'll also be part of a cross-studio producer team where you can exchange ideas, challenge each other, and share knowledge and complementary skills.

**Here's What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Implement and refine production processes and tools, shaping how we work and grow as a studio

• Drive the project forward by removing roadblocks and keeping delivery dates realistic

• Facilitate the team’s day-to-day rhythm (stand-ups, planning, reviews, post-mortems)

• Plan updates, roadmaps, and marketing beats together with the leads, and communicate plans clearly to stakeholders

• Manage the project long-term: priorities, scope, timelines, risks, and follow-up

• Take on team and people responsibility, including 1:1s, development reviews, and salary conversations

Last, but not least: There's plenty of room to shape this role to fit you.

**Must-haves

**

• Experience going through at least one full game production cycle

• Experience as a producer on at least one shipped game

• Experience with live service and online games

• Experience working with external stakeholders

• A deep understanding of the game development process

• A strong belief in nurturing team wellbeing because a sustainable pace and motivation directly shape the quality of what ships

• Experience with people management (development talks, hiring, 1:1s) and team production (version control, stand-ups, sprints, reviews)

• You’re ready to tell us where we’re going wrong and help us improve

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**We've always believed that games are made by teams, not solo superstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. We love people who bring curiosity, generosity, flexibility, and strong opinions, especially when those opinions come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to validate ideas properly.

We also care a lot about experimentation. Sometimes the weird idea is not the right fit. Sometimes the weird idea is the entire game! The trick is being able to explore it together, learn from it, and not get too precious when the experience tells us we're wrong.

**Practicalities

**

• We don't offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• No crunch. People over deadlines.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of coffee.

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

jobs.description:
R30528 Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus, GN

Do you want to make your financial knowledge count? Imagine a possibility where you will be responsible for financial excellence by supporting and further developing the finance function in a global organization.

The team you will be part of

As a Senior Group Financial Controller at GN, you will join Group Finance and take a central role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting.

Working closely with local finance teams, Group controllers and external auditors, you will drive the consolidation process while helping to simplify, standardise and strengthen the Group’s closing and reporting set-up.

Your contribution is appreciated and your responsibilities will include:

Consolidation, closing and Group reporting

You will own and drive the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring a robust, efficient and well-documented close.

You will:

• Lead and coordinate the Group consolidation process, from entity reporting to consolidated reporting

• Review reporting from Group entities and perform consolidation entries, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and other Group adjustments.

• Support the preparation of the consolidated financial statements

• Act as a on of the key point of contact for subsidiaries during the closing process, providing guidance on reporting and consolidation matters

• Support the transition of selected consolidation and reporting activities from external providers to an in-house Group Finance set-up

Process optimisation and reporting development

A key part of the role is to make the closing and reporting process faster, simpler and more reliable.

You will:

• Identify and drive improvements to closing, consolidation and reporting processes, including automation and standardisation opportunities

• Develop and maintain reporting packages in the consolidation system and process documentation

• Support the development and maintenance of consolidation and reporting systems and act as a key user where relevant

Financial controlling and collaboration

In close collaboration with other Group controllers, you will support the review and quality assurance of financial reporting from subsidiaries.

You will:

• Review and challenge selected financial information reported by subsidiaries

• Follow up on reporting issues, unusual developments and data-quality matters

• Contribute to the continued development of controls, governance and documentation within the Group reporting process

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

You are structured, proactive and analytical, with a strong sense of ownership and quality. You enjoy working with fixed deadlines, multiple stakeholders and continuous process improvement.

Moreover, you have a keen sense of quality, and you:

• Hold a master’s degree in finance, accounting, auditing, or a similar field

• Have several years of relevant experience from Group consolidation, financial reporting, or an international audit firm

• Have hands-on experience with consolidation processes and a good understanding of the flow from local entity reporting to Group reporting

• Have experience with financial reporting systems. Experience with systems such as OneStream, HFM or Microsoft Dynamics is an advantage

• Are comfortable working independently, driving tasks to completion and collaborating across functions and geographies

• Speak and write fluent English

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferrable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

To apply, use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 19 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.

• Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.

• Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).

• Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.

• Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.

• Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).

• Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

• Ability to communicate in English and Danish or Swedish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

**About The Job

**As the Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialists team, we work together with Field Sales Representatives (Account Managers), Customer Engineers, and our partners to help our customers modernize their operational and analytical data foundations on GCP. We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications. As a master of complex lakehouse solutions, data governance, and AI, you are the exact sales expert we need to translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes.

You will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. In this role, you will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization.

You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.

Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.860000 - kr.880000 (DKK) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.

• Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.

• Engage business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern Data & AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.

• Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.

• Whiteboard modern architectures (BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB) to demonstrate how unified data foundations power high-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our Director, BU Controlling (f/m/d) and help shape the financial performance and strategic direction of a global business. This role offers flexibility to be based at a Danfoss Power Solutions location within the European time zone, enabling close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our global organization.

Partnering closely with the VP of the Valves & Pumps (VPS) Business Unit, you will drive transparency across performance, profitability, and risk, turning financial complexity into actionable insights that support confident decision-making and **profitable growth.

**You will also help build and develop a high-performing global controlling community, strengthening financial capabilities across the organization while supporting business performance through coaching, governance, and matrix leadership.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive business performance through financial analysis, forecasting, and strategic planning that enables better decisions and profitable growth

• Challenge business and plant leaders with data-driven insights, helping identify opportunities, improve profitability, and mitigate risks

• Coach and develop controllers across a global matrix organization, strengthening capabilities and fostering a high-performing controlling community

• Provide clear visibility into financial performance, ensuring accurate reporting and transparency across key business metrics

• Strengthen financial governance, controls, and continuous improvement initiatives that support operational excellence and long-term value creation

**What We're Looking For

**

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline

• Proven track record of driving business performance through controlling, finance business partnering, or finance leadership within a manufacturing, industrial, or engineering environment

• Strong expertise in financial planning, forecasting, profitability analysis, performance management, and risk management

• Proven ability to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders while building trusted relationships across a global matrix organization

• Experience coaching and developing finance professionals, strengthening capabilities, and driving results through influence and collaboration

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you join a purpose-driven company committed to driving sustainable transformation and long-term growth. In this role, you will work closely with senior leaders and influence decisions that shape the direction and performance of a global business.

You will be part of a highly skilled, international finance community, with opportunities to influence senior stakeholders, contribute to global initiatives, and strengthen both people and organizational capabilities.

**Furthermore

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited about combining financial leadership with real business impact, we'd love to hear from you. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your perspective, experience, and ambition could be exactly what we're looking for.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Senior Business Consultant, Change Management

**Join NNIT as a Senior Business Consultant in Change Management

**Transformations succeed when people are ready, equipped and motivated to adopt new ways of working. As a Senior Business Consultant in NNIT’s working group for Change & Communication Consulting, you will help clients turn transformation ambitions into sustainable business outcomes.

Change & Communication Consulting is situated within the Life Science Project Consulting (LSPC) department. We deliver standalone and complementary services to project management, supporting clients across the people side of technology, process and organizational transformation.

You’ll join a professional, collaborative department that values quality and customer focus, while also making time for team socials, and casual get-togethers.

Location: This role will be based in Copenhagen, Denmark and will require onsite/office-based presence at customer sites as well as NNIT.

****The Role:

****As a Senior Business Consultant, you will lead change management workstreams in complex transformation programs. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape change strategies, and ensure that affected employees are prepared to adopt and sustain new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

You connect change plans to business benefit realization - ensuring adoption translates into measurable business outcomes, not just completed activities.

You will work closely with project managers, client teams, and colleagues across NNIT. Depending on the engagement, you may lead the change management track, provide strategic advisory support or contribute your expertise to a broader program.

Depending on the experience you bring, the successful candidate will be offered a position as Advanced, Senior, Principal or Managing Consultant.

****Your Responsibilities:

• Develop, implement and lead change strategies, plans, and activities in complex transformation programs.

• Assess organizational readiness, stakeholder needs and project health

• Build and coach sponsor coalitions to ensure visible, active leadership of the change

• Plan and coordinate communication, training and engagement activities

• Define and track adoption and readiness metrics

• Identify risks, resistance and adoption barriers, and develop practical responses

• Facilitate workshops with teams, functions and stakeholders across cultures.

• Translate transformation objectives into clear messages and actionable change activities

• Support the development of proposals, Request for Proposals, Statements of Work, client presentations, use cases, and thought leadership.

• Mentor and support consulting talent of tomorrow in junior-senior setups

• Contribute to the continued development of change and communication methods, tools and services.

Our approach is anchored in the Prosci® framework, while remaining adaptable to each client’s context, objectives, and needs.

****Your Qualifications:

****We are looking for an experienced profile who combines strong change management expertise with sound business understanding and the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in delivering complex change management projects within the Life Science sector. You may have worked as a Change Manager, Transformation Consultant, Senior Consultant, Project Manager, or in a similar role.

**We Expect That You Will Have:

**

• Several years of experience with change management methods, tools, and processes

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• The ability to translate complex changes into clear actions and messages

• Experience with communication planning, training, and adoption activities

• Experience integrating change plans with a project's delivery methodology (agile, hybrid or waterfall) so change activities land at the right time

• Experience with advisory, presales, proposals, or commercial support

• Strong facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders

• Confidence working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams

• Excellent English skills, both written and spoken

**It Is a Distinct Advantage If You:

**

• Have experience working in or for regulated industries such as life science or finance.

• Understand digital transformation in Regulatory, Safety, Clinical, or related life science areas.

• Are a Prosci® Certified Change Practitioner.

• Have experience from consultancy or customer-facing roles

• Are curious about human behavior, learning, culture and group dynamics.

• Are a well-liked colleague.

****Your Personal Profile:

****You are motivated by helping people and organizations succeed with change. You create clarity, build trust, and help stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to move forward.

You are proactive, structured, and able to balance strategic direction with practical execution. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and take responsibility for delivering results together with your team and customers.

****Why Join NNIT:

****At NNIT, you will join a company with strong roots in IT services, digital transformation, and regulated industries. We help customers develop, implement, and manage business critical solutions with high demands for quality, security, and reliability.

**We Offer:

**

• A professional and collaborative working environment

• Opportunities to work on meaningful projects for leading customers

• Skilled colleagues with strong business and technology expertise

• Room to grow your career and develop your consulting and change management capabilities

• A culture built on responsibility, respect, and delivering quality

****About NNIT:

****NNIT is a leading provider of IT services and consulting. We deliver solutions that support digital transformation and business critical processes for customers in Denmark and internationally. Our work is guided by a strong commitment to quality, trust, and long-term customer relationships.

**Apply now

**If you are ready to help organizations succeed with change, we look forward to hearing from you.

Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment system. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

****About NNIT

****NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are. We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request candidates to refrain from including their pictures in their applications.

Learn more about working at NNIT

Apply now and liberate your talent!

**Use your skills to revolutionize HR with Team Spirit and Innovation at NTT DATA

**Are you ready to be a part of a team that is reshaping the world of HR, making a real impact for our clients? As our new Employee Central consultant, you will get to combine leadership, technical expertise and business understanding with your genuine mentor mentality.

**A Close-Knit team – and a One-Stop-Shop for Pioneering HR Solutions

**We would like to invite you into a collaborative and inclusive environment where each member is a vital part of our success. Our culture is laid-back yet professional, with room for a good laugh and a shared commitment to excellence. This can be felt all the way to our clients, who often talk about the enjoyable and effective partnerships they have with us.

“We’re proud of being a comprehensive solution for all things HR – from SuccessFactors and support to strategic HR advisory. And as part of the larger NTT DATA Business Solutions network, we can leverage cutting-edge AI technology, ensuring our clients receive the most advanced and efficient solutions available,” says Danny Haschke, SuccessFactors Consultant.

**Innovative Employee Central Implementation with ready2run®

**As a Senior Employee Central Consultant, you will lead large, international and complex implementations, taking ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design through deployment. ready2run® builds on our preconfigured starting solution, proven delivery framework and the way we shape implementation projects and customer offerings.

**Specifically, You Will

**

• Translate business needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Help customers benefit from our ready2run® approach – both as a methodology and a mindset.

• Play an important part in strengthening our collective capability by sharing knowledge, supporting collaboration across projects and helping junior consultants grow their confidence and expertise.

**Combine your strong technical expertise with your business understanding

**In this role, you will need a proactive focus on quality, detail and delivery, using your critical thinking skills and experience in resolving complex technical and functional issues in a timely and effective manner. Also, you possess a genuine desire to guide, challenge and develop colleagues, review work and share practical knowledge – and you can do so constructively in international teams. Moreover, with your strong communication skills, you engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and build trusted relationships with colleagues and clients alike.

Finally, we know nobody is perfect, but we imagine that you may:

• Have several years of hands-on experience configuring and implementing SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central.

• Have proven experience leading large, international and complex implementations, with ownership of the Employee Central workstream from design to deployment.

• Possess strong Employee Central solution knowledge, combined with the ability to analyze HR processes and translate business priorities into practical, scalable design.

• Be open to travelling and working on diverse projects, adapting to new challenges and environments.

• Be fluent in English (this is required), with additional Scandinavian languages being a plus.

• The role can be based in any Nordic country, with the expectation that you are within practical daily commuting distance of one of our local offices.

**Will you give us the opportunity to let you shine?

**Applicants are assessed continuously, so do not wait! Apply now and take the first step towards a fulfilling career with us at NTT DATA Business Solutions. We are excited to welcome you and see what we can achieve together.

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe our strength lies in our diversity.
