About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The brain

The agents are the arms. The next layer is a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers: conversations on chat, email, phone and social, on-site behaviour, orders, returns and reviews.

The system identifies the moments where a sale is won or lost and intervenes while the session is still live. It scores answer coverage per product and closes the gaps, quantifies objections and unmet demand, and traces returns back to the expectation that broke.

Learning happens across all webshops, more than six million visits a month, where patterns become visible that no single shop has the traffic to see. Every intervention is measured against a control group. The patterns are shared, the data stays with each shop.

The hard problems are retrieval and evaluation of LLM output at scale, data isolation when patterns are shared across customers, latency in real-time flows, and attribution that holds up under scrutiny.

The stack

Java with Spring Boot, React and MongoDB, with language models and vector search on top. Moving the backend to C# and .NET is under consideration.

The role

You are one of the first engineers on the brain and own parts of it from idea to production: data model, retrieval, evaluation and the real-time flows that intervene in the session. You write the code yourself, ship it and follow it when it meets real customers.

The work is not split into tickets in advance. You help decide what gets built, and how, and your choices become the foundation the next engineers build on.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You come in while the brain is taking shape. There is no finished architecture to follow, and the choices you make now are the ones everyone after you builds on.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

Profile

• 
Experience building and running SaaS systems in production

• 
Solid backend experience in Java or C#, and comfortable in React

• 
Has built LLM-based features and knows how to measure whether they work

• 
Owns what they build, also when it breaks in production

• 
AI-assisted development as part of the daily workflow

The person

• 
Dreams of owning and building a company

• 
Ideally has tried starting something and knows what it takes

• 
Thinks like a founder, not an employee

• 
Happily gives more than a regular job asks for, because it is fun

• 
Says things as they are, and can take the same in return

• 
Takes ownership and looks for solutions rather than excuses

• 
Curious, learns fast and has a positive mindset

What we offer

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Equity

• 
Short decision paths and a high degree of technical freedom

• 
Office at Storms Pakhus in Odense

Application process

We take the time it takes to find the right match.

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. jobs.description:
A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years. The starting date is 01 February 2027 or later by agreement and depending on the candidate’s preferences.

We are seeking a researcher with documented experience in epidemiological research who can independently plan studies, conduct analyses and write scientific papers. We are looking for a future colleague with a clear academic interest in women’s mental health and the motivation to develop their research in this field. Experience in psychiatric epidemiology is a distinct advantage.

The project

The position is funded by a grant from the Wellcome Trust through PROMIS, an international research project on women’s mental health during perimenopause. The project is in its initial phase and will draw on cohort data linked to national registers, in collaboration with researchers in the UK, the USA and Sweden.

The project investigates risk factors for the onset or recurrence of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and psychotic disorders during perimenopause. The work includes epidemiological studies of risk, the development and validation of prediction models, and studies of hormone therapy and mental health outcomes using target trial emulation.

Research tasks

The postdoc will work closely with Principal Investigator Professor Trine Munk-Olsen and the project’s data analyst and participate actively in the international research collaboration. The candidate will have considerable scope to shape research questions, the structure of individual studies, study designs and methodological choices within the framework of the project.

The main tasks are to:

• 
Plan and conduct epidemiological studies using register and cohort data, including preparing study protocols and analysis plans.

• 
Independently perform statistical analyses, interpret results and write scientific papers.

• 
Identify risk factors for mental disorders during perimenopause and contribute to the development and validation of prediction models.

• 
Contribute to studies using target trial emulation to investigate hormone therapy and mental health outcomes.

• 
Together with other project team members, contribute to applications for access to external datasets and to the maintenance, quality assurance, harmonisation and documentation of the datasets used.

• 
Participate in subprojects and undertake tasks within the international collaboration, including coordination, organising project meetings and following up on joint agreements.

The position will involve limited travel. It is primarily research-oriented. Teaching and supervision duties may be included, depending also on the candidate’s interests and preferences.

Expectations of qualifications

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree in epidemiology, health sciences, biostatistics or data science with a strong focus on health. Candidates who have not yet completed their Ph.D. may apply if they expect to obtain the degree by the starting date. However, we envisage that, in addition to their Ph.D., the candidate will have at least 1–2 years of research-related experience, for example as a postdoc, research assistant or statistician.

The applicant must have the following qualifications:

• 
A clear academic interest in research on women’s mental health, including the relationships between reproductive life stages and mental disorders.

• 
First authorship of several scientific papers, including documented experience in epidemiological research based on register or cohort data.

• 
Documented experience with advanced epidemiological and statistical methods.

• 
Documented experience and competence in statistical programming, for example in R or Stata.

• 
A documented ability to independently plan studies, prepare study protocols, conduct analyses and write scientific papers.

• 
Good collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility for tasks and contribute constructively to joint research projects.

• 
The ability to work systematically with data quality, documentation and the maintenance of research data.

• 
Fluency in written and spoken English.

The following would be an advantage but are not requirements:

• 
Experience in psychiatric epidemiology.

• 
Experience in the development or validation of prediction models.

• 
Practical experience with target trial emulation.

• 
Experience in international research collaborations.

• 
Written and spoken Danish, as Danish is the working language of the research unit.

Research environment

The position is based in the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, a growing, dynamic and collaborative research environment at the Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark. Our research group brings together expertise in psychiatry, psychology, epidemiology and public health. We offer a friendly, inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment where early-career researchers are supported in developing their academic and professional skills. The unit leads several major research projects focusing on perinatal mental health, child and adolescent psychiatry, and early intervention and prevention.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Salary and terms of employment

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Theoretical Metamaterial Acoustofluidics - DTU Physics
jobs.description:
A 3-year PhD scholarship, starting 1 January 2027 is available in the Department of Physics (DTU Physics) in the field of theoretical metamaterial acoustofluidics supervised by Professor Henrik Bruus, www.staff.dtu.dk/bruus. 

We study the fundamental physics of fluids embedded in elastic solids particularly in the form of metamaterials and actuated by ultrasound through electromechanical transducers. We develop physical models and perform high-fidelity numerical simulations of selected systems often in international collaborations with various experimental groups. The PhD scholarship is part of the theoretical acoustofluidics project "High-performance, metamaterial-based acoustofluidc devices" funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark (DFF-FTP). The main research topics are microscale acoustofluidics, elastodynamics, electromechanical actuation, suppression of viscous dissipation by synchronous fluid-wall motion, acoustic resonances in microdevices, acoustic forces on suspended particles and solutions, and acoustic streaming.

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will be responsible for 

• developing physical models of acoustofluidic devices with metamaterial walls 
• implementing and performing weak-form FEM simulations of metamaterial acoustofluidic devices
• designing, and numerically testing, optimal metamaterial-based devices for high-performance acoustofluidic nanoparticle handling
We expect that you

• create and critically validate acoustofluidics models relevant for your research project, 
• deliver theoretical and modeling results of high quality,
• participate in team work with independent and original theory/modeling contributions,
• collaborate effectively with experimentalists among the international collaborators, 
• are excited to teach and to learn from other group members,
• communicate your insights and results effectively both orally and in writing,
• work with an outstanding drive and enthusiasm.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Mass Spectrometry and Proteomics Technology Development
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a two-year postdoctoral position in mass spectrometry and proteomics technology development at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG), Aarhus University, Denmark.

The position is available in the Nielsen Laboratory, which focuses on developing advanced mass spectrometry-based technologies to understand regulatory protein states, post-translational modifications (PTMs), and cellular signalling.

We are seeking an ambitious and technically skilled researcher with demonstrated experience in developing, establishing, or optimizing mass spectrometry-based proteomics methodologies. Candidates should have a strong background in at least one area of proteomics technology development, including LC-MS/MS method development, chromatographic optimization, sample preparation, PTM analysis, or related analytical technologies.

The position offers an exciting opportunity to pursue innovative technology development while taking an active role in building and shaping a growing research group at Aarhus University.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is a two-year postdoctoral appointment with the possibility of extension.
The expected start date is 15 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Job description
The successful candidate will join a growing research programme focused on developing advanced mass spectrometry-based proteomics technologies and applying these to fundamental questions in molecular and cellular biology.

Our research integrates state-of-the-art mass spectrometry, quantitative proteomics, analytical method development, peptide and protein chemistry, and PTM biology to investigate how regulatory protein states control cellular function.

A central objective of the position is to develop innovative analytical methodologies that expand the capabilities, sensitivity, robustness, and throughput of modern proteomics. Potential research directions include advanced LC-MS/MS acquisition strategies, quantitative PTM proteomics, chromatographic optimization, automated sample preparation, and novel approaches for studying protein regulation.

The position provides considerable scientific freedom to develop and pursue new technological ideas, with opportunities to establish independent research directions and translate methodological innovations into high-impact scientific publications.

As an early member of a newly established research group at Aarhus University, the successful candidate will also have a unique opportunity to actively contribute to the development of the laboratory's scientific activities, technological capabilities, and future research directions.

Primary responsibilities

• Develop, establish, and optimize innovative mass spectrometry-based proteomics methodologies.
• Design and independently drive research projects with a strong emphasis on analytical innovation and technological advancement.
• Explore and implement new approaches to improve proteomics sensitivity, quantitative accuracy, reproducibility, and analytical throughput.
• Develop and apply advanced proteomics technologies to investigate PTMs and regulatory protein states.
• Contribute to establishing new experimental workflows and analytical capabilities within the laboratory.
• Collaborate with national and international research partners across proteomics, analytical chemistry, and molecular biology.
• Communicate research findings through publications in leading international scientific journals and presentations at scientific conferences.
• Contribute to the scientific development and continued expansion of the research group, including mentoring junior researchers and developing new collaborative projects.
Your profile
Applicants must hold a PhD in proteomics, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, biotechnology, or a closely related discipline.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have demonstrated the ability to develop, establish, or substantially improve experimental and analytical methodologies, rather than solely applying established proteomics workflows.

Applicants must demonstrate significant hands-on experience and scientific contributions in at least one of the following areas:

• Mass spectrometry method development: Establishment or optimization of advanced LC-MS/MS acquisition methodologies, including data-independent acquisition (DIA), fragmentation strategies, instrument parameter optimization, or related approaches for improving analytical performance on modern mass spectrometry platforms.
• Liquid chromatography and separation technologies: Development and optimization of chromatographic methodologies for proteomics, including LC gradient design, peptide separation, nanoLC or microflow LC, improved peak capacity, or approaches to enhance sensitivity, robustness, and throughput.
• Proteomics sample preparation and workflow development: Development or substantial optimization of protein and peptide sample preparation methodologies, including automated or high-throughput workflows, digestion strategies, sample clean-up, enrichment techniques, or quantitative proteomics applications.
• Post-translational modification proteomics: Development and optimization of methodologies for PTM enrichment, characterization, or quantitative analysis, including phosphorylation, ADP-ribosylation, ubiquitination, or other regulatory protein modifications.
• Peptide and protein chemistry: Development of innovative approaches involving peptide or protein chemistry, chemical modification, affinity enrichment, selective capture, or related analytical strategies relevant to mass spectrometry-based proteomics.
• Innovative proteomics technologies: Development of other advanced analytical approaches, such as low-input or single-cell proteomics, alternative fragmentation techniques, novel sample processing technologies, or integrated analytical workflows.
Expertise in one of these areas is sufficient. Applicants are not expected to possess experience across all the listed technologies. We particularly welcome researchers with a strong technical specialization who are motivated to expand their expertise into complementary areas of proteomics technology development.

Demonstrated scientific achievements
A central selection criterion will be the applicant's demonstrated contribution to methodological development and technological innovation.

Applicants are expected to document relevant expertise through at least one first-author research publication in which they have made a substantial contribution to the development, establishment, or optimization of an analytical method or experimental technology.

In their application, candidates should identify the publication(s) most relevant to this requirement and briefly describe their personal contributions, the technological challenge addressed, and the methodological advances achieved.

Additional qualifications
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not required:

• Proteomics data processing, bioinformatics, quantitative data analysis, or systems biology.
• Advanced computational analysis of LC-MS/MS data, including DIA data processing and statistical evaluation.
• Mammalian cell culture, including experimental perturbations and cellular model systems.
• Handling and processing of biological tissues, clinical samples, or other complex biological materials.
• Development or implementation of laboratory automation and high-throughput experimental workflows.
• Protein biochemistry, molecular biology, or functional studies of protein regulation.
• Programming, scripting, or computational workflow development, including R or Python.
• Experience working across interdisciplinary projects involving analytical technology development and biological applications.
 
Personal qualifications
We are looking for a researcher who:

• Is scientifically ambitious, highly motivated, and driven by developing innovative solutions to challenging analytical problems.
• Demonstrates creativity, initiative, and a strong ability to translate scientific ideas into experimental advances.
• Takes ownership of research projects and has the determination to drive them from initial concept to publication.
• Enjoys solving technical challenges and continuously improving experimental methodologies.
• Thrives in a dynamic research environment where new ideas, technologies, and scientific directions are actively developed.
• Works independently while contributing positively to a collaborative and supportive research environment.
• Has strong scientific communication skills and an interest in developing an independent research profile.

Who we are
The position will be based in the Nielsen Laboratory at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG), Aarhus University.

Our research focuses on understanding how dynamic post-translational modification networks regulate protein function and cellular behaviour. We develop and apply innovative mass spectrometry-based technologies to characterize regulatory protein states and uncover fundamental mechanisms controlling cellular function in health and disease.

The laboratory builds on more than 15 years of internationally recognized research in regulatory proteomics, ADP-ribosylation biology, and mass spectrometry-based technology development.

We are currently establishing and expanding our research activities at Aarhus University, combining technological innovation with fundamental biological discovery.

Joining the laboratory at this stage provides a particularly attractive opportunity for a motivated researcher to help build a research environment, influence its technological development, establish new analytical capabilities, and contribute to defining future research priorities.

The group benefits from strong international scientific connections and an interdisciplinary research environment spanning molecular biology, genome stability, structural biology, enzymology, and advanced proteomics.

MBG provides an outstanding interdisciplinary research environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure and a strong commitment to scientific excellence.

More information:
https://mbg.au.dk

What we offer 
We offer:

• A unique opportunity to take an active role in establishing and shaping a growing proteomics research group at Aarhus University.
• Considerable scientific freedom to develop innovative technologies and pursue independent research ideas.
• Access to advanced mass spectrometry and proteomics research infrastructure.
• Opportunities to pioneer analytical workflows and establish technological capabilities with broad scientific applications.
• A research environment where technological innovation, scientific ambition, and independent initiative are strongly encouraged.
• Strong opportunities for high-impact scientific publications, international collaborations, and conference participation.
• Support for career development, scientific networking, and applications for independent research funding.
• Close interaction with national and international researchers working at the forefront of proteomics, PTM biology, and molecular biology.
• A collaborative and supportive environment that values scientific creativity, technical excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Place of work and area of employment 
Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Aarhus University, Universitetsbyen 81, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Contact information
For further information, please contact:

Professor Michael L. Nielsen

Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics

Aarhus University

Email: mln@mbg.au.dk

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 23 November 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

The position is a fixed-term full-time position for 2 years with the possibility of extension.

The Department of Biomedicine prioritises diversity and a good work environment, as this is a prerequisite for groundbreaking research. In a diverse and international research environment, dedicated employees are looking to generate new knowledge within biomedical research areas such as infection and inflammation, membranes, neuroscience and personalised medicine. The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. Academic staff contribute to the teaching. English is the preferred language in the laboratory, at meetings and at seminars. The department employs approx. 500 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory-, core- and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation, entrepreneurship and collaboration with business and industry, and numerous researchers from the department have established companies to develop new medicinal treatments founded in professional scientific basic research. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

About the research project
The project will investigate the mechanisms by which emotional imbalance regulates transcriptional programs and structural connectivity in disease-relevant brain regions in rodents. A drug candidate will be evaluated using these experimental paradigms and behavioral phenotyping.

Your job responsibilities
As Postdoc in translational psychiatry your position is primarily research-based but may also involve teaching assignments. You will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. In your daily work, you will work closely with colleagues on your project, where you will receive supervision and guidance.

Your main tasks will consist of:

• Independent research of high international quality, including publication.
• Conduct spatial and cell-specific molecular profiling using approaches such as RNAscope multiplex, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.
• Investigate, design, conduct, and analyze behavioral experiments in rodent models of depression, stress susceptibility, and resilience.
• Characterization of neuronal network structure by whole brain imaging
• You will work closely with the project leaders and collaborators in molecular neuroscience, neuropharmacology, and preclinical imaging.
You will report to Professor Anders Nykjaer, Director of PROMEMO, Dept. of Biomedicine.

Your competences 
You have a PhD in neuroscience and experience in experimental neuropharmacology or a closely related field. The candidate must have completed his/her graduate education abroad. Solid experience with confocal and light-sheet microscopy, spatial transcriptomics, and the analysis of complex molecular or cellular datasets is required. The successful candidate is also expected to have experience conducting behavioural experiments using rodent models of depression, stress susceptibility, or resilience.

As a person, you have good interpersonal skills, are inclusive and team-oriented and able to contribute to a good work environment. We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English.

The base salary includes a position related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Application

Who we are
The Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering at Aarhus University is a growing engineering environment with a clear vision for the future of the built environment.

Established in 2021, the department today includes more than 100 researchers and educators and around 1.050 students. The construction sector is facing major challenges related to climate, resource consumption, and the way we design and build our cities and buildings.

Through research, education, and collaboration with industry and public-sector partners, we contribute to developing technological solutions that support a more sustainable built environment.

Our research and development activities are closely connected to the needs of industry and society, and many projects are carried out in collaboration with companies, public authorities, and other research environments. This ensures that the knowledge and technologies developed at the department are relevant in practice and create value beyond the university.

Education is a central part of the department’s identity. We offer Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD programmes in engineering and continuously work to improve the connection between research, teaching, and practice.

Across our programmes, students work with real-world challenges, current technologies, and sustainable solutions for the construction sector.

The department provides well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories, and access to shared technical facilities. jobs.occupation: Process specialist in Nanofabrication to the Niels Bohr Institute
jobs.employer_name: KU- SCIENCE - CHEM og MATH og NBI-HCØ
jobs.description:
The NBI Cleanroom facility at the Niels Bohr Institute seeks an innovative candidate for a time-limited, part-time (8 hours per week) technical position as Process specialist in Nanofabrication.

The NBI Cleanroom is a research infrastructure providing nanofabrication, processing and characterization facilities to the research groups of NBI. With a focus on quantum electronics and quantum photonics, the research and innovation is mainly driven by The Center for Quantum Devices (Q-Dev) www.qdev.dk, Center for Hybrid Quantum Networks (Hy-Q) www.hy-q.nbi.ku.dk, and The Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme (NQCP) https://nqcp.ku.dk, involving coordinated activity in materials growth, processing, characterization, and nanoscale fabrication. The cleanroom also accommodates external commercial user groups.

The position
The candidate will join the department’s existing team of lab technicians and engineers. The tasks within the position are among others to develop processes in close collaboration with researchers and students allowing the fabrication of novel nanostructures for basic and applied research in electronics and other nanodevice applications. This will require the integration of multiple tools and methods, as well as the development of new nanofabrication methods. 

The candidate is expected to contribute within the following areas:

• 
Supervise and train researchers, postdocs and students and other technical staff in using research equipment.

• 
Developing state of the art processes within areas such as Electron Beam Lithography, UV-Lithography, Physical Vapor Deposition, Molecular Beam Epitaxy and Atomic Layer Deposition.

• 
Manage technical collaborations with research teams for the development of the nanofabrication facility.

• 
Maintain and trouble-shoot research equipment in collaboration with technical staff and run regular calibration procedures on the tools.

• 
Share responsibilities for tools and processes and purchases with other members of the technical staff.

Profile
We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic candidate with the following competencies and experience:

• 
Candidates should have a MSc or PhD degree in Electrical engineering or Physics or an equivalent relevant degree.

• 
An in-depth understanding of laboratory safety, and experience with hazardous tools and materials associated with nanofabrication facilities is required.

• 
Thorough knowledge about nanofabrication procedures with emphasis on electron beam lithography preferably using Elionix and Raith tools and skills necessary to design the entire fabrication process.

• 
Experience with device and materials characterization/imaging tools such as scanning probe and scanning/transmission electron microscopy.

• 
Have knowledge about a broad spectrum of nanofabrication methods, semiconductor physics, electronics, physics, mechanical and electrical engineering.

• 
Have cleanroom experience.

Terms of salary and employment
The position is part-time (8 hours per week) and is fixed for a 2-year term. The position is scheduled to start 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.
Employment will be as academic employee or special consultant, and the salary is based on seniority. Employment will be under The Circular on the Collective Agreement concerning Academics in the state sector concluded between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

Application
If you are interested in the position, please submit your electronic application, including attachments, via the UCPH Job Portal (click the “APPLY NOW” link at the bottom of the job posting).

• 
Letter of application addressing the requirements (max. one page).

• 
Current curriculum Vitae

• 
Letters of reference

• 
A certified/signed copy of certificate(s) of education

 Deadline for applications is 4 November 2026

The University wishes to reflect the diversity of the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

Further Information 
Questions regarding the position may be directed to Cleanroom Lab Manager Martin Saurbrey Bjergfelt, mail: martin.bjergfelt@nbi.ku.dk, phone +45 23 81 08 93.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager of Construction Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead impactful construction projects that shape the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing - while fostering a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment? Then we hope to hear from you.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

As the Senior Manager of Construction Management, you will contribute to keep strengthening our competencies, deliver high-quality results and to the strategy for the Construction Management function. You will also collaborate across departments to ensure alignment with broader business objectives.

Your leadership style should be passionate about creating a culture where people thrive, and you understand that high performance is built on trust, engagement, and a shared purpose – building on the foundation of NNE leadership principles. This is a unique opportunity to lead our organisation into effective operations, high compliance standards and a strong business focus.

How you might spend your days

As Senior Manager of Construction Management, you’ll:

• Lead and develop a high-performing construction management, while developing team capabilities and well-being

• Ensure successful project execution through effective site mobilisation and risk management

• Establish and continuously improve systems for construction management, including planning, resourcing, and budgeting.

• Build and manage effective client relationships on site, ensuring stakeholder alignment and project success.

• Ensure compliance with project plans, NNE’s quality standards, and execution model.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Translate high-level goals into actionable plans and guide your team through ambiguity with clarity and confidence.

• Ability to mentor and coach team members across experience levels.

• Understand industry challenges, make informed decisions and take ownership of results.

• Embrace innovation and continuous learning, especially in digital tools.

• Contribute with a thoughtful and purpose-driven work style, and model the values and standards expected across the organization.

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Degree in engineering or a related technical field (M.Sc. or B.Sc.)

• Experience in construction and site management (typically 8-10 years)

• Experience establishing and developing systems within this field (including construction and commissioning planning, systems for managing temporary work and installations, etc.)

• Familiarity with 4D/5D tools and digital construction management.

• Commitment to safety and experience in safety-critical environments.

• Proficiency in English.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. Can you keep a website fresh, turn ideas into engaging social content, and build workflows that make content production more efficient?

Patiro is looking for a part-time Content and Creative Specialist to manage and develop our content across our website, social media, press releases, and external profiles. You will help us communicate clearly, maintain a consistent brand, and reach the right audiences.

Your responsibilities

**SENIOR CONSULTANT - AI/ML

******Join Our Team at Devote Consulting

****Are you an experienced AI/ML professional with a passion for applying emerging technologies to solve complex business challenges within Life Sciences? Do you enjoy working closely with clients, building relationships, and turning innovative ideas into practical solutions?

Devote Consulting is expanding its team and is looking for Senior Consultants with expertise in AI/ML and generative AI (genAI) implementation in regulated life sciences environments.

****Are We Looking for You?

• You thrive in the dynamic world of consulting and enjoy leading innovation in emerging technologies

• You combine strong technical AI/ML expertise with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• You take ownership of your work, driving high-quality outcomes that create business value while ensuring compliance

• You have experience delivering AI-driven solutions and improving processes within Life Sciences

• You enjoy translating complex technologies into practical solutions and helping clients navigate change

• You’ll excel in our high-achieving culture, with ample opportunities for both personal and professional growth

****What You’ll Do

****As a Senior Consultant at Devote Consulting, your key responsibilities will include:

• AI/ML implementation: Lead and support the implementation of generative AI use cases in life sciences and drive AI-driven transformation in R&D, clinical operations, and regulatory affairs

• Business process optimization: (Re)design and enhance workflows by integrating AI-driven solutions, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability in regulated environments

• Client collaboration and stakeholder management: Work closely with clients to understand their needs, provide expert advice, and translate business requirements into practical AI solutions

• Driving project success: Ensure progress across AI initiatives, maintaining high-quality standards, managing risk-based validation, and ensuring readiness for ongoing advancements in generative AI technologies

• Validation and compliance: Support risk-based validation of AI/ML solutions and ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and compliance documentation

• Project delivery: Take ownership of project activities and deliverables, managing stakeholders and ensuring successful implementation of AI initiatives

**Your Qualifications

**We’re looking for individuals with the following qualifications:

• A master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Data Science, Life Sciences, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in AI/ML development, implementation, or platform engineering, including hands-on experience with generative AI or large language models (LLMs)

• Professional experience within Life Sciences (Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech), with an understanding of regulatory requirements

• Experience with software validation, GxP compliance, or related documentation in regulated environments

• Strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, with experience in client-facing roles and the ability to translate complex technical solutions into business value

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in English and a genuine interest in working closely with clients

• Experience with Clinical R&D systems (e.g., CTMS, eTMF, EDC, QMS, or LIMS) is an advantage

****What We Offer

****At Devote Consulting, you'll have the opportunity to take responsibility, lead initiatives, and help shape the future of AI within Life Sciences.

You'll work directly with clients on projects where you can combine your technical expertise with consulting, business process improvement, and stakeholder management. Depending on the project, you may take on responsibilities as a specialist, business analyst, or project manager.

You'll become part of a collaborative, high-achieving consulting environment where professional development, knowledge sharing, and personal growth are highly valued.

****Ready to Join Us?

****We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to a recruitment process that ensures equal opportunities for all applicants. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply today!

Working closely with Finance teams, Procurement, Support functions, and Business Units, you will identify cost-optimizing opportunities and implement best practices that strengthen our financial foundation.

All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. 🚀

🤩 **About the role

**We are looking for an AI Engineer to build the AI layer of All Gravy: agents that plan shifts, answer manager questions, and take real actions across 2,000+ hospitality and retail locations in the Nordics and UK.

This is a build role, not a research role. You will ship agents that customers use in production, then own how well they work. We are looking for someone who has already built and shipped AI agents and who is relentlessly curious about what just became possible. The field moves faster than any roadmap, so part of the job is noticing the new capability before anyone asks you to, testing it, and telling us whether it changes what we should build.

🎯 **What you will do

**

• Build agent harnesses. Design and ship agents that call internal and external tools to solve real customer problems, both interactively with users and autonomously in the background.

• Own the eval loop. Build the harnesses, datasets, and offline and online evals that tell us whether an agent got better or worse. You define what "working" means and you defend the number.

• Ship full stack. Take features end to end, from the manager and employee interfaces where schedules are built and shifts are picked up, through the backend services and data layers that power them.

• Run it in production. Own latency, cost, failure modes, and guardrails for the agents you ship. When one misbehaves at 6am on a Saturday, you are the person who understands why.

• Investigate what is new. Try the new models, frameworks, and techniques as they land, build small things to find out where they actually hold up, and bring back a clear read on what we should adopt and what we should ignore.

• Work across teams. Partner with product and the other engineering teams so AI features fit the wider All Gravy ecosystem, and contribute to shared standards and architectural decisions.

✅ **What we are looking for

**

• You have built agents that shipped to real users, not just demos. You can talk through what broke, what you changed, and what you would do differently.

• Genuine curiosity, evidenced by things you built. You have side projects, throwaway experiments, or strong opinions formed by actually running the thing rather than reading about it.

• Strong context and prompt engineering, including retrieval, tool design, and structured outputs. You know why an agent fails and it is usually not the model.

• Solid production engineering in TypeScript and Node.js, or the ability to get there fast from another typed language.

• Comfort reading and writing code, reviewing architecture, and working directly with infrastructure. You ship the fix rather than filing the ticket.

• Judgment about when an agent is the right answer and when a well placed SQL query or a boring deterministic rule is better.

🙌 **You'll thrive here if you

**We're looking for people with great energy, a good sense of humour, and a drive for getting things over the line. You think elegantly but act pragmatically, love being part of a team, and never stop learning

• 5+ years of proven full-stack experience across React, React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js.

• Ability to design and architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems.

• Startup or scale-up background. You know what it means to move fast, make pragmatic calls, and revisit them when the time is right.

• Fluent English, spoken and written.

• Based within European time zones, whether from our Copenhagen or London office or remotely.

An advantage if you have experience in:

• Vercel AI SDK

• Mastra or similar Agent framework

💎 **Why All Gravy

**

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• Top equipment. You'll receive all new equipment to do your best work

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

• The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

💡 Even if you do not tick every box on this page, you might be the perfect fit for the job! We treasure our learning culture and encourage all humble people to apply.

**Shape the Future of Privacy

**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Office of AI

**

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

**About the role

**

You are the hands-on technical arm of AI adoption at Usercentrics. Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and every other department have real AI use cases, and your job is to turn them into governed, working software, not slide decks.

You will prototype and build department AI applications, run technical enablement sessions directly with the teams who will use them, and make sure everything you ship meets our governance standards before it goes live. You work from the use-case pipeline the AI Enablement Lead runs, and you report progress and adoption back into it.

This is not a support role bolted onto engineering. You are a full engineer, building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, and the internal AI platform, and you are expected to leave every pattern you build reusable by the next team. What you build feeds the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub. As that platform grows into its next layer, LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, you will contribute to that build alongside the rest of the Office of AI team, not just consume it.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be one of two engineers doing this work day to day, with a Staff AI Enablement Engineer setting the technical bar above you.

**Requirements

****What you will do

**

• Prototype, build, and hand over department AI applications, working directly with the business team that will own the outcome

• Run technical enablement sessions with non-engineering teams: walk them through what was built, how to use it, and how to ask for the next thing well

• Guide teams on tech stack choices, MCP servers, AI artefacts (Skills, Connectors, plugins), and integration patterns for AI in a business context

• Ensure every implementation you ship meets GRC standards before it reaches a business user

• Document reusable patterns and components and contribute them back into the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub

• Contribute to the platform's next layer as it gets built: LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks

• Partner with the AI Enablement Lead on the use-case pipeline: help qualify requests, scope builds realistically, and report back on adoption

**What you bring

**

• 5+ years in software engineering, with a full-stack or solutions engineering background

• Genuinely hands-on with AI. You have built and shipped things with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar), not just prototyped them

• Strong communication with non-technical stakeholders. You can run a session with a Legal or Finance team and leave them able to use what you built, not just impressed by it

• Working knowledge of MCP servers, AI agent tooling, or integration patterns for AI in a business context

• Security- and governance-conscious engineering practice. You do not need to be told twice that this ships to a regulated business

**Nice to have

**

• Experience in consulting, solutions architecture, or embedded engineering

• Familiarity with the internal stack: Azure or GCP, and Usercentrics' own product platforms

• Exposure to model serving, RAG pipelines, or MLOps

• Background in AI governance or responsible AI deployment

**Benefits

****Why join Usercentrics?

**

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story

• together

• Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• Get involved. We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all departments enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• Your work-life balance is important to us too. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos Aires and New York

Some of our benefits

• Development budget for every employee: €800 per year

• Job-related language courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish, etc.): €350 per year

• Hybrid working policy with the option to take a workcation (up to 60 days per year)

• Online yoga sessions

• Events: team buildings, happy hours, parties/get-togethers, and occasional company-covered breakfasts or lunches (in-office, across offices, online, and in person)

• Gifts: we celebrate life and work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new baby arrivals, and similar occasions)

• Snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office

ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre. They show what we believe in and how we work. They help make our team special and guide us in everything we do. They're the heart of our company and inspire us to do our best every day.

We strive to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment (DEI) where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that our different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are our greatest strengths — so we are committed to building with them as we foster innovation and drive our success.

We recognize that this is an ongoing journey. We commit to listening and to continuous learning, growth, and improvement. By embracing DEI principles, we will create a more just and equitable society, and we are proud to play our part in making this vision a reality.

We are #BetterTogether.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our High-Performance Development team in Denmark in a role focused on Improving and maintaining our power plant control software solution that is deployed to SGRE wind farms all over the world.

Your day may start with investigating a support case, perform remote troubleshooting and conduct detailed event analysis of power plant operations to identify and resolve software or configuration issues.

Afterwards you would resume to your regular software development task in the agile development team, with daily scrums and develop high-quality code including unit- and automated integration tests to ensure correct behavior.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop/maintain. C# .NET based platform that supports real-time control

• Design and develop data services that serve, process and store large data amounts within wind farms.

• Relentless focus on cyber solutions.

• Develop configuration validation, monitoring and tooling

• Clarify and mature requirements

• Contribute to planning

What You Bring

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, preferably combined with relevant professional engineering experience.

• C# and automated testing.  Experience with CI/CD practices, agile development methodologies, C++ and Python language experience is appreciated as well.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, cybersecurity principles, and secure system integration, including areas such as PKI certificates, authentication mechanisms, secure communication interfaces, or IEC 62443-based environments.

About the Team

You will join the Development team in Denmark, where Software Developer/Engineers collaborate to constantly improve wind farm control and power plant solutions.

Knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and open collaboration are an integral part of the team's way of working. While the role offers a high degree of ownership and independent responsibility, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who work together to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver trusted measurement solutions.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

jobs.occupation: Head of People Insights, HR Technology & Rewards
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by connecting people, data, technology and business? Can you turn complex workforce topics into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders? And do you combine strategic perspective with the structure and drive required to make things happen in practice?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our new Head of People Insights, HR Technology & Rewards, you will lead and develop three closely connected areas: maturing People Insights, driving the HR Technology agenda, including Oracle HCM and the global technology roadmap, and providing governance and executive decision support within Rewards in close collaboration with our Rewards Partner.

Leading a small specialist team, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution, personally driving key initiatives, analyses and decision support while working with senior leaders across the business to turn data, technology and governance into clear recommendations and business impact.

More specifically, you will be:

• Building and maturing our People Insights capability through workforce KPIs, executive dashboards and forward-looking insights that support better workforce and organisational decision-making.

• Owning the HR technology landscape and roadmap, acting as senior P&C business owner for Oracle HCM and ensuring systems, data and global processes deliver business value and a strong user experience.

• Leading governance of the global rewards agenda, ensuring effective annual processes, clear decision support and strong collaboration across the business.

• Establishing robust people data and portfolio governance, ensuring clear ownership, data quality, privacy, compliance and effective prioritisation of initiatives, risks and resources.

• Combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a small team, setting direction while driving delivery and results.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad and evolving agenda, where you can help strengthen the way data, technology and rewards support both leaders and business decisions across Kamstrup.

**Meet your future team

**Reporting directly to the CHRO and being part of the P&C Leadership Team, you will lead a newly established team of three specialists responsible for Global Rewards, Reporting & Master Data and People Systems.

The team plays a crucial role in delivering trusted people data, supporting global reward processes, driving HR systems development and enabling workforce insights across the organization. Together, you will create a stronger governance foundation while continuously improving how People & Culture supports leaders and business performance.

**Less About Us, More About You

**You may come from People Insights, HR Technology, Workforce Strategy, Rewards or HR Transformation. More important than deep expertise across all areas is your ability to lead across disciplines, create structure and turn data, technology and rewards into better business decisions. You likely bring strong experience in People Insights or HR Technology, alongside sufficient rewards and governance expertise to lead the agenda credibly with support from specialists.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Bring experience from a global organisation, ideally within People Insights, HR Technology, Workforce Strategy or HR Transformation.

• Have strong analytical capabilities, including workforce metrics, data visualisation and translating insights into business recommendations.

• Have experience with enterprise HR platforms and transformations, preferably Oracle HCM or a similar cloud-based HCM solution.

• Understand rewards governance, compensation cycles and executive decision processes, enabling effective leadership of the agenda alongside specialists.

• Communicate confidently with senior leaders and provide clear decision support in English.

Success in the role will be reflected in stronger people insights, successful Oracle adoption, improved data quality and rewards processes, and a clear HR technology roadmap, with People & Culture recognised as a trusted, data-driven partner in strategic workforce decision-making.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Vice President - Chief People & Culture Officer, Sofie Mørch Ravn, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Do you want to lead project excellence across some of the largest and most complex infrastructure projects in Denmark? Are you an experienced project leader with a commercial mindset? Can you inspire and develop experienced project managers while improving project and portfolio performance? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

To further strengthen our project leadership and support the development of Transportation in Denmark, we are looking for a Vice President, Head of Projects. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of approximately 15 experienced multidisciplinary project managers, while taking direct responsibility for selected strategic projects. You will also have portfolio responsibility for medium-sized and smaller projects led by project managers across the organisation. You will report to the Senior Vice President, Transportation, in Denmark.

You will play a central role in connecting project delivery, portfolio performance, and strategic priorities. The portfolio comprises approximately 350 projects, from large multidisciplinary projects to smaller single-discipline assignments across key transportation disciplines. As a member of the Transportation leadership team, you will contribute to the strategic and operational development of the business.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and develop a team of multidisciplinary project managers, ensuring clear priorities and high-quality delivery across the portfolio.

• Act as project manager on selected strategic projects, with responsibility for scope, schedule, risk, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.

• Oversee and develop a portfolio of approximately 350 projects, ensuring governance, resource allocation, risk management, financial control, and profitable delivery.

• Improve commercial performance by identifying risks and opportunities early, leading contract and client negotiations, and balancing quality, customer value, and profitability.

• Advance project management excellence across Transportation by developing ways of working and promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across projects and disciplines.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is your ability to combine strong project management expertise with commercial understanding, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You thrive in complex environments where collaboration, cross-team coordination, and professional credibility are essential. You are committed to developing project managers, strengthening project delivery, and creating long-term value for our customers.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in civil engineering or other relevant education.

• Extensive project management experience from large multidisciplinary infrastructure projects in Denmark.

• A commercial mindset and solid understanding of portfolio performance, contracts, negotiations, risk, client relations, and financial results.

• Experience developing project management competences and ways of working across teams or portfolios.

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Work location

The position is based in Lyngby or Aarhus, Denmark, with regular travel across our offices.

Want to know more?

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Pricing Manager, you will develop and execute data-driven pricing strategies across our Flat-Station and Underfloor Heating portfolios, helping maximize gross margin while strengthening our competitive position in the market.

You will make a difference by balancing daily pricing operations with pricing strategy and tool optimization in a project-driven growth business, always taking a customer-focused and holistic view of the business.

Through your work, you'll help drive sustainable market share growth across global customer segments and regional markets while ensuring pricing decisions create value for customers and support profitable growth.

As part of the Portfolio Management team, you'll contribute to driving sustainable commercial success and product excellence across our climate and heating solutions portfolio. Together, we enable customers to improve energy performance, reduce carbon emissions, and create lasting value through innovative and efficient heating applications. You'll join a collaborative, data-driven, and commercially focused team that values open dialogue, continuous learning, constructive feedback, and pragmatic problem-solving.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**In this role, you'll combine strategic pricing leadership with hands-on commercial support to strengthen profitability, improve pricing governance, and enable data-driven decision-making across the business.

**You Will

**

• Lead global and regional pricing strategies, including value-based pricing, discount structures, rebate frameworks, and annual list-price reviews

• Partner with Sales, Portfolio Management, Finance, and Commercial Operations to evaluate tenders, pricing opportunities, and commercial terms

• Analyze transaction data, market trends, competitor activity, input costs, and currency movements to recommend pricing actions that protect and grow margins

• Drive continuous improvement of pricing processes, governance, and digital tools such as Vendavo and SAP to increase efficiency and transparency

• Develop and maintain pricing models, dashboards, KPI scorecards, and reporting that support commercial decision-making

• Success in this role means delivering measurable gross margin expansion, improving price realization, strengthening pricing compliance, and reducing margin leakage across the Flat-Station and Underfloor Heating portfolios

**What We're Looking For

**We're looking for someone who combines commercial acumen, analytical strength, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a global organization.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Proven track record in strategic pricing, commercial finance, revenue management, or similar commercial roles within a B2B industrial or manufacturing environment

• Demonstrated success leading pricing initiatives that improved profitability, price realization, or overall commercial performance

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and present insights to senior leaders

• Advanced analytical capabilities and proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau

• Experience working with pricing, ERP, or commercial systems to support pricing governance and business decision-making

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Experience working with pricing platforms such as Vendavo and ERP systems such as SAP

• Experience operating within a global or matrix organization

• Knowledge of heating, climate, building solutions, or related industrial markets

**What You'll Get From Us

**In this role, you'll have the opportunity to influence commercial strategy across global markets while supporting innovative heating solutions that improve energy efficiency and help reduce carbon emissions. You'll work closely with experienced colleagues across Sales, Portfolio Management, Finance, and Commercial Operations, gaining broad business exposure and the opportunity to shape how pricing creates value for both customers and Danfoss.

You'll be supported by knowledgeable and experienced colleagues who will help you build a strong understanding of the role, our business, and our customers, ensuring you have the foundation to succeed and grow.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

 Department of Mathematical Sciences
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  The position is in the history and philosophy of mathematics, with particular emphasis on teaching the history of mathematics within the university’s mathematics programs. The position is primarily associated with teaching, developing, and coordinating courses in the history of mathematics at the undergraduate and graduate levels.

  Applicants must have documented research qualifications within the history of mathematics. Emphasis will be placed on scholarly contributions that combine historical scholarship with a strong understanding of mathematics and its development.

  Applicants are required to have university-level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies, and the ability to explain and reflect on their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training program for assistant professors is required.

  Particular emphasis will be placed on extensive experience teaching the history of mathematics at the university level, including integrating historical perspectives into core mathematics curricula. Experience in developing and coordinating courses in the history of mathematics for students with a mathematical background will be considered an essential qualification.
