About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Principal Scientist, Analytical Development, you'll use your extensive experience in the analysis of synthetic therapeutics, including peptides and oligonucleotides, to serve as the analytical lead supporting our synthetics programs from first-in-human through commercial readiness.

You will support both early- and late-stage development, including phase-appropriate method validations and Quality Control activities, setting and justifying specifications, process and product characterization, and preparation of CMC regulatory submissions, including NDAs and MAAs. You will drive analytical strategies and manage analytical activities across multiple CROs and CDMOs, helping to ensure smooth progression from clinical manufacturing to commercial readiness.

What you'll do

• Own analytical strategy for synthetics programs, particularly peptides and oligonucleotides, from first-in-human through commercial readiness.

• Establish phase-appropriate analytical approaches, including setting and justifying specifications, product characterization, impurity marker synthesis and qualification, reference standards, stability protocols, comparability assessments and risk assessments.

• Provide technical input to CDMOs on method development and validation (especially for purity methods), as well as product characterization.

• Manage analytical method transfer, optimization and validation with external partners, including in support of commercial readiness.

• If appropriate, ensure an appropriate mechanism of action-based potency assay is in place to support Phase 3 readiness.

• Provide analytical expertise on CMC sub-teams, working closely with Drug Substance, Drug Product, Research, Quality and Regulatory colleagues.

• Provide analytical support for process characterization, including determination of Critical Quality Attributes and appropriate validation of methods for testing In-Process Controls.

• Lead and manage analytical CROs/CDMOs, material suppliers, consultants, vendors and collaborators; monitor regulatory trends, integrate new analytical approaches, identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs, and advise colleagues on data interpretation.

• Author and review analytical sections of regulatory submissions, from first-in-human through NDAs and MAAs, and represent Hemab as an analytical expert in regulatory interactions when needed.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Proven industry experience setting analytical strategy for synthetic therapeutics, particularly peptides and oligonucleotides, with substantial exposure to late-stage development through commercialization.

• Strong working knowledge of phase-appropriate analytical method development and validations, setting and justifying specifications, product characterization, impurity marker synthesis and qualification, comparability assessments and regulatory submissions, especially NDAs/MAAs supporting late-stage synthetic programs.

• Significant experience managing CROs/CDMOs, including navigating technical problems where an external partner needs hands-on guidance.

• Strong understanding of ICH expectations for stability and method validation, together with experience producing analytical content for regulatory submissions.

• Flexibility, a proactive approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced biotech environment spanning multiple time zones.

• A relevant scientific degree, with a PhD preferred, and the technical depth to operate as an independent analytical expert.

Nice to have

• Experience with mechanism of action-based potency assays.

• Experience establishing reference standards.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. You will likely build some of your own tools and processes instead of inheriting finished products. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This position spans early- and late-stage development and works across multiple internal teams, CROs, CDMOs, suppliers, consultants, vendors and collaborators. Hemab operates across multiple time zones.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

We are seeking an early-career RF Engineer to contribute to the design, development and validation of RF communication subsystems for nanosatellite missions.

In this role, you will support RF analysis and integration activities across UHF, VHF, S-band and X-band systems, perform link-budget analyses and help validate performance through hardware-in-the-loop and over-the-air testing.

You will join our Satellite Systems Hardware team in Aalborg and collaborate closely with colleagues across RF, Hardware, and Systems Engineering. You will work with GomSpace’s flight-proven NanoCom radios and SDR platform and gain practical experience across simulation, laboratory testing and system-level integration. Depending on the mission, you may contribute to conventional communication subsystems, software-defined radio applications or advanced RF sensing payloads.

Your Role

As RF Engineer, you will support the development and validation of RF subsystems for satellite missions, from link-budget analysis and RF-chain modelling through integration, hardware-in-the-loop testing and over-the-air validation.

Working with experienced engineers, you will gradually build the knowledge and practical experience needed to take responsibility for increasingly complex RF engineering tasks.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Support RF subsystem analysis and technical trade-offs across frequency bands, performance and mission constraints.

• Perform link-budget analysis and RF-chain modelling.

• Contribute to the definition and documentation of RF subsystem requirements and interfaces.

• Support the integration, verification and validation of RF subsystems, including hardware-in-the-loop and over-the-air testing.

• Assist with the evaluation and selection of RF front-end components across UHF, VHF, S-band and X-band.

• Prepare and carry out laboratory measurements using RF test equipment.

• Analyse test results and contribute to troubleshooting RF performance issues.

• Contribute to onboard signal-processing and data-reduction activities for RF applications.

• Document analyses, test activities and technical conclusions clearly and systematically.

• Provide technical input to mission proposals with support from experienced colleagues.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace’s NanoCom product portfolio and SDR architecture.

• Building effective working relationships with colleagues across RF, Hardware and Systems Engineering.

• Completing a link-budget analysis for an active mission with guidance from experienced colleagues.

• Performing your first hardware-in-the-loop or over-the-air RF test using GomSpace equipment.

• Documenting your analysis and test results in a clear and structured way.

• Communicating RF results and technical observations clearly to colleagues from other disciplines.

Over time, you will take increasing responsibility for RF subsystem analysis, integration and verification activities. You will contribute independently to mission proposals and projects while helping develop reusable RF models, test methods and engineering tools.

What You Bring

You are a recent graduate or early-career RF engineer who is motivated to apply your technical knowledge to real satellite systems. You enjoy combining analytical work with practical laboratory activities and want to develop your skills within an experienced multidisciplinary team.

You likely bring:

• An MSc in Electrical Engineering, RF or Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field.

• Up to one year of relevant experience in RF engineering, communication systems, testing or integration.

• A basic understanding of RF engineering principles and communication systems.

• Experience with RF analysis, simulation or laboratory measurements gained through your studies, thesis, student employment, internship or first professional role.

• Familiarity with RF simulation or engineering tools such as CST, ADS, HFSS, MATLAB, Python or similar.

• Some experience with RF test equipment, such as spectrum analysers, vector network analysers or signal generators.

• An interest in satellite communication systems, software-defined radio or digital signal processing.

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Good written and spoken English.

Experience from the space or aerospace industry is an advantage but is not required. Relevant academic projects, thesis work, internships and student positions will also be considered.

Knowledge of modulation schemes, communication protocols, RF payloads, ECSS standards or space-grade RF qualification would be beneficial.

Who You Are

You are curious, systematic and motivated by the opportunity to turn engineering analysis into working hardware. You enjoy learning from experienced colleagues while also taking responsibility for your own tasks and development.

You are known for:

• Technical curiosity – eager to understand how RF systems perform in practice.

• Attention to detail – careful when analysing results, conducting tests and documenting conclusions.

• Hands-on problem solving – interested in moving between simulation tools and the laboratory bench.

• Collaborative communication – comfortable working with RF, systems, payload and hardware engineers.

• Structured execution – able to plan your work, follow up on tasks and communicate when support is needed.

• Customer focus – understanding that good engineering contributes directly to the success of our customers’ missions.

• Willingness to grow – open to feedback and motivated to build deeper RF subsystem expertise.

Why Join Us

You will have the opportunity to begin or develop your RF engineering career by working on communication systems for real nanosatellite missions.

The position offers hands-on experience across RF analysis, laboratory testing and system-level integration. You will work with flight-proven NanoCom radios and SDR platforms while learning from experienced specialists across RF, Hardware, and Systems Engineering.

Your work will contribute to mission proposals, subsystem development and technologies that ultimately fly in space. As your experience develops, you will take on increasing technical responsibility and have the opportunity to shape the tools and methods used by the team.

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis.

If you have any questions regarding the position, do not hesitate to contact Kelly Antonini, Systems Engineering and Hardware Manager: klan@gomspace.com.

The primary workplace will be at our premises in Aalborg, Denmark. The position involves laboratory, integration and test activities and therefore requires regular on-site presence. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Team Leader to lead the Research Support team at the SDU eScience Center. The team plays a central role in helping researchers, research groups, and institutions across Denmark leverage advanced computing, cloud, AI, and data services to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

As Senior Team Leader, you will combine scientific insight, technical understanding, and leadership skills to guide a highly skilled team of research support specialists. Working closely with researchers across all disciplines, you will help shape how next-generation digital infrastructure is adopted and utilized within Danish research.

The position offers a unique opportunity to influence both the strategic development of national research services and the day-to-day support provided to tens of thousands of researchers using the center's infrastructure and platforms.

We are looking for a collaborative and forward-looking team leader who is passionate about enabling excellent research through advanced digital technologies. The ideal candidate combines scientific and technical credibility with strong leadership skills and enjoys working at the intersection of research, technology, and service development.

Key responsibilities

• 
Lead and develop the Research Support team, including strategic planning, prioritization, and staff development as part of the management group for the eScience center.

• 
Ensure high-quality support and consultancy services for researchers and customers from the public and private sector using the center's computing, cloud, AI, and data platforms.

• 
Build strong relationships with researchers, departments, external customers, and research infrastructures across SDU and nationally.

• 
Identify emerging research and customers’ needs and contribute to the development of new services, tools, and support initiatives.

• 
Collaborate with the center's technical teams to ensure that infrastructure and services align with user requirements and scientific developments.

Required qualifications

• 
Relevant university degree at Master's level or higher in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, data science, computational science, or a related discipline.

• 
Demonstrated leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, projects, or complex research initiatives.

• 
Strong understanding of computational research, scientific computing, data-intensive research, AI, or digital research infrastructure.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in both Danish and English.

• 
The ability to engage effectively with researchers, technical specialists, customers from the private and public sector.

• 
Proven ability to translate scientific and customers’ needs into practical solutions and service developments.

Desired qualifications

• 
At least 3 years of experience from a university, research organization, national research infrastructure, or technology-oriented organization, including experience leading projects, teams, or research support activities. 

• 
Familiarity with high-performance computing, cloud computing, AI platforms, research data management, or research software engineering.

• 
Experience developing research support services, training activities, or scientific user communities.

• 
Knowledge of the Danish or European research infrastructure landscape.

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense.

About the SDU eScience Center

The SDU eScience Center is a national center for advanced digital research infrastructure at the University of Southern Denmark. The center develops, operates, and continuously advances large-scale computing, cloud, data, and AI services that support research across all scientific disciplines.

Through close collaborations with Danish universities, public institutions, and international partners, the center helps researchers access the computational resources and digital platforms needed to address some of society's most complex scientific and technological challenges.

jobs.occupation: Tenure track Assistant professor/Associate professor Position in Materials Science and Engineering
jobs.description:
Aarhus University, Denmark

The Department of Mechanical and Production Engineering at Aarhus University invites applications for two positions at the rank of:

•   Tenure Track Assistant Professor, or

•   Associate Professor

The positions are offered within the broad field of Materials Engineering and Manufacturing, with a particular focus on participating in the department’s research and education in materials engineering, durability, emerging and advanced materials, advanced manufacturing and surface engineering. The department seeks candidates who will help shape a modern materials science profile, in research as well as in teaching, and who have demonstrated relevant experience in the field.

Expected start date

July 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible.

Research Areas

We welcome applicants with a solid background in materials science and engineering, mechanical engineering, materials-focused chemical engineering, applied physics, or closely related disciplines.

We particularly encourage applications within, but not limited to, the following research themes:

Additive and hybrid manufacturing

Including metal additive manufacturing, laser-based processing and welding, joining of metallic and dissimilar materials, post-processing, surface engineering, and process characterisation and modelling.

Materials durability and advanced materials

Including materials under demanding and extreme conditions, 4D printing, bioprinting, and biofabrication, surface modification, lubrication technologies and functional surfaces.

Applicants are expected to contribute to both fundamental understanding and applied solutions, with relevance to engineering systems and industrial applications

Research and Teaching Responsibilities

The selected candidates will:

•   Teach, contribute to, and develop courses in materials science and engineering, additive manufacturing, and manufacturing processes at different levels, from foundational bachelor’s courses to specialized master’s and PhD courses

•   Contribute directly to the further development of the materials and manufacturing science curriculum at different program levels

•   Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students

•   Attract external research funding

•   Engage in knowledge exchange with industry and research partners

•   Participate in departmental and university service activities

Your Profile

We are looking for candidates who can contribute to research, education, and innovation at an international level.

To meet expectations in this role, we expect the candidate to fulfill the following requirements:

-   A PhD in materials science and engineering, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field

-   Substantial experience conducting high-quality research in materials science and engineering, with publications in leading international journals that match career stage

-   Experience in at least one of the research areas listed above, along with familiarity with experimental, computational, or theoretical research methods

-   Interest in interdisciplinary collaboration across engineering disciplines and with industry

-   For the positions as associate professor, the applicants should, in addition, have:

-   Documented teaching experience and a clear commitment to teaching and advancing materials science courses, from introductory undergraduate instruction through master’s and PhD-level study

-   For associate professor applicants: a documented record of self-directed research leadership, external funding acquisition, supervision of PhD students, and teaching and course development at university level

Who we are

The engineering field in Aarhus University is evolving with a rapid growth in student population, major research initiatives as well as through the establishment of a number of new physical facilities in the city center of Aarhus. We have comprehensive plans for increased activities in research and education, as well as public and industrial cooperation. The  Department of Mechanical and Production Engineering  within the Faculty of Technical Sciences has cooperation with universities and advisory service providers in more than 20 countries. The engineering field at Aarhus University is well established with extensive research activities, over 700 mechanical engineering students and a long tradition of industrial cooperation that we wish to extend significantly.

What we offer

The department offers:

-   research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment

-   an exciting interdisciplinary environment with many national, international and industrial collaborators

-   a research climate encouraging lively, open and critical discussion within and across different fields of research

-   a work environment with close working relationships, networking and social activities

-   a workplace characterized by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance

Place of work and area of employment

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Mechanical and Production Engineering, Katrinebjergvej 89, DK-8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.

Contact information

For more information about the position contact Head of Section of Manufacturing and Mechatronics, Professor Ramin Aghababaei (ra@mpe.au.dk / +45 9350 8956)

or Head of Section of Mechanics and Materials, Professor Michal Kazimierz Budzik (mibu@mpe.au.dk, +45 4189 3217)

Deadline

Applications must be received no later than December 8th, 2026.

Technical Sciences Tenure Track

Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:

• attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level

• to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists

• to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:

• access to research infrastructure

• capability development, including postgraduate teacher training

• a mentoring programme

• support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

To build on this strong foundation, we are looking for a Senior Director, Global Service Sales to lead our international Service Sales organisation across Denmark, Spain, the USA and China.

In this role, you will have overall responsibility for driving profitable growth across the Service business. You will set the commercial direction, strengthen key customer relationships and further develop our sales capabilities, while ensuring strong execution across pricing, pipeline management and business development.

Reporting to the VP Service, you will be a key member of the Service leadership team and play an important role in shaping the future direction and continued growth of the business.

Purpose of position:

We are looking for a commercially driven leader who combines strategic thinking with strong execution and people leadership.

You know how to set a clear direction and turn commercial ambitions into results. At the same time, you stay close to customers, markets and your organisation, giving you a strong understanding of where the opportunities are and what it takes to capture them.

As a leader, you create clarity, accountability and momentum. You build strong teams, empower people to take ownership and bring the organisation with you as the business continues to grow.

Responsibilities

As Senior Director, Global Service Sales, you will have overall responsibility for driving the commercial development and performance of our global Service business. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Service business, driving sustainable and profitable growth across markets

• Identify and develop new business opportunities while strengthening KK’s aftermarket and Service offering

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and strategic stakeholders

• Strengthen pricing discipline, commercial decision-making and account management across regions

• Build a strong sales pipeline and improve forecasting, commercial planning and performance follow-up

• Translate market developments, customer needs and competitive insights into concrete commercial opportunities

• Lead, develop and motivate an international sales organisation across Denmark, Spain, the USA and China

• Build a strong performance culture with clear accountability, customer focus and commercial excellence

• Develop commercial capabilities and future leaders while ensuring the organisation is equipped for continued growth

• Work closely with Service Operations, Engineering, Project Management and other functions to ensure strong commercial execution

• Drive collaboration and knowledge sharing across regions and act as a visible and trusted member of the Service leadership team.

Our Requirements

We are looking for a commercially driven leader with a strong track record of delivering growth through people, customer relationships and business development.

You will likely bring:

• Significant experience in senior commercial or sales leadership roles, ideally from Service, Aftermarket or other similar recurring revenue businesses. Experience within the wind industry is advantageous.

• Responsibility for delivering profitable growth in an international business

• Experience leading teams across multiple countries and cultures

• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking

• A proven ability to build customer relationships at senior levels

• Experience operating successfully in a matrix organisation

• A structured and data-driven approach to sales management

GUBI is a modern design company offering a wide variety of luxury furniture, lighting, and interior objects for both residential and commercial settings. With a strong global presence, GUBI’s headquarters and showroom are located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About the position

As a Forward Deployed Engineer in GUBI’s Tech & AI team, you will embed in one department at a time to solve valuable business problems. You will write production code, connect AI to live business data, and refine systems with the people using them. Based in our beautiful Copenhagen office and showroom, you will have a company-wide mandate, established AI foundations, direct access to leadership, and short decision cycles.

Key responsibilities

• Build agents, tools, and integrations that connect LLMs to live business data (ERP, helpdesk, product, and stock data) so people get answers and can take action within their daily workflows.

• Turn vague requests into a concrete problem, a measurable outcome, and a first working version, fast.

• Work side by side with a department until you understand how the work gets done, where it slows down, and what would make a difference.

• Write production code, deploy it, and keep it running reliably and securely, in line with GUBI’s security policies.

• Define success with each department and measure the impact, whether that means time saved, fewer manual steps, or better service.

• Evaluate AI outputs, handle edge cases, and build appropriate monitoring and safeguards into the systems you deploy.

• Help colleagues adopt what you build through practical guidance, clear explanations, and ongoing support.

• Document your work and share reusable components and lessons across the business.

• Bring new perspectives, ideas, and ways of working into the business, helping teams turn experimentation into lasting change.

Qualifications

• You have shipped an LLM or agentic system to real users, and can show what it changed.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Personal attributes

jobs.occupation: Mid Level Backend Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description:
💰🇩🇰 up to 48,000 DKK/month gross _(varies by seniority)

_**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you'll own delivery of meaningful pieces of our financial systems and grow your expertise in the domain, helping us scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes ownership of what they build. You'll own medium-sized projects from design through to production, working independently within your team and delivering quality outcomes.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Help rebuild Monta's financial backbone. You'll contribute to the new invoicing system that every customer will use, owning meaningful slices of the new infrastructure.

• Power EU expansion. You'll build features within our compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Deliver core parts of the new invoice system. Build features within the new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows, owning your slice end-to-end and contributing to design discussions.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Build for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll write code with auditability, correctness, and scale in mind, and contribute to design discussions for new components.

• Grow with the team. Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, and help onboard new joiners as you grow into the domain.

What We’re Looking For

• Solid backend engineering experience. You've built and shipped production systems and you write clean, maintainable code. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Some exposure to financial systems is a plus. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness matters — but we'll help you grow the depth.

• A sense of ownership. You take responsibility for what you ship, follow it through to production, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.

• Comfortable asking questions and learning fast. Regulatory and financial domains have a lot of nuance — you bring curiosity and a willingness to dig in.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

**Tools We Use Daily

**

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

Would you like to lead a team of scientists and help turn scientific expertise into reliable QC delivery? Join Bavarian Nordic as Manager of the Biochemistry scientist team and support the quality of vaccines that help protect lives around the world.

**Your team and leadership environment

**Biochemistry consists of 10 laboratory technicians and nine scientists organised across two teams. In this role, you will lead the scientist team and work closely with colleagues across the area.

The area performs analytical testing of raw materials, intermediates, finished products, process development samples, stability samples and control cells for extraneous agents. Techniques include physico-chemical testing, ELISA, HPLC and hemadsorption assays. Biochemistry also performs method development, validation and comparability testing.

You will join a QC department of approximately 90 employees across six teams. Our Core Leadership Team of Senior Managers works closely with First-Line Managers, the Operational Excellence Partner and a Quality Integrator to develop people and processes and maintain strong quality oversight.

QC is undergoing significant change as we support increased production demands, improve efficiency and reduce lead times. As a first-line manager, you will translate changing priorities into clear direction while maintaining employee engagement, well-being and a strong quality mindset.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Lead and develop the scientist team. Provide clear direction, regular feedback and individual development planning. Coach your scientists, strengthen competencies and create psychological safety while holding the team accountable for high-quality results.

• Balance scientific and operational priorities. Maintain an overview of the scientists’ workload and operational risks. Align priorities across routine analytical activities, method development, validation and comparability testing, adjusting plans as QC and manufacturing needs change.

• Ensure quality and robust processes. Ensure the team’s work complies with cGMP and the Bavarian Nordic Quality Management System. Promote data integrity, accurate documentation and inspection readiness, and help maintain robust processes across the analytical sample lifecycle.

• Strengthen collaboration and improvement. Work closely with the laboratory technician team and stakeholders across QC and manufacturing. Use data and digital tools to improve coordination, address bottlenecks and support efficient analytical workflows and reduced lead times.

**Your profile

**

• You are a people-oriented leader who can support scientific specialists, create structure and maintain momentum in a changing GMP environment. You enjoy developing others and connecting scientific work with operational priorities.

• A relevant scientific degree and experience from a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment, preferably within QC biochemistry or analytical testing.

• An understanding of analytical methods and experience relevant to method development, validation or comparability testing.

• Leadership experience from QC, a laboratory or a similar area is an advantage, with the ability to coach specialists and support their professional growth.

• A solid understanding of cGMP, data integrity and Quality Management Systems, and confidence using LIMS or other digital laboratory tools.

• An ability to prioritise competing activities, communicate expectations clearly and build effective relationships across scientific and operational teams.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic

**You will lead a scientist team whose expertise supports vaccine quality and reliable manufacturing. You will have the opportunity to develop people, strengthen scientific collaboration and influence how Biochemistry delivers both routine activities and analytical improvements.

You will join a leadership team that values coaching, employee development and shared problem-solving. In a department undergoing change, you can contribute to continuous improvement and Operational Excellence while developing professionally in an international vaccine company.

**Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

**Apply by clicking the ‘APPLY’ button. We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your CV.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

**For us, it is all about improving and saving lives

**Improving and saving lives through innovative vaccines is at the heart of what we do at Bavarian Nordic. We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing and commercialisation of life-saving vaccines, and the largest pure-play vaccine company in the world.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist, Downstream, Late-Stage Process Development
jobs.description:
Join a fast-paced process development team where scientific expertise, collaboration and practical problem-solving help advance projects. As Senior Scientist, you will lead downstream development activities for mammalian cell culture processes, supporting their progression through late-stage development.

You will work closely with clients, laboratory technicians and colleagues across upstream, downstream and analytical disciplines. The role combines scientific leadership, study design, data interpretation and technical writing. Most hands-on laboratory work will be performed by technicians; you will work closely with them to develop protocols, design experiments and guide execution, ensuring studies are scientifically sound and generate decision-quality data.

**A role with scientific ownership and real project impact

**As a Senior Scientist, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of downstream development activities and contribute directly to the progression of projects. You will combine your scientific expertise with practical problem-solving and collaborate with both internal colleagues and clients.

The role gives you exposure to different projects, technologies and challenges rather than focusing on one narrow area. You will be involved in shaping studies, interpreting data and turning scientific findings into clear recommendations that support project decisions.

Your work will also give you the opportunity to collaborate closely with laboratory technicians and scientists, allowing you to stay connected to the practical side of process development while taking a leading role in the scientific direction.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead and coordinate downstream development activities for assigned projects, working with clients and cross-functional teams to align on project needs and deliver outcomes.

• Plan and evaluate downstream processes, including chromatography using ÄKTA systems and filtration operations such as depth filtration, virus filtration and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Design studies and author practical protocols in close collaboration with laboratory technicians; provide scientific guidance during experimental execution.

• Interpret study results, apply appropriate statistical approaches—including design of experiments (DoE) where relevant—and communicate findings through clear presentations and reports.

• Contribute to process characterization, including failure mode and risk assessments such as FMEA, and author process characterization (PC) work reports.

• Support investigations and deviation handling by assessing technical causes, interpreting relevant data, and documenting conclusions and follow-up actions.

• Provide scientific and technical input to business activities and support the generation of information for regulatory submissions.

**Required Qualifications And Experience

**

• Education: Master’s or PhD in Biochemistry, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, or a related discipline.

• Industrial experience: 5+ years with a Master’s degree, or 2+ years with a PhD.

• Downstream development: Demonstrated experience with mammalian cell culture processes.

• Unit operations: Chromatography and filtration; ideally ÄKTA systems and TFF systems.

• Study execution and data: Ability to plan, analyze and report complex development studies, including statistical analysis.

• Project work: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with scientific rigour and attention to detail.

• Communication: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to explain technical findings clearly to clients and colleagues.

• Language: Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience

**

• Process Characterization and FMEA

• Viral clearance studies or activities.

• Commercial manufacturing requirements and biologics regulatory frameworks, including relevant ICH guidelines and BLA submission requirements.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), including experimental design, data analysis, and evaluation using SAS JMP

• Liquid-handling automation, such as Tecan systems.

**What Will Help You Succeed

**You take ownership, bring a practical can-do attitude and are comfortable working at pace. You collaborate closely with technicians and colleagues, communicate openly, and use data and sound scientific judgement to find a way forward as project needs and priorities evolve.

**What You Can Expect From Us

**We want you to have the opportunity to use your scientific expertise while continuing to develop professionally. In this role, you can expect:

• Scientific ownership: Take responsibility for development activities and influence how studies are designed and executed.

• Variety: Work across different projects, technologies and scientific challenges rather than doing the same thing every day.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with scientists, technicians, upstream and analytical colleagues as well as clients.

• Client exposure: Develop your ability to communicate scientific findings and recommendations directly with clients and contribute to project discussions.

• Professional development: Continue developing your expertise in downstream processing, process characterization, data analysis and late-stage development.

• Impact: See how your scientific work contributes to advancing biopharmaceutical processes towards later-stage development and manufacturing.

**A team where science and collaboration go hand in hand

**You will become part of a team where scientific knowledge, practical experience and collaboration are important to how we work. We value people who share knowledge, ask questions and are willing to challenge and support each other.

You will work closely with experienced colleagues across different disciplines, giving you the opportunity to learn from others while also bringing your own expertise to the team.

We believe that good science is strengthened by open communication, different perspectives and a willingness to find solutions together.

**Ready to make your next move?

**If you are looking for a role where you can combine scientific expertise, project ownership, client interaction and practical problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through the AGC Biologics career site by **31 October 2026.

**Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system and cannot accept CVs by email.

**

• An initial screening interview with People & Culture

Applications will be reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We may close the position before the application deadline once the right candidate has been identified.

To support an objective recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your application or CV.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Department: Cloud

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're growing our engineering team and hiring several Senior Full Stack Cloud Engineers — people who can move confidently across our stack: React on the front end, Rust and Node.js on the back end, and a multi-account AWS underneath it all.

**About the role

**We're open on where your strengths sit. Some of these roles will lean more toward the back end — APIs, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure. Others will lean more toward the front end — the interfaces our customers use every day. What matters is that you're genuinely full stack: comfortable owning a feature end to end, and willing to work across the stack when the team needs it. We're not looking for anyone who only does front end or only does back end.

We’re looking for confident independent contributors that lean into ownership, are keen to shape architecture, and invest in mentoring others.

You'll fit right in if you've got a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset, a good instinct for testing and clean design, and you're just as happy explaining a technical trade-off to another engineer as to someone outside engineering.

**

What you'll do

**Building & shipping

• Operate within a Nix-backed ecosystem from development tooling to cross-compiled build artifacts

• Own features end to end — from a rough idea or user story through to a shipped, tested, monitored piece of production software

• Build and maintain frontend features in React and backend services in TypeScript on Node.js and Rust, backed by a multi-account orchestrated AWS environment (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EKS, and more, depending on the team)

• Write infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK) for the systems you build

**

Team & growth**

• Take part in code reviews—giving and receiving feedback that makes the codebase better

• Contribute to sprint planning, story breakdown, and demos

• Design systems and data pipelines from scratch, mentor other engineers, author RFCs and architecture decisions, and help set technical standards for the team

**About you

**We're looking for engineers who've seen more than one way of doing things, and who'll bring that perspective to challenge how we do things here — with a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset that can turn ambiguity into a plan.

**

The ideal background**

• At least five years experience since graduating from a relevant Masters program

• Solid, hands-on experience across the full stack — frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Rust/Node.js, or equivalent) — even if you have a natural preference for one side

• Comfort working with AWS or another major cloud provider

• A track record of shipping features independently, with a good instinct for testing, code quality, and clean design

• Good communication — you can explain a technical trade-off clearly, whether you're talking to another engineer or someone outside engineering. And you can do all this with strong English fluency.

• Experience designing systems from scratch, mentoring other engineers, or driving architecture decisions through to a decision

We welcome applicants from people eager to move to Denmark so long as you already have the legal right to live and work here. We can contribute to relocation costs for the right candidate.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

We'd love to hear from you

We are looking for a Solution Architect to drive the development and evolution of our Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations template and help shape a modern, scalable, and future-ready ERP landscape.

In this role, you will take ownership of design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our ERP template across our global organization focusing on D365F&O in our sales- and customer service area. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality, business-aligned solutions that support our sales and product initiatives. Furthermore, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, where standardization, optimization, and innovation go hand in hand with collaboration, trust, and continuous learning.

As a Solution Architect, you will bring together business needs, technical expertise, and structured processes to deliver stable, scalable, and user-focused ERP solutions. You will work closely with our colleagues in international sales and customer facing (web shop, CRM) and take ownership from ideas through implementation and support, ensuring alignment with business goals and long-term application roadmaps.

If you choose to join us, you will be working with the newest technologies, take on new challenges that will broaden your role and profile and potentially make you relevant for other opportunities within Demant IT in the long run.

Welcome to Hearing Aids IT – ERP Solutions

You will join Demant’s Hearing Aids (HA) IT organization, part of Global IT, consisting of around 265 talented professionals working together to enable innovation, reliability, and security across Demant’s global IT operations. Within this, you will be part of the ERP Solutions department, which consists of approximately 90 people (colleagues and external consultants). You will report to the Manager for ERP Design & Architecture and work closely with a team of solution architects and application architects.

Drive DFO Template Design and Development

In this role, you will take ownership of the HA Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations template withing the sales- and customer service area and ensure its continuous development, stability, and alignment with business needs and the rest of the areas. You will work closely with stakeholders, other architects, deployment teams, and support functions across regions.

By joining us, you will step into a key role where your expertise will directly impact our global ERP landscape. In this role, you will:

• Create and review functional design specifications within your area of responsibility, ready for development and/or technical specification

• Own HA Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Template changes from design to successful acceptance testing within the sales- and customer service area

• Lead template maintenance initiatives, including design and prioritization

• Work closely with other Solution Architects from Global IT to ensure solution alignment across the IT landscape within our sales domain

• Collaborate with deployment and support teams to define resource needs for testing and training in our sites

• Proactively inform management about risks, challenges, and concerns related to new functionality deployments

• Identify opportunities for improvement and lead initiatives from ideas to implementation

• Act as 3rd-level support within your area of responsibility

• Work with our product teams on Hearing Aid product launches to understand requirements for our systems, ensuring proper design and testing of changes with their products.

• Support key decisionmakers in defining and implementing optimal solutions across the Demant Group

• Contribute to application roadmaps and support execution by identifying risks, required competencies, and inputs to project plans

You can expect approximately 20 days of travel per year, visiting our site in Somerset (USA) and other sites.

What You Bring

You hold relevant education within IT, business, or a related field – or bring equivalent practical experience.

You bring 3–4 years of experience as a Solution Architect working with Microsoft ERP solutions, particularly Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, within a larger enterprise environment.

In addition, you bring a combination of business and technical insight within the sales area, along with a business mindset and the ability to translate requirements into scalable, effective solutions. You are a problem-solver who can navigate complexity, and you possess good facilitation, discovery, analysis, and prototyping skills.

Hopefully, you also have experience or familiarity with the Unified pricing module and Microsoft technologies such as Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), Azure DevOps, AI tools (Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, or similar).

Come and join us

We value collaboration, openness, and accountability, and we believe results are created through trust, inclusion, and continuous learning.

Send your CV before October 31st, 2026. We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact Manager for ERP Design & Architecture, Marcus Nötzel at marn@demant.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Recruitment Process Information:

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible. Selected candidates will be invited to first-round interviews throughout October, followed by second-round interviews in November.

_At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

DevOps Engineer

Are you interested in software development, automation, and the engineering systems behind advanced embedded products? Would you like to improve the daily work of hundreds of developers while contributing to products that help millions of people with hearing loss?

Then you may have found your next opportunity at Demant.

Join Team Continuous in R&D

Team Continuous is a software development team within Device Software R&D. We create the CI/CD platform, developer tooling, and specialized infrastructure used to build, test, and release software for Demant’s hearing care products.

We work directly with engineers developing firmware, embedded software, algorithms, and applications. Our solutions connect source code, build systems, test environments, hardware, and release processes into dependable development workflows.

The team develops software and automation across a broad technical landscape. We also manage Windows and Linux virtual machines across multiple locations, along with some of the specialized physical infrastructure used for building and testing our products. This infrastructure is a core part of our development platform, rather than traditional corporate IT.

We share ownership across the team. Everyone contributes to both the quality of today’s platform and the decisions about how it should evolve.

Build today’s platform and shape what comes next

Your primary responsibility will be to develop and improve the systems that make our development organization productive and our deliveries reliable.

You will:

• 
Develop CI/CD pipelines for firmware, embedded software, algorithms, and applications

• 
Build software and automation for pipeline orchestration, artifact handling, and developer self-service

• 
Create reproducible Windows and Linux build environments using infrastructure as code

• 
Develop integrations between TeamCity, Gerrit, GitLab, Artifactory, VMware, and other systems

• 
Investigate complex and intermittent problems across code, pipelines, build agents, operating systems, networks, USB devices, and physical test environments using evidence-based troubleshooting.

• 
Improve the reliability, observability, maintainability, and security of our development platform

• 
Work with development teams to identify friction and turn recurring problems into sustainable solutions

• 
Help shape our technical direction through experimentation, proof of concepts, and incremental modernization

An important part of our work is enabling other R&D teams. We create common capabilities and sensible standards while giving developers the tools to handle more of their workflows independently.

The role offers considerable technical variety. One task may involve improving a Kotlin-based pipeline definition, another debugging a Python service, and the next investigating a build agent or hardware-connected test environment.

About you

You have a background in software engineering, computer science, or equivalent practical experience with some years of professional experience. You enjoy working across code, operating systems, infrastructure, and hardware-connected environments.

You also care about whether our solutions work well from the developers’ perspective. You use monitoring, metrics, dashboards, and statistics to understand reliability and performance and to verify that improvements have the intended effect.

You take ownership, balance immediate needs with long-term improvements, and communicate well in English across teams and locations.

You do not need to know our entire technology stack. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, technical curiosity, and sound judgement. Experience with some of the following would be an advantage:

• 
TeamCity, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or another CI/CD platform

• 
Pipeline configuration as code, particularly TeamCity Kotlin DSL

• 
Ansible, Packer, VMware, or other infrastructure automation

• 
Linux and Windows development environments

• 
Docker and containerized services

• 
Git, Gerrit, GitLab, Artifactory, REST APIs, and event-driven integrations

We prefer a candidate eager to learn across the stack than someone who matches every item on the list.

Why join us

At Demant, we value curiosity, collaboration, and technical excellence. You will work in an international, high-trust environment with strong opportunities for growth, while contributing to solutions that improve people’s everyday lives**.**

How to apply

If you have questions, feel free to contact Senior manager Allan Cohn Malmros, aohl@demant.com

Please submit your application via the application system no later October 31st, 2026. Applications are reviewed continuously and final interviews are planned for 16th and 17th November 2026.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. jobs.occupation: Graduate - Technology Risk | Autumn 2027 (Aarhus and Copenhagen)
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

What if we didn’t focus on who you are now, but who you could become?

Are you ready to shape the future? Join us at EY as a Graduate in Technology Risk, starting August 2027. We focus on your potential and provide a supportive environment to enhance your professional and personal skills.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Graduate in Technology Risk, you will join our Assurance team and work closely with IT managers, CFOs, CTOs, and CISOs across industries. Our team consists of 35 colleagues with diverse educational and cultural backgrounds.

We are looking for analytical and structured individuals with an interest in IT audits, information security, risk management, and IT strategy. Your work will include:

• 
IT audits and risk assessments: Interview stakeholders, understand business and IT processes, test controls, analyse documentation and data, and contribute to reports and recommendations.

• 
IT General Controls and IT Environment Audits: Evaluate IT controls and identify risks related to financial reporting, compliance, and governance frameworks such as ISO 27001 and COBIT.

• 
Service Provider and Technical Platform Audits: Assess controls across service providers, operating systems, databases, and networks.

• 
Data Protection and Security: Support clients with GDPR compliance, information security assessments, and security maturity evaluations.

• 
Technical Platform Audits: Conduct technical reviews of operating systems, databases, and networks, linking technical aspects to business processes.

• 
Emerging Risk Areas: Work with topics such as AI, cybersecurity, cloud governance, DORA, NIS2, ESG, and third-party risk management.

We offer a range of experiences to help you grow in a personalized manner, fostering a culture of global teamwork. You will be surrounded by dedicated colleagues in an inclusive environment, with opportunities for social events to strengthen team cohesion.

Our internal coaching and training programs will equip you with the skills needed to remain relevant in the future, while you build a network of colleagues and mentors at EY.

To learn more about our various teams within Assurance, please visit our career page.

What we look for

• 
You have a growth-focused mindset. We value how you absorb information, learn and take action just as much as the skills you have gained through education and experience.

• 
You are curious and purpose-driven. You see opportunities rather than obstacles and ask insightful questions that help build a better working world.

• 
You are inclusive. You are actively seeking and valuing diverse perspectives, appreciating differences, and collaborating to create a foundation of safety and trust.

• 
Qualifications:

• 

• You completed your studies in 2026 or are set to graduate in 2027.

• 

• You speak and write English fluently.

• 

• You hold, or expect to complete before joining, a relevant master’s degree within IT, information security, auditing, finance, data science, cybersecurity or a related field. You speak and write both Danish and English fluently, enabling you to communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.

What’s in it for you

• 
An exciting introductory program with all new graduates in the Nordics.

• 
A safe onboarding by your own personal buddy and counselor.

• 
Flexible and hybrid-working conditions, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

• 
Highly collaborative teams and great support of a network of knowledgeable colleagues.

• 
Continuous development and opportunities to grow your own career through learnings and experiences. A structured learning journey with on-the-job coaching and opportunities to work toward relevant professional certifications.

What you can expect

If you find this position interesting and recognize yourself in the description above, we would like to hear from you as soon as possible. Application deadline: 15 November 2026.

The steps in our recruitment process are as follows:

• 
Application: Submit your cover letter, CV and most recent grade transcript.

• 
Assessment: After submitting your application, you will receive a link to our assessment within a few days. The assessment takes approximately 20 minutes and must be completed by 18 November.

• 
Video: Following the assessment, you are required to complete a brief video interview consisting of three questions outlining your motivation for this role. You can complete this at your convenience; however, it must be submitted by 22 November.

• 
Interview: Selected candidates will be invited to face-to-face interviews on an ongoing basis.

Please note that only applicants who have completed the assessment and video will be considered for the position. We look forward to receiving your application!

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
