The short version

A venture-backed Danish medical imaging company is hiring its first dedicated AI/ML scientist. The company has a CE-marked product already in clinical use and is now building the next generation of diagnostic tools on top of the imaging data that product generates.

This is not a role where you inherit a dataset and a backlog. The data largely does not exist yet. Part of this job is going out to hospitals, working alongside clinicians, and finding out whether the data they hold actually contains the answer to the question they are asking. The other part is turning that into methods and working prototypes.

If you want a clean pipeline and a defined problem, this is the wrong role. If you want to define the problem, it is close to ideal.

The company

Venture-backed, Danish, around 40 people, with offices in Copenhagen. The technology is PET-based functional imaging that produces quantitative measurements rather than pictures alone — the ability to put a number on physiological function, not just describe what an image looks like.

The first product is CE-marked and in clinical use, with a pivotal trial running and a regulatory submission planned in the United States. Quantification is the core of the company’s value: it is what competitors do not offer, and it is the thing this role is hired to extend.

The company is named at first conversation. We have not put it in writing here.

The mission

The imaging data is the future product line. Today the company measures blood flow in the heart. The question is what else the same data can answer – in cardiology, in neurology, and beyond – and what methods are needed to get there.

You are hired to answer that. You will be the company’s dedicated AI/ML voice, joining a software team of eight and reporting to the Head of Software. You will work across R&D, clinical development, quality and regulatory.

Concretely, the first twelve months look like this:

• Building working relationships with clinicians and technicians at partner hospitals, in Denmark and nearby

• Getting into clinics and understanding how the scans are actually acquired and read

• Identifying which data holds real signal — and being honest when it does not

• Running studies and projects alongside hospital doctors

• Building prototypes that show whether a method works

Success at six months is measured in relationships and prototypes, not in shipped features.

What you will actually do

• Invent, prototype and mature algorithms for extracting clinically meaningful information from PET data

• Translate clinical and scientific questions into testable algorithmic solutions

• Build the pipelines around the work — acquisition, quality control, processing, visualisation, presentation of findings

• Go to hospitals. Observe workflows. Ask clinicians what they need and validate that your assumptions survive contact with clinical reality

• Evaluate emerging methods and tools, and shape which directions the company invests in

• Support the AI/ML dimension of medical device compliance as methods mature toward product — CE-marking and FDA

Travel is roughly two to three days per month, primarily within Denmark and southern Sweden.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Demonstrable AI/ML development experience — applied, and with something you can point to and say “I built that”

• A software engineering and algorithm background, hands-on with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX or Keras, and disciplined about testing and version control

• Experience with data collection, selection, integration and quality control, and preparing datasets for training

• Comfort starting from a rough idea rather than a specification

• Someone who wants to be in the room with clinicians. This role does not work from a desk — you need to be willing to initiate conversations with doctors and technicians, ask uncomfortable questions, and keep asking

• Roughly three to eight years of relevant experience. A PhD, or a PhD plus postdoc, counts — provided the work was applied and you have built things

Strongly preferred

• Medical imaging: DICOM, and work on 3D or 4D volumetric data — segmentation, registration, classification or quantification. PET, MR or X-ray all count

• PET-specific knowledge — reconstruction, attenuation and scatter correction, tracer kinetics, quantification. Genuinely valuable, genuinely not required on day one. The company expects to teach this

• Medical device software or SaMD experience — IEC 62304, quality systems, verification and validation, CE-marking or FDA

• A background in healthcare, medtech, diagnostics or another regulated field

Education

Computer science, biomedical engineering, medical physics or similar is typical. Proven capability substitutes for credentials.

Relocation

Candidates relocating to Denmark will be considered.

What this is, honestly

The genuine appeal. This is the company’s first and only AI/ML hire. Nobody has done this before you, there is no established way of working to inherit, and the direction the company takes on AI is the direction you argue for. It is an unusual amount of ownership for someone at this level, and it is the main reason to take the role.

What you should weigh. You will be the only AI/ML person among eight developers. There is no in-house peer to review your methods and no senior imaging-AI person to learn from — the clinical and scientific expertise sits with the company’s hospital collaborators and advisors rather than inside the building. Some people find that liberating. Others find it isolating, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.

The other thing to weigh is the data. It is early. Expect to spend real time on access, agreements, site visits and data quality before you spend it on model architecture.

Interested, or want to know more?

Black Swans Exist is running this search exclusively. We will tell you who the company is at first conversation, and we will tell you the parts that are not in this document.

If it is not right for you but you know who it is right for, we would genuinely like to hear from you.

The Department of Biomedicine at the Faculty of Health at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Assistant Professor in the field of experimental virology as per 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a fixed-term full-time position for 18 months.

The Department of Biomedicine prioritises diversity and a good work environment, as this is a prerequisite for groundbreaking research. In a diverse and international research environment, dedicated employees are looking to generate new knowledge within biomedical research areas such as infection and inflammation, membranes, neuroscience and personalised medicine. The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. Academic staff contribute to the teaching. English is the preferred language in the laboratory, at meetings and at seminars. The department employs approx. 500 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory-, core- and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation, entrepreneurship and collaboration with business and industry, and numerous researchers from the department have established companies to develop new medicinal treatments founded in professional scientific basic research. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities
As Assistant Professor in Experimental Virology, your primary tasks will be research and research-based teaching. You will teach and supervise students at Bachelor’s and Master’s level, and you will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. In your daily work, you will work closely with both Danish and international colleagues. The position of Assistant Professor is a career development position in which you will receive supervision and pedagogical upgrading.

Your main tasks will consist of:

 * Independent research of high international quality on virus-host interactions, innate immune sensing and inflammasome signalling during RNA-virus infection, including publication of the results.

 * Establishment and characterisation of relevant cellular and cancer-associated experimental models to study how innate sensing pathways influence viral replication, cell death and oncolytic-virus responses.

 * Contribution to related collaborative projects in oncolytic virotherapy and antiviral innate immunity, including projects involving complementary RNA- and DNA-virus systems.

 * Teaching, guidance and examination of Bachelor’s and Master’s degree students, contribution to day-to-day supervision of junior researchers, and some degree of contribution towards attracting external research funding.

You will report to the the Head of Department, Professor Thomas G. Jensen.

Your competences
You have a PhD in virology, immunology, biochemistry, molecular medicine or a closely related field and independent research qualifications at a high international level. Your research profile should combine experimental virology with immunology and should demonstrate substantial hands-on experience studying host responses to virus infection.

For this position, particular emphasis will be placed on documented experience with:

 * Multiple RNA-virus systems and comparative virus-host studies; experience with VSV or another experimentally tractable negative-strand RNA virus is highly relevant.

 * Mechanisms connecting viral infection with inflammatory signalling, type-I interferon responses, cell death, cellular metabolism, mitochondrial function and/or reactive oxygen species.

 * Mammalian cell culture and quantitative virology approaches, supported by relevant molecular and cellular methods such as infection assays, immunoblotting, RT-qPCR, flow cytometry and microscopy.

 * Scientific publication in peer-reviewed international journals, including evidence of substantial intellectual contribution such as first- or co-first authorship.

 * Research collaboration in an international environment and supervision or mentoring of university students or junior researchers.

Experience with oncolytic virotherapy, cancer-relevant infection models, or translation of fundamental virus-host biology towards therapeutic virology will be considered an advantage. You are a clear communicator and have some experience of supervision and teaching at Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree level. Completed pedagogical training and experience with external research collaborations will be viewed positively.

As a person, you have good interpersonal skills, are inclusive and team-oriented, and are able to contribute to a good work environment. We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish, and Aarhus University arranges Danish teaching.

jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

Our research/The group

The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital).

Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘t_o reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

Your job

The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

Your tasks will include:

• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics

• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses

• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data

• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements

• Participate in grant and manuscript writing

• Present at local and international meetings

• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students

• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians

Start: February 1st, 2027

Duration: 2 years

Profile

We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology

• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques

• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material

• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data

• Experience with running projects across research groups

• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences

• Excellent written and spoken English skills

• Very collaborative

• Good social skills

Place of employment

The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. 3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

jobs.occupation: PhD in Light-Activated Micromotors for Biomedical Applications - DTU Health Tech
jobs.description:
If you are interested in pursuing a PhD at the interface of micro/nanotechnology, biomaterials, and biomedical engineering and want to work on a highly interdisciplinary and clinically relevant challenge, this position offers a unique opportunity.

At DTU Health Tech, within the interdisciplinary IDUN research section, you will develop near-infrared (NIR) light-activated micromotors for biomedical applications, with a focus on Hidradenitis Suppurativa (HS). You will work at the interface of micro/nanotechnology, functional materials, biomaterials, and disease modelling, investigating how active micromotor propulsion can overcome transport barriers in complex and confined biological environments.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The main purpose of this PhD project is to develop NIR-responsive micromotors and investigate their active transport within biomimetic models of HS tunnel architecture.

You will design and fabricate biodegradable Janus micromotors and develop three-dimensional hydrogel-based models that reproduce key geometrical features of HS tunnels. You will investigate how micromotor properties and geometric confinement influence active transport and compare propulsion-driven transport with passive particle behaviour.

Your primary tasks will be to:

• Design and fabricate NIR-responsive Janus micromotors with controlled size and surface properties
• Characterize micromotor morphology, optical and photothermal properties, stability, and biodegradability
• Evaluate NIR-activated micromotor propulsion in controlled and skin-relevant environments
• Develop 3D hydrogel-based models mimicking the confined architecture of HS tunnels
• Design channel geometries with different dimensions, branches, and bifurcations to investigate micromotor transport under geometric confinement
• Quantify micromotor penetration, transport velocity, and navigation through confined channel systems
• Compare active micromotor transport with passive diffusion and non-propelled particle controls
• Disseminate research findings through scientific publications, international conferences, and collaborative activities
Qualifications
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree, in nanotechnology, chemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, biotechnology, or a closely related field.

You should have a strong interest in micro- and nanotechnology and hands-on experimental research. Experience with particle fabrication, functional materials, surface modification, microscopy, microfabrication, or biomaterials is highly desirable. Experience with light-responsive or photothermal materials, micromotors, hydrogel fabrication, microfluidic systems, or quantitative particle tracking is considered an advantage.

You are a highly motivated and curious researcher who enjoys experimental work and interdisciplinary problem-solving. You should be interested in combining materials science and micro/nanotechnology with biomedical applications and in understanding how active microscale systems interact with complex and confined biological environments. You should be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively within an interdisciplinary research team.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is 1 February 2027 or according to mutual agreement. The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Assistant Professor Tijana Miseljic, tijma@dtu.dk, and Professor Anja Boisen, aboi@dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 3 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• Publication list
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Health Tech
With a vision to improve health and quality of life through technology, DTU Health Tech engages in research, education, and innovation based on technical and natural science. We educate tomorrow’s health tech engineers and create the foundation for new and innovative services and technologies for the globally expanding healthcare sector with its demands for the most advanced technological solutions. DTU Health Tech’s expertise can be described through five overall research areas: Diagnostic Imaging, Digital Health, Personalised Therapy, Precision Diagnostics, and Sensory and Neural Technology. Our technologies and solutions are developed with the aim of benefiting people and creating value for society. The department has a scientific staff of about 210 persons, 140 PhD Students, and a technical/administrative support staff of about 100 persons of which a large majority contributes to our research infrastructure and related commercial activities.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Job Description:

Are you a strategic thinker who can bridge the gap between complex business goals and a high-performing IT landscape? We are looking for an Enterprise Architect to take ownership of our architectural vision and governance. In this role, you will be the guardian of our IT integrity, ensuring that every new initiative accelerates our digital transformation while staying true to our core principles.

As the owner of the Enterprise Architecture (EA) governance process, you will provide the framework that evaluates IT projects and aligns them with our long-term strategy.

**What The Job Is

You will anticipate long-term business needs and ensure that Satair's IT model is perfectly synchronized with our organizational policies and strategies. By providing structured leadership, you will gain consensus from the management team on critical IT policy decisions, from platform selection to technology strategies, that support our overarching goals.

Your primary responsibilities:

• Process Ownership & Governance: Own the formal approach for implementing solutions. You will manage the "two-step funneling" methodology to screen new initiatives for strategic, cross-cutting, or architectural impact.

• Design Patterns & Models: Develop and promote standardized design patterns and models to ensure consistent application design and a resilient, scalable architecture across the enterprise.

• Principle Custodianship: Act as the lead custodian of Satair’s signature architecture principles, ensuring every solution adheres to these guidelines.

• Strategic Alignment & SLAs: Ensure that all IT solutions are strictly aligned with business needs and are designed to meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Documentation & Repository Management: Finalize and transfer EA-approved documents to the central repository, ensuring the Architecture Board has clear, high-quality materials for final review.

• Financial Stewardship: Produce detailed cost/benefit analyses for new technology implementations, providing the data necessary for informed investment decisions.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify where software, applications, or processes need to evolve to meet the needs of tomorrow’s aviation market.

You will have a leading role in the architecture landscape, acting as the primary driver for the Architecture Board. Your work ensures that the integrity of our current technology is protected while we build the capabilities required for a secure, resilient, and sustainable future.

We are looking for a seasoned professional with a deep background in IT strategy and architecture governance. You should have a proven ability to lead through influence, gaining commitment from senior management for major technology shifts.

• Architectural Excellence: A proven track record in developing resilient architecture models and reusable design patterns.

• Strategic Insight: The ability to perform cost/benefit evaluations that justify strategic technology choices to the CIO office and IT Management.

• Operational Focus: A commitment to ensuring technical solutions deliver on business promises and operational SLAs.

• Collaborative Leadership: Experience with EA frameworks (such as TOGAF) and the ability to navigate complex governance funnels with multiple stakeholders.

Beyond technical expertise, you are a master of communication. You can take a complex organizational challenge and translate it into a structured architectural solution. If you are ready to own the blueprint for Satair’s digital future, we’d love to hear from you.

Beyond technical skills, we value individuals who bring a collaborative mindset, excellent communication abilities, and the confidence to interact with stakeholders at all levels.

As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. **About Us

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

We are now hiring for an experienced Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering Team at our HQ in Islands Brygge.

Platform Engineers are an essential part of our technology foundation. You’ll be joining a team focused on empowering engineers by creating self-service infrastructure and tooling — “paved roads” that make the right path the easy path. You’ll work at the intersection of infrastructure and developer experience, contributing to our cloud architecture, Kubernetes operations, observability, and CI/CD.

You will join a multidisciplinary team spanning Network, Platform and SRE. While each team member deeply owns their primary craft, we operate with a highly collaborative mindset. We offer a supportive environment where you can not only continuously learn from domain specialists, but also make a direct impact on how we operate.

• Kubernetes Orchestration: Manage and optimize our Kubernetes platform, driving autoscaling, service resiliency, and efficient workload orchestration.

• Infrastructure as Code & Cloud: Design, build, and maintain secure, modular, and reusable cloud infrastructure using IaC to support global scalability and reliability.

• Security & Governance: Balance ease of use with compliance, security and efficiency.

Team work makes the dream work. You have worked in small to medium sized platform teams.

• 
Strong experience managing production workloads on Kubernetes.

• 
Hands-on proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, Crossplane...).

Practical experience building automated CI/CD pipelines and self-service platforms for software developers.

Experience with cloud fundamentals (we run on AWS) and security practices.

The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.

At 3Shape we improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients through innovative software and 3D scanners for dental professionals worldwide. A quarter of our staff work in R&D.

Your role

Our scanners have to work the same way in thousands of dental clinics as they do on an optical bench in Copenhagen. This role bridges the gap from optical concepts to solutions that can be manufactured, calibrated, verified, and released. You will join the optics team in R&D and own the optical subsystem in one or more scanner development projects at a time. Depending on the project, this means designing it yourself, or defining specifications for a development partner to build, then verifying the result. Finally, you will be responsible that the optical subsystem will work in the product.

Much of the work takes place where design meets real-world implementation: what tolerance mechanics can eventually hold, what a supplier can deliver at volume and at cost, what calibration needs from the optics, and what to do when the measurement disagrees with the model. You will work in a multidisciplinary team of mechanical, electronics, embedded software and test engineers alongside production engineering, quality and regulatory colleagues. Success in this role depends on your ability to collaborate effectively across these functions.

Day to day you will:

• Design, model and dimension optical imaging and illumination systems

• Specify optical components and modules for production by external partners

• Build and measure prototypes, interpret and act on measured results

• Run tolerance analyses in collaboration with mechanical engineers, and communicate evidence-based recommendations

• Work with software and electronics engineers on calibration and image quality

• Collaborate with optics suppliers and development partners, from feasibility through qualification

• Write the specifications, analyses and verification evidence a medical device requires

Within the optics team, early concept work and lifecycle support of our released scanners fall under the responsibility of other colleagues. This role covers the stretch in between — the projects on their way to becoming products. Technical direction is set together with our principal and senior engineers, so you will have experienced sparring partners close at hand.

Your profile

We care considerably more about how you work than about which degree you hold. The engineer we are looking for:

• Gets satisfaction from things that ship and keep working

• Decides with incomplete information, and takes it well when a measurement later proves the decision wrong

• Treats cost, tolerances, manufacturability and regulatory requirements as part of the design problem

• Works out optical requirements together with mechanical and electronics engineers

• Writes clearly, because in a medical device the documentation is part of the product

• Knows when an optical system is good enough, and balances technical perfection with project needs and timelines

Background we expect:

• A degree in engineering physics, photonics, optical engineering, physics or a comparable field — B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent competence built on the job

• A few years developing physical products that successfully transferred to manufacturing, which we value as highly as years of optics experience on their own

• Solid optical fundamentals: geometrical optics, radiometry, image quality and tolerancing

• Able to model and interrogate an optical design in a ray tracing tool — enough to lay out a system yourself, and enough to challenge a design someone else produced

• Strong on measurement and lab work: building and aligning setups, characterizing externally supplied subsystems to judge whether they meet specifications

• Scripting for analysis and data handling (Python, MATLAB or similar)

The role is based at our Copenhagen office. Prototypes, test setups, and the colleagues you will daily interact with are on site, so this is predominantly on-site work, with the option of one day a week remote. Travel is limited, typically a handful of days per year to suppliers and to our production site in Poland.

We offer

In 3Shape R&D we are proud of our diverse, ambitious and highly skilled colleagues. Working for 3Shape means joining one of the most successful MedTech companies and making a real impact. We offer:

• A chance to impact the treatments of millions of dental patients, globally

• Innovative technology in a true R&D focused company, with room to stay at the edge of what is possible

• Empowerment and entrepreneurial thinking: we believe the best results are achieved by empowering our people and teams

• Sparring, coaching, feedback and a personal development plan to sharpen your toolbox

• Highly skilled and motivated colleagues in an international atmosphere (30+ nationalities in our building)

• An attractive and informal work environment in downtown Copenhagen, with a good work/life balance, breakfast every day, lunch cooked by our own chefs, and many optional social clubs

Read more about us at https://careers.3shape.com/#vacancies

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

Are you passionate about working at the interface between medical devices and pharmaceuticals? Do you have significant experience navigating medical device quality requirements?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior QA Medical Device Specialist.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Senior QA Medical Device Specialist to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role providing quality oversight across the lifecycle of medical devices and drug-device combination products while acting as a trusted quality partner to development, manufacturing, regulatory, commercial, and external stakeholders. Working at the interface between medical devices and pharmaceuticals, you will help translate regulatory requirements into pragmatic and compliant quality solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the QA Medical Device team consisting of 3 colleagues, and report directly to Cecilie Bengtsen, Director of QA Medical Devicewho is based in Hellerup, Denmark_._ You will also be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Provide quality oversight of medical device and drug-device combination product activities throughout the product lifecycle.

• Support development projects through design control activities, risk management, design reviews, design transfer, and maintenance of technical documentation.

• Drive and support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System and implementation of evolving regulatory requirements.

• Provide quality support for product release, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, inspections, and post-market activities.

• Act as a trusted QA business partner to cross-functional stakeholders by facilitating risk-based decision making and ensuring appropriate quality governance.

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree – preferably a master’s degree in engineering, pharmacy, biotechnology, life sciences, or a related scientific discipline – and min 7 years of experience within the life science industry.

Furthermore, you have:

• Extensive experience with MDR, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, and ISO 14971.

• Preferably experience with drug-device combination products, including 21 CFR Part 4 and ISO 11608.

• Hands-on experience within Quality Assurance and medical device development, including design controls.

• Experience supporting audits, inspections, supplier quality activities, and quality system processes.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be:

• Confident in interpreting regulatory requirements and translating them into operational practice.

• Effective at building relationships and influencing stakeholders across development, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory functions.

• Pragmatic, adaptable, and solution-oriented, with the ability to balance compliance, quality, and business objectives.

Travel: 1-5 days per year.

Office: Ascendis Pharma A/S, Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark

Do you have experience within drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts that directly support innovation and scientific advancement?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior Legal Counsel (R&D).

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. We are looking for a skilled and curious electronics engineer with an interest in developing electronics and software solutions for various interesting research and development projects in the intersection between optics and electronics. 

We work on both fundamental and very applied research and development projects in close collaboration with both academic and industrial partners. These projects often involve many interdisciplinary competences. 

The job
You will be an important part of our research and development projects with responsibility for the development of innovative but still robust electronics and software solutions. You will support our researchers in optics and photovoltaics by ensuring high-quality solutions. The job includes a high freedom to experiment and select the most appropriate methods.

Our expectations of you
We expect you to be electronics engineer or have a similar academic relevant background.

Experience in the following is an advantage:

• Analog and digital electronics design.
• PCB layout
• FPGA programming
• Programming in LabVIEW
• Programming in C, MatLab, Python
We expect you to be open-minded, solution-oriented and take ownership of your work. It is important that you contribute actively to projects with ideas and thrive in an environment where development happens through close collaboration and technical discussions with interdisciplinary colleagues.

What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international environment with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. Through our research and development projects you will have the chance to contribute to the state-of-the-art research and development of solutions for our collaborating companies. A job with a high degree of freedom but also high expectations. The Technical University of Denmark is a leading technical university in Europe, and you can contribute to making us even stronger.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2027 (or as soon as possible).

The workplace is DTU Risø Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 2 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Senior Researcher, Ole Bjarlin Jensen, +45 4677 4553, ojen@dtu.dk, or Senior Electronics Engineer, Henning Engelbrecht Larsen on + 45 2367 5099, heel@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with the industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the next generation of nozzles, pumps, and spray solutions used in cooling, heating, humidification, snowmaking, and other critical applications. You will take ownership of mechanical product design and development, helping to ensure our solutions remain innovative, competitive and compliant while delivering value to customers around the world.

Your work will directly support Danfoss' position as a global leader in key components and technologies that help improve energy efficiency, enable sustainable heating and cooling, and contribute to responsible water usage. Through innovation, optimisation and close collaboration across the business, you will help create solutions that make a meaningful difference for our customers and society.

While Danfoss offers the scale and opportunities of a global technology leader, our Spray and Burner Technologies business combines those advantages with the agility of a smaller, highly independent organisation. Here, your ideas can quickly become reality, your contributions are highly visible, and your development is a priority. Whether you aspire to become a recognised technical expert or grow into a leadership role, you'll find strong support, meaningful responsibility, and clear opportunities to shape your career.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**In this role, you will take technical ownership of mechanical products and drive development activities from concept through implementation. One of the unique aspects of this position is the opportunity to work with full product responsibility throughout the entire product lifecycle.

Because our organisation combines the advantages of a global engineering business with the agility of a smaller, independent business unit, you'll gain exposure to every part of the value chain. This will allow you to broaden your technical and commercial understanding, develop your skills across multiple disciplines, and build close working relationships with colleagues across the organisation while seeing the direct impact of your decisions.

• Act as the technical owner of assigned products, ensuring performance, quality, compliance, innovation and cost competitiveness

• Lead the design and development of new mechanical solutions and products for emerging applications

• Drive product optimisation initiatives and continuous improvement activities across the portfolio

• Validate and implement design changes through testing, analysis and collaboration with key stakeholders

• Partner closely with Sales, Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics, suppliers and customers to deliver successful product outcomes

**What We're Looking For

**We're looking for an experienced mechanical engineering professional who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex technical challenges, and collaborating across disciplines to create innovative products.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Several years' experience in mechanical product design and development, ideally within manufacturing or industrial product environments

• Strong experience designing mechanical components and systems from concept through validation and implementation

• Proficiency with 3D CAD tools such as Inventor or similar design software

• Experience working with product compliance requirements and relevant standards such as UL, TÜV, CE, or similar

• Strong communication skills in English and a collaborative approach to working across functions and cultures

**Preferred Qualifications

**Experience with mechatronics, mechanical product design, simulation tools, AI-supported engineering methods, or product optimisation techniques would be considered an advantage.

**Work model

**This role requires close collaboration with colleagues, production, laboratories and key stakeholders on-site. Therefore, we are looking for someone who can work from our Nordborg location on a daily basis and enjoys being close to both the products and the people who bring them to life.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll join a highly experienced and collaborative team with a strong, family-like culture built on openness, trust and mutual support. Our organisation brings together development, production, assembly and testing capabilities in one location, giving you a unique opportunity to understand the complete product lifecycle and make a visible impact on the business.

You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're an experienced mechanical design engineer who enjoys technical ownership, innovation, and turning ideas into high-performing products, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Senior Contract Management Specialist (Senior Contract Counsel)
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes

• Supporting the Customer Success Management, the Service Delivery Managers, the Project Managers, and other internal stakeholders with contract and legal interpretations

• Monitoring and optimizing the commercial performance and quality of the contracts, and collaborating with the business on commercial management

• Supporting the obligation management and quality assurance process, and ensuring that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework

• Supporting the exit handling process, and assisting with drafting termination notices and handling contractual obligations related to the exit strategy

• Participating in weekly status meetings

• Learning and developing new skills and competencies related to contract management and legal matters

**What We Value

**

• A law degree or a relevant degree in contract management, contract administration, or business administration, with a focus on commercial law

• 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or as a legal counsel, preferably in the SaaS, Outsourcing or IT industry

• Knowledge of contract and commercial law, as well as the legal and regulatory aspects of SaaS and cloud services

• Knowledge of Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Co-Pilot/Claude, and in contract management software and tools

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Experience working in a collaborative team that values teamwork, humor, and good communication

• The CM is expected to have solid communication and presentation skills, as well as solid analytical and problem-solving abilities. The CM should be able to work on their own initiative and as part of a team, and to handle multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced and demanding environment. The CM should also have a high level of professionalism and integrity, and a customer-oriented and self-starter mindset

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact MadhuraPangarkjar], Senior Talent Acquisition Partner at madhura.pangarkar@simcorp.com If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.

We're looking for an experienced cyber and information security consultant in the GRC domain who has hands-on experience building automation and/or agentic tools into their work.

What you'll do

We're scaling our GRC services team, a team dedicated to making governance, risk, and compliance of cyber and information security more efficient, effective, and valuable to organisations. We do this by automating processes through software and agentic tools, and by defining tasks, inputs, and outputs more clearly than is currently the norm.

As our client list grows, we need someone who can deliver GRC consulting from day one and open up new paths to delivery by developing and implementing our own tools and automations.

This role is open to being shaped by your own passions and talents, whether that's software development, sales and marketing, or deep industry knowledge.

In this role, you'll definitely be:

• 
Helping companies implement and comply with laws, standards, and frameworks like NIS 2, ISO 27001, and the CIS Controls

• 
Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

• 
Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

Depending on your experience and interests, you may also be:

• 
Developing your own client networks

• 
Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

• 
Performing technical cybersecurity tasks in client environments

• 
Building new services from the ground up, targeting industries or problems you understand uniquely well

What you'll bring

You may be a great fit for this role if you have delivered GRC consulting for at least three years, ideally across several clients at once. On top of that, you should have:

• 
Automated GRC tasks with software and LLMs, refining the output until it beats human work in at least some aspects

• 
Driven the delivery of software products in collaboration with developers

• 
Gotten up to speed on new regulatory requirements under tight deadlines

• 
Fought the least valuable and most dull parts of GRC work while defending the value of good GRC against sceptics and cynics

The ideal candidate must be fluent in English – Danish is a plus, but not required – and we value a relevant master's degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

To fit in at The Tech Collective, you should:

• 
Thrive among diverse colleagues, from highly technical security professionals to energetic commercial profiles whose common language is a mix of humour, sarcasm, and passion

• 
Know how to break down and structure complex assignments, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with your team

• 
Bring a startup mentality that helps drive the innovation and ingenuity of our GRC services

This role is based in Copenhagen. We combine remote work with meaningful in-person work, and you should expect to be physically present at our office or with clients most of the time.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer the chance to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development, whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

How to apply

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply ASAP, as the role will close once filled.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation. If you've built tools, automations, or agentic workflows you're proud of, make sure to include a link or short description as we'd love to see them.

For questions, reach out to:

• 
Niklas Rendboe — nire@thetechcollective.eu · +45 27 14 55 56

• 
Úlfur Sonjuson — ulso@thetechcollective.eu · +45 25 53 19 98

About us

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We're passionate about technology, and we have a genuine interest in people. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry because we believe the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a turbulent world. We're rapidly expanding our Cyber Tech Services team, and we're excited to meet people who want to build the future of GRC at the intersection of business and technology.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US

**We are seeking a Delivery Excellence Principal – Securities Operations to help shape the future of our operational platform and delivery model, with reconciliation excellence as a core capability. You will join a small, high‑impact team within a large organization, with a clear mandate to influence how Securities Operations scale. • Reduce manual breaks through automation, standardization, and stronger controls.

• Enable teams through knowledge sharing, coaching, and clear solution design.

• Act as a platform authority on the SimCorp platform and influence best‑practice usage.

• Translate operational challenges into concrete solutions and process improvements.

• Lead complex client onboardings with a focus on scalable, repeatable setups.

• Define and maintain standards, documentation, and governance to ensure reuse and scale.

**What We Value

**

• Strong experience in investment operations within asset management, banking, or insurance.

• Proven hands‑on expertise on the SimCorp platform with a solution‑oriented mindset.

• Deep understanding of reconciliation processes across multiple asset classes.

• A track record of turning complex operational challenges into implemented outcomes.

• Ability to influence and drive change as part of a small, high‑impact team in a complex organization.

• A delivery‑focused mindset with passion for efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.

And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.occupation: (Junior) Wind Turbine Foundation Installation Engineer – Offshore Wind Projects
jobs.description:
to work within our Business Area Wind, Offshore, P****roject Delivery & Engineering.

The Engineering department is the technical backbone within Business Area Wind, setting the standards and guidelines as well as being embedded within our projects to drive technical excellence through the whole project lifecycle.

Working within the Project Execution department of P****roject Delivery & Engineering, grouped in the Transportation & Installation Engineering team our installation engineers use their strong technical and project management competences to develop and deliver class-leading foundation installation methodologies to project to meet the requirements of our strong offshore wind portfolio across northern Europe.

Your Job as Foundation Installation Engineer

• Provide Offshore turbine foundation installation engineering expertise to Offshore Wind development projects in order to deliver key engineering assignments

• Be accountable for individual projects in delivery phases to support the Installation Manager in overall Foundation Installation package delivery across the BU Offshore portfolio

• Responsible for project-specific engineering tasks within the development phase to understand and mitigate project-specific engineering risks

• Provide HSE leadership in the design and specification of offshore foundation installation methodologies

• Contribute to the structural growth of the Transportation & Installation Engineering team by taking ownership in development work packages

• Develop your own competences both in project management as well as offshore installation methodologies

Please note that this position is internally listed as Cable Installation Engineer, and therefore the title stated in the employment contract may differ from the advertised job title.

Qualifications

Your Profile as Turbine Installation Engineer

• Degree in a relevant Engineering discipline

• A minimum of 3 years project engineering experience in offshore foundation installation context

• Good knowledge of offshore installation equipment and systems

• Strong project management mindset

• Ability to identify installation engineering topics - balancing technical, commercial and consenting imperatives

• Good knowledge of the wind energy market

• Experience in installation of offshore transmission systems is an asset

• Good stakeholder management and strong interpersonal skills, enjoying an environment characterized by disciplinary and cultural diversity.

• Fluent in English

• Strong intercultural awareness and willingness to work across borders

• Enthusiastic about the potential of digitalization and self-propelled to implement the opportunities in the wind industry

Location  Choice of Vattenfall locations at Hamburg, Kolding or Amsterdam

Additional Information

Our offer

Are you looking for more than just a job? Our involvement at every stage of projects means you’ll be able to find your element working with the power of wind and solar in a role where your skills and experience will be leveraged to the maximum.

You’ll benefit from limitless opportunities to grow in your element through learning and development and to expand your horizons working across our diverse portfolio.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths.

The scale of our ambition means we need to bring together people from many different backgrounds and experiences. You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Sabrina Parsons, sabrina.parsons@vattenfall.de

We welcome your application in English no later than 01.11.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

BA Wind is responsible for the development, construction and operation of wind power onshore and offshore as well as other non-hydro renewable activities like solar and batteries. We manage the maintenance, operation and continuous improvement of wind generation assets, safely and with the highest levels of availability and profitability. We also perform the structuring and execution of project partnerships in accordance with overall wind strategy.
