jobs.occupation: Start your career as an Audit Graduate at Deloitte Copenhagen 2027
jobs.description:
With more than 2700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

Would you like to start your audit career at Deloitte's head office?

At our Copenhagen office you will get 600 Audit & Assurance colleagues across departments. We have a strong sense of community, with many joint events, from Friday bars to courses and development opportunities. This gives you plenty of opportunity to build a strong network and a foundation for where your career at Deloitte will take you.

Job Description

As an audit graduate, your day-to-day work will take place in either our Portfolio or Large & Complex departments. You will be assigned to one of our four client segments: Public, Private, Financial Services, or Top Tier and your daily work will be team-based. You will have a dedicated department manager and a coach to support your personal and professional development.

You will quickly become part of your new community and have ample opportunity to build new relationships.

As an audit graduate you:

• Always work in audit teams and be in close contact with both colleagues and clients - often working on site at the client's premises.

• Acquire extensive knowledge of your department's clients and, most importantly, the skills to advise and audit them.

• Assist in planning client's audits, coordinating efforts with, for example, Deloitte's Service and Delivery Centres, which handle many of our administrative tasks, ahead of the reporting season.

• Contribute to risk assessments of accounting areas, using your knowledge of the client's internal processes.

• Work with an experienced audit team to conduct audits to ensure that the financial statements give a true and fair view.

Your role will vary depending on which department you join but we promise that your days will not be the same. There will be room to learn, to ask for help, and to grow and take on the responsibility you want.

NEXT - our graduate development programme

When you join as an audit graduate, you enter a full-time role and will join our internal development programme, NEXT, along with around 100 other graduates across the country. You are regularly brought together for training and to prepare for new roles.

Depending on where you are in your training when you join us, you will also be studying part-time at the university. And for your first 100 days with us, you will be assigned a buddy who has been through the experience of being a new graduate and will help you settle into your new role.

Qualifications

There are several paths to become an audit graduate in our audit business. We are open to your educational background and to you completing a level of training while you are with us. The most important thing is that you have the interest and motivation to learn. And it is important that you:

• Want to develop personally.

• Are curious about auditing.

• Have social skills that will support your future relationships with clients and colleagues, and team-based working.

• Can show relevant professional experience or extra curricular activities , in which you have excelled.

• You speak and understand both English and Danish, or any of the other Nordic languages.

• You are eligible to work within the EU, either as a citizen or with the correct permits.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Click on "I am interested" above to apply for this position.

Please attach your CV and grades from your current and previous education. Please do not upload a traditional cover letter. Through the application process we will also ask you to answer a few questions about your motivation for the joining Deloitte.

We process applications and arrange interviews continually.

Expected start date to be 10.09.2027.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Coordinator Emil Morelli Nørgaard on mobile: +45 53793260 or email: talent@deloitte.dk

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

With an IoT platform connecting more millions of devices, and growing - Trackunit is building the connectivity layer underneath the construction industry. Every one of those units carries a cellular radio, and every one of those radios sits inside a web of standards, type approvals, and patent licences that decides whether we can ship and where we can ship.

You will join our IoT Division, Device Reliability Engineering (DRE) team as an expert on IoT certifications, standards, and licensing including Standard Essential Patents (SEP). This position shapes both our exposure and our coverage arguments, and it means this role works in every direction at once, with suppliers, regulatory approvals, legal advisors, product and engineering, and with customers.

This is a role for someone who can hold a genuinely complex domain in their head and then explain it in three sentences to a customer who has never heard the phrase “patent exhaustion.”

Experience level: a deep specialist role. We expect solid, hands-on experience with cellular device approvals and licensing — likely 10+ years across regulatory, certification, or IP/licensing work in mobile, IoT, or telecom hardware. This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports, high autonomy, and direct executive visibility.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

****What's in it for you?

• A domain you will own, not administer. IoT Cellular License, SEP and certification strategy is an executive-level topic at Trackunit right now, with real financial exposure attached. You will not be filing paperwork in a corner, you will be shaping the position the company takes.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****What you'll do

****Your work splits roughly into four parts: licensing, approvals, guidance, and governance.

• Own our SEP position. Understand where our cellular SEP exposure actually sits across our device portfolio, track the relevant patent pools and licensing programmes, and maintain a clear, evidence-based view of what is covered through our supply chain and what is not.

• Run supplier licensing due diligence. Establish and maintain a consistent set of asks across module suppliers — coverage confirmation, standards and generations covered, and honest disclosure of known gaps — so responses can be compared side by side and fed into supplier qualification.

• Support licensing negotiations and claims. Work alongside our General Counsel, external patent counsel, and economic advisors on royalty basis questions, valuation and apportionment arguments, and claims that reach us through our OEM customers. You bring the technical and supply chain substance; they bring the legal strategy.

• Own global type approvals and certification. Plan and steer RED/CE, FCC, ISED, UKCA, and the wider set of regional approvals, plus GCF/PTCRB and carrier certification, across a multi-region device portfolio. Keep certification on the critical path of new product programmes rather than at the end of them.

• Stay ahead of regulatory change. Cyber Resilience Act, RED delegated acts, radio spectrum and network sunsets, environmental and product compliance requirements — know what is coming, when it bites, and what it means for our roadmap.

• Make the complex simple, and guide without over-promising. Write and maintain the internal playbooks, customer-facing explainers, and OEM guidance that turn this domain into something a commercial colleague or a customer can act on. Be the person Sales, Legal, and customers come to when a licensing notification lands, explaining the landscape accurately, saying clearly where the limits of our position are, and pointing customers to independent specialist advice where that is the right answer.

• Build the governance. Response protocols, decision records, escalation paths, and embedding licensing and compliance requirements into how we qualify suppliers and run the product development lifecycle.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

• Communication as a core skill, not a bonus. You can take a genuinely complicated subject and land it in plain language, in writing, with an audience that has no background in it.

• The judgement to know what we can and cannot say to a customer, and the discipline to hold that line even when it would be easier not to.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You are honest about uncertainty. In this domain, no one can offer a blanket guarantee, and the people who claim otherwise create problems later. We would rather be accurate than reassuring.

• You are curious and self-driven, this is a field that changes constantly, and nobody is going to hand you a reading list.

• You finish things. A clear one-page answer delivered this week beats a perfect analysis that arrives after the decision was made.

• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows a subject, and you use that position to make others smarter rather than to make yourself indispensable.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement, but a strong motivation and interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work, including MCP servers and agents against our own platform, and we see clear potential in applying it to research, documentation, and compliance workflows. We don't expect you to have experience with this but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

****How you'll grow here

****This is a specialist role with an unusually wide view of the business, and we've set it up that way on purpose.

• Executive proximity. You will work closely with the SVP of IoT Division, while reporting into a central function for IoT, as the Device Reliability Engineering. You will help in presenting to executive leadership on exposure, risk, and recommendations. Your analysis will inform on a product technical matter (Not Legal) but with real financial and commercial decisions.

• Cross-functional reach. Legal, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales all depend on this domain. Few roles at Trackunit touch as many parts of the company.

• External network. You will work with external patent counsel, economic consultants, module suppliers, certification bodies, and industry forums — building a network that extends well beyond Trackunit.

• Room to define the function. This discipline is being built out now. What it becomes — and whether it grows into a team — is substantially yours to shape.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

If you’re a top-performing closer with experience navigating e-commerce brands and fast-moving decision-makers, this is your chance to join Europe’s leading Video Commerce and Live Shopping platform.

jobs.occupation: Associate Director - External Data Acquisition Lead (EDAL)
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Associate Director, External Data Acquisition Lead (EDAL) role is a clinical data manager with expertise in the data collection of 3rd party data from various external providers (e.g. laboratories, eCOA providers, technology providers, etc.). The EDAL provides a leadership role in the oversight of the external clinical data integration processes as well as oversight of data quality from various external providers performing testing or data collection services on behalf of Genmab. The EDAL serves as the subject matter expert for all external data management activities performed for clinical trial teams. This role provides strategic data management expertise and is accountable for all end-to-end Data Management activities and deliverables pertaining to external data. The employee will provide oversight of external vendors and the data and/or data services they provide to Genmab. The External Data Lead will support the development and optimization of processes and tools to enable success of the Clinical Operations department. The employee will represent Data Management in Operational Committee’s/fora with the partners and/or DM/stat vendors. The employee will support /train colleagues in and advise on handling of external data management related processes/issues and may act as a mentor. Moreover, the employee shall support the overall strategy and development of Data Management by attending/leading task force initiatives within the department and/or as part of cross-departmental teams.

**Responibilites

**

• Lead external data acquisition across one or more studies/programs, ensuring high-quality, timely, analysis-ready data aligned with trial objectives.

• Influence protocol and amendment development by advising on external data collection design, integration feasibility, and alignment with CDASH/SDTM and EDC requirements.

• Lead planning and oversight of external data flow strategies and DTS across diverse data types (PK/ADA, biomarker, imaging, central lab, eCOA/ePRO, PD, IRT, etc.) to ensure compliant integration.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure external data acquisition supports operational and scientific goals.

• Develop and manage Trial Data Integrity Plans (TDIP) and Data Flow

• Create and maintain data transfer specifications (DTS) requirements. Ensure data collection requirements are aligned with external vendor capabilities and vendor data are compatible with the clinical database and SDTM requirements to support data integration, analysis and reporting. Ensure vendor data is transferred in standard data formats.

• Provide thorough review of external vendors budget and change order

• Act as escalation point for complex vendor issues (timeline deviations, integration challenges, misalignment to trial needs).

• Mentor and guide junior External Data Acquisition Leads, providing direction on best practices, issue resolution, and development.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives including SOP development, process improvement, tools optimization, and external data standards governance.

• Partner with procurement/legal/vendor managers to review technical language in contracts and work orders, ensuring alignment with Genmab standards and systems.

• Promote portfolio-level consistency and scalability through training, knowledge sharing, and strategic planning support.

• Mentor and develop team members to ensure consistency of External Data Management practices.

• Ensure External Vendor deliverables are performed in compliance with protocol, ICH, GCP and SOPs

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or Master's degree in a relevant technical area; Master’s degree preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in external or clinical data management, with strong third-party vendor oversight and data acquisition experience.

• Experience working on Oncology trials/data

• Experience designing and governing DTS and complex data flows supporting EDC integration and CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM).

• Strong knowledge of diverse external data types (e.g., biomarker, central lab, imaging, eCOA/ePRO, genomic) and ability to align acquisition strategies to clinical and analytical objectives.

• Experience managing projects, vendors, and process improvements in global environments.

• Proven performance in earlier role.

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$157,360.00---$236,040.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

**About You

**

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose

• You bring precision and excellence to all that you do

• You believe in our rooted-in-science approach to problem-solving

• You are a generous collaborator who can work in teams with a broad spectrum of backgrounds

• You take pride in enabling the best work of others on the team

• You can grapple with the unknown and be innovative

• You have experience working in a fast-growing, dynamic company (or a strong desire to)

• You work hard and are not afraid to have a little fun while you do so!

**Locations

**Genmab maximizes the efficiency of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are crafted as open, community-based spaces that work to connect employees while being immersed in our powerful laboratories. Whether you’re in one of our office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

About the position

Are you ambitious, commercially minded, and eager to take the next step in your career within the intersection of strategy, branding, sales and marketing?

As a Consultant/Senior Consultant in Sunrise’s Insights & Strategy team, you’ll work with ambitious Danish and international companies to turn customer, market, and business insights into strategic direction and creative solutions with commercial impact.

Your main objective will be to create strong market positions for our clients and accelerate their business growth by helping them navigate transitions across three critical domains: Brand Transition, Marketing Transition, and Sales Transition. Especially within complex business-to-business (B2B) environments. This requires a combination of thorough analysis, insight-driven strategy, commercial thinking, and an understanding of how strategy translates into creative execution or actionable initiatives.

You will take an active role throughout our projects – from research and analysis to developing strategic recommendations, preparing and participating in client workshops, and translating strategy into clear briefs and direction for our creative and activation specialists.

We are looking for someone with 2-4 years of relevant experience from a consultancy, agency, or an in-house strategy, marketing, insights, or commercial function. You know how to structure a problem, work independently with analysis and strategic deliverables, and communicate your thinking clearly – while still being eager to learn from experienced colleagues and take on increasing responsibility.

Depending on your experience, you’ll either own key parts of our projects or take the lead on workstreams and day-to-day client contact.

At Sunrise, you will be part of a social, ambitious, and informal organization where you’ll work closely with consultants, specialists, project managers, and partners – with direct client exposure and responsibility from day one.

Your tasks will include

• Conducting and driving desk research, market analysis, competitor analysis, and qualitative and quantitative insights gathering

• Turning complex data, research, and customer insights into clear conclusions and strategic recommendations

• Challenging our clients’ business issues and identifying untapped potential across their commercial activities

• Developing strategies within areas such as positioning, commercial, branding, customer insights, communication, and marketing

• Contributing to and independently owning parts of client projects and strategic deliverables, and driving client engagements and workstreams independently (or with the ambition to gradually take on this responsibility)

• Preparing, facilitating and presenting at client meetings and workshops

• Translating strategic recommendations into clear input and briefs for our creative teams and Activation specialists across areas such as content, SoMe, Web, CRM, and campaigns

• Developing compelling presentations in Keynote/PowerPoint for existing and potential clients

• Contributing to and co-owning new business development through research, identification of opportunities, development of proposals, and pitches

• Planning and managing research projects with external partners (qual/quant)

Your profile

• You have 2-4 years of relevant professional experience from a consultancy, agency, or an in-house strategy, marketing, insights, branding, or commercial function

• You hold a relevant master’s degree within business administration, marketing, management, communication, or a related field

• You have a strong interest in marketing, branding, commercial strategy, customer insights, and communication

• You are analytically strong and comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative insights – but equally importantly

• You have solid business acumen and are curious about how companies, customers, markets, and brands work – B2B experience is a benefit but not a requirement

• You are a structured problem solver who can take ownership of your own workstreams and deliverables

• You are a strategic thinker with a creative flair and enjoy moving from analysis to ideas and solutions

• You are a strong team player who enjoys collaborating across different disciplines and personalities

• You are eager to take responsibility, learn quickly, and continuously develop your consulting toolbox

• You are fluent in Danish and highly proficient in English

• It is a plus if you have experience in facilitating workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders

• It is a plus if you are interested in and have strong skillset within various AI tools and want to take a leading role in challenging existing processes from this point of view

We offer

• A steep learning curve with increasing responsibility and client exposure

• A clear path towards senior roles, and real influence on how we develop our methods and offering

• The opportunity to work with leading Danish and international companies across industries

• Personal and professional development with close sparring from experienced consultants and partners

• Exposure to projects spanning insights, commercial strategy, positioning, branding, communication, and marketing

• The opportunity to follow projects all the way from analysis and strategy to creative development and activation or actionable business initiatives

• An ambitious and personalized development path with long-term career opportunities at Sunrise

• A social, informal, and ambitious work environment in Copenhagen

About Sunrise TcTa

Sunrise TcTa isn’t a large conglomerate with standardised processes. We’re a privately owned commercial transition agency based in Copenhagen – independent and built to develop tailor-made strategic and creative solutions across industries, mostly B2B and often with an international footprint.

We’re a team of 30+ advisors, strategists, creatives, project managers, and specialists working closely together to help companies navigate change and unlock commercial growth – all while having a lot of fun along the way. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: expect an open culture where every voice is heard, music in the office, plenty of laughter, and a calendar with social events and celebrations.

We combine customer and market insights, strategy, creativity, and activation – allowing us to move from identifying the commercial challenge to developing the strategic direction and bringing it to life.

Our ambition level is high, our pace is fast, and our structure is deliberately informal. You’ll work closely with experienced colleagues and partners, get responsibility early, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact on both our clients’ businesses and Sunrise itself.

Transitions are never easy.

But they’re often necessary.

Join us in working with the commercial ones.

Sunrise TcTa – Brand, Marketing & Commercial Strategy.

How to apply

Submit the form below. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your CV and motivational letter.

Are you a skilled and detail-oriented tester with a passion for delivering high-quality digital solutions?

At Satair, we are looking for a Backend API Automation Tester who will ensure our e-commerce platform and underlying services meet the highest standards of functionality, performance, and reliability. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on building robust automation frameworks and ensuring that the "engine" of our digital ecosystem is flawless.

The position will be located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

What The Job Is...

You'll play a crucial role in shaping the quality of our platform by leveraging your expertise in backend automation, security validation, and defect analysis. You will work closely with developers, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure our backend services are scalable and resilient, contributing directly to our mission of delivering seamless customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks specifically for backend services and APIs.

• API Automation: Create and execute sophisticated API tests using Playwright .Security & Auth: Automate complex authentication flows, including OAuth, JWT, and API keys, to ensure secure service-to-service communication.

• Validation: Validate RESTful (and SOAP) APIs for functionality, performance, and schema integrity (JSON/XML).

• CI/CD Integration: Implement and manage automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable continuous quality.

• Defect Management: Analyze test results, identify root causes of defects, and collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolutions.

• Strategy & Documentation: Develop comprehensive test cases, test plans, and data strategies for backend systems, ensuring high test coverage and clear API documentation.

• Full Lifecycle Testing: Conduct regression, smoke and integration testing to support frequent production releases.

How You Will Contribute To The Team

• Technical Expertise: 5-7 years of experience in backend/API testing with deep hands-on experience in Playwright.

• Scripting Skills: Proficiency in automation scripting using JavaScript or TypeScript.

• Protocol Mastery: Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, headers, status codes and version control (Git).

• Agile Knowledge: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira and modern test management tools like XRAY, HP ALM, Practi Test.

• Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks and optimizing automation frameworks for speed and reliability.

• Stakeholder Acumen: Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical backend requirements and business needs.

• Collaboration: Ability to work within diverse teams and foster a positive, solutions-oriented environment.

Nice to Have

• Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or K6.

• ISTQB Foundation Certification.

• Experience with E-commerce platform architectures.

Would you like to be part of exciting and challenging projects within the IT world? Do you dream of having the opportunity to contribute to some of Denmark’s most business-critical IT solutions? Then we have the ideal student job for you.

At Netcompany, we are looking for a student who wants to take part in our innovative projects. Here, you will have the chance to influence our solutions while working alongside some of the industry’s most skilled colleagues, who will inspire you and support your learning.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a student assistant with us, you will be given responsibility from day one and become an important part of one of our teams. You will experience how your work directly contributes and creates value in the solutions we deliver to our clients. A student position with us gives you the opportunity to take on challenging tasks on equal footing with our full-time consultants.

We follow a well-established methodology from identifying client needs to implementing and rolling out solutions. You will therefore gain hands-on experience with developing IT systems from start to finish. You will primarily work on IT solutions and service-oriented architectures based on .NET and Java technologies, typically within maintenance, development and testing. The role provides the opportunity to put many of the skills gained during your studies into practice.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing functional and technical designs for system components.

• Programming tasks across all layers of the system.

• Configuration and development of extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes.

About you

We are looking for a student who can work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to project deadlines and other key milestones. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field.

• Have some experience with object-oriented programming and familiarity with languages such as C# .NET and/or Java.

Continue developing with us

All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Can you turn complex logistics data into practical improvements?

Do you know how to challenge transport flows, strengthen supplier performance and uncover what drives distribution costs?

And would you like to build capabilities that continue to make a difference beyond your assignment?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Global Distribution Network Optimization Lead to improve our global distribution network and strengthen the tools, insights and ways of working behind it.

This position is initially established for approximately 12–18 months to deliver priority network improvements and build a lasting capability within Global Distribution & Logistics.

**Your role

**You will assess how our distribution network performs today and identify how it can better balance cost, service, lead time, capacity and resilience. Turning network data and operational insights into a prioritized roadmap, you will work with colleagues and logistics partners to put agreed improvements into practice.

You will report to the Head of Global Distribution & Logistics. The role has no direct reports, so your impact will come through your analytical expertise, project leadership and ability to create alignment across functions.

You will collaborate closely with Distribution Leads, Global Planning, Regional Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain Compliance, Quality and the I2O Process Manager, as well as logistics service providers and carriers.

**What You Will Do

**Your responsibilities will cover three connected areas:

Optimize the distribution network

• Assess the current network and develop a prioritized optimization roadmap covering cost, service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Analyse distribution lanes, shipment profiles, routes, transport modes and network flows to identify improvement opportunities.

• Build transparency on distribution costs and cost-to-serve to support informed decisions.

• Identify opportunities for shipment consolidation, routing improvements, changes in transport mode and network redesign.

• Lead or support the implementation of agreed changes, working with Distribution Leads to turn recurring operational issues into lasting improvements.

**Strengthen supplier strategy and performance

**

• Develop logistics supplier and carrier strategies in close collaboration with Procurement.

• Establish a supplier performance framework with clear KPIs, governance, performance reviews and improvement plans.

• Support logistics tenders, supplier selection and contract optimization.

• Work with suppliers, carriers and internal stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in cost and service.

**Build Capabilities That Last

**

• Establish analytical tools, standards and governance that make network optimization an ongoing part of how we work.

• Support future digital ways of working, including the use of transportation management systems (TMS) to improve visibility and decision support.

• Build and transfer knowledge so that colleagues can sustain and develop the capability beyond the assignment.

**What Success Looks Like

**During the assignment, you will establish a clear network optimization roadmap and a prioritized set of improvement opportunities. You will provide better visibility of distribution costs, develop practical lane and routing recommendations, and put a supplier performance framework and strategy in place.

Success will also mean implementing changes that deliver tangible improvements in cost, service and network resilience—and leaving colleagues with the tools and knowledge to continue that work.

**What You Bring

**You have strong experience in logistics, transportation, distribution or supply chain network optimization. You understand both the commercial drivers of a distribution network and the operational realities of making changes work.

**We are looking for someone with:

**

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into practical business decisions.

• Experience in logistics sourcing, tenders, carrier management and supplier performance management.

• A strong commercial and cost mindset, with the ability to assess trade-offs across service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Strong project and change management skills, including the ability to move improvements from analysis into implementation.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across functions.

**How You Work

**You combine a strategic perspective with a practical approach. You are comfortable challenging existing arrangements but take the time to understand operational needs before recommending changes.

You create clarity around opportunities, priorities and expected benefits, and bring colleagues with you through implementation. You also share your knowledge openly, helping others take ownership of new tools and ways of working.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful improvements within a defined assignment while shaping how global distribution develops over the longer term. You will influence network decisions, supplier strategies and the analytical capabilities that support reliable vaccine distribution.

At Bavarian Nordic, we work to improve and save lives through vaccines. Our culture values persistence, openness to change and collaboration. In this role, you can put those values into practice by solving complex distribution challenges and building improvements together with colleagues across the business.

Turn photonic quantum processors into real-world value

At Sparrow Quantum, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of light-matter interfaces for quantum technology to enable state-of-the-art scalable photonic quantum systems.

Sparrow Quantum is building universal photonic quantum processors based on deterministic quantum emitters. We are looking for a Quantum Applications Scientist to build on Sparrow’s work on use cases and algorithms and to help push the frontier demonstrating what photonic quantum can do for real end users.

You will act as the bridge between our theory, experimental, and business teams and our end users. You will take an end user's problem, work out how our hardware can address it, and turn it into a concrete plan that you help execute together with the teams.

This is a technical role with a clear focus on applications. You have the theoretical depth to develop applications yourself, with an eye for the quantum algorithms behind them, the experimental insight to discuss feasibility with our experimentalists, and the overview to translate between what end users need and what our hardware can do. You are expected to take initiative and move from a loosely defined question to a workable solution.

Responsibilities of the role

• 
Identify and develop use cases and quantum algorithms for our demonstrator, from initial end-user needs to proof of concept

• 
Translate end-user problems into well-defined computational tasks, and assess where our hardware can offer value

• 
Discuss feasibility with our experimental team, and feedback which hardware capabilities matter most for applications

• 
Run and guide simulations of algorithms and use cases to benchmark performance and compare against classical approaches

• 
Join end-user meetings initiated by the business team as the technical bridge, and turn results into clear recommendations

• 
Work with the business team on proposals, demonstrations, partnerships, and funding applications

• 
Represent Sparrow Quantum at conferences, workshops, and end-user meetings

In brief, we offer a unique opportunity for a talented Quantum Applications Scientist to collaborate with world-leading professionals in the field. Your work will shape how end users apply our quantum hardware and help steer our technology towards the problems that matter most.

Required qualifications

• 
PhD in quantum physics or a closely related field, with a strong theoretical foundation, ideally with postdoctoral or industry experience

• 
Good understanding of quantum computing use cases and where they may offer an advantage, e.g. in optimization, machine learning or simulation, with an interest in the underlying algorithms

• 
Worked alongside experimentalists, giving you a solid sense of what is experimentally feasible

• 
Solid programming skills, e.g. in Python, for simulating and benchmarking algorithms

• 
Proven ability to communicate complex technical ideas to non-specialists, including end users and business stakeholders

Nice-to-have qualifications

• 
Experience with quantum photonics, quantum optics or photonic quantum computing

• 
Experience working with industry partners, customers or end users on applied projects

• 
Experience leading projects or supervising junior researchers

• 
Experience with collaborative R&D projects or funding applications

• 
Knowledge of boson sampling, measurement-based or fusion-based quantum computing

• 
A track record of publications in quantum technologies

Additionally, we expect that you thrive in a collaborative work environment and are inspired by the chance to contribute to groundbreaking advancements in quantum computing.

Desired abilities & competencies

• 
Overview: you keep the big picture in view and connect technical detail to what matters for the end user and for Sparrow Quantum.

• 
Translator: you are equally comfortable discussing algorithms with theorists, feasibility with experimentalists and value with end users.

• 
Proactive and solution-oriented: you spot opportunities, take the first step, and come back with options rather than obstacles.

• 
Constructive challenger: you are confident challenging assumptions, just as open to having your own challenged, and look for solutions that work both for the end user and for our hardware.

What we offer

• 
Passionate international team and high individual impact: Join a high-performance team of dynamic and highly motivated international professionals working towards photonic quantum computing. Your innovative ideas, unique perspectives, and unwavering drive to succeed are essential to the team and will have a direct impact on the future of our organization.

• 
Cutting-edge projects and world-renowned collaborators: Collaborate with world-renowned companies and researchers, working on cutting-edge projects that will shape the future of quantum technology. You will contribute to scientific publication, represent the company at conferences, and have the possibility of travelling to our collaborators for new insights and knowledge sharing.

• 
Personal and professional growth: Expect a steep learning curve in a supportive environment at the border between research and industry. Our commitment to your growth and development is reflected in our supportive culture, which includes group-based knowledge transfer, skill development, and opportunities for training and mentorship.

• 
Attractive compensation and career advancement opportunities: Receive a salary that is competitive and commensurate with your qualifications, with ample opportunities to advance your career and achieve your professional goals.

• 
Inclusive and positive work culture: Become part of a positive and inclusive work culture where we build meaningful relationships and celebrate one another and our achievements. Our work culture emphasizes work-life balance, with generous vacation time, flexible working hours with up to 10-20% working from home, lunch paid by the company, and a focus on employee well-being.

How to apply

If you share our passion for delivering a real-world impact through the development of unique quantum photonic technology and have the skills we believe are essential for future Sparrows, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace at Sparrow Quantum and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

• bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team

• understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry

• have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management

• can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions

• communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

JMP, a subsidiary of SAS, is committed to empowering scientists and engineers via our world-class family of statistical software products. For over 35 years, JMP has enabled customers to speed new drugs to market, to design better products and processes, and to figure out how to restore ecosystems. Advancements are made when brilliant people use JMP statistical discovery software to see what they’ve not seen before. If you are a problem solver, a connector, and someone who enjoys helping others, then you might just be the next person to join this dynamic, growing, and global team.

About the job

We are looking to hire an experienced New Business Salesperson to join our successful sales team, selling JMP software to both new and existing customers. To join this team the successful candidate will need to prove their record of consistently over-achieving sales targets while helping their customers to deliver long-term value from the use of their products.

You will be responsible for finding new business and managing existing accounts where you will have ownership of the full sales cycle through to close. You will be responsible for sales of JMP software products in a high volume, multi-tasking sales environment.

You will work with the JMP Sales Team to demonstrate and prove JMP’s customer value and drive new business across Ireland and Nordics.

As an Account Executive, you will:

• Create opportunities and customer alignment to JMP’s likely customer profile.

• Prospect within the assigned sales territory to uncover business needs.

• Help define and deliver the territory and account management plan; identify new target accounts with high "close" potential, qualify sales opportunities and accurately forecast your pipeline of qualified sales opportunities to deliver JMP software sales revenue.

• Work closely with the sales territory teams, including Inside Sales, Sales Engineer and JMP management in all aspects of the sales process.

• Prepare quotations and proposal information as needed; work with relevant JMP departments to create and finalize contracts.

• Engage with senior Decision-Makers in your existing customers to ensure ongoing satisfaction with their JMP products and to discover and develop additional revenue opportunities.

• Apply your knowledge of JMP’s marketing goals, JMP applications, supported hardware platforms, marketing and business trends, and industry knowledge to assess your customer’s potential needs.

• Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.

• Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Required qualifications

• Requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in a full sales cycle - with a successful and proven track-record - in the sales of computer software solutions or scientific and engineering hardware (including products and services related to JMP’s target markets). Specific experience related to JMP’s target markets may be considered in combination with the above requirements.

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Marketing, MIS, or other relevant discipline.

• This is primarily a new business role which would suit a focused and high activity salesperson. The new business revenue comes from new-name accounts and growing the use of JMP software for existing customers, where the sales opportunities need to be uncovered and developed.

• Ability to analyse and evaluate territory dynamics and develop a sales plan; ability to communicate technical and business concepts and relate them to JMP software and user needs; ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Knowledge of sales techniques; knowledge of software acquisitions cycles and buying influences.

• Ability to travel regularly and extensively within the territory and occasionally internationally.

• Hybrid work style.

• Proof of Right to work in the UK or Denmark with ability to travel across Europe. Fluency in Danish is preferred.

• Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.

Additional competencies, knowledge and skills

• Creating Demand Through Insight - Identifying the targeted account’s business challenges and needs and their probable causes; providing and provoking convincing insights that compel decision makers to discover or reconsider unrecognized problems and opportunities and the value of addressing them with new solutions to achieve better long-term results (e.g., profitability, revenue, market share).

• Advancing Sales Discussions - Leading discussions with influential decision makers that progress the sale by effectively clarifying information, offering insights, addressing objections, and gaining agreement to move to the next step in the buying process.

• Driving for Results - Setting high goals for personal and group accomplishment; using measurement methods to monitor progress toward goals; tenaciously working to meet or exceed goals while deriving satisfaction from that achievement and continuous improvement.

You are welcome here.

What if your curiosity could help build the world we all imagine?

Are you eager to impact modern society while growing your professional and personal skills in a welcoming environment? Launch your career with our Forensic & Integrity Services team at EY, starting August 2027. We’re committed to investing in your potential throughout your journey.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Graduate in Forensic & Integrity Services, you’ll join our Assurance services, gaining experience alongside forensic professionals across different sectors. Our team spans accounting, law, finance, data analytics, technology and investigations, helping clients navigate sensitive challenges.

From the start, you’ll join project teams investigating complex matters across industries. Assignments may involve financial and accounting records, electronic data, interviews, policies, contracts, and transaction documentation.

Depending On The Assignments, You May Work On

• Supporting investigations into suspected fraud, misconduct, conflicts of interest and other integrity concerns

• Reviewing financial records, transactions, contracts and documentation to identify patterns and relevant facts

• Assisting with whistleblower investigations and other sensitive fact-finding assignments

• Analyzing structured and unstructured data, including financial data and electronic communications

• Supporting compliance reviews and assessments of ethics, governance and internal control frameworks

• Contributing to interviews, evidence summaries, presentations and investigation reports

We offer varied work experience that helps you grow professionally in an inclusive culture. You’ll be surrounded by committed colleagues, we value spending time together, both at work and socially.

Through internal coaching and training, you’ll build the skills to stay relevant now and, in the future, while growing a network of colleagues, mentors and leaders at EY.

To learn more about our teams within Assurance, please visit our career page.

What We Look For

• 
Enjoys understanding how facts and financial information connect

• 
Approaches complex information in a structured and analytical way

• 
Pays attention to detail without losing sight of the broader issue

• 
Can communicate clearly and objectively, both in writing and in conversation

• 
Takes responsibility, asks questions and is motivated to learn

• 
Qualifications:

• 
You completed your studies in 2026 or are set to graduate in summer 2027 with a degree within economics, finance, law, data analytics and/or technology (e.g. cand.merc.(aud.), cand.merc.(jur.), cand.jur., cand.polit, data science or similar).

• 
You communicate fluently in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing.

What’s In It For You

• Supportive onboarding with your own buddy and counselor.

• Flexible and hybrid working conditions.

• Highly collaborative teams and great support of a network of knowledgeable colleagues.

• Continuous development and opportunities to grow your career.

What You Can Expect

If this position interests you and you recognize yourself in the description, we would like to hear from you soon. Application deadline: 15 November 2026.

Recruitment Process

• Assessment: After submitting your application, you will receive a link to our assessment within a few days. It takes about 20 minutes and must be completed by 18 November.
