jobs.occupation: Compliance Product Enablement Student Assistant - Danish Speaking
jobs.description:
**In this Compliance Product Enablement Student Assistant role, you’ll be…

**

• Translating legal documents and compliance-related content from English into Danish, ensuring legal precision, clarity, and consistency.

• Translating marketing materials containing compliance concepts to fit regional standards without losing accuracy.

• Supporting our software compliance work by helping maintain alignment with local laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Assisting in the creation and maintenance of compliance blueprints alongside experienced market experts and our partners.

• Supported through a mentor-mentee relationship with a senior compliance specialist.

**Who is the Product Enablement Team?

**The Product Enablement Team sits at the intersection of our compliance domain expertise and market expansion. We ensure that our platform content, legal frameworks, and product materials are localised accurately across every market Formalize operates in.

We are part of Commercial, partnering closely with stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Legal to bridge domain expertise with localised execution.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision by ensuring our software and messaging speak the language of local compliance with absolute precision.

**What you’ll bring:

**

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Communication, Business, or a related field.

• Native-level fluency in Danish with professional written and spoken English.

• Strong written communication skills with close attention to detail, tone, and legal nuance.

• A structured, proactive mindset with an interest in learning compliance frameworks and software localisation.

• Availability to work at least 15 hours per week at our Aarhus office.

**What do we offer you?

**

• An hourly salary ranging from 155 to 195 DKK.

• Our salary levels are directly linked to our structured career framework, which includes regular performance reviews, clear progression, and bi-annual growth talks.

• Dedicated guidance through a mentor–mentee relationship with a senior compliance expert.

• Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• An office-first culture in a central location in Aarhus C (Frederiksgade 25), with benefits including lunch, health insurance, and social events.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

****Our recruitment process

• Send your application and upload relevant information

• 15-30 minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team

• Completion of Personality Assessment

• 45-minute in-person final interview with our Product Compliance Consultant Lead, Rasmus, and another student from the team.

****About Formalize

****Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid & Munich. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from 19 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

****Ready to apply?

****We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

Make an impact with Laerdal!

Do you want to develop cutting-edge products that train healthcare professionals and ultimately help save lives? Join us at Laerdal Copenhagen, where we build world-class digital learning solutions used by millions globally.

The Team

We are building new capabilities for RQI (Resuscitation Quality Improvement) that help hospitals run CPR training the way their organisation actually works. That means connecting the training station to the learning systems hospitals already use, removing the friction between a learner walking up to the cart and starting a session, and giving the people who implement RQI the tools to configure it for their own context. You'll help shape these capabilities and weave them into one cohesive experience. In that way, your work will directly expand access to CPR training and support Laerdal's mission to help save more lives.

We work close to our customers: we visit hospitals, test our assumptions and build on modern technology, with an eye on where resuscitation training is heading next. You will work in a cross-functional product team in Laerdal Copenhagen with product management, design and engineering, as well as with other product teams across Copenhagen, Stavanger, and the US. The team owns the core platform capabilities and collaborates closely with partners across the wider RQI ecosystem.

The Role

We are looking for a React Frontend Engineer with experience building modern web and mobile applications. In this role, you will take ownership of the key user-facing flows of the platform.

You will,

• experiment, build and maintain web and mobile user interfaces using React and React Native

• collaborate closely with backend engineers on API design and data flows

• work closely with product managers and designers to translate user needs into intuitive frontend experiences

• contribute to the frontend architecture, patterns, and technical direction

• work in a "you build it, you run it" mindset with responsibility for production quality

Your Background

• Around 3+ years of professional software development experience

• Strong experience with React in production systems

• Hands-on experience with React Native and mobile development

• Understanding of frontend architecture, state management, and performance considerations

• Care deeply about usability, quality, and real user impact

• Enjoy close collaboration with designers and product managers

• Actively using AI-assisted development in your daily work

Our Tech Stack

• React (Web) & React Native (Mobile)

• C# / .NET Backend

• API‑driven integrations

• Cloud‑based infrastructure & modern CI/CD practices

Why Laerdal

Laerdal is a mission‑driven company working to help save one million more lives, every year, by 2030 (One Million Lives by Laerdal: A Shared Goal for 2030 - Laerdal - One Million Lives). You’ll be part of a collaborative, international environment with a strong focus on product quality, real‑world impact, and sustainable work–life balance.

We have a collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse close to Islands Brygge.

This is a full‑time role based at Laerdal's office in Copenhagen. We expect most workdays to be spent on‑site, with some flexibility for remote work during the week. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work closely with senior peers across engineering, product, and design.

Get a feeling of who we are in Laerdal Copenhagen in this video.

Reach Out

When you are ready to apply, please submit your CV and a short motivation letter. (remember that LinkedIn only allows one document, so just merge them into one):

• CV

• Motivation letter

If you have any questions that might keep you from applying, reach out to Lukas Zimmerli (Engineering Manager) at lukas.zimmerli@laerdal.com.

We’re looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Product team in Copenhagen. Someone with a strong legal foundation who is excited about AI, technology, and finding better ways to do legal work. You’ll get hands-on with our product, work on real legal problems, and help us build AI-powered tools that lawyers can actually rely on.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**As a Legal Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of law, AI, and product. You'll join our Product team and work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

This is a hands-on role: rather than practising law, you'll use your legal expertise to evaluate AI-generated legal work, figure out where and why it falls short, and turn real legal problems into scalable AI-powered workflows. It's a good fit if you like getting deep into legal detail but also enjoy stepping back to ask why something works and how it could work better.

**What You'll Do

**

• Evaluate and improve legal AI quality: test AI-generated legal research and analysis for correctness, completeness, reasoning, and source selection. Investigate where outputs fall short and turn findings into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

• Turn legal problems into AI-powered workflows: break down how lawyers actually perform a task, define what a good outcome looks like, and help develop, test, and refine workflows that solve it at scale.

• Bring UK legal expertise into product development: apply your knowledge of UK law, legal sources, and lawyer workflows to how we evaluate and build our products.

• Work on complex customer problems: partner with Customer Success and Sales on cases needing deeper legal expertise — understand the underlying problem, shape practical solutions, and feed what you learn back into Product.

• Help lawyers work effectively with AI: build workflows and examples that help customers get real value from AI in their legal work, and flag recurring needs that could inform future product decisions.

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re primarily looking for strong legal expertise and judgement. You don’t need a background in engineering, AI, or product development — those are things you can develop in the role.

• Advanced legal education or professional legal qualification, with a strong foundation in UK law gained through your education and/or professional training. You should be able to independently research, analyse, and assess UK complex and abstract legal questions.

• A couple of years of hands-on legal experience from a law firm, in-house legal team, public institution, or comparable legal environment.

• Strong experience with legal research and analysis, and the ability to work independently with complex legal questions and source material.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess the quality of legal work, identify weaknesses or unsupported conclusions, and explain clearly what could be improved.

**Nice to have

**You don’t need to tick every box below. These are a plus, not requirements:

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for legal work, such as legal research, drafting, contract analysis, or document review.

• Familiarity with prompting, LLM evaluations, or systematically testing AI-generated outputs.

• Experience with document-heavy or structured legal workflows, such as due diligence, contract review, regulatory analysis, or multi-jurisdictional research.

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders and translating complex legal needs into practical solutions.

• Exposure to product development, user testing, or workflow design.

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or legal systems, particularly both common-law and civil-law systems.

• Basic technical or data literacy, such as structured data, APIs, advanced spreadsheets, or simple scripting.

• Additional language skills beyond English.

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Hamburg, Zurich and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_

Do you want to lead one of the most exciting growth areas in the Nordic energy market?

As Head of Flexibility Solutions, you lead the strategic development, commercial growth, and operational excellence of Mind Energy’s flexibility business.

You’re leading a multidisciplinary domain being responsible for flexibility products, ancillary services, market participation, and the digital platform that enables it all. Working at the intersection of business, technology, operations, and energy markets, you will create scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer value while strengthening Mind Energy's position as a leading flexibility partner in the Nordics.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

At Mind Energy, we organize around domains rather than traditional functional silos.

Each domain brings together commercial, operational, product, and technical capabilities around a shared business objective and customer outcome. This enables faster decision-making, stronger ownership, and closer collaboration across the value chain.

In this role you lead the Flexibility Domain and bring together commercial specialists, traders, product experts, developers, and operations professionals around a common mission: delivering market-leading flexibility solutions that create customer value and accelerate the energy transition.

Your mission is to:

• Define and lead the Flexibility Domain strategy, priorities, and roadmap, ensuring long-term business performance, growth, value creation, and market readiness.

• Drive the commercial development of flexibility solutions by translating customer needs, market developments, commercial opportunities, and regulatory changes into scalable products, services, business capabilities, and system initiatives.

• Co-own the roadmap and evolution of the Energy Trading Management Platform with the Product Owner, guiding investment and prioritization decisions across products, processes, and technology to deliver measurable business value.

• Ensure operational excellence across activation, monitoring, settlement, and performance management, while acting as the escalation point for critical commercial, operational, market, and system challenges and maintaining deep insight into Nordic balancing markets, ancillary services, and TSO requirements.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, turning market complexity into clear priorities, scalable solutions, and tangible results.

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

Working alongside commercial specialists, traders, developers, product experts, and operations professionals, you join a high-performing, cross-functional domain with end-to-end ownership of our flexibility business.

Combining deep market expertise with commercial, operational, and technical capabilities, the team has the mandate to make decisions that directly impact our products, customers, and business results. This setup enables close collaboration, rapid execution, and the ability to turn market complexity into scalable solutions that drive growth and support the energy transition.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are a commercially minded leader who thrives in complex environments and enjoys turning market opportunities into scalable solutions.

You combine strategic thinking with operational execution and know how to create results through people, collaboration, and clear priorities.

We imagine you bring:

• Proven leadership experience with responsibility for people, business performance, and strategic execution, including building and developing high-performing teams

• Strong commercial acumen and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align commercial, operational, and technical interests to drive growth and value creation

• Experience balancing strategic priorities with operational execution and day-to-day delivery

• Relevant experience from the energy sector, preferably within flexibility, balancing markets, ancillary services, trading, or grid-related services

• Excellent communication skills, fluency in English, and a relevant degree or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of demand response, virtual power plants (VPPs), and balancing products such as mFRR, aFRR, and FCR is an advantage

• Proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting, movie premieres and our Christmas family day. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognizing that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.

LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED

If you want to join us – do not wait – send your resume and application as soon as you can, and no later than October 27, 2026.

Please send a short resume and application including:

• your motivation

• key examples of competences and experience

• your personal profile

If you have questions regarding the position, feel free to contact Vice President, Commercial Excellence, Sidse Mogensen by email at simo@mindenergy.com.

For general recruitment matters, contact people@mindenergy.com.

Can you bring together people, technology, and commercial ambition to accelerate the energy transition? Help us write the next chapter.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. Our work includes solutions for areas such as data centers, gas sensing, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring.

As our Development Engineer, you’ll help bring new sensing technologies and product concepts from idea to reality. Working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists, you’ll contribute to developing products supporting our Data Center, Gas Sensing, and future technology programs.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across different areas of engineering, from mechanical design and prototyping to testing and integration with electronics and software. With a solid foundation in mechanical and electrical engineering and a curiosity to learn, you’ll build hands-on experience while contributing to meaningful product innovation from day one.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You’ll work across a variety of development activities, gaining exposure to different engineering disciplines while helping bring new ideas and technologies to life.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Supporting the development of new sensing products and technology platforms from concept generation through prototype development and testing

• Creating CAD models, drawings, fixtures, mechanical components, and development tooling to support new product designs

• Building, assembling, and evaluating prototypes, while collecting and analyzing test data to support engineering decisions

• Collaborating with engineers across mechanical, electronics, software, and systems disciplines to mature new concepts and solve technical challenges

• Contributing to design verification, technical investigations, and engineering documentation

As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills across product development and explore different technical disciplines based on your strengths and interests.

**What We're Looking For

**You don’t need to have experience in every area of the role. What matters most is a strong mechanical foundation, a practical mindset, and the curiosity and motivation to keep learning.

To be successful in this role, we would expect you to have:

• A BSc or MSc degree in Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• A solid understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals

• Experience using CAD tools for design and engineering documentation

• Practical, hands-on engineering experience gained through work, university projects, internships, or personal projects

• Curiosity, initiative, and an interest in developing your skills across different engineering disciplines

It Would Be An Advantage If You Have Gained Exposure To One Or More Of The Following Through Work, Studies, Projects, Or Personal Interests

• Product development

• Prototyping and testing

• Electronics and sensors

• Software development

**What You'll Get From Us

**You’ll join an environment where collaboration, learning, and continuous development are part of how we work, with the opportunity to broaden your experience as you grow in the role.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

**Nice to have

**

• Experience working on live games

**Requirements For Any Job At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• You value a positive work environment

• You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

**Practicalities

**

• Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role

• 37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

• No crunch, we put people before deadlines

• Our working language is English

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects

• The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of paid vacation

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Pension plan and private health insurance

• Endless amounts of coffee

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who make the team better, bring new perspectives, and will challenge us and our way of doing things!

Are you passionate about enabling global mobility and creating practical compliant solutions? Can you work both strategically and hands-on in close collaborating with internal stakeholders as well as external immigration, tax and mobility providers?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new responsible for Global Mobility

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Global Mobility professional to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in establishing and managing the global mobility framework, ensuring compliance across all countries where we operate. This role combines policy development, process ownership and operational execution

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining  the Global HR team and report directly to Anne Marie Knuth, Head of HR Rewards, Data & Systems who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Define and drive Ascendis' global mobility strategy aligned with business objectives and workforce needs.

• Establish principles, governance, and decision frameworks for international mobility.

• Ensure mobility programs balance employee experience, business flexibility and compliance requirements.

• Act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor to HR, managers and leadership on global mobility matters and being the primary point of contact for immigration requirements and travel-related compliance obligations.

• Identify and proactively manage risks related to immigration, employment law, cross-border taxation and social security

• Build scalable and efficient workflows for; work permit applications, visa administration, business traveler compliance, A1 certificates and social security coverage as well as cross-border employee movements, as well as managing and coordinating the applications globally.

• To ensure timely renewals and ongoing compliance of permits and authorizations.

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree and have 5-10 years of experience within global mobility, immigration, international HR and employment tax.

Furthermore, you have:

• In depth knowledge of immigration, work authorization, and business travel compliance.

• Experience managing cross-border taxation and social security matters.

• The ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a growing global organization.

• Great stakeholder management skills and can see yourself partnering with HR, Legal, Payroll, and Finance to address complex international employment scenarios.

• Experience with vendor management as you will be the primary contact point to our external mobility vendors

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to monitor changes in global legislation and assess business impact while ensuring ongoing compliance.  We expect you to take ownership in continuously improving global mobility processes and procedures.

Travel: 10 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Anne Marie Knuth, akn@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

**A Snapshot of Your Day

**The Commercial Sales Manager is responsible for optimizing the financial and commercial outcome of projects and takes the active role of negotiating the commercial parts of Offshore Service contracts. Do you want to be part of an industry that is striving to protect our planet from further damage? Are you one who looks for solutions and regards a problem as an opportunity? Are you a person who believes in getting things done right the first time? If yes, we are looking for an enthusiastic Commercial Sales Manager to join our dedicated Offshore Service Sales team. The role provides an opportunity to operate in a dynamic department working on some of the biggest, most complex renewable energy projects in the world; negotiating with customers the financial and commercial outcome of projects, putting together compelling offers, presenting to management and internal stakeholders and ultimately working collaboratively with our customers to grow the wind industry.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**

• You will be integral to the sales process for our wind turbine and service contract offerings for the offshore wind sector.

• You will be working, as part of team, to deliver deals shaped to represent the commercial interests of both our customers and the business.

• Working on multiple high value service and maintenance contracts at any one time,

• Working with the Sales Director and Sales Project Manager to develop and drive the sales strategy; subsequently taking the lead on all commercial elements of the process (such as currency risks, financial security, payment terms, insurance, export control, and compliance),

• Ownership of commercial and financial documents during the sales and bidding process

• Developing the negotiation strategy on commercial terms and conditions,

• Clarification, annotation, mark-up of Terms & Conditions with commercial and financial implications

• Leading the negotiation of commercial terms and conditions in coordination with the relevant departments (Legal, Insurance, Trade Finance, Finance, Tax, Export Control & Customs, Operations, Logistics, etc...),

• Leading commercial evaluation of risks and opportunities facing your projects,

• Understanding and demonstrating impact of changes on customer business cases for energy projects,

• Preparation and presentation of project specific sales forecasts and budgets to high-level management,

• Working with the commercial team to establish and implement efficient processes and best practices.

What You **Bring

**

• A passion for renewable energy and a sense of the importance to lead the change,

• Knowledge of customer business case, preferably for energy projects,

• Demonstrable commercial contract management skills including in commercial negotiations, preferably within sales and/or the energy or construction sector,

• Good interpersonal skills with ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment and the ability to multi-task to meet deadlines,

• An ability to communicate technically complicated topics concisely to high-level management and customers in a high-pressure environment,

• A good knowledge of cost calculation approaches, finance methods, and commercial financial topics (bonds, escalation, currency, indemnities, liabilities, etc.),

• Project management skills,

• Fluency in English, both orally and in writing, International experience and willingness to travel (25%) and work in a global environment,

• Qualified applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment (no work authorization sponsoring now or in the future),

• A degree, preferably in business admin, finance or law.

**About the Team

**Wind Power division is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community.

**Who is Siemens Energy?

**At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

**Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on

inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits

**Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave

• Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

• Access to a variety of employee resource groups

We're looking for an experienced cyber and information security consultant in the GRC domain who has hands-on experience building automation and/or agentic tools into their work.

**What You'll Do

**We're scaling our GRC services team, a team dedicated to making governance, risk, and compliance of cyber and information security more efficient, effective, and valuable to organisations. We do this by automating processes through software and agentic tools, and by defining tasks, inputs, and outputs more clearly than is currently the norm.

As our client list grows, we need someone who can deliver GRC consulting from day one and open up new paths to delivery by developing and implementing our own tools and automations.

This role is open to being shaped by your own passions and talents, whether that's software development, sales and marketing, or deep industry knowledge.

**In This Role, You'll Definitely Be

**

• Helping companies implement and comply with laws, standards, and frameworks like NIS 2, ISO 27001, and the CIS Controls

• Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

• Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

**Depending on your experience and interests, you may also be:

**

• Developing your own client networks

• Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

• Performing technical cybersecurity tasks in client environments

• Building new services from the ground up, targeting industries or problems you understand uniquely well

**What You'll Bring

**You may be a great fit for this role if you have delivered GRC consulting for at least three years, ideally across several clients at once. On top of that, you should have:

• Automated GRC tasks with software and LLMs, refining the output until it beats human work in at least some aspects

• Driven the delivery of software products in collaboration with developers

• Gotten up to speed on new regulatory requirements under tight deadlines

• Fought the least valuable and most dull parts of GRC work while defending the value of good GRC against sceptics and cynics

The ideal candidate must be fluent in English – Danish is a plus, but not required – and we value a relevant master's degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

**To Fit In At The Tech Collective, You Should

**

• Thrive among diverse colleagues, from highly technical security professionals to energetic commercial profiles whose common language is a mix of humour, sarcasm, and passion

• Know how to break down and structure complex assignments, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with your team

• Bring a startup mentality that helps drive the innovation and ingenuity of our GRC services

This role is based in Copenhagen. We combine remote work with meaningful in-person work, and you should expect to be physically present at our office or with clients most of the time.

**What We Offer

**On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer the chance to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. **How To Apply

**We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply ASAP, as the role will close once filled.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation. If you've built tools, automations, or agentic workflows you're proud of, make sure to include a link or short description as we'd love to see them.

**For Questions, Reach Out To

**

• Niklas Rendboe — nire@thetechcollective.eu

• +45 27 14 55 56

• Úlfur Sonjuson — ulso@thetechcollective.eu

**About Us

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We're passionate about technology, and we have a genuine interest in people. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry because we believe the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a turbulent world. We're rapidly expanding our Cyber Tech Services team, and we're excited to meet people who want to build the future of GRC at the intersection of business and technology.

**Job Description

**

Global Business Development Manager

Posting Start Date: 10/8/26

Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Working hours: Full-time

Work model: Hybrid

Contract type: Permanent

**About The Role

**We are excited to offer an incredible opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join Scandinavian Tobacco Group’s growing Next Generation Products team. In this pivotal role, you will be essential in supporting our innovative ventures beyond tobacco, using strategic insights and a strong understanding of global market trends. Moreover, you will be responsible for shaping and managing our global product portfolio while identifying strategic business opportunities to drive global growth. You will work cross-functionally to deliver and execute portfolio strategies & business development opportunities that help grow our brands and company.

Your role as a self-reliant professional is crucial in our fast-paced environment. A key part of your role will involve ensuring clear communication and alignment within the organization, while fostering robust professional relationships. You will be reporting to the Head of Business Development.

**WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

****Lead Category Development

**

• Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for next generation products, ensuring alignment with consumer preferences and market trends.

• Analyzing market trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats for the brand and category portfolio to improve performance & profitability.

• Evaluate the performance of the portfolio and adjust as needed to ensure it continues to deliver growth and profitability.

**Business Growth & Development

**

• Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, including market expansions, strategic partnerships, and potential acquisitions.

• Lead cross-functional teams to develop and execute business development initiatives that accelerate revenue growth and expand market presence.

• Leverage data and market insights to continuously evolve the product portfolio, ensuring the company remains ahead of industry trends.

• Utilize market research and consumer insights for the development of the next generation products portfolio strategy and to define its role and roadmap.

**Global Collaboration

**

• Work closely with regional and local teams to adapt portfolio strategies to local market needs and ensure the successful global rollout of new products.

• Ensure a cohesive approach to portfolio management and business development across markets, driving synergies and efficiencies globally.

**New Business Opportunities

**

• Identify and assess emerging trends and consumer needs to develop new product categories that align with the company's strategic goals.

• Lead the exploration and validation of new business ideas through market research, pilot programs, and feasibility studies.

• Develop business cases for new category initiatives, including market analysis, financial projections, and risk assessments.

• Collaborate with R&D, marketing, and sales teams to bring new product categories from concept to market launch.

• Establish strategic partnerships and alliances to support the development and growth of new categories.

• Monitor and evaluate the performance of new categories, making data-driven adjustments to ensure their success and profitability.

**WHAT SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WILL BE REQUIRED?

**

• 3-5 years of experience in business development and/or project management, ideally within multinational FMCG companies. Global/regional experience is preferred.

• Strong analytical skills and strategic thinking with a track record of identifying and capitalizing on growth opportunities.

• Deep understanding of consumer behaviour, what drives their decisions and how we can adjust our strategies to fit their needs and expectations.

• Excellent project management skills, with experience leading cross-functional teams & influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong communication and relationship-building abilities across diverse global teams.

• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills and proven experience in utilizing data analytics tools.

• Fluency in English and ability to travel up 10-15% of the time.

We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

**Position, purpose & impact

**As a Support Engineer in Global Tech Support, you will provide hands-on, customer-facing technical support that helps our customers operate Queue-it reliably during business-critical moments. Reporting to the Head of Global Tech Support, you'll join a global, collaborative support organization working across regions and cultures.

This role bridges customer needs with technically sound solutions - validating feasibility, answering technical questions, and guiding customers through supported implementation patterns. You'll troubleshoot incidents and product or integration issues with a calm, structured, and analytical approach, and contribute to proactive Event Support activities delivered together with Pre-sales & Solutions as part of Queue-it's professional services offering. This is a hands‑on role for someone who takes ownership and cares deeply about clear communication and reliable customer outcomes.

**Your toolkit

****Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Experience

**

• 1–3 years of experience in technical support, solutions engineering, web engineering, or a similar customer‑facing technical role.

**Skills

**

• Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Solid understanding of web fundamentals and delivery concepts, including HTTP, headers, cookies, caching, load balancing, and basic networking.

• Technical proficiency within the web communication knowledge domain and the ability to understand customer integrations.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks or customers in parallel in a structured way.

• Strong collaboration skills for working effectively with internal teams, including Product & Technology, Pre-sales & Solutions, and other GTM teams.

**Preferred

**

• Programming or scripting experience, such as JavaScript, .NET, Java, PHP, or Lua, mainly for troubleshooting and understanding customer integrations.

• Familiarity with CDN and edge delivery technologies such as Akamai, Cloudflare, or Amazon CloudFront.

• Experience with ecommerce platforms, ticketing platforms, or high‑traffic web environments.

• AWS, Azure, or similar technical certifications.

**The role in action

**

• Provide technical support for Queue-it customers as part of a 24/7 follow‑the‑sun support setup, including incident handling, alert response, and ticket resolution.

• Troubleshoot issues related to Queue-it configuration, product usage, supported integrations, and customer implementations.

• Support customers with integration‑related questions across common web technologies and supported deployment patterns.

• Diagnose technical issues related to traffic protection, waiting room behavior, connectors, and customer implementations.

• Participate in proactive monitoring and support during high‑traffic customer events, launches, and sales as part of Queue‑it's Event Support service.

• Communicate clearly with customers throughout incidents and support cases, ensuring timely follow‑up, accurate updates, and resolution within agreed SLAs.

• Collaborate with Product & Technology, Pre-sales & Solutions, and other Go‑To‑Market teams during escalations and complex investigations.

• Produce clear technical documentation and internal knowledge‑sharing material within the role's domain knowledge.

**Why join the Queue

**In this role, you will be working from our Vesterbro office in Copenhagen - Queue-it's largest office and global headquarters. The office is designed to support both collaboration and focus, with open workspaces, quiet rooms, and areas dedicated to deep work. You'll also find a ping pong table, foosball, and regular social activities that bring colleagues together.

At Queue-it, you're trusted to work in a way that suits you best, supported by a strength-based approach and a flat hierarchy inspired by Danish work culture. You'll be part of a global, collaborative environment with colleagues from 40+ nationalities, where diverse perspectives are valued and teamwork across cultures is the norm. We prioritize professional growth, open dialogue, and creating a strong sense of community. Daily snacks, fresh fruit, great coffee, and access to a subsidized canteen in the building are all part of the experience.

**What We're About

**At Queue-it, we help some of the world's biggest brands like Ticketmaster, Sky Mobile, Hermes and Peach Aviation navigate their busiest days with confidence. Our virtual waiting room technology keeps websites running smoothly during high-traffic events – creating fairer and more reliable online experiences for billions of users.

But we're more than just software. We're a global team representing 40+ nationalities across Denmark, the U.S., South Korea, Australia, and Japan. We believe in the power of trust – not only in the digital experiences we protect, but in the culture we build together.

We take a strength-based approach to work, encouraging people to do what they do best and supporting them to thrive. You'll join a supportive, collaborative environment that values individuality, learning, and connection. And yes – we like to have fun too. From regular social events and celebrations to cultural and learning initiatives, we make time to connect and enjoy the Queue.

We are empowered by trust and strengthened by people.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Consultant - Fund Administration & Accounting
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values : caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a Senior Business Consultant in Consulting, you will support our clients with best-practice market solutions and with services related to the use of SimCorp Dimension and beyond. You will work closely with local and global SimCorp teams, serving clients in their post-implementation phases. Drawing on your coordination skills and SimCorp Dimension expertise, you will collaborate with client and internal stakeholders on investment solutions, incident and problem management, and small changes or enhancements to current or future flows, all aimed at raising the level of automation and the end-user experience and satisfaction. Because the role is functional, Fund Administration & Accounting expertise is required. As part of your induction, you will work hands-on with our software and attend the three-week SimCorp Dimension® Academy, so you have steady support as you grow into the role.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Contribute to all aspects of SimCorp Dimension implementation projects.

• Advise on process improvements through better use of SimCorp Dimension, and help improve and document best practices for implementations.

• Map client needs to SimCorp Dimension functions and processes, and design and configure the setup.

• Lead the delivery of customised solutions with focus on Fund administration and Accounting.

• Assist clients in developing an overall test strategy and test plans, and support them in executing those plans.

• Drive the preparation and execution of test cases.

• Facilitate workshops to gather requirements for new and existing clients.

• Mentor, coach and enable colleagues to secure reliable project deliveries.

**What We Value

**

• Motivation to contribute and thrive in the position described above, which matters most.

• Proven skills in the areas below, however you gained them, as the route matters less than the capability.

• Investment accounting knowledge, some familiarity with any local GAAPS, IFRS9 would be an advantage

• Fund administration knowledge, including NAV calculation, Fund Structure and NAV Validation

• A strong background in effective consulting and project management.

• Demonstrated experience in software implementation projects.

• Enthusiasm for learning and using new software.

• A desire to act as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues.

• Good English, our corporate language, which is used in all communications.

• Knowledge of another European language is also appreciated. Danish is also an advantage

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Launchpad user our Lead Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. Would you like to help shape cyber security across products, processes, and engineering practices in a growing technology company?

At INVISIO, we are strengthening our cyber security capabilities as part of our continued focus on secure product development, vulnerability management, and compliance with the Cyber Resilience Act.

We are therefore looking for a Product Cyber Security Specialist who can turn technical and regulatory requirements into clear, practical solutions.

We offer a self-driving role with broad responsibility, room for professional development, and the opportunity to contribute directly to INVISIO’s cyber resilience and compliance journey.

About the role

As our Product Cyber Security Specialist, you will play a key role in developing, documenting, and improving cyber security processes across INVISIO. Your main focus will be secure software development, vulnerability monitoring, and practical security guidance for our product and engineering teams.

This is a broad role where you will combine specialist knowledge with internal consultancy. You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation, supporting them with analysis, documentation, and hands-on recommendations that strengthen cyber resilience throughout the product development lifecycle.

Your key responsibilities:

• Monitoring, assessing, and documenting vulnerabilities relevant to INVISIO products and systems

• Supporting the development and maintenance of vulnerability management procedures

• Contributing to secure software development lifecycle processes and documentation

• Supporting INVISIO’s work related to the Cyber Resilience Act

• Acting as an internal cyber security consultant for product development, software, and engineering teams

• Preparing and maintaining cyber security policies, procedures, guidelines, and technical documentation

• Supporting risk assessments and security impact analyses

• Helping ensure that cyber security requirements are considered throughout the product development lifecycle

• Following relevant standards, regulations, and best practices, including secure software development and industrial cyber security frameworks

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders across engineering, quality, compliance, and management.

About you

You bring broad cyber security knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear and practical procedures.

You are structured, proactive, and able to turn complex cyber security topics into clear, practical guidance. You work independently, take ownership, and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Due to the nature of INVISIO’s business, you must be able to obtain and maintain the required security clearance throughout your employment.

Required qualifications:

• A relevant educational background, such as, (but not limited to), a Master’s degree in Cyber Security, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.

• Knowledge of cyber security principles, secure software development, and vulnerability management

• Strong technical and analytical skills

• Good documentation and written communication skills

• The ability to work independently and drive tasks forward

• Good communication skills and the ability to advise stakeholders across different functions

It is an advantage if you have experience with one or more of the following:

• Secure Software Development Lifecycle processes

• Vulnerability management and vulnerability disclosure processes

• IEC 62443 or other industrial cyber security standards

• Product security or embedded systems security

• Risk assessment methods and cyber security compliance

• Security documentation for regulated products or systems

What we offer

You will become part of an international, growing tech company developing advanced communication solutions trusted by defense and public safety professionals around the world.

You can expect:

• A high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and influence in your role.

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international, high-tech environment.

• Opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.

• A culture built on passion, innovation, working as one team and putting the customer first.

• A flexible working environment, primarily based at our headquarters in Hvidovre, Copenhagen, with the possibility of working from home when appropriate.

Additional information

The position is based at our headquarters in Hvidovre, Copenhagen. Please note that we do not offer relocation assistance.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the selected candidate.

How to apply

Please submit your application through the link before Oct. 30, 2026. A cover letter is not required. Instead, we encourage you to include a short introduction and tell us about your motivation for the role in your CV.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. All candidates will be notified by email, so please remember to check your spam folder.

We believe in equal opportunities for all and encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

We are looking for an experienced Azure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD Engineer to help elevate our SaaS operations and internal deployment processes to the next level.

Key About Your Role

We aim to take Operations to the next level by onboarding more skilled human power (you) and using your expertise to refine and modernize our existing Azure setup. The goal is to make it more elegant, clean, and scalable.

As a central figure in the infrastructure everyone depends on, communication and collaboration will be a natural part of your work. You will provide ad hoc support to colleagues and customer representatives, contributing directly to the stability and growth of our platform.

We work with two layers of deployments:

• Platform deployments: Low frequency (around once per month), planned well in advance

• Customer component deployments: Higher frequency (around once per week), shorter planning horizon

Both typically take place outside normal office hours. For these, you will be compensated with time off from your regular schedule. Deployments usually last about 15 minutes, with occasional on-call backup needed for unforeseen issues (fortunately, rare).

Your work will revolve around three main areas as follows:

Key responsibilities:

• Environments: Refining and improving the setup of our internal and external environments in a beautiful Kubernetes architecture in Azure

• CI/CD: Configuring, maintaining and continuously improving our entire CI/CD universe

• Operations: Participate actively in operations tasks, maintenance windows, deployments, and incident debugging. Together with the small operations team, ensure our platform runs smoothly 24/7

There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

Key About Your Team

Our team, named Obex, is a business unit of Keylane, employing around twenty-five awesome developers, business analysts and a few other professions. Our main product is our Obex Platform, a SaaS solution for financial advisory used by advisors in a variety of pension funds and banks.

We are proud that finances of an estimated two million Danes have been through our software. The Obex Platform is developed in close collaboration with our customers, resulting in a product that users truly appreciate.

In Obex we care for each other. Thriving is top priority. You will feel that atmosphere as soon as you enter.

Our organization is flat, the best argument wins, not the highest title. We do things because they make sense. If something stops making sense, we stop doing it, whether that's a process, a line of code, or a piece of architecture. We aim for the best solutions, not for rigid conformity.

We believe in mutual elasticity: We go the extra mile to support you, each other, and our customers. And we expect the same spirit in return. Together, we share responsibility for keeping the Obex machine running smoothly.

There's much more to tell about our way of working, our culture, and our social side (fun activities and parties included), but let's save that for a chat, either online or over a great cup of coffee.

Questions?

If you have any further questions regarding this position, please reach out to the hiring manager Rasmus Amossen via mail to rasmus.amossen@keylane.com.

When you have any general questions about Keylane or want to have a quick chat before applying, just reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Thomas Thomsen via mail to thomas.thomsen@keylane.com.

Experience?

• You know your way around log and performance monitoring tools and have a passion for clean, well-architected systems

• You are not content with things merely working, you want them to work beautifully

• There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together

For example, to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, generate or improve code and tests, refactoring, troubleshoot issues, document solutions and support code reviews;

Other

Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously

Department: R&D

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're creating a new role at the top of our Engineering career ladder: Lead Architect. It's the senior end of our Technical Track — the rung above Tech Lead — and today it's a role we've deliberately left lightly defined, because we want the first person in it to help define it. You'll set Factbird's technical direction: architecture, tooling, and the multi-year technology bets that shape where the product goes next.

This is our most senior technical role, with no direct reports — your authority comes from judgment and track record, not the org chart. You'll work alongside our Tech Leads in Factbird's technical leadership group, partner closely with our Director of Engineering, and be the person other senior engineers go to when a decision is genuinely hard to reverse.

**About the Role

**As Lead Architect, you own Factbird's company-wide technical vision: the architecture our services run on, the tooling and standards our engineers use every day, and the multi-year technology strategy that ties it all together. You make — or sign off on — the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse architecture calls, and you're accountable for getting them right with the full context of where the business is headed, not just where the code is today.

You'll work across a team built on Rust, React, Node.js, and AWS, with AI-assisted development already a core part of how we ship. Some of what this role owns is already well-defined — reviewing RFCs, stewarding language and platform standards, setting the team's AI-tooling strategy. Some of it isn't yet: Factbird is still a growing company, and part of the job is helping us figure out what technical leadership at this level should look like as we scale.

You'll thrive here if you'd rather be trusted with genuinely hard calls than manage a team, and if you can hold both the technical detail and the commercial context — cost, risk, market direction — well enough to make a technology bet you can still defend a year later.

**

What you'll do

**Architecture & technical strategy

• Own Factbird's multi-year technology strategy, and make the high-stakes architecture calls that are hard to reverse — with cost, risk, and business context factored in, not just engineering elegance

• Author and drive major RFCs from proposal through to an actual decision, and review the highest-risk architecture changes across the team

• Act as steward for our core languages and frameworks — setting standards, library choices, and the platform's overall shape

• Make build-vs-buy calls for new technical capabilities, and bring a clear point of view on emerging technologies worth adopting

• Define the observability, reliability, and security posture the platform is held to

**

Tooling & standards**

• Set the team's technical tooling and platform standards, and keep them evolving as the stack and the company grow

• Define Factbird's strategy for AI-assisted development — which tools we adopt, how we balance velocity against code quality, security, and IP risk, and where we draw the line

• Shape engineering-wide quality philosophy and help set the technical bar used in hiring interviews

• Help define shared components and reference architecture that other engineers build on, rather than reinvent

• Give input into technical org design and team topology as Engineering scales

**

Technical leadership & mentorship**

• Act as the trusted technical advisor to our Director of Engineering and the technical leadership group, partnering with Tech Leads and Product Leads on cross-team alignment

• Mentor senior engineers and Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without formal ownership of their people management

• Communicate technical vision and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including leadership

• Identify technical risks to the business early, and say so before they become expensive

• Represent Factbird's technical thinking externally where it makes sense — a talk, a blog post, an open-source contribution — though this isn't a requirement on day one

**What we’re looking for

**We're looking for someone who's already earned this kind of trust somewhere else — someone whose technical opinions carry weight because they're right more often than not, and who'd rather solve the interesting, ambiguous problem than manage the team solving it.

**

The ideal background**

• 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience, including real time spent as an architect or equivalent senior technical authority, not just a senior engineer with a bigger title

• A track record of owning multi-year technology strategy or platform architecture decisions that other teams had to live with — and that held up

• Has led major RFCs or architecture proposals cross-team, through genuine pushback, to an actual decision

• Comfortable making build-vs-buy and technology-adoption calls that account for cost, risk, and where the market is heading, not just what's technically interesting

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without needing formal authority to do it

• Practical, current experience with AI-assisted development, and a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps versus where it creates risk

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

**

Here's what you can look forward to:**

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Cristina Vartej at **crva@factbird.com
