FPRT is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

Composite Process Engineer for FirePoint Rocket Technology – Denmark

FirePoint Rocket Technology (FPRT) is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark – a brand new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. Our ambition is significant: we are scaling from the early operational phase to 300+ employees within the next 18 months.

By joining our team now, you will become part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up. We are looking for a Composite Process Engineer who will ensure that our composite manufacturing processes are safe, stable, repeatable, and ready for serial production. You will report directly to our Senior Composite Process Technology Manager and collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Materials, HSE, and Maintenance.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Translate composite technology and material requirements into practical production parameters, SOPs, and work instructions.

• Own day-to-day process stability by monitoring variation, investigating deviations, and defining corrective actions.

• Prepare and verify process readiness prior to production runs, including equipment settings, tooling, and environmental requirements.

• Lead and support technical trials, pilot builds, process prove-outs, and qualification activities.

• Support the commissioning and validation of production equipment, tooling, ovens, curing systems, and machining equipment.

• Drive continuous process improvement to reduce variability, scrap, cycle times, and material loss.

• Manage technical change control for changes to process parameters, tooling, equipment, or manufacturing methods.

Qualifications and Competencies

Professional and Operational Skills

• Degree in Engineering (BSc or MSc) in Materials, Mechanical, Chemical, Manufacturing, Composite Engineering, or equivalent strong industrial experience.

• 3–5+ years of experience in composite manufacturing, process engineering, or materials engineering.

• Practical experience with fiber-reinforced composites and thermoset resin-based processes (epoxy experience is highly desirable).

• Hands-on experience with processes such as resin infusion/transfer, filament winding, lay-up, prepreg, molding, curing, or composite machining/finishing.

• Proven experience creating or improving SOPs, work instructions, and manufacturing standards.

• Background in industrialization, production ramp-up, technology transfer, or process stabilization.

• Professional English language skills are a requirement; Danish language skills are considered an advantage.

Personal Attributes

• A hands-on, highly structured, and solution-oriented approach to your tasks.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a mindset for root-cause analysis (e.g., FMEA, 5 Whys).

• Ability to work close to shop-floor operations and maintain a clear overview under ramp-up pressure.

The Ideal Candidate

We are seeking a proactive engineer who combines strong technical capabilities with a practical understanding of production. You thrive on being close to the shop floor, working with operators to ensure that process standards are practical, understood, and followed. You are motivated by establishing structure and stability in a dynamic Greenfield environment, and you maintain a clear perspective—even when working under tight deadlines in an accelerating growth phase.

Why Apply for This Position

At FPRT, you are offered a rare career opportunity to shape one of Denmark's most unique industrial and defense-tech projects. You will take on a central role with real impact, where your expertise directly determines the integrity and manufacturability of safety-critical products. We provide a professional, international environment with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a clear mission. Additionally, we offer top-of-market compensation and modern office facilities including an on-site gym and sauna.

Practical Information

• Full-time position with an immediate start.

• Location: Vojens, Denmark.

• Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Join us in building the foundation of next generation hearing device platforms.

_Are you passionate about firmware close to the metal? Do you enjoy understanding how hardware really works and applying your expertise to build stable, efficient real time embedded systems? Would you like your work to make a real difference for millions of people living with hearing loss worldwide?

If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

About The Team

You will join our Foundation Firmware area within the R&D Device SW organization — a group of about 25 highly skilled engineers working in three scrum teams. Together we build and maintain the low level firmware that forms the foundation of all Demant hearing device software platforms.

We work closely with hardware, software and production teams throughout every stage of platform development. The atmosphere in the team is informal, friendly, and highly engaged. We believe the best results come from a fruitful team effort. We support each other, provide constructive feedback, and share knowledge and ideas to continuously improve our solutions and reach common goals.

What You Will Be Working On

Our work spans the full development flow of a resource-constrained platform — from IC specification and early bring-up, through development, verification, and production, all the way to product release. This means working in simulations, on FPGA prototypes, and on real silicon as our platforms mature. Our chipsets are internally developed, multi-core network-on-chip solutions designed for ultra-low-power audio. Our firmware platform includes hardware drivers and HAL, RTOS integration, power management, file handling, communication stacks, security, firmware update functionality and more.

You will design, develop, test, and release firmware for our custom ICs, working closely with other embedded software, hardware, production, and verification teams. Your focus will be on delivering advanced functionality with real-time guarantees for the system, while always balancing memory consumption, compute cycles, and power efficiency to meet the high standards of medical devices. This means writing safe, efficient C code that enables our hearing devices to perform reliably in highly resource-constrained environments. You will use and help improve specialized in-house tools that assist the development process, as well as automated regression tests that safeguard stability and performance of our platform as it evolves.

In summary, your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Design, develop and test efficient firmware for our chipset platform

• 
Support hardware and production teams in bring up, calibration and verification

• 
Contribute to the definition and development of our internally developed ICs

• 
Implement safe and efficient C code for real time applications

• 
Help ensure high quality through automated tests and CI/CD

• 
Participate in team ceremonies and knowledge sharing

What You Bring

You hold a degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or similar, and you have a solid hands-on experience – at least 3 years – within the following areas of embedded SW development:

• 
Embedded C programming for memory , power and time constrained systems

• 
Understanding of processor architectures and MCUs

• 
Real time operating systems (RTOS) and real-time handling of HW

• 
Reading HW schematics

• 
Working with measurement instruments such as logic analyzers or oscilloscopes

• 
Automated unit and system testing

• 
Version control systems (git)

• 
Linux, scripting and custom toolchains

You take pride in building high-quality, maintainable code and are comfortable working in large, shared code repositories with comprehensive testing and a complex build flow. You can work independently, but you also enjoy collaborating within the team and across teams to achieve the best results.

Why Demant?

At Demant, we believe in balancing professional passion with a fulfilling personal life. Our flexible hybrid work model allows you to work from home up to two days per week. Each morning, you can enjoy complimentary breakfast, and lunch is provided daily in our canteen. To support your well-being, you will have access to fitness facilities, weekly training sessions, and massage services. If you are parent, we offer attractive parental benefits, including the option to stay home when your young child is unwell. Above all, we prioritize a respectful and inclusive workplace culture where colleagues support one another, and everyone feels valued.

How To Apply

This is a full time position located at our headquarters in Smørum, Greater Copenhagen area. (Please note: We are not considering part time, consultant, or internship contracts for this role.)

Please submit your CV and a short motivation via our online portal no later than October 30th, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis. If you have questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Maja Lončar, Senior Manager System Firmware, at mjln@demant.com.

We expect to conduct first-round interviews in weeks 44-45 and second-round interviews in weeks 45-46.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Do you want to help build one coherent way for a global technology organization to deliver, bringing scaled product-centric ways of working project and program execution _together into a single system, rather than running them as separate worlds? Are you as comfortable helping shape that system and turning it into ways of working people actually use in the room with the people who'll actually use it?_We are hiring a Manager, Delivery Enablement to help shape and evolve how Pandora's D&T organization delivers. D&T spans the full range of technology that keeps Pandora running: from customer-facing platforms to manufacturing systems, ERP, logistics and operations, security, covering build, run, and operate across all of it. This role does not carry people-management responsibility. Your impact comes through the quality of what you build and how well it lands across the organization.

You'll join Delivery Enablement, a team combining operating-model design and implementation, coaching, and delivery tooling capability. It's built to make Digital & Technology (D&T) faster, clearer, and more coherent at scale. Delivery Enablement sits within Delivery Excellence, alongside the Scrum Masters, Delivery Leads, and Project and Program Managers. You will work with the wider team to shape ideas and turn them into practical ways of working across D&T.

**Your Role

**You will help harmonize and evolve how scaled agile delivery and more structured, plan-driven delivery work together, building on what already exists across D&T rather than replacing it, closing gaps only where they cause real friction. This is as much about leading change as it is about designing structure. You will also advise on structuring new or reshaping delivery entities (product lines, programs, organizational changes, or other setups) as they take shape, and help teams and entities build the capability to adopt the model as it evolves.

You will work closely with the wider delivery community, as well as product, engineering, and leadership more broadly, to facilitate structural workshops, build the case for change, and make sure what gets designed is something people actually want to use, not just a document on a shelf. A key part of the role is building the relationships, networks and momentum needed to bring ideas to life across D&T.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Co-design and evolve how scaled agile and structured, plan-driven delivery work together, harmonizing and building on existing practice rather than replacing it

• Advise on structuring new or reshaping delivery entities (product lines, programs, organizational changes, or other setups) as they take shape

• Lead workstreams that take new or improved delivery processes (for example dependency management or capacity planning) from idea through pilot, rollout, adoption and continuous improvement

• Support onboarding and capability-building for teams and entities adopting the model, working alongside the team's wider coaching capability

• Facilitate structural workshops and working sessions with the wider delivery community to shape and pressure-test the model

• Build relationships, networks and communities that help change spread and stick across D&T

• Pilot approaches, learn from feedback, and scale what works

• Help translate high-level decisions about how delivery is prioritized, funded, resourced, and executed into practical structures and standards teams can use

• Help projects and programs connect into the wider D&T Operating Model, including common governance, planning, dependency management and delivery tooling

• Contribute to keeping the model coherent as it evolves, spotting where new structures overlap or conflict with what already exists

• Provide point-in-time advisory support where operating-model gaps are most costly

• Document how the operating model works and how it evolves over time

• Build strong relationships across the wider delivery community and leadership to ensure what gets built is genuinely adopted

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• ignificant experience in delivery transformation, operating-model implementation, PMO, program/project delivery or organizational change within a large, complex technology organization

• Demonstrated experience working across both scaled/product-centric agile delivery and more structured, plan-driven delivery, with enough understanding to contribute credibly to how they work together

• Track record of taking new ways of working from idea through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement

• Ideally a mix of hands-on delivery experience and consulting or advisory experience, but real, first-hand delivery experience matters more than advisory polish alone

• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and narrative-building skills across senior and operational levels

• Comfortable leading through organizational change: helping people, not just structures, adapt as delivery models shift

• Able to build trust, networks and momentum without relying on formal authority

• Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your own analysis, design, and documentation work

• Working understanding of how delivery tooling (e.g. Jira/Confluence, or equivalent) underpins an operating model, enough to design frameworks that translate into practice, not to configure the tooling yourself

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity: building on foundations already in motion, while still shaping significant parts of the model from scratch

• Systems thinking: able to see cross-domain and cross-entity dependencies, not just local fixes

• Pragmatic bias toward incremental, adoptable change over comprehensive upfront design

• Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe) are an advantage

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Warehouse management

Network optimisation

ERP as a secondary area of expertise

Our values are simple but powerful: we strike a balance between delivering high-impact client work and prioritising wellbeing. We grow through knowledge sharing, mentoring and hands-on experience and we all contribute towards building a workplace where belonging and social connections thrive. If you would like to see more about our culture, check out our instagram and LinkedIn @UnifyPartners

If you’re ready to join an ambitious, fast-paced and forward-thinking team – apply today, we’d love to meet you.

**Responsibly 🌍🌱

**Responsibly is a VC-backed sustainability tech start-up with a vision of making every purchase in the world responsible. We're founded by serial entrepreneurs with previous successes like Ofload, Dixa and Neurons, funded by some of Europe's top VCs and angels, and now cash-flow positive with an incredibly exciting roadmap ahead.

**Let's change the world together 🎯

**More than 40% of global emissions, and really any ESG issue, are directly or indirectly impacted by procurement. Companies wield enormous purchasing power when they select and manage suppliers, so if we can put sustainability on every supplier scorecard out there, we really can change the world.

But it's hard: a company can have anywhere from 100 to 100,000 suppliers, analyzing each one's sustainability efforts is near-impossible, and most ESG ratings suck. Responsibly's AI-powered due diligence engine automates the due diligence on every supplier across every ESG data point, from risk and violations to positive actions, and turns it into insights that help companies build more sustainable supply chains.

**The engineering problem 🧩

**Most of what we do comes down to one hard thing: turning the world's messy, unstructured supplier data into something you can score.

A supplier's ESG reality is scattered across PDF sustainability reports, half-broken corporate websites, regulatory filings, news, and a dozen ERP exports that all name the same company differently. We scrape it, extract it, resolve the entities, normalise it, and put a number on it, at a scale where a single customer can have 100,000 suppliers.

That means real problems, not ticket-shaped ones. Extraction pipelines where the LLM is confidently wrong 5% of the time and you have to decide what to do about it. Entity resolution where "Nordic Steel A/S" and "NORDIC STEEL" and "Nordisk Stål" may or may not be the same company. Schema design for data that arrives in a different shape every time. If that sounds fun rather than exhausting, we should talk.

**Build next-gen products with next-gen technologies 🌟

**You'll work on a Next.js app leveraging the latest in server actions, server components and serverless architecture, building dynamic, high-performance applications with TypeScript, PostgreSQL and AI integrations.

We don't just leverage AI in our product; we're building a next-generation engineering team where you're not only encouraged but expected to adopt the latest technologies in how you work. Our engineers run agentic coding tools daily, and we'd rather talk about where they fall down than whether to use them.

**How We Work 🛠️

**

• The engineering team is small and you're reporting directly to Christian, our CTO. There is no layer between you and the decisions

• Specs are limited. You'll get a problem, what the output should look like, sometimes vaguely, and you're expected to own it from there to release; including where to ask for more information. If you'd rather have the approach agreed before you start, you will find this uncomfortable

• You choose how to solve it, and you ship it. Idea to production is days, not quarters. We run weekly sprints - considering going bi-weekly - most often with releases as the goal for the sprint. You own what you write across its whole lifecycle, including when it breaks

• There is little process versus a bigger organization, and what we're planning to adopt is mainly for the ai agents to support you

• You will sometimes be wrong, ship it, and fix it. That's okay

• We're in the office at Islands Brygge 3-5 days a week, on the water. We prefer meeting face-to-face to stay in sync and move fast, with some support for remote working

**What You'll Be Doing 🙌

**

• Take operational ownership of the code you write across the entire software development lifecycle

• Work on production code, from customer-facing features to bug fixing

• Design new features and see them through to completion

• Help build and evolve our services and infrastructure to stay ahead of our growth curve

• Turn conceptual ideas into production-ready, scalable features

• Be a big part of finding the best solutions to our daily challenges

**Requirements

**Where you lack a line on this list but can convince us you'll close the gap fast, apply anyway. We mean that literally: one of the best engineers we've had joined us as a junior and was senior within two and a half years.

**Three things we do need:

**

• A proven track record - or evidence of extraordinary ability. We care far more about what you've actually built than how many years you've been doing it. Senior engineers should have a track record of shipping and maintaining serious production software. But if you're earlier in your career and you've built something remarkable, we want to hear about it. We're looking for exceptional people, not arbitrary numbers on a CV

• Strong TypeScript, and the judgement that comes from shipping real software. You know the language deeply, but more importantly, you know what good production code looks like. You can make architectural tradeoffs, keep a codebase healthy as it grows, and tell the difference between an interesting technical problem and one that actually matters

• Strong database fundamentals, and an AI-native mindset. You understand PostgreSQL and relational data deeply — schema design, query performance, indexes, migrations, monitoring, and what happens when your database meets millions of messy real-world records. And AI isn't something you're interested in. It's already part of how you work. You use machines to build machines. You automate aggressively. You constantly look for ways to make yourself and the team 10× more effective. This is non-negotiable for us

**Nice to have, genuinely not required:

**

• Next.js specifically (Server Components, Server Actions, API routes). If you know modern React, you'll be fine within a fortnight

• Web scraping at genuinely awkward scale

• Working with large-scale data: data pipelines, analytics, transformations, or making sense of millions of messy records

• General ESG, procurement or supply-chain domain knowledge

**Benefits

****Practical stuff 📋

**

• Salary: band between 50-60k / month for a senior engineer

• ESOP: every full-time Responsibly'er owns a piece of the company. We'll show you the actual numbers, strike price, vesting, and what your slice could be worth at a few exit scenarios, before you have to decide anything

• Location: Copenhagen. You'll need to be here or firmly planning to move, and to have the right to work in Denmark. English is our working language

• Office: Islands Brygge, right on the water. Great lunch, great coffee, obligatory ping-pong table. Roughly three days a week together, flexible on which and on hours

**Also 🤩

**

• Enthusiastic, highly talented teammates from all backgrounds, always ready to share knowledge, support, and a beer

• Strong personal and professional development in a high-growth environment

• Annual company events and Friday bars

• Real impact. Life is about more than work

Combine weather modelling, machine learning and Python to turn complex data into actionable insights and production-ready solutions that support trading decisions across various power markets.

In the role, you will work at the intersection of weather data modelling and fundamental forecasting, driving research and innovation within quantitative weather analysis.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• 
conducting research in AI- and data-driven weather modelling within a power trading context

developing and improving fundamental forecasting solutions that translate weather signals into actionable power market insights

• 
performing ad hoc weather and market analyses to support trading, renewable asset balancing and commercial decision-making

• 
exploring new data sources, modelling approaches and analytical methods to strengthen our quantitative weather capabilities

• 
turning research and analysis into robust, scalable solutions that can be used directly by traders and algorithms

Together, we have built a culture where we help each other, share knowledge freely and feel comfortable asking questions or challenging ideas.

By combining multidimensional weather data, machine learning and market understanding, you’ll help shape trading decisions and optimise the balancing of our renewable asset portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

What To Expect At Dalux

At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

Ready for the next step?

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

About Dalux

Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

As soon as possible

****About The Role

**We are looking for an experienced financial-crime leader to be our registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig (HVL

• 7, stk. 2) for Monta Pay ApS under our EMI license and to lead Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) across Monta, group-wide for the Danish/EEA EMI plus UK and US compliance as those markets scale. The role is registered with Finanstilsynet, so the appointment is subject to a fit & proper assessment as a change of key function holder.

Monta Pay ApS holds an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license, granted by Finanstilsynet in April 2026. We are now migrating our financial services from Monta ApS to Monta Pay ApS, with go-live planned for Q2 2027. This is the moment the AML/FCP framework moves from build to live operation, and you will own it.

This is a high-profile, senior role. You sit at the centre of our financial-services compliance strategy as we scale, "directly exposed to the fire." You must balance obligations against resources with a risk-based approach, communicate complex issues clearly to senior leaders and the Board, and run your work-streams with strong, solution-oriented project management. In return, you have an outsized impact on how Monta builds and operates financial services compliance, and direct exposure to decision-making at a fast-growing scale-up.

You report day to day to Nick Skovsen, COO of Monta Pay ApS, with direct, independent access to the CEO and executive management of Monta Pay ApS and to its Board and Governance, Risk & Compliance Committee.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig: Act as the statutory AML-responsible person for Monta Pay under the EMI license. Approve AML/CTF policies and high-risk customer relationships escalated by the first line (PEPs, and business involving high-risk third countries). Receive internal escalations, decide on and file SARs/STRs with the FIU, and be the primary AML contact for Finanstilsynet.

• Own the Financial Crime Prevention framework: Steward Monta's FCP model (our nine-pillar "FC9" framework) covering AML/CFT, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery & corruption. Propose the risk appetite and risk-based approach for Board approval and monitor against it, and keep the framework effective and proportionate to our activities, customer types (B2B & B2C), and transaction flows.

• Fraud, transaction monitoring & customer due diligence: Own the frameworks for fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and KYC/KYB (CDD/EDD, PEP and sanctions screening) across onboarding and the lifecycle (EU and US). Set the rules, thresholds and procedures the Financial Operations team runs in the first line, and assure their quality and effectiveness.

• Sanctions & screening: Set the screening standards (lists, thresholds, re-screening frequency) and assure the quality of first-line alert handling.

• Policy suite, risk assessment & governance: Maintain the AML/CFT policy suite in the Centralised Policy Register (with version control and Board-approval tracking), and own the Business-Wide Risk Assessment (BWRA) and the AML risk assessment underpinning the framework.

• Regulatory reporting: Deliver AML and payments regulatory reporting (for example Section 99 Payment Act, KPSD, AML/CTF returns) and ensure CESOP readiness.

• Technology, controls & assurance: Work with Product and Engineering on case management, screening and monitoring tooling and AI/automation, oversee AML-relevant third parties, and run the internal-controls framework (monitoring, QA, remediation).

• Training, culture & Board liaison: Build AML/FCP training and a strong compliance culture, and advise Senior Management and the Board GRC Committee on financial-crime risk, regulatory change, and performance.

• Build and lead the team: Build out and lead the second-line FCP/AML team as volumes grow post go-live.

What You’ll Walk Into (first 6 to 12 months)

• The foundations are in place; the job is to make them operational for go-live.

• On AML: everything required to obtain the EMI license has been submitted and approved. The remaining gap is operational readiness, and that is the focus: embedding the framework in day-to-day operations and rolling it out with our customers and with colleagues across Monta.

• On FCP: This role brings centralised ownership and direction, consolidating what already exists, formalising it into clear Standard Operating Procedures, and training the relevant teams on them ahead of go-live.

• Concrete early priorities include standing up transaction monitoring and fraud detection, locking v1.0 of the policy suite (Sanctions, PEP, EDD, Outsourcing, and the Sanction-Screening and SAR/STR filing SOPs) into the Centralised Policy Register, building the regulatory-reporting data structure and CESOP readiness, finalising KYC/KYB (EU + US), and securing your Finanstilsynet fit & proper approval ahead of go-live. A structured focus-areas plan accompanies this role.

**Requirements

**

• Minimum 3 years (ideally 5+, given this is a registered key-function role) of relevant experience in the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing, ideally in a licensed EMI, payment institution, bank, or regulated fintech. Comparable experience in public authorities, AML consulting, or other AML-regulated sectors (for example gaming/gambling) will also be considered.

• Strong, current understanding of Danish AML law (Hvidvaskloven) and the EU framework (AMLD/AMLR, EBA guidelines), plus sanctions regimes. Awareness of the incoming EU AML package (AMLR + AMLD6, applying July 2027) is a plus.

• Eligibility to pass a Finanstilsynet fit & proper assessment. Prior approval in a fit & proper / key-function role at an EU financial institution is a strong advantage.

• Hands-on experience with fraud prevention and transaction monitoring, and with the underlying tooling (KYC/KYB, screening, monitoring, case management). Data literacy and comfort with AI/automation are a plus.

• Experience across risk controls, compliance, the payments area, credit management, or lines-of-defence leadership. Fintech/scale-up experience is a plus.

• Strong communication skills, autonomy, and sound decision-making, with the ability to build from a blank page and then scale a function and team.

• Analytical and investigative skills to detect patterns and anomalies in financial transactions and to investigate suspicious activity.

• Danish speaking, or willing to learn (the role is regulator-facing).

• Relevant education (economics, mathematics, law, or financial-sector training) is a plus.

• No prior convictions or legal issues that would make the candidate unfit for the role, particularly offences related to financial crime, fraud, money laundering, or other criminal activities undermining trust and integrity.

_If this sounds like you, we look forward to receiving your application.

_Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

**The Role & Department

The role is based in Denmark and reports to the Director of QA Commercial – Drug Substance & Intermediates.

You will be part of an experienced and highly skilled QA organization, with this position holding primary accountability for Drug Substance and Biological Intermediates across commercial supply chains. The role interfaces closely with CMOs, partners, and internal subject matter experts across Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain.

**Key Responsibilities

**_**General Compliance

**_

• Lead QA representation for Drug Substance and Biological Intermediate in cross-functional Genmab project groups and key external collaborations, providing expert input and ensuring alignment with QA governance and regulatory expectations

• Act as a QA subject matter expert on GMP for biologics Drug Substance and Biological Intermediates, providing expert guidance, supporting resolution of complex quality issues, and ensuring consistent application of quality standards

• Gain and maintain expert knowledge of applicable GMP legislation, guidelines, and industry practices relevant to DS and BI manufacturing; assess relevance for Genmab activities and ensure structured dissemination of applicable updates to relevant stakeholders

• Lead the resolution of DS- and BI-related quality issues in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, escalating critical or high-risk matters as appropriate to ensure timely and compliant decision-making

_Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS)

_

• Continuously improving PQS: Participate in developing, maintaining, and continuously improving Genmab’s Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) in alignment with applicable GMP and GDP requirements

• Quality Risk Management: Apply and support quality risk management principles in complex PQS activities, providing expert input to risk assessments and mitigation actions

• Procedures: Review/authoring and approval of SOPs, Work Instructions, templates and forms within assigned areas, and support document updates in accordance with the PQS

• Deviation, CAPA, Change Control: Handle and support deviations, CAPAs and change controls, providing expert input and ensuring compliance with procedures and applicable regulatory requirements

• Inspections & Audits: Participate in audits and inspections performed by national authorities and internal or external auditors as required. Support audit and inspection readiness by ensuring documentation, procedures and processes within assigned scope are maintained in compliance with company standards and applicable regulations. Support audit and inspection preparation and conduct through back-office activities, documentation and presentation support

• QMR: Provide expert input to Quality Management Reviews (QMRs) as part of the PQS, contributing to data analysis, trend interpretation and identification of quality risks and improvement opportunities

Pack Tech, a packaging company founded in Denmark in 1946, is looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist to join our Quality team at our headquarters in Hellerup.

We develop and supply packaging solutions primarily for the beauty and personal care industry and work with manufacturing partners across Asia and Europe. We are also the company behind Ocean Waste Plastic (OWP), our own initiative for collecting and recycling ocean- and river plastic waste.

About the role

As our Quality Assurance Specialist, you will become part of a Quality team and report directly to the Head of Quality. You will work closely with the Head of Quality and Quality Assistants, as well as colleagues across Sales, Purchasing, Logistics and Product Development at our Danish headquarters.

You will also collaborate closely with our colleagues at our office in China and with manufacturing partners in both Asia and Europe.

The role has a strong focus on maintaining and developing our Quality Management System, supplier qualification, complaint and CAPA handling, audits, and ensuring that quality requirements are properly implemented and documented throughout our supply chain.

As Pack Tech operates in a fast-moving and customer-focused environment, an important part of the role is being able to balance solid QA processes with a practical and service-minded approach.

Your primary responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining and continuously improving our ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 Quality and Environmental Management Systems, including audits, procedures & records.

• Managing supplier qualification and ongoing supplier evaluation and audits, including QA and documentation related to relevant packaging requirements.

• Handling customer complaints, including CAPA and 8D processes, in cooperation with colleagues and manufacturing suppliers.

• Coordinating customer audits of Pack Tech, including preparation, participation and follow-up.

• Managing customer supplier qualification of Pack Tech, including questionnaires, documentation requests and follow-up.

• Working closely with our China office on supplier quality, quality documentation and follow-up with manufacturing suppliers.

Who you are

We are looking for someone with experience or education within Quality Assurance, Quality Management or a related field.

You do not necessarily need to come from the packaging industry, but you should be comfortable working systematically with quality processes and documentation.

We expect that you:

• Have experience with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 QMS processes.

• Have a strong understanding of QA principles such as supplier qualification, audits, non-conformities, root cause analysis and CAPA.

• Are structured and comfortable working with procedures and documentation without losing sight of practical business needs.

• Have strong written and spoken English skills and communicate confidently with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the world.

Experience with packaging, plastics, PPWR or other regulatory requirements affecting packaging is an advantage but not a requirement.

The practicalities

The position is based at our headquarters in Hellerup (Greater Copenhagen), Denmark. Full-time presence in the office is expected, as the role involves close collaboration across departments.

Some travel should be expected in connection with audits with manufacturing suppliers in Europe.

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible, so please apply today.

For questions about the position, please contact Head of Quality Ann Sofie Gade at ans@packtech1946.com.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Management

• Executing projects within your area in close collaboration with your team, identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

• Focusing on overall project planning, ensuring delivery quality, and planning the necessary resources to maintain schedule and cost targets.

• Estimating costs and planning budgets in collaboration with our engineers and specialists.

• Managing project scope and ensuring that changes are analysed and agreed upon with stakeholders.

• Work across the boundaries and you like to work in a diverse and international environment

• Create results through efficient project management and communication, leveraging from your relations to your team and stakeholder

• Have a personal commitment, known for your effectiveness and an open management style and know the impotency to win as a team

**What You Bring To The Role

• 6–10 years of experience with a proven track record in DCS and ECS/PLC Process Automation projects, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience with on-site commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, and UAT.

• Project Management certification, e.g. PMP or PRINCE2, is preferred.

jobs.occupation: Lead Developer to support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced developer interested in building high-quality software and contributing to critical applications that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment, where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with two Lead Developers and five Senior Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC.

Your role

As a Lead Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative department of approximately 23 developers who design, develop and maintain the internal applications supporting our current and future business services. If you are curious about Nordic RCC and what we do, learn more about our innovative solutions on the Nordic RCC webpage.

Your role combines hands-on development with broader technical leadership. You will work closely with Application Architects to help define and communicate technical direction, translate architectural principles into practical solutions and promote consistency across our application landscape.

You will connect technical expertise across teams, identify shared challenges, and contribute to reusable, sustainable solutions. Through cross-departmental collaboration, you will build alignment around technical opportunities, constraints, and impacts across the organization.

What you will do :

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

• 
Set and communicate technical direction with Application Architects, translating architectural principles and business needs into practical solutions and Architecture Decision Records

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

• 
Support operational excellence by helping diagnose and resolve production issues and continuously optimize existing systems

• 
Share knowledge and technical expertise supporting colleagues’ professional development and help strengthen development practices across the team. This role does not include formal line-management responsibilities

Technology Stack:

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs

• 
Databases & storage Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX

• 
Tooling and collaboration  Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines

We’re looking for someone with:

• 
Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

• 
Proven Expertise: Minimum 5 years’ experience as full-stack developer in C# for the .NET platform. Experience providing technical guidance, facilitating technical decisions, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating development activities is a definite plus.

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling basis up until the right candidate has been found.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

If you have any questions, please contact Pernille Yde Juul Hansen, Manager, Application Development pyh@nordic-rcc.net / +45 3092 3111.

Are you a recent or upcoming graduate interested in making an impact? Become part of a global and successful MedTech company located in the heart of Copenhagen.

About 3Shape

Things have moved fast at 3Shape ever since our founding in 2000. 3Shape specializes in developing 3D scanning and software technology solutions that enable dental and hearing professionals to treat more people more effectively, and with improved care. Every second of every day, a 3Shape scanner is used all around the globe. A number which is skyrocketing and cementing our position as technology and industry leader, Danish growth comet and unicorn company. We are a truly international workplace with 50+ nationalities and more than 2200 employees globally. We are headquartered in Denmark in the center of vibrant Copenhagen at Kongens Nytorv.

About the 3Shape 2-Year Graduate Program

3Shape’s two-year Graduate Program serves as a launchpad for a high-impact career. Graduates rotate through three different departments within the Technical Track, with the possibility of an international assignment. This program gives talented and motivated young professionals the chance to acquire new knowledge, expand their skillset, and gain valuable expertise from the very beginning. Graduates gain unique insights into the core of our business and play an essential role in our strategy to develop future leaders and specialists at 3Shape.

Become Our Next Technical Graduate

As a 3Shape Graduate, you will be a valued team member, tackle complex business challenges, and become part of an extensive network of professionals in a global organization. We offer a steep learning curve and expect a lot from you, but in return, you will have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.

• Rotate through three departments (8 months each) working with e.g., UX/UI, Software Development, Computer Science, IT, Data, Discovery, Regulatory Affairs, Product Management, and Production and Supply Chain.

• Play an essential role in an international and innovative organization that is constantly evolving.

• Lead and contribute to real projects with measurable impact.

• Broaden your horizons by working as part of integrated teams across the globe and collaborating with people from diverse backgrounds.

• Join a well-established, social, and friendly community of current and former Graduates.

• Receive ongoing feedback, coaching, and support from rotation managers, a mentor, and a buddy.

We Fuel Your Career With

• Comprehensive onboarding - including an offsite, teambuilding, and networking with the Senior Leadership Team.

• Regular meetings with your Graduate Manager focused on your development and well-being.

• Multiple training sessions (such as Case Challenge, People Module, Technical Training, etc.).

• A production visit to our site in Poland.

• Quarterly Graduate-community activities with Graduates from our two cohorts

What Makes a 3Shape Graduate?

You are about to complete or have just completed a master’s degree. You have achieved top academic results and are highly proficient in English. You are enthusiastic, focused, and eager to learn.

• An excellent collaborator with an empathetic approach and a global mindset.

• Versatile and adaptable.

• Thrives in an international environment.

• Motivated to take responsibility.

• Strong analytical thinker with solid problem-solving skills.

• Brings positive energy and is eager to apply knowledge and make an impact.

What 3Shape Offers

• A vibrant, international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled colleagues - over 20 nationalities represented in our Denmark-based office.

• An attractive healthcare package

• Daily breakfast, Friday juices, and healthy lunches prepared by our private chefs.

• A good social work environment with many optional activities and clubs, from wine and beer tastings to board games, running, and paddle.

• Modern offices and R&D labs in downtown Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

Application Process

• Application deadline: 15/12/2026

• Graduate Program start date: 01/09/2027

• To apply, click "Apply Now" and attach your CV, answer two screening questions, and submit your academic records. Only complete applications will be considered.

• Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis – please apply as soon as possible.

• After a successful application and initial video call screening, candidates will be invited to our headquarters in Copenhagen for an assessment center on Friday, January 29th.

• If you have questions about the position or process, contact people@3shape.com.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

Job Description

How does Europe reap the benefits of AI, while remaining secure, sovereign and true to its democratic values? These are some of the questions that Netcompany Institute has set out to answer, and we are looking for two student assistants to help us do just that.

Netcompany Institute is a new analytical unit providing data-driven analyses of how AI and digitalization affect Europe. The aim is to strengthen the evidence base for public debate and help decision-makers navigate the choices that will shape Europe’s digital future.  You'll join a small team: a Chief Economist and two full-time Analytics Consultants.

Responsibilities

You will support analyses throughout their lifecycle – from framing questions to communicating results. Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Monitor policy developments and research on AI and digitalisation in Europe

• Collect and structure data from Eurostat, OECD and statistical offices

• Produce descriptive statistics, tables and charts publication-ready

• Write analytical text and fact-check sources

Responsibility grows with experience. At the beginning you will work closely with an Analytics Consultant on clearly defined tasks; over time we expect you to take ownership of analyses in your own right.

How we work with AI

AI tools are integral to our work. We use them for literature searches, data work and monitoring – so human time focuses on what matters most: finding the right questions, interpreting results and communicating them clearly. You don't need expertise at the start, but must be willing to learn and maintain high accuracy standards.

About you

We are looking for two students who can each work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to publication deadlines and events. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in economics, political science, statistics, data science or a similar field.

• Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a must; Danish is an advantage.

• Are comfortable working with data: confident in Excel and ideally familiar with Python, R, Stata or a similar tool.

• Are curious about how AI and digitalisation are changing European economies and societies

• Are willing to learn to use AI tools effectively in your own work, and to keep relating output critically to prior knowledge and theory.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, GP's, Specialist Clinics & Private Hospitals
jobs.description:
Lead the team. Grow the business. Shape what comes next.

Are you ready to lead commercial growth across a diverse and important healthcare customer segment? This is a visible leadership role where strategy, customer insight and an engaged sales team come together with real ownership of commercial performance and the future direction of the business.

At Mediq Denmark, you will lead a team of 8 sales professionals supporting GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals. You will work closely with the Sales Director to turn market insight into action, strengthen customer partnerships and identify the opportunities that can move the segment forward.

This is a role for a leader who enjoys being close to the market. One day you may be shaping the sales strategy or challenging a business case; the next, joining a strategic customer discussion, coaching a colleague or turning a new idea into a practical growth plan.

Your impact

You will set the direction for the segment and translate ambition into profitable, sustainable growth. With ownership of the sales budget, forecast and commercial performance, you will keep customer value, market opportunities and team development firmly in focus.

• Develop and execute the sales strategy for GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals, supported by clear segmentation, targeting and account plans.

• Strengthen relationships across the customer landscape, from individual practices to strategic private hospital accounts, and take an active role in key negotiations and customer meetings.

• Use customer, market and competitor insight to identify growth opportunities, shape go-to-market plans and guide pricing and commercial decisions.

• Lead, coach and develop eight sales professionals, creating clear priorities, accountability and the confidence to perform at their best.

• Connect Sales with Category, Product Management and Sourcing to align the assortment, supplier strategy and commercial priorities around a strong customer experience.

What you bring

We are looking for a commercially curious and customer-focused sales leader who sees the bigger picture, acts with pace and brings people with them. You are comfortable moving between strategic business development and hands-on sales leadership, and you know when to explore the detail and when to step back and set direction.

• At least five years of documented experience in a comparable commercial and leadership role, including leading, coaching and developing sales professionals.

• A strong track record in sales execution, performance management and working with sales processes at both operational and strategic level.

• Strong commercial and analytical judgement, including the ability to develop and assess business cases and make sound pricing and growth decisions.

• Confident negotiation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, supported by a structured and pragmatic approach to projects and processes.

• High energy, clear ownership and the ability to prioritise in a fast-paced and complex environment.

• Fluency in Danish and English. Experience from MedTech or the healthcare sector is an advantage.

Why join Mediq?

You will join a role where sales leadership is close to the action and your decisions will be visible. You will have the opportunity to influence commercial direction, build stronger customer partnerships and develop a team that can take this customer segment into its next chapter.

Our values - Customer Drive, Champion Spirit and Caring Heart - guide how we work, with a constant focus on creating value for patients.

Ready to lead the next stage of growth?

Bring your commercial leadership, customer focus and energy to Mediq. Help us strengthen the business, develop our people and build what comes next for customers across Denmark.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark.

Interested?

Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to the future of Mediq Denmark.

We will be reviewing applications and interviewing candidates on a rolling basis as suitable candidates are identified. For this reason, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

About Mediq

Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics and home care, we help ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

At Mediq, we offer jobs that change lives. Join us.

Are you a people-focused leader who thrives on guiding teams toward shared goals? We’re looking for a supervisor who can inspire and develop a team while ensuring effective collaboration and results.
