jobs.occupation: Start your Analyst career with Manager Selection
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**_Start your analyst career in investment management with our Manager Selection Team, where you will work with leading global asset managers and develop expertise across diverse asset classes. You will be part of a collaborative environment that offers significant learning opportunities and career progression. This role provides the foundation for building specialised knowledge in investment strategy and portfolio management.

_But first, who are we at Danske Bank?   Danske Bank, the largest bank in Denmark, serves a diverse range of customers from individuals and businesses to large institutional clients. At Danske Bank, we create an environment where creativity and strategic thinking are central to all our activities.

LC&I business unit supports Danske Banks’ most sophisticated customers across the Nordics with their financing and transaction needs. Our experts across areas such as Corporate Finance, Markets, Transaction banking, Asset Management and Investor Services – are highly skilled and engage with our customers on some of the most complex transactions in the Nordics.

**What You Will Be Doing

**Join the Manager Selection Team at Danske Bank Asset Management. The team is responsible for identifying, selecting and monitoring asset managers and investment funds used across Danske Bank's investment platform. You will collaborate with portfolio managers and analysts to deliver multi-asset portfolio solutions. Working closely with internal teams and external partners, you will contribute to strategic decisions that shape our investment products and client outcomes.

• Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses of portfolio management teams and investment strategies

• Support manager searches, due diligence reviews and investment recommendation processes on internal and external opportunities

• Monitor performance, risk and key investment characteristics across various asset classes and investment products

• Contribute to the design and management of asset class specific investment strategies

• Collaborate with portfolio managers and analysts on multi-asset solutions

**About You

**

• Academic background in investment analysis, finance, economics, or related field

• Analytical mindset with structured approach to problem-solving

• Strong collaborative skills and ability to work with diverse stakeholders

• Interest in financial markets and investment management

• Clear communication skills for internal and external interactions

It would be beneficial if you have some exposure to financial analysis or investment concepts, though we welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives to learn and develop in this area.

**What We Offer You

**Join our First Year Analyst programme, which includes dedicated sessions and social events to ease your transition into our culture and operations. You will build valuable connections across the organisation while developing both personally and professionally. Furthermore, we provide substantial learning opportunities where you will acquire specialised knowledge in investment strategy, asset allocation, and manager selection.

You will work in our Copenhagen office with a hybrid model of 3 to 4 days per week to support collaboration and knowledge sharing. As Manager Selection is a strategic focus area, you will gradually take on more responsibility as the business develops and grows.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would love to hear from candidates who are ready to develop their career in investment management. Please reach out to Torben Badsberg Overgaard, Head of Manager Selection, at toov@danskebank.dk or Carla Carlotta Zoe Steuer, Senior Portfolio Manager with any questions.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We're looking forward to exploring the possibilities with you! Starting a career at Danske Bank means joining a collaborative environment where you can engage actively from day one. As a full-time employee, you will be part of our Young Minds community, designed to help you grow personally and professionally through development sessions and social events with your peers. If you are looking for a rewarding and interesting opportunity, apply now and become part of our team! #YP

**About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

Would you enjoy leading drug development for rare conditions? Are you a medic with experience designing clinical trials and interacting with regulatory authorities?

_If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Medical Director, Clinical Development, Endocrine & Rare Diseases

_

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Medical Director to join our team. As a member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in driving the design, safety monitoring, and data analysis within the Endocrine and Rare Disease Medical Sciences area. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will join the Clinical Development team, being part of the Endocrine & Rare Disease Medical Sciences organization. You will report directly to the VP of Clinical Science who is based in the US. You will be based in Hellerup together with the Danish team.

Since you will join a team based in different time zones, you must be available for evening meetings. This position also may require occasional international travel.

Your key responsibilities will be

• Contribute to formulation and implementation of the Clinical Development Plan

• Leverage medical expertise and hands-on clinical experience to promote relevance and rigor of the development program

• For clinical trials: design, provide overall oversight, and support site and subject retention

• Serve as a Medical Monitor for clinical trials, ensure study integrity, and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Provide leadership to teams of medical monitors and study teams

• Ensure successful completion of trial-related documents (including clinical trial protocols, investigator brochures, medical monitoring plans, site training materials, clinical study reports, health authority responses, standard operating procedures, etc.) with cross-functional team members

• Ensure study integrity, and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Analyze, evaluate, interpret, and report clinical data

• Anticipate and solve complex drug development problems

• Contribute to regulatory strategy

• Contribute to drafting and reviewing of clinical documents, manuscripts, presentations, and regulatory submissions

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant science, medical information, good clinical practices, and regulatory guidance

• Collaborate with—and serve as a clinical research resource for—cross-functional colleagues (e.g. in clinical operations, statistics, regulatory affairs, medical affairs, health economics outcomes research, commercial, finance) to optimize product development

• Contribute to (and may be asked to represent the clinical development department in) corporate strategic and organizational initiatives

• Cultivate relationships with investigative sites, clinical consultants, and key opinion leaders to represent the interests of the company

• Assist in portfolio management and commercial activities as needed

• Complete assigned tasks thoroughly, accurately, and on time

• Adhere to rigorous ethical standards

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold an M.D. degree and preferably also a Ph.D. degree. You have hands-on experience treating patients.

Furthermore, you have:

• At least 5-7 years of industry experience (other relevant experience e.g., post-graduate experience in the clinical and/or academic realms may also be considered on a case-by-case basis).

• Strong track record of scientific and clinical inquiry

• Possess excellent communication skills (written and oral)

• Demonstrate sound judgement in terms of handling complex, confidential, and regulated information

Key competencies:

You have a proven ability to learn quickly, even in fast‑paced environments.

You take ownership of your work, lead by example, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across the organization. You are trusted by others for your sound judgment and discretion, particularly when handling confidential, sensitive, or regulated information.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to be comfortable working with complex instructions, managing multiple priorities, and consistently maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Travel: 20-30 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Are you motivated by optimization and business-critical application operations, and do you have strong Linux expertise? If so, you could be the Linux Operations Engineer we are looking for to join one of our Operations teams, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing some of Denmark’s most innovative IT solutions.

Responsibilities and technologies

As our new Linux Operations Engineer, you will become part of Netcompany Operations, a department responsible for everything from application operations to infrastructure management across two data centers. You will join a small, highly skilled team focused on the optimization and operation of large, complex Enterprise Linux environments.

We are involved in every stage of the lifecycle: from proposal development and project delivery to daily operations, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. Our customer base is highly diverse, ranging from small private companies to large public-sector initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a key link between our development teams and infrastructure specialists, playing a central role in delivering stable and efficient solutions.

As a Linux Operations Engineer, your responsibilites will typically include:

• Deploying, operating, and maintaining environments and applications based on Linux, Java, Oracle, and other modern technologies.

• Configuring, troubleshooting, and optimizing systems in a technically challenging environment, with ownership of specific systems and technologies.

• Automating and streamlining operational tasks through scripting and programming.

• Participating in ongoing operations projects, taking responsibility for tasks aligned with your experience and professional development.

About you

To succeed in this role, we expect you to:

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field or possess an equivalent level of qualification.

• Be motivated by delivering high-quality business-critical and mission-critical solutions.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

We encourage you to apply even if your educational background differs from the above, provided you have relevant qualifications and/or professional experience from a similar position.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

**Are you passionate about leading product teams and ensuring technology investments deliver real business value? Then we might have just the job for you at Specsavers.

**_Join Specsavers as our new Technology Product Manager for our Clinical Product Team and play a key role in shaping product strategy, enabling high-performing teams, and driving the delivery of technology solutions across Northern Europe. This role is a parental cover for 12 months.

_**Your role

**As our Technology Product Manager, you will be responsible for leading our Clinical product team and creating the conditions for them to deliver outstanding business value and setting the Strategic direction for the product together with Heads of Product Management and Architects, as well as driving the product Vision together with the Product Owner.

You will work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure product development aligns with business priorities and strategic goals. Acting as both a people leader and product leader, you will support your teams in delivering valuable outcomes while fostering a collaborative and agile culture. You are a strong communicator who enjoys bringing people together, navigating complexity, and enabling others to succeed.

**Key Responsibilities Include

**

• Lead and support product teams to deliver valuable business outcomes.

• Drive alignment between product vision, delivery plans, and business objectives.

• Partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and stakeholders to enable successful product delivery.

• Foster collaboration, agile ways of working, and continuous improvement across teams.

• Provide people leadership, coaching, and development for team members.

• Build strong stakeholder relationships and communicate product progress, priorities, and outcomes.

• Remove barriers and help teams overcome challenges that impact delivery.

• Support and strengthen a product-led mindset across the organisation.

**Your new team

**You'll Join The Northern Europe Technology Function And Lead Our Clinical Product Team, Which Consist Of Seven Team Members.The Team Is Accountable For Maintaining And Developing Our Technology Platform For Optics, In Collaboration With Various Vendors. The Platform Supports Our Instore Customer Journey And Consists Of

• Clinical Eye Examination- and Integration platform.

• Clinical Devices for capture of Eye Measurements and EyeHelth examinations, and

• Clinical Journals.

In this role, you'll lead product teams that develop and deliver technology solutions supporting colleagues, customers, and business operations across Northern Europe. Together, you'll focus on creating value through strong product leadership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**What are we looking for?

**We are preferably looking for a candidate with the following competencies:

• Proven experience in Product Management and leading technology product teams in complex environments.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across all levels of an organisation.

• Deep understanding of agile product development, delivery, and leadership.

• Experience developing people, building high-performing teams, and driving business value through technology investments.

• Strong commercial awareness with the ability to align product strategy, customer needs, and business objectives.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have

**

• Experience working across multiple countries, markets, or distributed teams.

• Experience with coaching, mentoring, facilitation, or organisational change initiatives.

• Knowledge of retail, healthcare, optometry, or audiology environments.

• Experience working within large-scale agile organisations and product-led operating models.

**As a Person, We Believe That You Are

**

• A collaborative and inspiring leader who empowers others to succeed.

• Curious and proactive, with a continuous improvement mindset.

• An excellent communicator who builds trust and navigates complexity with confidence.

• Structured and pragmatic, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Solution-oriented and motivated by creating value for customers and the business.

**What Awaits You Upon Joining Specsavers

**At Specsavers, you'll get more than just a job. You will join us on a journey to make eye health and hearing services accessible to everyone. We offer an exciting and challenging role in an organisation with strong ambitions, where you'll be part of a collaborative and supportive culture.

**Joining Us, You’ll Get

**

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• A collaborative and inclusive workplace.

• The opportunity to lead talented product teams in an international environment.

• The chance to influence technology products and services used across multiple countries.

• A meaningful role where your leadership helps shape business outcomes and customer experiences.

**Is this your next step? Then apply today

**To apply, please send us your CV using the button below. We want to respect your time, so including an application letter is optional. Feel free to apply as soon as possible. Please avoid including any photos or references to your age in your CV. It contributes to a fairer and more unbiased assessment.

We review CVs and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. Our recruitment process typically consists of an initial screening, two rounds of interviews, and a personality assessment feedback session.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact the hiring manager Lea Lie Kirk Holdensen by e-mail: lea.holdensen@specsavers.com.

**Diversity & Inclusion at Specsavers

**Specsavers will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected factor.

In line with our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we integrate these principles into all aspects of our work, from product development to team building.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Product Manager, Sloped Roof Windows
jobs.description:
Step into a role where commercial insight meets strategic impact. If you are passionate about understanding customer needs, identifying new growth opportunities and shaping the future of one of the most important product categories in VELUX, you could be our next Commercial Product Manager.

Meet your future team

You will join the Sloped Roof Windows Category team at our Head Office in Hørsholm. The team plays a central role in shaping the future of our largest and most important product category, working at the intersection of customer needs, innovation, strategy and commercial performance.

Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. You will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Product Development, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations and regional organisations around the world. Together, we translate market opportunities and customer insights into product portfolio decisions that drive sustainable and profitable growth.

The team is characterised by a high level of ambition, an informal and collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to creating meaningful business impact.

What We Offer

This is not a traditional product management role focused on maintaining an existing portfolio. Instead, you will play a key role in identifying where future growth will come from, shaping strategic choices and mobilising the organisation to bring them to life.

You will gain exposure across our international business, collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence decisions with significant commercial impact. In return, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while helping shape the future of healthy, comfortable and sustainable living.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Identify and develop growth opportunities across products, solutions, customer segments and markets

• Translate customer, market and commercial insights into portfolio recommendations and compelling business cases

• Strengthen value propositions, positioning, pricing and category differentiation to improve commercial performance

• Drive portfolio priorities, product launches and strategic category initiatives in close collaboration with regional and functional stakeholders

You should expect some travel, both within Denmark and internationally, to engage with customers, markets and colleagues across our global organisation.

What You Will Bring

You are commercially minded, customer-focused and motivated by complex business challenges. You enjoy connecting strategic thinking with practical execution and thrive in environments where collaboration, influence and analytical thinking are key to success.

You know how to turn insights into action, create alignment among diverse stakeholders and move initiatives forward. Most importantly, you are motivated by delivering meaningful business results and helping shape the future direction of a category.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from product management, category management, business development, commercial strategy or a comparable role, ideally within an international organisation

• Have strong commercial and analytical capabilities and can build robust business cases based on data, customer understanding and sound judgement

• Are skilled at influencing decisions, communicating recommendations clearly and creating alignment across functions and organisational levels

• Work in a structured and proactive manner, balancing multiple priorities while driving initiatives forward with ownership and energy

Experience from building materials, construction, durable goods, consumer products or another product-oriented industry is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are equally interested in candidates who bring a fresh commercial perspective and can apply it successfully within our business.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect from our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark.

Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

In the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected and valued.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.occupation: Excellence & Engagement Manager - Health, Safety & Security
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure employees at DFDS go to work for DFDS and return safely and unharmed home to their loved ones? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role  Be part of the movement - and play your part.   As Excellence & Engagement Manager in the Global Health, Safety & Security Team, you will be part of the continuous strengthening of DFDS’ health, safety and security culture. This is a new global role, and we expect you to participate in shaping and developing it. We anticipate that you will contribute by developing, implementing and continuously improving the frameworks, standards, tools, learning processes, communications and engagement activities that enable a strong Health, Safety & Security (HSS) performance across DFDS landside operations.

You will be responsible for ensuring consistent and effective deployment of group-wide HSS initiatives across DFDS operations area, supporting operational teams in anchoring safe and secure behaviors. The role works closely with the HSS Business Partners, other operational stakeholders and senior management to strengthen organizational learning, capability, culture and performance.

The role reports directly to the Global Director for HSS, and you will be based at our Global Headquarters in the port of Copenhagen. The role requires on-site presence.

What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:  **Role

**As Excellence & Engagement Manager - HSS you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role but the initial areas we expect you to cover are:

• Develop, coordinate and monitor global HSS initiatives.

• Develop, coordinate and maintain global HSS culture-building activities, campaigns and engagement programs aiming to strengthen safe and secure behaviors.

• Maintain and continuously improve our HSSEQ Management System.

• Develop, implement and continuously improve a Managers Toolkit on HSS.

• Manage Performance Monitoring and Improvement related to HSS in close collaboration with HSS Business Partners.

• Develop and coordinate DFDS’ organizational learning processes on HSS, ensuring learnings from incidents, audits etc. are translated into practical improvements and shared across the organization.

• Support leadership teams in understanding and applying HSS frameworks, standards and improvement methodologies.

• Build strong working relationships with operational leaders, local HSS teams, and functional stakeholders.

About You We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are passionate about health, safety & security, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, are a good listener and can digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

You Are Structured, Self-supporting And Capable Of Both Prioritizing And Multitasking In a Demanding Environment. Moreover, We Imagine That The Ideal Candidate Brings

• Ability to think strategically, translating HSS strategy into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

• A passion for building a strong HSS culture through engagement, communication and leadership influence.

• Experience in developing and implementing standards, frameworks and management systems within operational environments.

• Natural collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.

• Strong organizing skills, bringing structure, governance and consistency to complex initiatives.

• Capability to operate between strategy and execution, balancing long-term objectives with day-to-day deliveries, in a global corporate function.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, good listening abilities, and the ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

• A self-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize and multitask in a demanding environment.

**Furthermore, You Have

**

• A degree in business, organizational development, safety or security management, or related field.

• Proven experience (5+ years) within safety or security related functions in a global or matrixed organization.

• Experience in shipping, logistics, or industrial sectors is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of safety/security culture principles and organizational behavior is an advantage.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Knowledge of or certification in change management methodologies is a plus.

• Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is an advantage.

• Proficiency in English (oral and written) as English is corporate language.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 suite.

• Experience in utilizing AI tools is an advantage.

Working at DFDS  Join the movement and grow with us.  While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.   If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your resume as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director HSS (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you.   This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

Requirements

Experience

> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

Operating Skills

> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

At Mind Energy, technology enables how we trade, optimise and evolve in a fast-moving energy market. As our Senior Software Engineer, you take a central role in building and evolving the digital backbone that supports critical business decisions every day.

You combine strong technical depth with architectural thinking and a hands-on engineering mindset. Working closely with experienced colleagues across development and business, you help shape scalable systems, influence technical direction and raise the engineering bar around you.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

In this role, you take an active par t in shaping the technical direction of our digital landscape. You modernise existing systems, build new solutions and turn complexity into reliable, scalable software that supports both trading and long-term growth.

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

You’ll join an autonomous, cross-functional team with end-to-end ownership of its domain, spanning design, architecture, implementation and operations.

Together, you work closely with business stakeholders to translate complex needs into robust, scalable and secure solutions that create real value for our customers.

At Mind Energy, we value both independence and collaboration.

Your work ranges from refining existing systems to shaping entirely new solutions, always with a clear sense of ownership and responsibility. You approach complexity with curiosity and turn challenges into solutions built to last.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are an experienced engineer who thrives with ownership, technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence how solutions are designed and built. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural understanding and the confidence to challenge decisions when better

solutions exist.

We imagine that you bring:

If this sounds like the right fit for you - do not wait - send your resume as soon as you can, and no later than November 6, 2026.

What if your code shaped the future of energy?

Energy is changing. Fast. And at Mind Energy, we’re right at the epicentre of it all.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**Why this role is important to us

As Senior Director, Enterprise Applications, you will own the strategy, governance, and operational health of Workday and Salesforce across the organization. This is a senior leadership position with high visibility across Group IT, P&C, and Sales, providing direct influence over the evolution of two of SimCorp's most business-critical enterprise platforms.

You will step directly into a strategic and business-critical transformation initiative: the migration of financial processes and data from Workday to SAP S/4HANA, with a planned go-live in January 2027. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly engage in data mapping, integration planning, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution from day one.

**

• 5 individual contributors reporting directly to the role

• 2 managers reporting directly to the role

• 29 employees in total across the Enterprise Applications area

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Establish and chair platform governance forums with P&C, Sales, Customer Success, and other key stakeholders to prioritize enhancements, integrations, releases, and investment decisions

• Drive continuous improvement and adoption of platform capabilities to increase business value, operational efficiency, and user experience across the organization

**What We Value

**

• 5+ years of people management experience leading teams of platform owners, administrators, business analysts, or related application specialists

• A proven track record of establishing and operating governance models for enterprise platforms in a global, regulated, or financial services environment

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration architectures.

• Experience managing SaaS vendors, software licensing, commercial agreements, and strategic partner relationships

• Solid knowledge of data privacy, risk, and security frameworks, including GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at both executive and technical levels

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we provide custom paths for professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**For Poland Location

**Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

**Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Join IO Interactive’s Finance team at our Copenhagen Studio as Finance Director and play a key role in shaping the financial direction of a multi-studio, multi-entity games company. You will lead the Finance function, drive the automation of the finance processes, and act as the CFO's trusted partner and second-in-command. Responsible for the day-to-day leadership of Finance while providing strategic, financial, and commercial guidance that supports IO Interactive's continued growth across all studios.

If you are a strategic finance leader who combines commercial understanding with strong technical expertise, we would love to meet you.

**Please note that our finance team is primarily based in Copenhagen, and we would love local leadership; this position requires you to be on-site at our Copenhagen studio.

****What You Will Do

****Finance Leadership

**

• Lead the day-to-day Finance organisation across IO Interactive's global studios.

• Manage, drive, mentor, and develop Finance team members while building a high-performing and collaborative function.

• Drive the ongoing project of full automation of the finance process

• Act as the CFO's right-hand and trusted sparring partner on both operational and strategic matters.

**

• Support decision-making related to investments, headcount planning, studio growth and organisational development.

• Partner with Production, Commercial, Technology and Corporate leadership on financial performance and business priorities.

**Controlling & Governance

**

• Upscale and improve Financial and Business controlling.

• Oversee Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling activities across the organisation.

**Who You Are

**

• Significant experience in a senior Finance leadership role.

• Strong background across Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling.

• Experience leading and driving Finance teams in a complex international organisation.

• Strong commercial mindset with the ability to influence strategic business decisions.

• Experience partnering with executive stakeholders and senior leadership teams.

• Excellent understanding of financial reporting, governance, planning, and performance management.

**We would love it if you had

**

• Experience with ERP transformations

• Experience with Unit4 or similar ERP systems.

**Who We Are

**IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, and Brighton. We know that to achieve those goals, we need courage, talented people, and a great working environment—and we do our utmost to have all of that. Across our multiple studios, we’re working on several projects. Crucially, though, we’re all one team. With more than 50 nationalities, we know that everyone is different, and we are proud to have a reputation for being a friendly workplace with highly talented people.

IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, Brighton and Istanbul. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are dedicated to creating unforgettable characters and experiences – all powered by our award-winning proprietary Glacier technology.

**The Role

**The Senior Manager, Clinical Programming is responsible for the establishment, governance, and integrity of Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) standards, perform sponsor oversight of relevant programming activities on the Biometrics vendor, ensure the quality and consistency of data standards to support the portfolio towards the ultimate objective of data quality and consistency across programs and systems.

**Responsibilities

**

• Develops and implements company Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) standards that support the scientific need of a study/program while ensuring quality, consistency and compliance to CDISC standards and other industry standards that supports the exchange of data, reporting, and analysis.

• Ensures alignment of SDTM standards with data collection standards and relevant company tools/system requirements by reviewing study eCRFs, supporting creation of external data collection standards, and providing SDTM mapping guidance

• Serves as a subject matter expert on all aspects of standards development that includes industry standards (CDISC), regulations, and processes

• Ensures study or portfolio-level SDTM datasets are in compliance with CDISC and regulatory submission requirements, reviews study submission data packages to ensure quality and integrity

• Directly supports knowledge development of others as a subject matter expert on data standards, reporting and analysis standards, change control management and related tools/applications

• Creates quality control processes, metrics and other measures to ensure compliance with standards

• Ensures work carried out in accordance with applicable SOP’s and working practices, as well as global agency regulations/guidance’s

• Creates any needed documentation and training for standard processes, change control management and tools

• Responsible for defining standards specifications working closely with implementation support teams (database set-up, completion guidelines, CRF designers, procedures, algorithm specifications and reporting requirements)

• Facilitates a culture of continuous process improvement and a high level of customer service by maintaining and improving the standards processes associated with standards creation, maintenance, decision-making and implementation

• Working with Digital Solutions and IT, support the implementation of future strategies and technology-enabled processes and tools for clinical trials standards, change control management and the exchange of standards information to internal downstream consumers and externally consumers

• Serves as a liaison between Clinical Programming and External Data Management to ensure data standardization alignment and proactively resolve external data issues that impact SDTM deliverables.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Life Sciences. Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Life Sciences preferred

• At least 6-8 years relevant experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO or Regulatory Agency

• Proficient in SAS programming, 6-8 years experience.

• Practical knowledge and experience using R to support clinical trial preferred

• Demonstrated knowledge of clinical research, metadata management, industry standards (CDISC), FDA & ICH, GCP, and related regulatory requirements

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple tasks, complex projects and working with cross functional teams delivering to project and portfolio timelines and metrics

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; independent and effective working in a multi-study, multi-disciplinary atmosphere in a matrix environment

• Experience in clinical data management and/or trial management experience with technical expertise in standards management and implementation is preferred.

jobs.occupation: Kok med speciale i kinesisk gastronomi søges til YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS i Hundested & Chef Specializing in Chinese Cuisine Wanted at YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS in Hundested
jobs.description:
Vi søger 1 kok til vores restaurant i Hundested.

Har du passion for autentisk kinesisk madlavning, gode råvarer og kulinariske oplevelser? Har du samtidig erfaring med sushi, er det en ekstra fordel. Så er du måske vores nye kollega!

YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS er en kinesisk restaurant beliggende på Nørregade 29A, 3390 Hundested. Vi lægger vægt på traditionelle kinesiske retter, autentiske smagsoplevelser og god service i hyggelige omgivelser. Vores køkken kombinerer kinesiske madtraditioner med et udvalg af andre asiatiske retter, herunder sushi.

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret kok med erfaring inden for kinesisk gastronomi, som kan bidrage til den daglige drift og den fortsatte udvikling af vores køkken. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og respekt for asiatiske madtraditioner er i centrum.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Tilberede autentiske kinesiske retter med fokus på kvalitet, smag og præsentation.

• 
Klargøre råvarer samt fremstille saucer, marinader og andre centrale elementer i det kinesiske køkken.

• 
Medvirke til udvikling og tilpasning af menuer og nye retter.

• 
Efter behov bidrage til tilberedning og anretning af sushi og andre asiatisk inspirerede retter.

• 
Sikre korrekt håndtering og opbevaring af råvarer samt overholdelse af gældende hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler.

• 
Bidrage til en effektiv og velfungerende daglig drift i samarbejde med resten af køkkenteamet.

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har praktisk erfaring med kinesisk gastronomi og gerne kendskab til forskellige regionale kinesiske køkkentraditioner.

• 
Har en god forståelse for råvarer, traditionelle tilberedningsteknikker og sammensætning af smage.

• 
Gerne har erfaring med tilberedning af sushi, herunder håndtering af råvarer, tilberedning af sushiris, rulleteknikker og anretning. Erfaring med sushi er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og effektivt – også i travle perioder.

• 
Har sans for detaljer, kvalitet og præsentation af maden.

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og har gode samarbejdsevner.

• 
Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til restaurantens udvikling og fastholde en høj gastronomisk standard.

• 
Gerne taler kinesisk, da det kan være en fordel i den daglige kommunikation og i arbejdet med traditionelle kinesiske opskrifter. Det er dog ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En spændende stilling i en veletableret kinesisk restaurant med stærk lokal forankring.

• 
Mulighed for faglig udvikling og indflydelse på køkkenets retter og menuer.

• 
Mulighed for at arbejde med både traditionelle kinesiske retter og andre asiatiske specialiteter, herunder sushi.

• 
Et uformelt og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med plads til engagement og faglig stolthed.

• 
En varieret arbejdsdag med engagerede kollegaer.

•

Siteimprove helps organisations make their digital content accessible to everyone. Our accessibility products scan entire web estates and document libraries, find the barriers that stop people using them, and increasingly fix those barriers automatically. The work is measured in public: our customers are universities, health systems, government agencies and Fortune 500 companies who have legal deadlines to meet and auditors to satisfy.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our two accessibility product teams. You will own the delivery, quality and technical direction of a cross-functional team of engineers working alongside a Product Manager and a Designer, and you will be accountable for what that team ships and for how the people in it grow.

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. We need a leader who is credible in the code, fluent in modern AI-assisted development, and able to coach a team through that change without trading away quality or the well-being of the people doing the work.

What we will be doing

• 
Own delivery for your team. Turn a product roadmap into a sequenced, realistic plan, keep commitments honest, and be the person who says early and clearly when something will not land.

• 
Lead the people. Hold regular one-to-ones, give direct and useful feedback, run performance and growth conversations, and build a team where engineers at different levels can do their best work. Recruit, onboard and retain.

• 
Stay hands-on enough to be credible. Read and review code and designs, take part in architectural decisions, and pair with engineers when it helps. You are not expected to carry a full delivery load, but you are expected to understand the system well enough to challenge a design and to know when an estimate is wrong.

• 
Coach the team in AI-assisted development. Raise the whole team's effectiveness with AI tooling: how to decompose a problem so an agent can take it, how to write a prompt and a specification that produce reviewable work, and how to review agent-generated code properly rather than approving it on sight.

• 
Set the standards for how AI-generated work is accepted. Define with your engineers how such work is reviewed, tested, secured and documented before it merges, and hold the line that a human is always accountable for what ships.

• 
Partner with Product and Design as equals. Work with your Product Manager on outcomes, scope and sequencing, and make the technical trade-offs visible so the three of you decide together.

• 
Work across teams. Depend on and contribute to Platform, AI and other product teams. Much of what your team needs will be built elsewhere, and much of what it builds will be consumed elsewhere.

• 
Protect engineering health. Hold a deliberate balance between roadmap delivery, compliance obligations, customer-reported defects and technical debt, and make that balance explicit rather than letting it be decided by whatever is loudest.

• 
Own quality and operational responsibility. Testing, accessibility conformance of our own products, security and vulnerability remediation, incident response and the reliability of what your team runs in production.

• 
Adjust your working hours to overlap with the United States. This role reports to a manager on the US Pacific coast and partners with colleagues across the US. You will regularly take meetings in the late afternoon or early evening Central European Time, and we will protect the rest of your week in return.

• 
Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• 
Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• 
Engineering management experience. Several years leading software engineering teams as their direct manager, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers at more than one level. You have owned delivery for a team over a sustained period, not just a project.

• 
A real software engineering background. You have built and shipped production software yourself and can still read a pull request, follow a design discussion and form your own view. We will talk about systems you have built.

• 
Depth in at least one of our core languages, and comfort across the rest. Our services are written mainly in C# and .NET, TypeScript and JavaScript, Go, Rust and Python. You do not need all of them; you do need to be genuinely strong in one and unafraid of the others.

• 
Modern cloud and delivery practice. AWS, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, observability and on-call practice.

• 
Practical use of AI in the software lifecycle. You have personally used AI coding assistants and agents on real work, you know where they help and where they mislead, and you have opinions about how their output should be reviewed. Experience helping other engineers adopt them is what sets this role apart.

• 
Strong partnership with Product. A track record of working with Product Managers and Designers as a peer, shaping scope rather than receiving it.

• 
Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical audience.

• 
Willingness to work a shifted day. Regular overlap with US Pacific time, and occasional travel.

What we will love about you

• 
Digital accessibility knowledge. Familiarity with WCAG, assistive technology, or the accessibility conformance and reporting that regulated customers require. If you do not have it, you must be willing to learn it properly — it is the product.

• 
Experience in a compliance or regulated environment, such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a public-sector authorisation, and comfort working inside an audited change process.

• 
Open-source stewardship. We build and maintain an open-source accessibility rules engine, and experience running a public project and its community is valuable.

• 
Large-scale data or crawling systems, document processing, or machine learning applied to content analysis.

• 
Experience leading a distributed or multi-site team, including working effectively with contractors and vendor partners.

• 
Having introduced AI-assisted development to an organisation, including the governance, measurement and change management that goes with it.

• 
Danish language skills are a nice-to-have and are not required; our working language is English.

What you'll love about usWe’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral research in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral position in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence, starting 1 April 2027.

You will design new sequence-to-expression deep learning models that predict gene expression from DNA sequence in plants, using new experimental datasets generated in the project. The position includes a 6- to 12-month research stay at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, combining plant genomics expertise at Aarhus with AI expertise at CSHL.

This is an opportunity to advance the state of the art in AI for plant biology while working across two leading research environments. For more information, feel free to reach out to Guillaume Ramstein (QGG) and Peter Koo (CSHL).

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 2-year position from April 1st 2027, or as soon as possible.

Job description

You will advance the field of artificial intelligence applied to regulatory genomics, as part of the GRASP project funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark. In this project, you will leverage new training sets, build novel deep learning architectures and define dedicated learning objectives, to learn the effects of genetic variants on gene expression.

The position will focus on data science and genomics in a model plant species, Brachypodium distachyon. You will work at the cutting edge of AI in biology and propose new solutions to predict the effects of regulatory variants in plant genomes, which remains an open research problem in plant genomics. 

These activities will be carried out in close collaboration with the Koo lab, a leading group in AI and regulatory genomics at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA. As part of this collaboration, the position will include a 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a PhD in computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field, or expect to complete it before the start date. They should have research experience in deep learning.

Applicants are expected to have published in international peer-reviewed journals, preferably on topics related to AI and genomics. Experience in developing new deep learning techniques (model architectures or learning objectives) is especially relevant to this position. 

Good communication skills in English are required, as well as the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team of AI experts, computational geneticists, and plant biologists.

Who we are

The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) is a major center for research and education in quantitative genetics and genomics at Aarhus University (http://www.qgg.au.dk/en). We conduct basic and applied research in animal, plant, and human genetics. Our focus areas include quantitative genetics, artificial intelligence applied to agriculture and medicine, population genetics, and integrative genomics. Research within QGG is characterized by a very close synergy between method development and application on practical problems across species, in collaboration with industry partners. QGG is an international research center with about 70 employees and visiting researchers from over 15 nations. QGG works in teams and strives for an excellent working environment, in which we value self-leadership, open communication, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

What we offer

The succesful candidate will be offered:

• A 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, providing international experience and the opportunity to work across two leading labs in plant genomics and AI.
• Computational ressources, including the GenomeDK high-performance computing cluster, with growing capabilities such as high-memory nodes and state-of-the-art GPUs.
• An interdisciplinary interdisciplinary environment, in which the candidate will be able to exchange across research fields (machine learning, bioinformatics, biology, and quantitative genetics) and applications (plant biology, agriculture, and biomedicine).
• A research environment characterized by collaboration, professionalism, commitment to diversity and inclusion, and success in mentoring and supervision.
• A healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment

The primary place of work is C. F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000, Aarhus (Denmark), and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

The position will also include a 6- to 12-month research stay at 1 Bungtown Rd, Cold Spring Harbor, NY 11724, United States. The time and duration of the research stay may be negotiated with the supervisors Guillaume Ramstein and Peter Koo.

Contact information

For further information, please contact:

• Tenure-Track Assistant Professor Guillaume Ramstein, +45 42 52 12 66, ramstein@qgg.au.dk
• Associate Professor Peter Koo, +1 516 367 5520, koo@cshl.edu
Deadline

Applications must be received no later than November 20th, 2026.

Om Aarhus Universitet

Aarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.500 studerende og 9.000 medarbejdere med en årlig omsætning på 8,9 mia. kr. Læs mere på www.au.dk

Are you an experienced Product Sustainability Assessment professional? Then this is an exciting opportunity to strengthen Coloplast's product sustainability evidence and help translate environmental impact into better product decisions across the organisation.

About the job

You will be responsible for conducting and continuously improving life cycle assessments and product environmental impact assessments, ensuring robust methodologies, transparent assumptions and decision-relevant outputs. Based in the HQ in Denmark you will work across R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Product and Project Management, Procurement and other functions, you will provide credible evidence to support product development, portfolio decisions, priority Impact4 roadmap initiatives and externally relevant assessments.

You will maintain and contribute to Coloplast’s LCA methodologies, assessment tools, environmental datasets and emission factors. Also support the quality assurance of product-related Scope 3 emission accounting, product KPI progress and other product sustainability metrics. The position offers an opportunity to provide technical expertise and play a key role in advancing Coloplast’s 2030 product sustainability ambitions.

The Sustainability Team

You will join Coloplast’s Global Sustainability team, which sits in Global Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Sustainability under Global Operations. The team leads the development and implementation of the company’s sustainability strategy, including Environment, Health and Safety, and supports the business in delivering on its Impact4 strategic commitments.

We are a team that values curiosity, integrity, collaboration and transparency. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work while enjoying what they do. With direct report to the Head of Sustainability Product Impact, you will work alongside dedicated sustainability professionals and collaborate extensively across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

•    Apply specialist knowledge in life cycle assessment, product environmental impact assessment, methodologies, datasets, emission factors and product sustainability evidence.

•    Conduct LCAs and product impact assessments across climate and other relevant impact categories, ensuring robust methodologies, transparent assumptions and decision-relevant outputs.

•    Maintain and continuously improve LCA methodologies, assessment tools, datasets, emission factors and technical guidance to ensure consistency, credibility and scalability.

•    Provide environmental impact evidence, methodological guidance and practical tools to support product development, portfolio decisions and sustainability integration across business processes.

•    Support the development and harmonisation of product impact assessment guidance for medical devices, translating evolving scientific, payer, customer and market expectations into practical recommendations.

•    Maintain and contribute to the calculation methodology and quality assurance of environmental impact data used for product-related Scope 3 accounting, product KPI progress and other relevant sustainability metrics.

•    Define data requirements, quality standards and validation approaches for product-related supplier environmental data.

•    Develop, validate and translate product impact evidence into clear recommendations for Product and Project Management, Marketing, Market Access, Operations and other business functions.

What you bring

Qualifications:

•    Master’s degree or equivalent in engineering, environmental science, chemistry, sustainability, materials science or another relevant technical field.

•    At least three years of relevant experience in life cycle assessment, environmental footprinting, product environmental impact assessment, sustainability analytics or a closely related technical field.

•    Hands-on experience with leading LCA platforms such as SimaPro, Sphera, OpenLCA, etc. and associated databases.

•    Strong knowledge of relevant standards and methodologies, including ISO 14040/44, ISO 14067, PEF and related environmental assessment frameworks.

•    Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with complex datasets, emission factors, modelling assumptions and decision-support tools.

•    Ability to translate complex environmental assessments into clear, actionable recommendations for product development, portfolio decisions and business stakeholders.

•    Experience from MedTech, healthcare, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry is an advantage.

•    Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and developing sustainability evidence for customers, payers, healthcare professionals, public tenders or regulatory submissions is an advantage.

•    Professional proficiency in English.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Kostyantyn Pivnenko, Head of Sustainability Product Impact at dkkopi@coloplast.com

jobs.description:
Are you our new ambitious student assistant that wants to help us in the R&D department and gain hands-on experience working in the Medico Industry?

Join Coloplast and support our efforts to ensure a safe and healthy working environment by strengthening our chemical management capabilities. You will become part of the EHS & Metrology team, Centre of Excellence, within our R&D organisation, dedicated to support that Coloplast’s EHS performance is world class as we continue to make life easier for people with intimate health care needs.

Welcome to your new team

At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the EHS & Metrology team, Centre of Excellence, working to ensure a safe and healthy working environment and environmentally responsible operations. We are responsible for supporting Coloplast’s strategic EHS plan incl. the EHS management system certified to ISO 14001 and 45001 standards. To succeed, we collaborate closely with a wide range of stakeholders within and outside of Coloplast.

Help us drive the EHS agenda forward

As our new Chemical Assistant, you will have a wide number of tasks and will contribute to improving our EHS performance within chemical safety. We offer a flexible and friendly work environment that accommodates your studies, having the opportunity to expand your areas of responsibility depending on the company priorities and your interests.

In this position you will:

•    Manage Safety Data Sheets in our chemical managing system (CHESS) for Humlebæk Site

•    Control incoming Safety Data Sheets to ensure correct CLP classification of chemicals (The Classification, Labelling and Packaging Regulation EC)

•    Create and manage labels to our internal chemical mixtures

•    Assist with enquiries from the global Coloplast organisation in relation to CHESS and other EHS aspects

What you bring

As an ideal candidate, you:

•    Have completed around one to two years of relevant university studies within chemistry, toxicology or similar, and have at least two years left before finishing your studies

•    Have a keen interest in EHS, chemical safety and risk assessment

•    Are structured and methodological

•    Speak and write Danish and English fluently

•    Have a can-do attitude with a high degree of personal efficiency

•    Can work 10-20 hours per week at our headquarters in Humlebæk

Previous experience with the CLP regulation and safety data sheets is advantageous

What we offer:
