Nordic Sales Coordinator

STADA Nordic, Herlev

Would you like to work at the intersection of sales support, portfolio coordination and commercial operations, while helping ensure that plans are turned into action?

STADA Nordic is looking for a Nordic Sales Coordinator to join one of our commercial teams within prescription medicines at our Nordic head office in Herlev.

Your role

As our new Sales Coordinator, you will play an important role in our Nordic setup for the pharmacy sales of prescription medicines. You will help ensure that our products move efficiently through our flows, from commercial planning to availability at the pharmacy.

This is a highly collaborative role with a strong focus on coordination, follow-up and execution. You will work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders across Denmark, Sweden, Finland and Norway.

Your key responsibilities

You will have a broad range of responsibilities centered around coordination, commercial awareness and effective execution. Your main tasks will include:

• Ensuring a smooth order flow to the customer in collaboration with wholesalers across the Nordic markets

• Following up on sales activities and commercial decisions related to pharmaceutical tenders

• Coordinating price submissions to the relevant authorities in connection with tenders

• Taking the lead on portfolio-related activities and ensuring alignment and progress in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders

• Working closely with support functions such as Quality, Supply Chain and Product Management

• Monitoring changes in product demand and coordinating the appropriate response with Product Managers and Supply Chain

• Following up on decisions and activities to ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time

Who are you?

You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change and where your ability to maintain an overview and move tasks forward makes a real difference.

We imagine that you:

• Are a supportive colleague who values teamwork and contributes positively to a strong sense of community

• Remain calm and efficient when unexpected changes require quick decisions and action

• Are comfortable working in a dynamic and volatile market where change is part of everyday business

• Have experience with order management, product flow, sales support or a similar area

• Are commercially minded and comfortable making decisions throughout the working day

• Work in a structured way and take ownership of tasks from start to finish

• Communicate and collaborate effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders

• Are fluent in at least one Scandinavian language and have a high level of proficiency in English

Previous experience from the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated environment would be an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

Why join STADA?

At STADA Nordic, you will become part of an ambitious and collaborative organisation that works closely across countries, markets and functions.

We offer:

• A visible and collaborative role where your contribution makes a real difference to the business

• A cross functional role with close collaboration with all departments throughout the Nordic organization

• An informal and hands-on working environment with short decision-making processes

• A high degree of responsibility and ownership

• Opportunities to develop professionally and grow within the role

• An exciting workplace within a global organization where cooperation across countries is part of everyday life

About STADA Nordic

STADA Nordic is part of the international STADA Group, a global pharmaceutical company headquartered in Germany.

Across the Nordic region, we work together with a shared ambition to make high-quality healthcare products available to more people. Our portfolio ranges from generic medicines to consumer healthcare products, and we collaborate closely with pharmacies, wholesalers and the healthcare sector to support a stable and efficient supply of our products.

Everyday life at STADA Nordic is characterised by collaboration across markets and functions. We are an organisation with short decision-making processes, a high degree of responsibility and a strong hands-on approach. We support one another and work together to turn plans into results.

Our purpose, “Caring for people’s health as a trusted partner,” guides the way we work, while our values of Integrity, Agility, Entrepreneurship and One STADA shape how we collaborate and achieve our goals. This purpose is also reflected in STADA’s official corporate culture and career materials.

Based at our Nordic head office in Herlev, you will become part of an international organisation with strong local market knowledge and close cooperation across the Nordic countries.

Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator

(m/f/d)

As a Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator (m/f/d) you will do the following:

Production planning

Draw up and monitor production plans

Develop capacity and resource plans including checking the availability of materials

Plan and coordinate production orders

Track production performance and proactively implement corrective actions in cases of deviation

Work closely with production, design and materials management

Compile key performance indicators and produce regular reports based on production data

Purchasing and Supplier Management

Create and process purchase orders and associated documents in BC

Obtain and verify order confirmations and monitor delivery times

Obtain quotations, compare prices and identify opportunities for cost savings

Optimise costs and procurement processes

Build and maintain professional relationships with suppliers

Data and process improvement

Ensure accurate and up-to-date master data in BC, e.g. products and suppliers

Improve workflows within planning and procurement

Contribute to new standards and continuous improvements across production and procurement

What you bring with you

You have a commercial or technical qualification, for example as an industrial technician, technical assistant, procurement officer or similar.

Experience in production planning, procurement or materials management within a manufacturing company is an advantage.

You have practical experience with EPR systems, preferably Microsoft Business Central and are keen to work actively with the system.

It is a plus if you have:

• Experience in production planning or procurement

• Strong Excel skills for data management, analysis and reporting

• Experience with key performance indicators and operational reporting

• Knowledge of Lean or other process improvement methods

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is a plus.

You do not need to be an expert in all these areas from day one. The most important thing is that you have an interest in production and supply chains, work systematically and take responsibility for seeing tasks through to completion.

**You also

**

• Build positive working relationships through clear and professional communication

• Demonstrate a structured, reliable, and detail-oriented working style

• Take initiative, contribute proactively, and collaborate effectively with others

• Stay organised and adapt priorities when circumstances change

• Use analytical thinking to identify and drive process improvements

**We offer you

**

• A dynamic position where your decisions make a real impact on operations and customer delivery

• A collaborative and supportive team environment with colleagues across Denmark and Germany

• The freedom to drive improvements and influence how we work with Business Central

• The chance to be part of an international company helping make offshore wind safer and more reliable worldwide

Welcome to Sabik Offshore A/S

We have been mastering the art of metalworking since 1888. With over 130 years of experience, we are committed to innovation and delivering exceptional solutions for our customers and partners. Our skilled team of 20 employees specializes in crafting high-quality components and structures from sheet metal and tubes in steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.

Combining traditional craftsmanship with a focus on flexibility and quality, we pride ourselves on exceeding customer expectations.

Sabik Offshore A/S is looking for a structured and committed Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator. The role combines production planning and procurement, acting as the link between production, design, materials management and our suppliers.

You’ll report to production management and join a team of 5–8 colleagues in Vejle who work in Microsoft Business Central (BC). BC will be your primary tool, and you’ll play an active role in both its day-to-day use and its further development – working closely with BC users at Sabik Offshore in Glostrup and Schwerin.

Sabik Offshore A/S is an international company in the offshore industry. In Vejle, we manufacture metal structures, including railing systems for offshore wind farms.

As a Production Planner & Supply Chain Coordinator you will be working at the forefront of an industry of the future. Are you ready?

This is the way

to your future

If you would like further information or to submit your application,

please contact our HR Manager Wolfgang Schaper at +49 385 6767 0018 or jobs@sabik-offshore.com.

We look forward to hearing about you and your experience.

jobs.occupation: Senior Associate, Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing
jobs.description:
We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

Adjective: A unique word for Genmab meaning to go way beyond what is

usual; to be remarkable; proudly unique and authentic

Back to search results

Previous job Next job

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Genmab is searching for an energized Senior Associate to be part of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing in Copenhagen within commute distance from our office locations to work according to your hybrid work arrangement.

With an impressive pipeline and many ongoing clinical trials, you will have a central role in supporting inspection readiness across our late-stage clinical development portfolio. Your work will help ensure that documentation is complete, compliant and readily available to support the successful execution of business-critical GMP and GCP inspections.

You will support inspection readiness activities within Global Clinical Supply, collecting, organizing and performing completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation. During inspections, you will participate in back-office activities and help ensure timely retrieval and follow-up of requested information.

The role also offers an opportunity to develop beyond inspection readiness. You will work closely with the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and support selected functional initiatives, providing exposure to broader activities across the organization and our CMO and vendor network. In parallel, you will have the opportunity to build your GMP and clinical supply knowledge by learning and supporting selected operational activities related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

The position reports to the Director, Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing based in Copenhagen.

Responsibilities

• Support inspection readiness across late-stage clinical trials by collecting, organizing and maintaining relevant clinical supply documentation.

• Perform completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation against applicable procedures and inspection-readiness expectations.

• Participate in back-office activities during GMP and GCP inspections, including document retrieval, request coordination and tracking of responses and follow-up items.

• Support preparation for mock inspections, audits and health authority inspections, including compilation and review of supporting documentation for completeness and readiness.

• Support the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing with selected functional initiatives and tasks across the organization.

• Support activities related to our external CMO and vendor network, including coordination, follow-up and preparation of relevant material and documentation.

• Build knowledge of GMP and clinical supply activities within Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and learn and support selected operational tasks related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

• Participate in maintenance and continuous improvement of procedures, tools and ways of working supporting inspection readiness and clinical supply activities.

• Responsible to be compliant with Genmab´s quality system.

Requirements

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

• Some experience working with documentation, quality or compliance activities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical research or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• Knowledge and understanding of GMP and GCP; experience with inspection or audit readiness is an advantage.

• Strong interest in documentation, quality and compliance, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.

• Ability to coordinate activities, maintain structure and follow up on actions involving multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines, including during inspections.

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic, curious and goal orientated, with a willingness to learn new GMP-related activities.

• A team player with demonstrated ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including CMOs and vendors.

• Strong communication skills in English - both oral and written.

The Team

You will be part of a highly competent team focused on GMP applicable to packaging and labelling of supplies for clinical trials, with a strong focus on quality, inspection readiness and successful collaboration with our internal stakeholders and CMOs.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Portfolio & Project Delivery and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department.

We have an international and informal working environment with a high pace, strong one-team spirit and close collaboration across functions.

Application

Has this sparked your interest? Then we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter including your motivation for this position. We screen candidates on a continuous basis and call in for interviews.

Fully remote applicants will not be considered, so please indicate if you are willing to relocate if you’re not currently living in commute distance.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK544.000,00---816.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

What Makes Us, Us Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**You will be joining an innovative application development team within SimCorp's Product Division. We provide a cloud native SaaS product built on Azure using modern development principles, technologies and practices.

The product, Digital Engagement Platform (DEP) has been operational for over 5 years and based on client feedback and our own experience we have begun to lift the product to the next level, modernizing architecture and tech stack so we can scale DEP for a much larger audience than we can today.

This is why we need you - to help test and ensure the quality assurance of the new DEP 2.0 that we are building that can support the biggest clients, asset managers, across the globe.

The future success of our SaaS hinges on the ongoing enhancement of the application and the refinement of associated processes and tools. QA will continue be a vital element of this journey. While we have achieved remarkable milestones, there are still challenges to conquer.

Your contribution to the robustness of the DEP will be pivotal as we continually onboard new clients, ensuring high performance, top-notch security, and exceptional user experience for a diverse clientele.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As part of your role, you will collaborate with three agile development teams, each consisting of approximately 5-7 members. Your daily tasks will involve understanding and questioning customer requirements, discussing solutions, implementing automated tests for chosen solutions, some manual testing and providing support. The tools you will use are centered around .NET, Data Build Tool (dbt), TypeScript, and Microsoft Azure.

Our current and near future priorities include ensuring good maintainability, observability, high system performance, scalability, continuous integration, and deployment. Additionally, you will actively contribute to improving the product and its related processes within our modern cloud-based environment. Expect to leverage your current skills while also delving into and acquiring knowledge about cutting-edge technologies and testing methodologies in the cloud.

In addition to implementing customer features, we place a strong emphasis on continual improvement at every level: Across the entire company, within divisions, product areas, teams, and even at the individual level. Your everyday tasks will involve tackling issues such as how to streamline build and deployment durations, enhance collaboration, and increase the degree of test automation.

Overall, your contributions will spread across following primary areas:

Focus on test automation for the DEP product

• Automation of Testing in general

• Automate load and data ingestion from multiple sources

• Contribute to the test strategies

• Enhancement in Test Management and Processes (such as planning, structuring, tracking, coordinating releases, assessing etc.)

• Conducting Manual Tests (while there is still a need for some manual testing, your efforts will accelerate our progress, rendering it less required over time)

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

Testing

• TDD

• Agile testing

• Test methodologies (testing pyramid)

• Automated UI tests (Selenium/Cypress)

• Automated API based feature testing

• Data driven testing

• Automated Data testing

• C# and .NET development

• Microsoft Azure

• Continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD)

• Writing and organizing cool testcases

• Manual application testing

Knowledge on the following technologies is considered a plus:

• XUnit / NUnit / RestSharp

• Moq

• Data Build Tool (dbt)

• AutoMapper

• FluentAssertions

• SpecFlow (BDD)

• JMeter

• Postman

• Azure Load Testing

• Azure DevOps

• Docker/Kubernetes

As a person, you value

• You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals.

• Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is.

• Clear communicator who speaks up when needed.

• Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset.

• Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork

• Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you

jobs.occupation: Physiological & Sports Medicine Advisor - Elite Football
jobs.description:
At Twinspire, we're building a digital twin platform for individualised athlete modelling in elite football. We are already testing this live in clubs through ongoing pilot studies.

The question we care about is simple: can data-driven signals actually support decisions that practitioners trust?

The role

We're looking for a physiotherapist, sports medicine professional, or physician with experience in elite or semi-elite football. Not to validate what we're building, but to challenge it.

This is not a narrow return-to-play role. We're looking for someone who can connect:

• physiology

• data

• research

• and real-world decision-making

You understand that athlete management is not clean or protocol-driven, but contextual, uncertain, and often subjective. That's exactly the gap we're trying to close.

What you will do

You will work directly with the founding team and DTU research group.

You will:

• Pressure-test whether model outputs make sense physiologically

• Call out when signals don't translate to real decisions

• Help bridge the gap between research and applied practice

• Shape what a useful signal actually looks like in elite environments

• Push us to build something that holds up under scrutiny, not just in theory

What we are looking for

Someone who:

• Has worked closely with elite or semi-elite football players

• Brings strong physiological and/or sports medicine expertise

• Is comfortable questioning both data and established practice

• Has felt the gap between what's measured and what's actually useful

• Wants to be part of defining what better looks like

What we offer

• Direct involvement in a validation study with elite football clubs across the Nordics

• Opportunity for research co-authorship

• Equity participation

• A chance to shape how athlete modelling is applied in real environments

If this resonates, reach out: roxane@twinspire.ai

As a key member of the local QC leadership team, you will help shape and build a future-ready QC organization, ensuring scalable, innovative, and inspection-ready capabilities that enable accelerated development, successful product launches, and robust lifecycle management.

The role combines strategic leadership and transformation as a critical business enabler through digitalization, advanced analytics, and modern analytical technologies.

The laboratory is newly established, so expect a pioneering atmosphere, where you will help adjust the ways of working in an efficiency-oriented direction. We expect you to be ambitious, motivated, self-driven, and to be able to make your colleagues shine in an environment of respectful and flexible collaboration.

You will be joining a team of ambitious and professional colleagues within related fields, who can help you settle into your role, and keep the spirit high while performing the important tasks for our laboratory.

You will report to the Senior Director, Quality Control Lab.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build and lead the E-System Team providing business understanding, clear priorities and coordination of tasks

• Ensure a team environment that supports engagement, wellbeing and career development opportunities

• Develop, implement and maintain strategy and roadmap Laboratory Systems in Genmab's QC

• Ensure validation of relevant IT systems for the QC laboratory as System Owner

• Develop and manage the performance

• Serve as the primary point of contact across functional teams and external vendors

• Drive a culture of quality excellence, LEAN and continuous improvements

• Direct, guide, and monitor documentation and evolution of Standard Operating Procedures

• Support and participate in audits and regulatory agency inspections

• Ensure that QC employees comply with required safety and cGMP procedures and requirements

• Responsible for being compliant with Genmab's quality system

**Requirements

**

• It is expected that you hold a Master's degree in science or a related technical area

• Preferably 10+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry

• Strong experience working in a cGMP environment with knowledge of laboratory IT systems, QC equipment, testing, sampling and release.

• Experienced people leader

• Experience in working in cross-functional teams to accomplish shared goals

• Strong experience working in analytical and regulatory requirements

• Significant applied experience in laboratory operations, including development and adherence to quality metric programs

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK734.400,00---1.101.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

In our delivery stream we cater primarily for dental laboratories. We are building both administrative software for dental laboratories (Lab Management Software – LMS) and AI-assisted dental CAD software (Automate) for designing crowns, bridges and other types of dental restorations with a clear strategy to converge these applications and offer seamless and smooth workflows for our customers.

Our cloud infrastructure is in Microsoft Azure. Our primary coding language is C# with Blazor for front-end and Pulumi for IaC. We use GitHub Actions and PowerShell scripts for build and deployment.

You will be joining the mature LMS team of app. 10 people distributed across Copenhagen and Kyiv, Ukraine. We in the LMS team have established sound processes; working in short iterations, high degree of test automation, frequent releases, relentless addressing of incoming bugs and continuous improvement. We have a strong focus on collaboration between everyone in the team and pride ourselves in having a great team spirit of having a good time while delivering high-quality work on schedule.

Your role

In this role, you will be a hands-on member of LMS team, spending most of your time designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining product features. Alongside your development responsibilities, you will help your and other teams incorporate secure development practices into their daily work and contribute to building robust and trustworthy solutions for our customers.

We see you as a developer picking up tasks from the prioritized backlog and working as a generally capable and engaged team member. We do not expect you to be a dedicated security expert or to own security activities alone. Instead, we are looking for someone who understands how to build secure cloud applications and can help the teams make practical security decisions while continuing to deliver business value. You will proactively propagate good security practices to developers, testers and the architect in the team, and you will take pleasure in motivating and propagating these practices to other teams, e.g. through our stream architect community, where you are expected to be a guest star.

We are yearning to hear your suggestions for initiatives to increase secure coding practices, e.g. tooling, courses, breakathons and penetration tests, and we expect you to establish a good and active dialogue with our chief security architect and kindred spirits in the company. We thus expect you to be proactively outgoing; sticking your nose into things outside your team scope, but for “the right reasons”.

Success in this role comes from balancing strong engineering skills with pragmatic security thinking while remaining focused on delivering great software.

Your profile

We are looking for a senior software developer with savviness for and proven experience in building secure high-quality cloud applications. Likewise, we see that you can check most of the following boxes:

• 
Senior-level Software development competences; C# and/or C++

• 
Proven hands-on experience with building secure large cloud systems

• 
Proven hands-on experience with cloud security engineering, including container, Kubernetes, IaC and CI/CD security

• 
Experience applying security concepts such as OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and API security

• 
Experience with IaC and DevSecOps, including tool chains and security scanning pipelines

• 
Familiarity with Azure operational and governance tools, e.g. Azure Advisor Security

• 
Interest in staying informed about emerging security threats and development practices

• 
Taking ownership, seeing the big picture, and having a pragmatic approach

• 
Strong collaboration and communication skills and fluent in written and spoken English

o You are influential, but not manipulative

o You are outgoing, but maintain your focus

We offer

• 
Strong focus on professional and personal development – and budget to back it!

• 
Empowerment and challenging tasks in a successful MedTech company with cutting edge technology;

• 
An inspiring international and informal environment with committed and highly skilled colleagues – we are more than 30 nationalities in our building;

• 
Attractive office in the center of Copenhagen, next to Kongens Nytorv metro station;

• 
Healthcare package to keep you fit and well, and fresh and delicious lunch cooked by our private chef;

• 
With us you will be part of the success that 3Shape has created over the past 20 years. You will be able to work on solutions used by thousands of dental professionals worldwide!

Join 3Shape and make a difference by changing dentistry together with dental professionals across the world by developing innovative solutions that provide excellent patient care in a rapidly growing industry.

Visit our website if you want to read more about our company, mission, or why 3Shape is a great place to work!

Get in touch now!

Please do not hesitate to apply for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest-growing high-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously. We do expect to end our search for this position as soon as possible.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. At Genmab, we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients through innovative antibody-based medicines. To support our biologics pipeline and portfolio, we are looking for a CMC Senior Stability Specialist in the CMC Stability department to strengthen our CMC organization with a focus on life-cycle-management activities.

**The Role and Department

**As CMC Senior Stability Specialist, you will be part of the CMC Stability department organized in CMC Development and Manufacturing. The CMC Stability department supports the Genmab portfolio from early CMC development projects to commercial products. Additionally, you will be part of and collaborate with CMC project teams

You will join a department of eight skilled and dedicated employees. In the role, you will be responsible for stability, governance of products and collaborate closely with colleagues within the department, across CMC, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Supply, and with external partners at CDMO’s/CMO’s in a highly matrixed, international environment.

Besides having extended experience with biologics and stability, the ideal candidate is statistically well-founded and can help advance the department’s data-handling capabilities.

This position will report to the Head of Department, CMC Stability.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as stability subject matter expert supporting Genmab’s biologics products.

• Ensure alignment and oversight of stability activities performed at external partners, CDMO’s/CMO’s, and internal laboratories.

• Ensure scientifically sound and regulatory-compliant stability approaches aligned with ICH guidelines and regulations.

• Perform and oversee statistical evaluation of stability data, including data handling, trend analysis and shelf-life determination.

• Author and review CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, BLA/MAA, variations).

• Support health authority interactions, e.g. be part of the request for information processes for topics related to stability.

• Be part of establishing a mature life-cycle-management set-up for commercial products.

**Requirements

**

• PhD or MSc in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, statistics, or related discipline.

• Significant experience (typically 7+ years) within CMC stability for biologics and strong knowledge of ICH guidelines, including Q1A–Q1E, Q5C, and Q6B.

• Extensive knowledge and understanding of stability for marketed biologics/clinical biological products according to current requirements and best industrial practices.

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience in statistical methods applied to stability data (e.g. regression analysis, pooling, trend analysis).

• Experience working and interacting with CDMO’s/CMO’s.

• Experience with supporting global regulatory submissions.

• Ability to translate complex scientific and statistical data into clear regulatory and business recommendations.

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• You seek and have demonstrated ability to collaborate with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to support product development programs.

• You have a structured and analytical approach when solving problems.

• Flair for IT and user software to monitor stability.

• You can manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and define steps needed to achieve project and department goals.

• You can work successfully and with integrity in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.

**What You Can Expect At Genmab

**

• A high-impact role in a science-driven organization focused on patients.

• A collaborative and inclusive culture with strong cross-functional teamwork.

• Opportunities to shape strategy and contribute to key project decisions.

• Professional growth in a global biologics company with a strong pipeline.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

The Opportunity

Every day, thousands of manufacturers rely on Secomea's Secure Remote Access platform to securely connect engineers with the industrial equipment that keeps factories, utilities, and critical infrastructure running.

Secomea is entering its next phase of accelerated growth. Building on strong commercial momentum, the company is now strengthening its engineering teams as a strategic foundation for further growth.

We're hiring an Engineering Team Lead for one of our Cloud teams, reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people leadership.

This is a role with significant influence in a growing international company where initiative, technical excellence, accountability, and impact matter.

What You'll Do

As Engineering Team Lead, you'll lead one of the engineering teams building the customer-facing heart of our cloud layer that brings together identity, governance, secure access, APIs, and user experience into a seamless experience trusted by industrial organizations worldwide. It enables enterprise IT to centrally govern secure access while allowing technicians to quickly find, access, and work with the industrial resources they're responsible for.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role where leadership is an addition to engineering—not a move away from it. You'll spend much of your time designing, coding, reviewing code, solving complex technical problems, contributing to architectural decisions, and supporting production operations while serving as the direct people leader for your team.

You will work closely with UX, Product Management, and engineering teams across the platform to deliver intuitive user experience while maintaining the enterprise-grade governance, security, and reliability that industrial customers expect.

You'll solve challenging engineering problems spanning distributed cloud systems, APIs, identity, governance, scalability, observability, security, and user experience.

As a people leader, you will coach and support team members through regular feedback, development discussions, hiring activities, and performance management. You will drive engineering excellence through sound architecture, high code quality, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role requires both technical depth and the ability to create clarity, build trust, and help a team perform at a high level.

You will be part of Secomea's engineering leadership community, working closely with other Team Leads and Engineering Managers to evolve our technology organization, engineering practices, and technical direction.

What We’re Looking For

You may already be leading a team, or you may be a senior engineer who naturally takes ownership, mentors colleagues, and drives technical initiatives. In either case, you are motivated by helping people succeed and understand that strong teams are built through trust, communication, and shared accountability.

You have a strong software engineering background and significant experience building distributed software systems using modern technologies such as .NET and Azure. More importantly, you're curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new technologies as products and platforms evolve.

Most importantly, we are looking for a strong team player who thrives in a rapidly growing environment and is energized by combining deep technical work with leading and inspiring people.

Experience We Value

You don't need to tick every box below, but you should bring a solid foundation in .NET and modern cloud technologies.

Core Skills

• Strong experience with C# and .NET

• Ability and curiosity to quickly master new technologies

• Experience with modern databases, preferably document databases

• Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools in production settings

• Unit and integration testing — xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest; comfortable with TDD or BDD

• Ability to work closely with UX and Product Management to translate customer needs into intuitive product experiences

Cloud Skills

• Experience designing scalable, high-performance distributed systems, including performance analysis and optimization.

• Experience designing, deploying, and operating distributed applications in public cloud environments. Experience with Azure is an advantage. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.

• Experience designing secure, scalable, and intuitive APIs.

Security and OT Knowledge

• Core security concepts — encryption, authentication, and authorization for web applications and APIs.

• Operational Technology (preferred) — familiarity with OT protocols such as Modbus, OPC UA, or MQTT, and the unique security challenges of ICS and SCADA environments.

Leadership Qualifications

• Proven experience as a senior technical contributor with the ability and desire to remain hands-on while leading others.

• You may already be leading a team, mentoring junior engineers, acting as a Staff Engineer, or simply be the person others naturally turn to for technical guidance. We care more about your ability to help others succeed than about previous management titles.

Just as important, you:

• Take ownership and drive tasks to completion

• Proactively identify gaps, risks, and improvements.

• Translate high-level goals into concrete technical outcomes

• Care about building robust systems that are stable and perform reliably in the real world.

You do not need to meet every requirement to be successful in the role. We value curiosity, ownership, and the ability to learn as highly as specific technical experience.

About Secomea

Secomea is a global leader in Operational Technology (OT) and secure remote access solutions for industrial environments. We help manufacturers, machine builders, and system integrators securely connect, monitor, and manage industrial equipment around the world.

Founded in Denmark in 2008, Secomea has spent more than fifteen years helping organizations enable protected access to their critical industrial infrastructure while supporting efficient and secure operations. Today, we serve customers globally through our offices in Denmark, the United States, Japan, and China, through a network of partners across more than 70 countries.

As cybersecurity and compliance become increasingly critical to industrial operations, our mission remains simple: Protecting the factory floor.

Why Join Secomea?

This role combines technical depth, product thinking, architectural influence, and people leadership in equal measure.

You'll help shape the customer-facing heart of Secomea's cloud layer, solving engineering challenges where distributed systems, identity, security, APIs, and user experience come together. Success isn't measured only by the quality of the software you build, but by how naturally enterprise governance and technician productivity work together.

As a Team Lead, you'll have genuine influence. You'll help shape the technical direction of the cloud layer, grow an experienced engineering team, and work closely with Product Management, UX, and fellow engineering leaders to define how the cloud layer evolves. You'll remain close to technology while helping others succeed.

Perhaps most importantly, your work has a tangible impact. Every improvement your team delivers helps manufacturers and critical infrastructure operators securely connect the people who keep factories, utilities, and essential infrastructure running. It's engineering where technical excellence directly improves how people work in the real world.

You'll join an engineering organization that's large enough to build globally trusted products, yet small enough that your technical decisions, leadership, and ideas genuinely shape the future of both the product and the company.

How To Apply

Ready to take the next step?

Submit your CV and let’s start the conversation. We are more interested in meeting the right person than finding someone who checks every box. If you are excited about leading talented engineers while remaining deeply involved in building secure, high-performance systems, we would love to hear from you.

Job Description

You are newly graduated or have 1-3 years of experience and will play a central role in ensuring timely and accurate management reporting, as well as in-depth analyses of our business and financial KPIs. You take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by contributing to the development of the organization. Continue developing with us

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, not just juice, sandwiches, coffee, and much more. When joining us, you step into a high-energy community where the music is loud, the bar is your stage, and your personality matters as much as your skills.

**Job Summary

**The Security Architect is responsible for defining and driving the Group cyber security architecture and roadmap across the entire technology portfolio, ensuring robust protection, regulatory compliance, and resilience at a global scale. The role establishes security standards, frameworks, and controls across all platforms, applications, and infrastructure, working closely with IT Operations, Product, and Engineering Teams to embed security by design throughout the organization.

As part of the global technology leadership team, this position plays a strategic role in strengthening the company’s cyber posture, safeguarding business operations, and enabling secure growth by ensuring that security capabilities evolve alongside the company’s digital and operational ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and evolve the company’s global security architecture and strategy across applications, cloud, identity, endpoints, and enterprise systems.

• Lead and develop the security function, managing a team responsible for Security Operations and Identity & Access Management.

• Serve as the senior security authority for major technology initiatives, architectural decisions, and enterprise platform changes.

• Define and maintain security principles, standards, and reference architectures applied consistently across engineering teams and regions.

• Ensure security architecture aligns with business priorities, technology strategy, and regulatory requirements.

• Drive secure-by-design practices across internally developed applications, APIs, and integrations.

• Oversee the organization’s cloud security posture, including architecture, governance, and controls across AWS environments.

• Establish and strengthen identity and access management practices, including authentication, privileged access, and lifecycle governance.

• Ensure effective security operations, monitoring, and endpoint protection in partnership with internal teams and external security providers.

• Oversee security testing and assurance activities, including penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation oversight.

• Drive the organization’s security awareness and human risk program to strengthen overall security culture.

• Act as a trusted advisor to engineering and business leadership, clearly communicating security risks, priorities, and improvement initiatives.

**Key Qualifications

**

• 8–10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, or related infrastructure/security roles, including experience in security architecture or senior security engineering roles.

• Strong understanding of security architecture across cloud, applications, identity, endpoints, and enterprise platforms.

• Hands-on experience securing cloud environments, preferably AWS, including IAM, monitoring, and security controls.

• Solid background in application security and secure software development practices, including threat modeling, architecture review, and API security.

• Practical experience with identity and access management concepts such as authentication, privileged access, and lifecycle governance.

• Familiarity with Microsoft security environments, including Entra ID; experience with enterprise SaaS platforms such as Dynamics is a plus.

• Experience working closely with engineering, infrastructure, and platform teams to embed security into technology delivery.

• Experience overseeing security operations or working with MSSPs, including areas such as endpoint protection, detection and response, or monitoring.

• Proven ability to lead security initiatives, influence stakeholders, and guide security improvements across multiple teams.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate security risks into clear priorities and practical actions for both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred

**

• Experience in distributed or multi-site environments (e.g., retail, hospitality, or similar).

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent are advantageous but not required.

**About Joe & The Juice

**JOE & THE JUICE is a healthy fast-casual concept founded in Copenhagen in 2002. Since then, we've grown to more than 500 locations across 20+ countries, employing more than 4,500 people worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028. From day one, our ambition has been to prove there's no trade-off between taste and health.

We serve high-quality, freshly prepared juices, shakes, coffee, and sandwiches in relaxed, contemporary cafés that combine convenience with distinct urban atmospheres. JOE & THE JUICE goes beyond products towards the full experience around the bar, creating one consistent universe for guests and Juicers across every location.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future.

jobs.occupation: Deciphering host-pathogen interplay by utilizing biostructure prediction and New Genomic Techniques (NGTs) to engineer durable disease resistance in plants
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Agroecology programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Deciphering host-pathogen interplay by utilizing biostructure prediction and New Genomic Techniques (NGTs) to engineer durable disease resistance in plants

Research area and project description
The Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University is offering a PhD position focused on genetic modification of plants for higher resistance to pathogens. The position is available from 01-02-2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

The PhD is part of the project that aims to develop novel and durable disease resistance in cereals by targeting key protein–protein interactions between plants and pathogens. Using hexaploid wheat (Triticum aestivum) and diploid barley (Hordeum vulgare) as model systems, the project will focus on
powdery mildew disease caused by Blumeria graminis f. sp. tritici (Bgt) and B. hordei (Bh).

The PhD student will establish and optimize an AI-based structural biology modelling and prime editing toolbox and apply it to introduce genome modification in vitro culture. These edits are designed to disrupt critical plant-pathogen protein interactions, thereby enhancing disease resistance without relying on classical resistance genes. Computational prediction tools, including AlphaFold-based protein-protein interaction modeling, will be used to guide target selection and interpret the molecular effects of the edits. Wheat transformation will be carried out in three varieties with contrasting resistance profiles, and barley transformation will be done in Golden Promise. Disease resistance will be assessed through controlled inoculation experiments. Edited and wild-type plants will be inoculated with Blumeria graminis isolates and evaluated at the whole-plant level.

Overall, the project aims to establish a new resistance concept based on blocking essential plant-pathogen interactions rather than relying on single resistance genes. This strategy has the potential to deliver more robust and durable disease resistance and to open new avenues for precision breeding in cereal crops.

The position is funded by a project supported by the DFF, in collaboration with Copenhagen University and will last 3 years.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant MSc degree within molecular biology, plant or agricultural sciences, biology, biotechnology or similar.
• Knowledge in plant transformation and in vitro culture
• Experience with Alphafold and/or structural biology.
• Be fluent in English (written and spoken).
• Have scientific writing and communication skills.
• Have the ability to manage your own tasks and collaborate in an international research team.
Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Agroecology, Forsøgsvej 1, 4200 Slagelse, Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Kim Hebelstrup, e-mail: Kim.hebelstrup@agro.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Olga A. Oxholm, e-mail: olgaa@agro.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply:
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 09 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 February 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services?

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

**Turn complexity into one plan the business can act on.

**Across the Nordics, demand is shaped by tenders, contracts, launches and changing customer needs. The opportunity is to bring those signals together early, translate them into clear choices and create a healthier balance between product availability and inventory. That is where you come in.

As our Demand & Supply Manager Nordics, you will create one reliable view of demand and supply across Denmark, Sweden, and Finland. ****Role

**This is not a role where you simply maintain a forecast. You will set the direction for how the Nordics plan, decide and improve. You will:

• Lead any technical validation or trial processes, ensuring alignment between stakeholders and measurable success criteria.

• Negotiate and close deals with commercial rigour and customer-centricity, aligned to targets and timeline expectations.

• Ensure a smooth handover to onboarding and success teams so new customers experience immediate value.

Account penetration

• Create detailed account plans that map stakeholders, current systems and areas of opportunity for Sedna.

• Identify expansion opportunities through continued discovery and regular engagement with operational and strategic leaders.

• Develop multi-threaded relationships across functions - ensuring Sedna is positioned as a mission-critical platform, not a point solution.

• Coordinate with pre-sales, customer success and product teams to craft joint plans that drive long-term value and platform growth.

• Proactively track and pursue cross-sell opportunities across Sedna's product suite where aligned to customer goals.

Building relationships with your existing customers and closing deals

• Prioritise your customer book based on strategic value, expansion potential and product fit.

• Keep aligned with evolving customer goals and demonstrate how Sedna's roadmap and features can continue delivering business impact.

• Run product workshops and strategic reviews to surface opportunities for additional modules, integrations or licenses.

• Lead commercial conversations around renewals and expansions - ensuring favourable outcomes for both customer and Sedna.

• Maintain frequent contact with decision-makers, offering strategic guidance and facilitating cross-functional collaboration to ensure continued success.

• Work closely with GTM, product and success teams to align efforts around shared goals and ensure consistency across the customer experience.

Continuous improvement

• Contributing and maintaining data for effective forecasting.

• Contributing to the Product, Marketing, Success and other teams to help Sedna be a better company and platform, and in turn, make a bigger impact on our customers.

• Reflecting on successes and failures, and making improvements to your ways of working as a result.

**About You

**At Sedna, we believe it's your skills and attributes that ultimately make you successful in a role. Here's what we're looking for:

Either:

Shipping experience - hands-on commercial experience within the shipping or maritime industry (e.g. operations, chartering, broking, ship management) matters to us.

Or:

Sales experience - a minimum of 3-5 years' sales B2B sales experience, ideally in a solution-led, consultative environment where you've owned the full cycle from discovery to close.

• Self motivated - you are motivated to achieve in this role because of your enthusiasm - you relish pressure from others but don't need it to succeed.

**Our Values

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of the OS together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

What you'll do

This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

In this role, you'll:

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Beyond that, you'll bring:

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• 
Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• 
Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• 
Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• 
Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• 
Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• 
Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• 
Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• 
Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• 
Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• 
Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• 
Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• 
Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• 
Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• 
Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

Experience & Skills

• 
4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• 
A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• 
Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• 
Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• 
Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• 
Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• 
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• 
Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• 
A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• 
Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• 
A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• 
Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• 
AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• 
A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• 
Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• 
A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• 
Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• 
Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

**As Vertical Market Development Lead for HVAC & Refrigeration in Europe, you will play a key role in shaping and accelerating Danfoss' growth within one of our most important market segments.

You will develop and drive the regional vertical strategy, helping customers address challenges related to energy efficiency, sustainability, and system performance. By combining deep market understanding with strong commercial leadership, you will identify growth opportunities, strengthen our market position, and support the successful execution of business priorities across Europe.

You'll join a global team driving growth and market development within HVAC & Refrigeration. Working closely with colleagues, customers, and stakeholders across regions, you'll help shape strategic initiatives and accelerate business growth. The role can be based at any Danfoss Drives location in Europe and requires travel of up to 50% of the time.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead the development and execution of the HVAC & Refrigeration vertical strategy across Europe to drive growth, market penetration, and customer engagement.

• Develop regional go-to-market approaches by leveraging customer insights, market trends, regulatory developments, and competitive intelligence.

• Identify and assess market opportunities, support business case development, and provide recommendations on growth priorities and investment decisions.

• Build and strengthen relationships with key customers, system integrators, partners, and industry stakeholders to expand Danfoss' presence and create new business opportunities.

• Enable commercial success by providing market intelligence, sales guidance, training, and strategic support while helping secure a strong pipeline, portfolio mix, and pricing position.

As a recognized vertical expert, you will promote best practice sharing across the organization, identify emerging market trends, and drive collaboration across global and regional teams to maximize customer value and business impact.

**

• Strong understanding of HVAC & Refrigeration markets, customers, applications, and value chains.

• Proven ability to develop and execute growth strategies, go-to-market plans, and commercial initiatives.

• Skilled at leading through influence, building alignment across a matrix organization, and engaging stakeholders with credibility.

You are a strategic and customer-focused professional who enjoys turning market insights into action, building strong partnerships, and driving growth across a complex international organization.

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

This role offers the opportunity to shape Danfoss' growth agenda within HVAC & Refrigeration, influence strategic decisions at both regional and global levels, and collaborate with industry-leading customers and partners across Europe.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

Even if your experience doesn't match every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply and show us how your skills, experience, and perspective can contribute to our success.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.
