Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

**This includes things like...

**

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

**Nice to haves

**

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

• managing flue gas emissions data and reporting, including follow-up on emission limits, permit conditions and regulatory documentation

As Senior IT Windows Server Architect, you will set the vision for the Windows Server operating system platform across Novo Nordisk, and turn it into a roadmap. You will be the architectural authority for two segregated environments: the General Network for enterprise IT services and the Production Network for business-critical production systems. Your decisions will shape how the platform is designed, secured, automated and run for years to come, keeping the systems our business depends on stable every day.

What you’ll bring

You are an established architect who has already set direction for Windows Server platforms in large enterprise companies. You will bring:

· A proven track record in architecture roles, such as Windows Server Architect or Infrastruc-ture Architect, in large, complex enterprise organisations.

· A clear, well-reasoned vision for building a best-in-class Windows Server operating system platform, and the ability to turn that vision into roadmaps, standards and decisions.

· Deep expertise in Windows Server architecture and engineering at scale, including Active Di-rectory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI/certificate services and Windows authentication.

· Expert knowledge of Windows Server security and hardening, privileged access and adminis-trative security models, risk management and lifecycle management.

· Experience architecting high availability, clustering, backup, disaster recovery and resilience for business-critical production environments.

· Experience designing for strict network segregation, including segmentation, firewalls, load balancing and secure communication between network zones.

· A strong grasp of virtualisation (preferably VMware and/or Hyper-V), monitoring and enter-prise management platforms, PowerShell automation and patching architecture.

· The ability to translate business, security and operational requirements into practical archi-tecture, document it clearly and win support for it across teams.

Useful, but not essential:

· Experience with Azure, Azure Arc, hybrid infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and modern automation platforms (highly desirable).

· Experience from regulated, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, financial, healthcare or other highly controlled environments.

What you’ll do

Together with the product owner, you will decide where the platform goes next. This is a strate-gic architecture role, not day-to-day server administration. You will:

· Own the enterprise Windows Server architecture, vision, roadmap and standards across the General and Production environments.

· Define and govern secure, standardised platforms, covering configuration, networking, stor-age, virtualisation, monitoring, backup and recovery.

· Set the security architecture and hardening standards for privileged access, authentication, service accounts, certificates, vulnerability management and compliance.

· Design architectures for segregated networks with secure integrations, controlled access, and high availability and disaster recovery standards that meet business recovery objectives.

· Lead modernisation, including upgrades, migrations, automation, Infrastructure as Code and reducing technical debt.

· Act as the senior technical authority, leading architectural governance and design reviews, and guiding infrastructure, security and application teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Server Platform sub-department within Infrastructure Platforms, part of Enter-prise IT & Quality. The team operates and manages all enterprise servers at Novo Nordisk, cov-ering Windows and Linux in both public and private cloud. Its goal is to streamline server opera-tions across platforms and domains, so they run fast, reliably and in line with compliance re-quirements.

You will work with colleagues in the Philippines, India, Poland, the Czech Republic, Denmark and the United States. Alongside the product owner, you will partner with infrastructure engineer-ing, operations, cybersecurity, network, application, cloud and enterprise architecture teams. Your job is to bring them together around clear architectural decisions and move them forward.

Your hiring manager will be [insert hiring manager name and title].

What you can expect here

You will own the architecture of a platform the whole company relies on. You will be trusted to set direction, challenge convention and make your voice heard, then commit with the team once a decision is made. Working across two very different environments and a global team, you will keep building your skills as the platform moves towards hybrid cloud and automation.

jobs.occupation: A Post doc position is available in the Grønbæk Group at Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC),
jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

  Our research/The group

  The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital). 

  Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

  Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

   

  The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

  The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘to reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

  Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

  This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

   

  Your job

  The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

  Your tasks will include:

   	
• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics 	
• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses 	
• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data 	
• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements 	
• Participate in grant and manuscript writing 	
• Present at local and international meetings 	
• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students 	
• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians   Start: February 1st, 2027

  Duration: 2 years

  Profile

  We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

   	
• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology 	
• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques 	
• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material 	
• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data 	
• Experience with running projects across research groups 	
• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences 	
• Excellent written and spoken English skills 	
• Very collaborative 	
• Good social skills     

  Place of employment
 The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

   

  Terms of employment 
 The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of two years. The starting date is 01.02.2027 or after agreement.
 Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025

   

  Questions 

  For further information regarding the position, please contact Professor Kirsten Grønbæk, kirsten groenbaek@regionh.dk; phone + 4535456086 / +4525211598.

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

   

  Application
 The application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position.

  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

  4. List of publications.

   

  Recommendation 
 Furthermore, the applicant should provide two letters of recommendation or two references. To be taken into consideration, the letters must be signed by the supporting person on paper with institutional letter head and in PDF-format.

   

  Application deadline 15 November 2026, 23.59pm CET.

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications 3 of 4 or letters of recommendation that do not live up to the above-mentioned requirements.

   

  The further process

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Working across Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, and Quality, you will also share your expertise and strengthen process understanding across teams.

**

**What You Bring

**You hold a master’s degree in Chemical, Bioprocess, Process, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, and have at least 10 years of industrial process engineering experience.

• A strong track record in process design, optimization, and structured troubleshooting within GMP manufacturing. Experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred.

• In-depth knowledge of process equipment, piping, valves, and instrumentation, together with an understanding of how process and automation systems interact.

• Experience with equipment introduction, qualification, validation, PPQ, and technology transfer, including changes requiring regulatory approval.

• Solid knowledge of pharmaceutical quality systems and regulatory expectations, with practical experience in investigations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, and inspection support.

**You combine analytical thinking with practical judgement and take ownership of moving issues towards resolution.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

_For more information, visit _**www.bavarian-nordic.com

**_

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer, RF Systems to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s systems engineering capability for advanced RF, aerospace, and signal-intelligence products. You will translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, and parametric requirements, system architectures, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, integration strategies, and verification plans. The work covers requirements decomposition and traceability, system performance budgeting, interface management, technical risk analysis, design reviews, integration planning, and system level verification and validation. You will work closely with RF and microwave hardware engineers, antenna systems engineers, embedded and control engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, project managers, and partner engineering teams. You will ensure that requirements, design decisions, implementation, integration, testing, and validation remain connected throughout the development lifecycle. The role requires strong RF system understanding, structured systems-engineering expertise, technical ownership, and a hands-on integration mindset. Working with technical leadership, you will turn product and architectural intent into an executable, traceable, and verifiable engineering baseline and help carry the product through integration, qualification, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Develop and maintain the functional and physical system architecture, allocate requirements to subsystems, and define key technical trade-offs.

• Establish and maintain system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Define and maintain system requirements, subsystem requirements, interface control documentation, acceptance criteria, and verification logic.

• Align RF subsystem requirements, including frequency coverage, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, phase noise, spurious responses, channel isolation, and interference resilience.

• Define antenna-system requirements covering frequency coverage, antenna gain, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, isolation between antenna channels, placement, and platform integration.

• Define embedded control, data acquisition, timing, synchronization, diagnostics, logging, networking, and system-monitoring requirements.

• Coordinate mechanical and platform requirements covering dimensions, mass, thermal management, connectors, cabling, grounding, shielding, mounting, environmental constraints, and serviceability.

• Work with RF test and characterization engineers to define measurable acceptance criteria, calibration needs, verification methods, test coverage, and required evidence.

• Prepare and maintain system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, system budgets, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Lead system integration planning and support prototype bring-up, laboratory validation, qualification, and field-test preparation.

• Identify system-level risks, interface conflicts, missing requirements, invalid assumptions, and integration blockers, and drive their resolution.

• Facilitate cross-functional technical alignment between engineering disciplines, technical leadership, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams.

• Support requirements reviews, system design reviews, integration reviews, test readiness reviews, and milestone decisions.

• Maintain traceability between stakeholder needs, requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification results, and acceptance evidence.

• Help establish systems-engineering methods, documentation practices, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future MITS Industries development programs.

Required qualifications and experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, telecommunications, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of professional experience in systems engineering for complex RF, electronic, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.

• Strong understanding of RF systems, including receiver architectures, RF signal paths, antenna interfaces, signal acquisition, data conversion, embedded control, timing and synchronization, calibration, and system validation.

• Proven experience translating product, mission, and stakeholder needs into functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Experience developing functional and physical system architectures, decomposing systems into subsystems, allocating requirements, and defining interfaces and technical trade-offs.

• Experience establishing and maintaining system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Strong understanding of requirements decomposition, traceability, acceptance criteria, and verification methods, including analysis, inspection, demonstration, and testing.

• Experience preparing and maintaining system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Practical experience with requirements-management and traceability tools such as IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, Polarion, or equivalent.

• Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams covering RF and microwave hardware, antennas, embedded systems, signal processing, mechanical design, test, manufacturing, and system integration.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs across RF performance, embedded implementation, mechanical and thermal constraints, testability, manufacturability, reliability, and operational use.

• Hands-on experience with prototype integration, laboratory validation, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting of complex multidisciplinary systems.

• Experience identifying and managing system-level risks, interface conflicts, assumptions, technical dependencies, and integration blockers. Strong technical communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align senior engineers and drive decisions across engineering disciplines.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based systems and high-throughput RF data acquisition.

• Experience with broadband, multiband, coherent, or multichannel receiver systems.

• Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering, SysML, and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent.

• Experience establishing and maintaining controlled system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, verification status, configuration, and engineering changes.

• Experience with engineering analysis, data processing, or system modelling using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent.

• Experience with field integration, testing, calibration, and deployment of complex RF or aerospace systems.

• Experience working on aerospace, mission-critical, ruggedized, or internationally distributed engineering programs.

Success in the first 6 months

• Establish the initial system requirements baseline, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, and performance budgets for the assigned product scope.

• Create a clear technical decomposition across RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, embedded control, signal processing, mechanical design, test, and system integration.

• Define the integration, verification, and validation approach for the initial prototype or subsystem, including acceptance criteria, traceability, and required evidence.

• Identify unclear interfaces, missing requirements, technical assumptions, and system-level risks early, and drive practical resolution actions. Support prototype integration, bring-up, and laboratory validation with structured system-level analysis, troubleshooting, and verification evidence.

• Establish repeatable systems-engineering practices, documentation templates, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future development programs.

Are you motivated by how companies decide which products, technologies, and business opportunities to invest in? Do you enjoy combining market insight, customer needs, financial potential, and strategic analysis to support difficult decisions? Are you looking for an internship where you can contribute to strategic portfolio decisions in Kamstrup’s international Heat/Cooling business?

Here is what your role entails

As our intern, you will work closely with Strategic Portfolio Management on questions that influence the direction of the Heat/Cooling business. You will contribute to portfolio strategy, evaluate business opportunities, analyse the balance of the portfolio, and help prepare recommendations for prioritisation and investment decisions.

More specifically, you will be:

• Contributing to the annual portfolio strategy process for the Heat/Cooling business

• Mapping customer needs, market trends, competitor movements, and technology developments

• Analysing business opportunities and assessing their strategic fit and value potential

• Developing business cases, portfolio dashboards, and decision material for management reviews

• Supporting prioritisation discussions across development initiatives

You will take ownership of analytical assignments and contribute directly to ongoing portfolio decisions. At the same time, you will gain insight into how strategic choices are made across Product Management, Sales, Finance, and Research and Development.

Meet your future team

You will become part of our Product Management Team in the Heat/Cooling department, where you will work closely together with Strategic Portfolio Management. In Strategic Portfolio Management, we challenge ideas, prioritize business opportunities, and then support them as projects on their way to our customers. Using sales numbers, market input, customer interviews, and strategic priorities, we give guidance to the organization on what to build next. We do so by seeking out data and diverse perspectives to challenge each other’s assumptions. Otherwise, we enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, and we are not shy about celebrating successes and learnings along the way.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an ambitious bachelor’s or master’s student who are curious about how companies make strategic investment decisions and motivated by analysing complex questions and turning your insights into clear recommendations.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are currently studying, or have an interest in, International Business, Business Development, Economics, Innovation Management, or Technology Management

• Have experience with Excel and PowerPoint and are comfortable working with both quantitative and qualitative information

• Are interested in how AI can be applied in your daily work

• Can structure ambiguous problems and identify the most important questions

• Communicate complex insights in a simple and convincing way and thrive when collaborating with stakeholders

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Strategic Portfolio Manager Anders Rønnau on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

jobs.description:
🇩🇰 ER DU VORES NYE MEDARBEJDER?

Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt!

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent til en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med mulighed for merarbejde.

Læs og forstå hele opslaget, før du ansøger. Vi forventer, at du har læst og forstået opslaget, inden du søger stillingen. Ansøgninger fra personer, der ikke opfylder de grundlæggende krav i opslaget, vil ikke komme i betragtning.

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os. Hos RenTid spiller øje for et perfekt resultat og sans for detaljen en stor rolle.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent og skal først og fremmest levere rengøring af høj kvalitet hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi ser ikke kun på dit CV – vi ser på din arbejdsmoral, ansvarlighed, kvalitet og lyst til at udvikle dig.

🇩🇰 🚀 MULIGHED FOR UDVIKLING

Når RenTid vokser, opstår der nye muligheder. Den rette medarbejder kan med tiden få ansvar for eksempelvis:

• 
Kvalitetskontrol

• 
Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

• 
Kundekontakt

• 
Koordinering og planlægning

• 
Teamlederfunktioner

• 
Større driftsansvar

Hvor langt du kan komme, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

🇩🇰 🧹 VI FORVENTER, AT DU:

• 
Har solid erfaring med rengøring i private hjem.

• 
Ikke er bange for at arbejde alene.

• 
Gerne har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring.

• 
Arbejder selvstændigt og grundigt, men også kan fungere i mindre teams.

• 
Har øje for detaljer og kvalitet.

• 
Er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst.

• 
Har en positiv indstilling og tager imod feedback.

• 
Har kørekort B og ikke er bange for at køre bil er et "Must". Du skal ikke søge stillingen, hvis du ikke har kørekort og lyst til at køre bil.

• 
Selv kan komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus.

• 
Er indstillet på, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde. Kan du ikke arbejde i weekenderne, så er RenTid ikke stedet for dig.

🇬🇧 SPROG – VIGTIGT

Du skal kunne tale, forstå, læse og skrive flydende engelsk.

Du skal ikke søge stillingen, hvis du ikke taler og forstår engelsk.

Dansk er en klar fordel, men ikke et krav.

⏱️ PRØVEPERIODE

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode efter gældende danske regler.

Her vurderer vi blandt andet din arbejdsindsats, kvalitet, samarbejde, ansvarlighed og udvikling.

💰 LØN OG MULIGHEDER

Du får en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Din startløn vil være 145,00 kr. pr. time, plus 12,5 % feriepenge og ATP efter gældende regler.

Større ansvar, højere løn og andre goder følger med, når du viser, at du kan løfte mere.

Efter de 3 måneders prøvetid har du mulighed for at genforhandle din løn ud fra de kvalifikationer og den udvikling, du har vist os i løbet af prøveperioden.

Vi leder efter en person, der ikke bare søger et job – men gerne vil være en del af RenTids udvikling.

📍 ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Aarhus og omegn.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

📩 LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Send os en motiveret ansøgning og CV med billede.

Fortæl kort om:

• 
Dig selv

• 
Din erfaring med rengøring

• 
Din erfaring med private hjem

• 
Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

• 
Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

Ansøgningen skal være på engelsk.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

🇬🇧 ARE YOU OUR NEW EMPLOYEE?

Start date: As soon as possible!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaning assistant for a full-time position of 37 hours per week, with the possibility of additional hours.

Please read and understand the entire job advertisement before applying. We expect you to have read and understood the advertisement before applying for the position. Applications from candidates who do not meet the basic requirements will not be considered.

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaning assistant who is skilled at their workand motivated to develop and grow with us. At RenTid, attention to detail and delivering a perfect result are extremely important.

You will be employed as a cleaning assistant, and your primary responsibility will be to provide high-quality cleaningfor our customers in Aarhus and the surrounding area.

We do not only look at your CV – we look at your work ethic, responsibility, quality of work and willingness to develop.

🚀 OPPORTUNITIES FOR DEVELOPMENT

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right employee may, over time, take on responsibility for areas such as:

• 
Quality control

• 
Training new employees

• 
Customer contact

• 
Coordination and planning

• 
Team leader responsibilities

• 
Greater operational responsibility

How far you can go depends largely on you.

🧹 WE EXPECT YOU TO:

• 
Have solid experience in residential cleaning.

• 
Not be afraid of working independently.

• 
Preferably have experience with commercial cleaning.

• 
Be able to work independently and thoroughly, while also being comfortable working in small teams.

• 
Have a strong eye for detail and quality.

• 
Be reliable, flexible and responsible.

• 
Have a positive attitude and be open to feedback.

• 
Have a valid Category B driving licence and be comfortable driving a car – this is a MUST. Please do not apply if you do not have a driving licence or are not willing to drive.

• 
Be able to get to and from the workplace in Aarhus independently.

• 
Be prepared for occasional weekend work. If you are unable to work weekends, RenTid is not the right place for you.

🇬🇧 LANGUAGE – IMPORTANT

You must be able to speak, understand, read and write fluent English.

Please do not apply if you do not speak and understand English.

Danish is a clear advantage, but not a requirement.

⏱️ PROBATIONARY PERIOD

The first 3 months will be a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish rules.

During this period, we will evaluate your work performance, quality, cooperation, responsibility and development.

💰 SALARY AND OPPORTUNITIES

You will receive a fair and competitive salary from the beginning.

Your starting salary will be DKK 145.00 per hour, plus 12.5% holiday pay and ATP in accordance with applicable Danish rules.

Greater responsibility, higher pay and other benefits will follow as you demonstrate that you are capable of taking on more responsibility.

After the 3-month probationary period, you will have the opportunity to renegotiate your salary based on the qualifications and development you have demonstrated during the probationary period.

We are looking for someone who is not just looking for a job – but someone who wants to become part of RenTid’s continued development.

📍 WORK AREA

Aarhus and surrounding areas.

RenTid provides a company car for you or the team during working hours.

📩 DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Send us a motivated application and CV with a photo.

Please briefly tell us about:

• 
Yourself

• 
Your experience in cleaning

• 
Your experience with residential cleaning

• 
Any experience with commercial cleaning

• 
What areas you would like to develop your skills in

Your application must be written in English.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

Sky‑Watch A/S is a leading Danish drone company that since 2009 has specialized in the development, production, and servicing of high‑technology mini UAS systems for Defense – nationally and internationally. With more than 155+ dedicated employees and a strong international growth journey underway, Sky‑Watch today stands as one of the most innovative players within tactical mini UAV systems. At Sky‑Watch, robust, reliable, and advanced drone systems are developed for demanding environments and critical situations where predictability, mechanical durability, traceability and user safety are paramount.

As an ambitious scale-up company in rapid development, Sky-Watch continues to expand across products, markets and the organization.

To support the company’s international growth and further strengthen the strategic level of its marketing function, we are now looking for an ambitious, strategic and inspiring

Director of Marketing

Strategic Marketing Leadership – International Defense – Commercial Impact

Do you want to shape the marketing direction of a fast-growing high-tech defense company? As Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch, you will lead and develop the marketing function across Product Marketing & Strategy, Field & Event Marketing, and Brand & Digital Influence. You will strengthen the strategic level of marketing, set clear priorities and create the framework for a multidisciplinary team of specialists to succeed. At the same time, you will connect Sky-Watch’s advanced engineering capabilities with customer needs and government procurement requirements, strengthening the company’s positioning and commercial impact in international defense markets.

Working closely with Sales, Business Development and R&D, you will ensure that marketing supports strategic procurement programs, priority accounts and Sky-Watch’s international growth ambitions.

You will report to the VP Marketing and lead a marketing team of five.

Your key responsibilities include:

• 
Product Marketing & Strategy – positioning, go-to-market strategies, technical narratives, CONOPS and tender enablement.

• 
Field & Event Marketing – international defense exhibitions, live demonstrations and targeted market activities.

• 
Visual Brand Design & Digital Influence – compelling visual communication, digital narratives and consistent brand positioning.

• 
ABM & Partner Enablement – targeted initiatives towards priority accounts, procurement programs and international partners.

• 
People Leadership – develop the marketing team and create clear direction, collaboration and ownership.

To succeed in this role, you have around 10 years of experience within Marketing and Product Marketing in international high-tech companies, preferably within a regulated industry such as aerospace or defense, combined with a few years of leadership experience. You know how to set strategic direction while empowering specialists to take ownership of execution. You bring experience with Account-Based Marketing, lead generation and partner enablement and understand customer acquisition in public tender-driven markets. Experience with technical product marketing, Tier-1 accounts, international exhibitions and complex hardware and software portfolios will be important in the role, and a strong technical understanding or flair is considered an advantage.

You are based within reasonable commuting distance of Sky-Watch’s location in Støvring or Valby.

As a person, you are a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to translate strategy into execution. You provide clear direction while giving specialists the trust and autonomy to excel within their areas of expertise. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication and interpersonal capabilities. You are curious, adaptable and resilient in a dynamic scale-up environment and bring a collaborative and inclusive approach to leadership. With high accountability, integrity and professionalism, you are motivated by building a strong and high-performing marketing function.

Are you the new Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion. For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky‑Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and no application deadline is set.

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark - a new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. Our ambition is significant: we are scaling from the early operational phase to 200+ employees within the next 18 months.

It is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

Joining FPRT now means becoming part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up.

They are looking for a Maintenance & Engineering Manager who will establish and execute an absolute, zero-compromise reliability strategy from day one.

The Role

As the Maintenance & Engineering Manager, you are responsible for the operational integrity, availability, and safety of all production assets and process equipment. Manufacturing rocket propellant leaves no room for trial and error—our process equipment must be predictable, fully mastered down to the individual component, and maintained at peak condition.

Reporting directly to the Chief Production Officer (CPO), you will lead the technical team in deep equipment mastery, anticipating service intervals with precision, and proactively replacing high-risk components before failures occur. You will work in close functional alignment with Process Engineering, Manufacturing Automation, EHS, Quality, and Production Planning to ensure seamless, compliant operations.

What You Will Do

1. Production Maintenance Strategy & Asset Management

• Develop and implement a preventive and predictive maintenance strategy for all production equipment, focusing on long-cycle and batch-based processes (mixers, thermal curing ovens, polymerization, climate-controlled chambers) to ensure thermal stability and high uptime.

• Minimize downtime by transitioning from reactive repairs to condition-based monitoring and planned interventions.

• Lead the selection, implementation, and management of a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) to track work orders, asset history, and maintenance costs.

• Integrate maintenance requirements into the equipment acquisition process alongside QA, establishing preventive risk assessments and managing obsolescence planning.

2. Process Utilities & Production Support Engineering

• Oversee point-of-use process utilities directly feeding production lines, such as process vacuum, specialized process gas loops, and line-dedicated thermal fluids.

• Coordinate with internal and external facility teams on utility drop interfaces to ensure production machinery interface readiness.

3. EHS & Process Safety Compliance

• Enforce strict adherence to EHS standards across all equipment maintenance activities.

• Rigorously execute Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and "Permit to Work" systems on energetic material processing machinery and hazardous equipment zones.

4. Production Spare Parts & Technical Inventory

• Define critical spare parts strategies for production machinery to balance inventory costs with operational risk mitigation.

• Partner with the Warehouse team to track, store, and preserve technical production spares correctly.

• Monitor market lifecycle status for key equipment components and execute end-of-life obsolescence planning.

5. Team Leadership & Technical Development

• Lead, mentor, and schedule a team of production maintenance technicians and equipment specialists.

• Ensure the team is fully trained in safety protocols (ATEX, energetic materials) and advanced technical troubleshooting.

• Plan technician resources and build mechanical redundancy strategies to protect production during interventions or unplanned events.

6. Production Line CapEx & Commissioning Support

• Support the installation, mechanical integration, and commissioning of new production lines with Process Engineering and Automation.

• Provide early input on machine "serviceability and accessibility" during the design phase to eliminate future shop-floor bottlenecks.

First 90 Days – Expected Outcomes

• Critical spare parts inventory analysis completed and gaps identified.

• Preventative Maintenance (PM) schedule established for all key production assets.

• Maintenance team skills matrix assessed and training plan initiated.

• Design of the “obtain equipment” process and equipment lifecycle framework completed in collaboration with QA.

What We Offer

• A rare career opportunity to lead the engineering and maintenance function for one of Denmark's most unique industrial and defense-tech projects.

• A role where your technical expertise directly determines the reliability and safety of high-stakes, safety-critical production.

• A professional, international environment with a clear mission and purpose.

• Brand-new factory & equipment.

• Real authority, Greenfield impact, Zero toxic culture, Mastery over busywork.

• Top-of-market compensation for the right experience.

We Are Looking For

Are you an experienced Talent Acquisition (TA) professional with a strong track record in recruitment and proactive sourcing? Would you like to help shape TA in a growing, international technology company?

Because we are a small team, everyone plays an important role. You will have a high degree of ownership and independence while working closely with your TA colleagues and the wider HR team. •

• 
Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical profiles.

We are looking for an experienced TA professional with a strong recruitment foundation, demonstrated experience in proactive sourcing and a strong passion for the field. Have a strong focus on candidate experience and quality.

Are curious about AI, automation and new TA technologies and how they can improve recruitment.

This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

jobs.occupation: Senior Backend Engineer wanted at Relewise
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who notices what others overlook? Do you need to understand the whole picture before you trust a solution? And do you get energy from learning new things while keeping an eye on the details?

Then read on!

For Relewise, we are looking for a sharp, hands-on engineer to help evolve Relewise's core platform. We are looking for someone with sound engineering judgment, system-wide understanding, and the ability to assess complex designs and implementations, including AI-generated work.

Hours: Full-time

Start date: As soon as we have found the right candidate

Location: Aarhus (or hybrid)

If you recognise yourself in this, you're the one we're looking for!

• 
You have a "no-bullshit" filter that errors rarely slip through. You notice what others overlook, and you dare to challenge when your critical sense catches something that doesn't make sense.

• 
You need to see the common thread before you act. You spot when things don't add up, and you want to understand the full context so you're not guessing.

• 
You value structure and deliver high-quality work. You are thorough, see your tasks through to the end, and make sure details are not forgotten on your watch.

• 
You're quick to learn new things and get to grips with new areas. At the same time, you dig to the bottom of things because you value thoroughness and precision.

• 
You always have a good overview, and you find it easy to work on even complex projects. You know where things stand, and you prioritise ruthlessly how your time is best spent.

• 
You get energy from solving problems, because challenges are fun and exciting to you. You're not afraid to take something apart to see what it is and what it can do, and you often think "what if".

Your responsibilities will be:

• 
Design and deliver features across the core search and recommendation engine, directing groups of coding agents as your own development team.

• 
Review code, both human-written and AI-generated, and, once sufficiently familiar with the platform, join the small group of "Last Defense" reviewers who determine whether changes are ready for production.

• 
Improve performance, scalability and resilience using profiling and production evidence.

• 
Own your changes through deployment and maintenance. When incidents occur, you investigate them systematically to find the root cause, ensuring we learn from the history and prevent similar issues in the future.

• 
Work closely with the Lead Engineer and CTO on design and the technical roadmap, and improve shared tooling, documentation and AI workflows.

What we expect from you:

• 
You have deep practical production experience with C# and .NET.

• 
You have experience with software architecture and domain modelling, and you apply SOLID, KISS and YAGNI pragmatically.

• 
You have owned and evolved a mature production backend with high throughput and low latency, and you remain close to the code.

• 
You have already or are more than ready to embrace AI throughout the development process, and you explain your decisions clearly to the team.

• 
You speak and write English fluently. Danish is a plus.

We'd be over the moon if you also have experience with:

• 
Search, recommendation systems and/or e-commerce.

• 
Azure, CI/CD and Windows Server/IIS.

• 
Domain-Driven Design. Clear modelling and sound reasoning matter more than terminology.

About Relewise and the team culture

Founded in 2020, Relewise is a headless personalisation and search platform serving more than 100 million requests daily, primarily for mid- to high-end e-commerce businesses in Denmark and Europe.

Our core platform was built from the ground up, including our own search technology, recommendation and personalisation algorithms, and proprietary event-sourced datastore. We control the complete pipeline, and scalability, exceptionally high performance and a low tolerance for errors shape our engineering decisions.

We are a small, close-knit team of senior engineers with substantial autonomy and clear alignment. We keep process overhead to a minimum by avoiding pointless meetings, but we value clear agreements, documentation, and a structured workflow so everyone knows where they stand.

You'll have daily technical partnership with our Lead Engineer and CTO, and every Friday we meet to discuss progress and lessons learned. The culture is informal and supportive; everyone's professional opinions are welcome, and we discuss lessons learned and improvements openly, turning mistakes into valuable insights for the whole team.

What we offer

• 
A role where you help set the standard for quality in a platform that reaches consumers across Europe.

• 
The opportunity to develop your skills in AI-first development alongside a highly skilled team.

• 
A work environment where we strive to understand you, so we can set you up for success in terms of tasks, leadership style and team culture.

• 
A competitive salary package with a warrant programme, pension, health insurance and paid vacation.

Talent profiling in the recruitment process

We use talent profiles in our recruitment process, so you will receive a link to the profile along the way.

It's not about giving right or wrong answers, but about whether your natural behaviour and strengths match the context you'll be working in here with us.

Do you recognise yourself in this job posting? Then we look forward to hearing from you!

Questions

If you have any questions, please contact:

Camilla B. Madsen

Recruitment Lead

TalentX

Tel: +45 5362 8226

Email: camilla@talentx.dk (for questions only. Please apply at this page)

jobs.occupation: Proteomics Application Specialist for the Proteomics Research Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The Proteomics Research Infrastructure (PRI) is a cutting-edge core facility specializing in mass spectrometry (MS)-based proteomics. PRI provides researchers with end-to-end support, including project consultation, automated sample preparation, mass spectrometry acquisition, and advanced data analysis. Established within the Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Research (CPR) and now part of the Center for Core Facilities (CCF), PRI operates in an international, collaborative, and innovation-driven environment. English is the primary working language.

  We are seeking an experienced Proteomics Application Specialist (Special Consultant) to support and further develop PRI's clinical proteomics and single-cell proteomics pipelines.

  
 Job description
 The Proteomics Application Specialist will be an integral member of the PRI team and will play a key role in the development and operation of advanced proteomics applications and service pipelines, with particular emphasis on clinical proteomics and emerging single-cell workflows. The position involves planning, performing, analyzing, and documenting advanced proteomic experiments, as well as contributing to the development, optimization, and implementation of robust, reproducible, and scalable laboratory workflows. The successful candidate will work closely with the PRI team, particularly the Proteomics Service Manager, and will report directly to the PRI Director.

  Key responsibilities

   	
• Plan, execute, analyze, and document experiments within PRI's proteomics service pipelines. 	
• Support and further develop clinical proteomics and single-cell proteomics workflows. 	
• Perform sample preparation for proteomics analyses, including the processing of large-scale cohorts comprising thousands of samples. 	
• Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize automated sample preparation and liquid-handling platforms. 	
• Operate and support state-of-the-art LC-MS instrumentation and related proteomics technologies. 	
• Perform proteomics data analysis using specialized software and contribute to high-quality interpretation of experimental results. 	
• Maintain comprehensive and accurate experimental documentation using electronic laboratory notebooks and project and sample management systems. 	
• Contribute to the development, validation, standardization, and continuous improvement of laboratory workflows. 	
• Support the implementation of scalable and reproducible processes to ensure high quality and efficiency across PRI's service activities. 	
• Collaborate with researchers, project partners, and PRI colleagues in an international and multidisciplinary environment. 	
• Contribute to the development of new applications and technologies relevant to PRI's research and service portfolio. 	
• Perform other relevant duties as required to support the activities and strategic development of PRI.   Qualifications
 We are looking for a reliable, well-organized, and highly motivated scientist who is able to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative team environment. The position requires flexibility, accuracy, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to high-quality laboratory work and service delivery.

  The ideal candidate will have:

   	
• A PhD degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, proteomics, or a related field. 	
• Demonstrated expertise in molecular biology, biochemistry, proteomics, or related laboratory techniques. 	
• Demonstrated experience with state-of-the-art LC-MS-based proteomics, including experience with Bruker timsTOF and Thermo Fisher Astral platforms. 	
• Experience with proteomics sample preparation and the handling of large-scale sample cohorts. 	
• Experience with automated liquid-handling platforms and laboratory automation. 	
• Experience with data analysis and specialized software relevant to mass spectrometry-based proteomics. 	
• Strong computer literacy, including experience with databases and laboratory/project management systems. 	
• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to independently plan and execute complex experimental workflows. 	
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.   The following qualifications will be considered advantageous:

   	
• Previous experience in clinical proteomics. 	
• Previous experience in single-cell proteomics. 	
• Experience with automated sample preparation workflows and sample management systems. 	
• Experience working in a proteomics core facility or other service-oriented research environment. 	
• Experience with development, optimization, and implementation of standardized and scalable proteomics workflows.   Salary and Terms of Employment 
 The employment is a fixed-term position until 30 June 2030. The estimated start date is 1 February 2027. Working hours are 37 hours per week.

  Employment will be as Special Consultant (Staff Scientist) under The Circular on the Collective Agreement concerning Academics in the state sector concluded between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). 

  Application 
 If you are interested in the position, please submit your electronic application, including attachments, via the UCPH Job Portal (click the “APPLY NOW” link at the bottom of the job posting). 

  Your application must include: 

   	
•  	Cover letter

 	    	
•  	CV 

 	    	
•  	Diploma(s) and academic transcripts 

 	   The application deadline is 26 October 2026.

  The University wishes to reflect the diversity of the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

  Further Information 
 Informal enquiries about the position can be addressed to the PRI director Michael Wierer; michael.wierer@pri.ku.dk. For more information on PRI visit: www.pri.ku.dk

jobs.description:
Location: On-site with possibility to work remote

Team: Data & AI

Seniority: Mid-Level to Senior

**About The Platform

**Our team is building the platform that captures, stores, and exposes the complete history of mission-critical OT (Operational Technology) asset access. Through event ingestion, audit logging, activity tracking, and data services, we provide the foundation for compliance and security reporting as well as AI-driven insights. Reliability, traceability, and data integrity are at the core of what we do.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong hybrid skill set across C#/.NET and Python to help us build the services that turn our audit and activity data into insight. Your main mission is to design and build the event-driven pipelines and backend services that sit on top of the audit platform: processing events as they arrive, enriching them with context, detecting meaningful patterns, and delivering the result to the people and systems that need to act on it.

You will work closely with colleagues in the Data & AI team to take analytical work from proof of concept into production. That means the plumbing that makes intelligence useful: pipelines triggered by platform events and completing inside a tight SLA, structured outputs stored in a schema that can evolve, APIs that expose those outputs cleanly, and delivery into customer tooling such as SIEM and collaboration platforms. Our data workflows run on Azure Databricks and our services run on Azure, and you will own significant parts of how these two worlds fit together.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of event-driven backend development, data engineering, and production operations. You will influence architecture across processing pipelines, detection logic, and integration interfaces.

We are looking for a self-driven and curious engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You value a healthy feedback culture, are open and approachable, and enjoy working closely with colleagues, ideally from the office, to solve problems together. You are focused, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve both our processes and your own work. You are comfortable navigating external constraints and can design robust solutions within those boundaries. You maintain a practical balance in documenting your work: thorough enough to ensure clarity and knowledge-sharing, yet efficient enough to avoid unnecessary overhead.

Beyond all that, this role is a fantastic chance to grow professionally, personally, and as part of a team that genuinely enjoys building great things together and having fun along the way.

**What You Will Do

****Event Processing & Pipelines

**

• Build event-driven pipelines in C# and Python that pick up audit events as they land, process them inside a time budget, and turn them into records the product and customer tooling can query

• Design processing that is correct under real-world conditions: retries, out-of-order delivery, poison messages, backpressure, and at-least-once semantics

• Decide how pipeline output is stored and versioned. Our audit data is append-only, so there is no going back and rewriting it. A schema decision here is closer to permanent than in most systems

• Take analytical work that has been proven in a notebook and make it a service that runs unattended: scheduling, retries, throughput, cost, and the monitoring that catches it when it stops being accurate

**Detection & Enrichment Services

**

• Build the backend that separates the handful of events worth investigating from the thousands that are routine: aggregation across sessions, users and devices, time windows, behavioral baselines, and risk scoring

• Keep the signal-to-noise ratio high enough that customers leave the feature switched on: deduplication, suppression, thresholding, and confidence scores that are honest about uncertainty

• Design a rules layer that customers can configure, without every new detection requiring a release

• Enrich raw events with the context that makes them actionable: severity, reasoning, and links back into the product

**APIs & Integration

**

• Design and build the C# APIs that carry this output to the three places it gets consumed: our own product UI, customer SIEM platforms, and downstream services

• Build integrations that deliver notifications and structured evidence into customer tooling (SIEM platforms, collaboration tools, downstream services)

• Design clean data contracts and event formats suitable for compliance, security, and analytics consumers

• Ensure APIs are robust, performant, and scale with growing event volumes

**Running What We Build

**

• Operate the services you build: monitoring, alerting, tracing, and incident response across Azure, Databricks, and our messaging layer

• Build the observability that tells us when output quality degrades, not just when a service is down

• Maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for the services you own

**What You Bring

****Required Qualifications

**

• Solid experience with C#/.NET backend development

• Working proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline work — you do not need to have been a Python-first engineer, but you should be productive in it

• Strong experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems — queues, event buses, or message brokers — and a clear understanding of their failure modes

• Experience designing and implementing ETL or data pipelines in a production environment

• Experience designing and building APIs (REST, and ideally streaming or event-driven interfaces)

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure Databricks) and with working across a Python data stack and a C#/.NET production environment

• Solid understanding of relational and/or distributed data stores, including schema design and evolution

• Experience building multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a correctness requirement — authorization enforced in the data access path rather than bolted on at the edge

• Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions)

• Strong sense of code quality, testing, and maintainability

**Nice to Have

****Experience with any of the following is a plus:

**Platform and engineering breadth

• Queuing technology (e.g., RabbitMQ)

• Data streaming architectures (Kafka, Event Hubs, change data capture)

• Kubernetes and container-based deployments (Docker, AKS)

• Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Bicep, Terraform)

• Workflow orchestration tools (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)

• Azure services (Functions, Container Apps, Data Lake, API Management, Monitor / Log Analytics)

• Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

• Distributed systems failure modes and resilience patterns

• Append-only / immutable data stores and time-series databases

**Domain

**

• Familiarity with SOC tooling and concepts (SIEM integration, log forwarding, security event formats such as CEF/LEEF)

• Rules engines or customer-configurable detection logic

• Exposure to OT, ICS, or other mission-critical / regulated environments

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, or IEC 62443

**Machine learning and data science

**

• Working alongside data scientists or ML engineers to productionize models — packaging, serving, and versioning

• MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation pipelines, confidence calibration, and drift detection (MLflow or similar)

• Databricks and PySpark, Delta Lake, or other lakehouse technologies

• Practical exposure to anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or statistical/ML approaches to event data

• Applied use of LLMs in production systems — structured output, evaluation, and cost control

**Why Join Us

**You will be joining an ambitious and fast-growing team that is shaping how data and AI power our products. We move quickly, take ownership of what we build, and care about doing things well. This is a place where your work has visible impact, where your ideas are heard, and where you can grow alongside colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving hard problems together. If you want to be part of building something meaningful with a team that values curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship, you will feel at home here.

Our operations team is looking for a Finance Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will work closely with our software engineers and operations team to help shape the future of finance in property management.

Turn priorities into clear commitments, make trade-offs visible, and protect the team so committed work gets finished.

Lead the shift to agentic development in your team

• 
Make agentic development part of how your team works every day, moving beyond individual experiments to shared practice.

• 
Adapt how work flows through your team as agents take on more of the building. That includes how work is specified, how code is reviewed and how quality is assured.

• 
Apply shared practices for quality, security and data handling as they develop, and stay accountable for what your team ships.

• 
Work with colleagues across engineering on how we adopt agentic development. Bring your team's needs and feedback, and help test and roll out new tools and practices.

• 
Track what agentic development changes for your team's delivery and quality, and share what you learn with other teams.

Ensure sound engineering

• 
Be accountable for the quality of your team's engineering decisions, including architecture, security, operational readiness, observability and technical debt, while your Tech Lead and engineers lead the design work.

• 
Make sure what the team ships is tested, observable and ready to run in production, and that incidents lead to real learning.

• 
Work with other Engineering Managers and Tech Leads to keep our platform and practices coherent across teams.

Collaborate across Spirii

• 
Partner with Product, Design, other departments and external consultants to align priorities and resolve dependencies.

• 
Communicate clearly and early about progress, risks and trade-offs.

Who You Are

• 
You care about people and want to build teams that grow, thrive and deliver.

• 
You hold a high bar for quality and for yourself, and you take ownership of results.

• 
You're genuinely excited about AI as the new way to build software. You want to be ahead of the curve, and you're curious about where it goes next.

• 
You're technical enough to challenge a design, read an incident and spot risk, even if you're not writing production code day to day.

• 
You communicate clearly with engineers, product people and leadership alike.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate has relevant experience with development of digital cloud-based solutions in an agile start-up environment and can take the responsibility for leading a team of developers.

We further look for a candidate with the following experience and personal traits:

• 
Relevant technical graduate degree at minimum bachelor level (engineer).

• 
3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager with direct reports, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

• 
A background as a software engineer (backend or full-stack) building cloud-based solutions.

• 
Solid understanding of distributed systems, such as microservices and APIs, and what it takes to run them reliably in production.

• 
Experience improving engineering practices like automated testing, CI/CD, observability or incident management.

• 
Familiarity with DORA metrics or similar ways of measuring delivery.

• 
Experience making senior engineers and tech leads more effective, rather than doing their work for them.

It's an advantage if you have

• 
Experience leading a team's adoption of AI-assisted or agentic development, including changing practices, not just introducing tools.

• 
Experience with AWS and containerised workloads.

• 
Experience from eMobility products.

• 
Experience leading a team through organisational change.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

• Experience working with AI professionally

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.
