jobs.occupation: Senior Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist (Construction Sector)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

.

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is seeking a proactive and driven Senior Recruiter to support talent acquisition across our fast‑growing European business. This is an exciting opportunity to join a global consultancy with ambitious regional growth plans.

Based in Copenhagen, you will play a key role in attracting and hiring top talent for our Industrial, Science & Technology team in Europe, while supporting recruitment across Data Centre, Life Science and Manufacturing projects in the Nordics.

This is a hands‑on, end‑to‑end recruitment role where you will identify, engage, and hire exceptional project managers, cost managers, and project controls specialists who help deliver world‑class construction projects. You will collaborate closely with the wider European recruitment team, contributing to a high‑performing, fast‑paced environment.

This role would suit an experienced recruitment professional with corporate experience, ideally within a professional services environment, or agency recruiter from a construction background who is looking for more variety and responsibility in a corporate recruitment role within a thriving international consultancy.

Key accountabilities:

• Lead and execute the end-to-end recruitment process for the area of responsibility.

• Responsible for identifying and sourcing active candidates.

• Understand and navigate the local market, promoting market activity and best practices.

• Responsible for ATS (SmartRecruiters) data accuracy and process compliance, from raising requisitions and job posting through to hiring.

• Engage with key programme, country, and regional stakeholders to understand the short-, mid-, and long-term recruitment needs, promoting a positive, proactive response to meeting demand.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and successfully liaise with functions such as HR, Business Operations, Global Mobility, Hiring Managers, and Country MDs to ensure a seamless hiring process.

• Guide candidates through the recruitment process, ensuring a positive candidate experience through proactive communication, timely updates, and professional stakeholder management.

• Act as a trusted recruitment partner, providing market insights and guidance to stakeholders throughout the hiring process.

• Work closely with the wider recruitment team, including coaching, mentoring, and line managing colleagues as agreed.

• Ensure compliance regarding CI and EDI within the European recruitment process.

Qualifications

• Minimum 7 years' experience in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally gained within a corporate/in-house talent acquisition function or a recruitment agency with a strong focus on permanent placements.

• Experience in the construction market recruiting project managers, cost managers, project controls specialists and and other related disciplines.

• Passion for recruiting and finding top talents in a challenging and competitive environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communicator.

• Strong team player who builds positive relationships across functions

• Fluency in English is essential for this role, a Nordic language (Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, or Danish) would be considered a strong advantage.

• Highly developed organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Commercial Awareness, with the ability to balance business objectives, project requirements, and market conditions.

Additional Information

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. We also encourage our staff to strive to ‘make a difference’ and become involved in various working committees and forums (for example, Inclusion Working Group, Social & Wellness, Learning & Development, Corporate Social Responsibilities and Net Zero Vision).

At Turner & Townsend we offer a competitive remuneration package and company benefits.

Turner & Townsend value greatly and have a focus on Corporate Responsibilities (CR), this includes a day’s leave entitlement to support a local charity or community activity along with the opportunity to participate in several office events that held throughout the year.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from people from all sectors of the community.

At Spirii, we are building world-class charging products and digital solutions for the future of mobility. Our Digital Development team drives a listen, learn, and lead culture that keeps us improving how we work and how we build.

We are now looking for a Cloud Engineer to join us on this journey. In this role, you will help our engineering teams embrace the DevOps mindset while designing and running our cloud setup. You will be part of building and maintaining a modern, scalable, and secure cloud platform that powers Spirii’s products.

You will report to our Engineering Manager and work closely with colleagues across our Engineering teams, both in-house and near-shore.

**What You Will Be Working On

**

• Build, operate, and improve Spirii’s AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning with CDK for Terraform (CDKTF).

• Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling for fast, secure delivery.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to embed platform capabilities and DevOps best practices.

• Ensure security best practices and protect against threats across our cloud setup.

• Monitor infrastructure health and performance using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments.

• Document processes for knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding.

• Contribute to incident management and disaster recovery processes.

**Who You Are

**

• You enjoy working hands-on with cloud infrastructure while enabling others to succeed.

• You bring a DevOps mindset and like to share your knowledge to drive adoption.

• You have a strong sense of ownership and pride in building quality solutions.

• You communicate clearly and collaborate easily across teams.

• You care about developer experience and making platforms easy to use.

• You contribute to an open, friendly, and collaborative team culture.

**What You Bring

****Must-have

**

• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 4+ years in a Cloud/DevOps/Platform Engineer role.

• Strong experience with AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, etc.) and security best practices.

• Kubernetes (EKS) administration and operations.

• Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CDKTF.

• CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions or similar).

• Linux/Unix systems and scripting with TypeScript.

• Monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

• Excellent troubleshooting skills.

**Nice-to-have

**

• Experience with platform development (shared services, APIs).

• Working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Knowledge of security architecture for cloud-native applications.

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours, and a good work-life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company, however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Can you inspire and develop experienced project managers while improving project and portfolio performance? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

jobs.occupation: Lead consultant - Information protection and Data security; Workplace: DK - Fredericia, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build the technical protection layers that keep Denmark's electricity, gas and hydrogen infrastructure safe from cyber threats?

Energinet is looking for a skilled cyber security professional for our new Attack Surface Management department in the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the focal point for translating security requirements into concrete, operational solutions, from requirements documents to the finished implementation of security tools and technologies. 

Key responsibilities

• Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise information protection capabilities.
• Develop and implement data protection strategies covering data classification, labeling, encryption, data loss prevention (DLP), information governance, and secure data sharing.
• Oversee the deployment and enhancement of technologies such as Microsoft Purview and related information protection solutions.
• Ensure sensitive information is appropriately protected across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. 
• Develop security requirements, technical standards & baselines for infrastructure, platforms, applications, and data.
• Implement information security improvements across networks, endpoints, servers, cloud platforms, and supplier-integrated environments.
• Act as a technical authority on information protection and security engineering practices
• Translate technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Define technical standards and security architectures for information protection and data governance.
• Guide project outcomes by ensuring security considerations are embedded early in technology initiatives.
• Collaborate with vendors and strategic partners to ensure solutions meet Energinet's security standards and operational requirements

“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to

• Have a solid technical understanding of infrastructure - e.g. networks, servers, identity, cloud and on-prem environments.
• Have experience in implementing information protection technologies
• Can write precise requirements documents and technical documentation that others can act on.
• Have an education as an engineer, computer scientist or equivalent - or solid practical experience at the same level.
• Preferably have a relevant certification (e.g. Microsoft Security, GIAC or CISSP). 
• Works in a structured and self-managed manner and thrives on both immersion and collaboration.

About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management & Technical Cyber Protection – a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface, vulnerability management, penetration testing, protection of platforms, data and applications, as well as secure configuration and hardening.

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organisation, processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors. You will have a broad interface across the IT and OT environment and get close to some of Denmark's most socially critical systems.

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes. Therefore, we are looking for Systems Engineer to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 
Your role as part of the team
As a Systems Engineer within Maritime Projects, you will play a key role in defining technical solutions for some of our advanced defense systems. You will take ownership of technical decisions within assigned system areas while ensuring alignment with the overall system architecture. Throughout the product lifecycle, from early concept and proposal work to development, integration, verification, and customer delivery, you will drive systems engineering activities and help shape the best overall solutions.
In our team, we take pride in developing people and technology. You will become part of a team of 14 System Engineers focused on Maritime projects. As one of the first points of contact for new projects entering the Integrated Product Development department, the team supports project clarification and Sales activities. We work in an informal and collaborative environment where teamwork, knowledge sharing, and open dialogue are key. We care about the work we do and the people behind it.

jobs.occupation: Associate Consultant, Netcompany Application Services (Swedish speaking)
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Netcompany, we’re looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social, and fast-developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Do you want to help build some of Denmark’s most complex and business-critical IT solutions — in a role where software development, project management, and close client collaboration shape your everyday work?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Application Services and Consulting. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best — either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & Technologies

As an Associate Consultant, you’ll help translate client needs into the right technical solutions. We use the technologies that best fit the project and the client, so it’s important that you enjoy working with new and varied technologies and domains while continuously developing your skill set.

A large part of our projects are based on web technologies such as Angular or React, combined with Java or C# on Java or .NET platforms. We also work with several enterprise platforms including Microsoft, Salesforce, IBM, Oracle, Adobe, Snowflake, Guidewire, and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle with a strong technical focus. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your day-to-day work will typically include:

• Building and developing frameworks and integrations

• Implementing features in the user interface

• Configuring and developing extensions for enterprise platforms

• Automating business processes, for example through batch jobs

• Developing tools and scripts for large-scale data migrations

You’ll join a team with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise — what we all have in common is a strong technical mindset and a shared ambition to build the best possible IT solutions together.

Our projects include some of Denmark’s most innovative and mission-critical IT initiatives across the public and private sectors, meaning you’ll help shape and improve everyday life for a large part of society.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are a recent graduate or have a few years of experience — the most important thing is your motivation to take your IT career to the next level

• Have solid technical skills within object-oriented programming

• Have a foundational understanding of software development and a strong willingness to grow your competencies

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way

• Full professional proficiency in Swedish and English (written and spoken) is a must. As you will be working closely with Danish clients and colleagues, you should be able to communicate and collaborate effectively in a Danish work environment.

Continue your development with us

At Netcompany, we invest heavily in both your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you’ll be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development journey and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure both professional growth and personal well-being, while also giving you insight into the many career paths available as you gain experience.

You’ll also take part in our training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you’ll have access to courses and seminars covering everything from technologies to client management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that the content is highly relevant and directly connected to your professional development. This prepares you for a wide range of responsibilities and continuously strengthens your expertise throughout your career with us.

Become part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, community matters. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture built on collaboration, trust, and knowledge sharing, where there is always room for sparring and support.

As part of our culture and values, all employees — regardless of background, identity, or experience — are treated with respect and understanding and given equal opportunities to grow and thrive.

You’ll also have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from different cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices across multiple countries.

We offer an environment where collaboration happens across teams and projects, combined with a wide range of social and professional events that help you expand and build your network early in your career.

Apply now

Upload your CV and application through our recruitment system via the link. If you still have questions, feel free to contact us at hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion or belief, political opinion, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at  reasonableadjustmentsdk@netcompany.com  for assistance.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Director acts as a statistical expert supporting the clinical development of compounds as compound and/or indication lead for both early and late-stage programs, and/or as trial responsible statistician with responsibilities as described below. The Director contributes to clinical development strategies and plans.

**Responsibilities

**Compound/Indication Level

• Act as lead and main point of contact related to Statistics for designated compound/indication

• Follow scientific and technical progress within the field of biostatistics in drug development and advise of new methodologies that may support innovation and improve efficiencies

• Engage with regulatory authorities on compound/indication level discussions

• Acts as a role model

• Ensures consistency of statistical methods and data handling across trials

• Ensures all compound/indication related work and information is shared between biostatisticians involved in the compound and with the vendor

• Supports compound responsible programmer in developing an integrated database specification

**CDT Member

**

• Responsible for giving statistical input to overall strategy and the synopsis development in the CDT

• Provide scientific advice to the CDT including design of trials, analyses and analyses requiring advanced statistical methodologies/techniques

• Represent the CDT/the company at regulatory meetings, during Key Opinion Leaders meetings, network and/or Partner meetings, as applicable

• Drive design and synopsis development together with relevant stakeholders

• Ensure transparent communication to relevant stakeholders from the CDT

• Ensure availability of integrated database(s), as needed, and planning and conduct of integrated analysis to support development decisions, submissions, and marketing needs

• Support development and communication in relation to communication strategy and/or scientific input to presentations, posters, and articles

Trial Level

• Represent Genmab during meetings/congresses and courses and perform professional networking

• Engage with regulatory authorities on trial level discussions

• Arranges/attends lessons learned to share learnings

• Represents Genmab during Key Opinion Leaders meetings

• Ensure biostatistician review of partner synopsis, protocols, statistical analysis plans, results meetings presentations and clinical trial reports

• Coordinate data transfers from/to business partners in collaboration with the programmer and the data manager, as applicable

• Ensures state of the art statistical work which includes but is not limited to:

• Applying adequate methods for which a solid scientific foundation exists

• Ensure proper documentation of work done

• Keep oversight and QC essential documents/data provided by vendors

• Ensure trial related work is performed in accordance with Genmab SOP/processes and standards and ICH-GCP

**CTT Member

**

• 
Participate and represent Biostatistics

• 
Review and provide input to protocol and amendment development

• 
Perform vendor oversight according to applicable SOPs

• 
Give input to eCRF setup, edit checks, validation plan, protocol deviations classifications, DSUR, IB updates, tables, figures, and listings etc.

• 
Review assay validation reports, as applicable

• 
Perform exploratory analysis, ad hoc analyses, and modelling of data

• 
Review and approve randomization and stratification plans

• 
Perform UAT of Randomization part of the IRT system as applicable

• 
Ensure procedures for blinding are in place as applicable

• 
Support timely delivery of statistical deliverables

• 
Responsible for planning and conducting trial result meetings

• 
Review and approve the CSR

• 
Attend trial and investigator meetings if/as needed

• 
Collaboration with Genmab Global Drug Safety:

• 
Participate in definition, review, and approval of data packages for Data Monitoring Committees

• 
Review and approve any amendments, corrections, and updates of data packages

• 
CRO selection and collaboration

• 
Perform vendor qualification (Request for proposal, bid defense meetings etc.) in terms of Statistics and define/specify scope of work for functional tasks

• 
Review scope of work (within own project) in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and review/challenge major work orders (WOs)/change orders (COs)/change notification forms (CNFs)

• 
Attend operational and steering committee meetings, as applicable

• 
Support regulatory submission/filing activities

**Experience

**

• Master's or PhD in a statistical discipline

• 12+ years of experience in relevant area preferred, or demonstrated capability

• Experience in statistical analysis, modelling and simulation and adaptive trial designs

• Experience with drug development in biologics, targeted therapies, and companion diagnostics preferred

• Experience working with FDA, EMA, and ICH guidance for drug development pertaining to statistics

• Experience with the relevant regulatory requirements for biostatistics processes and SOPs

• Experience with regulatory submissions including BLAs and previous experience in dealing with Health authorities such as discussions/negotiations in filing strategies

• Experience working with SDTM, ADaM, eSUB, and CDISC requirements for regulatory submissions

• Experience directing multiple complex projects/studies in a technical capacity

• Experience leading and mentoring teams

• Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role

$203,440.00---$305,160.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

Ready to be part of our crew?

At Comfort Hotel Vesterbro, we keep things real, urban, and uncomplicated. We give our guests what they need and skip the fluff, creating a space where locals, travelers, startups, and globetrotters all feel at home. We’re looking for a breakfast team member who gets our vibe - someone who knows how to make guests feel welcomed, energized, and inspired in the morning. Comfort Hotel  has taken the undisputed position as the Nordic region's leading budget hotel chain.

What you’ll be doing:

• Welcome guests with a friendly, no-nonsense approach, setting the tone for a great day

• Prepare and cook breakfast according to the Comfort Breakfast Manual and food safety guidelines

• Keep the breakfast room clean and tidy, buzzing with energy and positivity, working closely with colleagues to maintain Comfort’s effortless, urban vibe

• Refill breakfast during opening hours and taking care of dishes both during and after service hours

• Always following the Comfort rules and keeping our guest promise

• Work hours will be according to schedule with shifts between 05.30-15.00 and will include weekends and holidays.

Is this you?

• You’re upbeat, approachable, and thrive in a fast-paced, urban environment

• You’re excited to be part of a diverse team, with colleagues from several backgrounds

• You’re a morning person who gladly swaps the morning rush hour commute for the freedom of afternoons and evenings for personal interests. Your work shift will start from 5:30.

• Quick on your feet, you adapt to whatever the day throws your way - with a smile

• Experience in hospitality or customer service is a bonus, but your personality and drive are what really count

As a breakfast crew member at Comfort Hotel, it is a plus to be proficient in English. Additional language skills may be beneficial to your application.

That little extra we offer our employees at Strawberry

We believe in making things easy - not just for our guests, but for the team too. Here’s what you’ll get:

• A fast-paced, energetic work environment that values your individuality

• Opportunities to grow and make your mark within the Strawberry group

• Staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 200+ hotels

• Four free hotel nights each year based on contract

• A 25% discount on food & beverages at our restaurants and bars

• Sweet deals on experiences, travel, retail, and more.

• Access to a digital training and development tool with some mandatory and LOTS of other courses

About Strawberry

Strawberry is not your typical hotel company. With over 240 hotels, 120 restaurants, and 20 spas, we create thousands of experiences every day. Built on our core values - energy, courage, and enthusiasm - our team of 20,000 employees from 166 countries keeps us moving forward.

Perfect match much?

Apply now and be part of a team that makes every stay easy, urban, and unforgettable. We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don’t wait - positions may be filled before the deadline. This is a permanent position with a start date to be agreed upon.

**Product Management At Dalux – Built On Real Construction Experience

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and we're looking for a Product Manager with something particularly important for our Field product: deep knowledge of how construction actually happens on site.

Dalux Field is used every day by contractors, subcontractors, site managers, quality managers, safety professionals, and other construction professionals around the world.

To continue improving these products, we want even more real-world construction experience within our Product organization.

You might already be working in Product Management or construction technology. But you might also currently be a Site Manager, Construction Manager, Project Manager, BIM/VDC Manager, Digital Construction specialist, or similar and be interested in using your industry experience to improve the digital tools used across construction.

For this role, deep construction knowledge and a strong product mindset are more important than previous Product Manager experience.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• Product Discovery: Identify and understand problems experienced by construction professionals and turn them into product opportunities.

• Customer Insights: Spend time with customers and users to understand how work is actually performed on construction sites – not just how processes are supposed to work.

• Domain Expertise: Bring practical construction knowledge into Product and Development and challenge assumptions about real-world workflows.

• Feature Ownership: Lead new capabilities from initial problem discovery through development, release, and validation with users.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with developers, Product Designers, and fellow Product Managers to translate complex construction processes into simple digital experiences.

• Product Prioritization: Balance customer needs, strategic opportunities, technical feasibility, and business impact when deciding what we should build.

• Product Strategy: Help shape the future direction of Dalux Field and identify where technology can fundamentally improve how construction work is performed.

**About You

**Unlike many Product Manager positions, we don't require you to already be an experienced Product Manager .

What we care deeply about is your understanding of construction.

We believe you:

• Have significant practical experience from construction projects, preferably working close to the construction site.

• Understand the everyday workflows of contractors, subcontractors, site managers, and other on-site stakeholders.

• Have experience with areas such as quality assurance, inspections, defects, health & safety, site coordination, documentation, progress, or similar construction processes.

• Understand the difference between how construction processes are designed and how people actually work on site.

• Are passionate about improving construction through digitalization.

• Are curious, analytical, and naturally interested in understanding why problems occur rather than simply accepting existing processes.

• Can communicate effectively with both construction professionals and technically oriented colleagues.

• Are comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Previous Product Management or software-development experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

If you have spent years using construction software and regularly found yourself thinking "surely there must be a better way to do this" , this might be an opportunity to help build that better way.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

About this opportunity

As part of Getinge's Acute Care Therapies (ACT) business area, you will join a team dedicated to improving outcomes for critically ill patients through innovative cardiovascular solutions. The Danish ACT Cardiovascular team is responsible for supporting hospitals and healthcare professionals with advanced technologies used in cardiac surgery and critical care environments.

We are now looking for an Account Manager to join our team in Denmark. This is a replacement recruitment for a well-established territory, offering the opportunity to further develop customer relationships and drive growth within a highly specialized product portfolio. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across the Nordic region, including Sales, Service, Product Management, Finance, and Back Office functions.

In this role, your primary responsibility will be to develop and grow sales of Getinge's ACT Cardiovascular portfolio across Denmark while acting as a trusted partner to healthcare professionals and key decision-makers.

**

What you will do**

As Account Manager, you will combine commercial responsibility with clinical customer support, helping healthcare providers optimize patient care through our solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

• Driving sales growth of the ACT Cardiovascular portfolio across Denmark.

• Building and developing long-term relationships with surgeons, cardiologists, perfusionists, nurses, purchasing departments, and hospital management.

• Providing product expertise and clinical support during customer interactions and evaluations.

• Managing tender processes and commercial opportunities within your territory.

• Maintaining accurate sales forecasting and CRM reporting while ensuring compliance with Getinge's quality standards and processes.

This position is home-based in Denmark and requires regular travel throughout the country, as well as occasional international travel. The role offers a high degree of flexibility and autonomy while remaining closely connected to the Nordic ACT organization.

You will bring

To be successful in this position, we believe you have:

• Experience in medical technology sales, or a combination of clinical and commercial experience within MedTech.

• Proven experience working with hospitals, healthcare professionals, or healthcare organizations.

• Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience using CRM systems and strong general IT proficiency.

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively within Denmark.

Meritorious qualifications include:

• Experience within perfusion, cardiac surgery or vascular surgery.

• Experience supporting complex medical technologies in clinical settings.

• Knowledge of public procurement and tender processes.

• Experience working in an international or Nordic matrix organization.

In addition to your professional background, we value individuals who are self-driven, collaborative, structured, and customer-focused. You enjoy creating trusted relationships, take ownership of your territory, and thrive in an environment where commercial success and patient outcomes go hand in hand.

At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities.  We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers.

We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.

**

Why join Getinge**

Getinge offers a job in a safe and informal work environment, where we appreciate close team collaboration. We keep an open dialogue between leaders and employees, as well as between teams. We are focused on developing people, and together we will create a plan for learning and competence development when you start your career with us.

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 01-11-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

#LI-JM2

About us

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer for Financial and Non-Financial Risk Areas
jobs.description:
**About The Role

**Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations within financial and non-financial risk areas?

If so, this may be the right opportunity for you at Saxo.

You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. Our team oversees compliance risks across a broad range of areas, including the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk, as well as non-financial risk areas such as ICT, operational risk, model risk, data governance and strategy, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk as well as non-financial areas such as operational risk, model risk and strategic risks in relation to policies, procedures, segregation of duties, limits, calculations, samples, controls, etc.

However, if you are curious about the other areas covered by the team, we will help you develop your skills and knowledge within these areas.

As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

**Responsibilities

**

• Perform compliance risk assessments

• Provide advice and compliance opinions to the business on managing compliance risks and regulatory requirements

• Conduct compliance monitoring activities

• Contribute to regular compliance reporting to senior management of the bank

• Participate in developing the bank’s compliance framework

• Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

**Your profile

**We are looking for a colleague with experience from working with one or more prudential risk areas, who is motivated to develop deeper expertise in these areas.

**Further We Expect You To Have

**

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from the financial sector, preferably within compliance, risk management, audit, finance, credit or another relevant first-line function

• A relevant educational background within economics, finance, accounting, audit or similar

• Interest in prudential risk areas such as capital, liquidity, market risk, credit risk, model risk, strategic risk, operational risk areas, governance, and internal controls

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as CRR/CRD, Basel guidelines, EBA/ESMA guidelines, the Executive Order on Management and Control of Banks and other relevant Danish financial regulation is an advantage

Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation.

It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’.

You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

The Impact You'll Make

At Danfoss Power Solutions, we're strengthening the cost competitiveness of our Connect & Control Solutions (CCS) portfolio to support future growth and profitability. As our new Sourcing Project Manager, Pipeline, based in Nordborg, Denmark, you'll play a key role in that journey.

Working across sourcing, engineering, operations, and finance, you'll identify and drive cost optimization initiatives that improve product competitiveness and create lasting value for our customers. You'll help advance our design-to-cost approach and deliver sustainable cost improvements across a global product portfolio.

This is an opportunity to influence strategic decisions, collaborate with stakeholders across a global matrix organization, and turn ideas into measurable business results.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Lead pipeline generation of cross-functional cost optimization projects that improve product competitiveness and deliver measurable business value

• Identify and prioritize cost reduction opportunities through data-driven analysis and collaboration to build a strong pipeline of impactful initiatives.

• Facilitate workshops and improvement activities that generate ideas, align stakeholders, and accelerate implementation

• Influence and align stakeholders across sourcing, engineering, operations, and finance to secure commitment and successfully deliver results

• Strengthen cost management processes, tools, and governance to improve consistency, transparency, and long-term effectiveness.

What We're Looking For

• Strong project management experience with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and delivering measurable business results

• An engineering background, preferably within electronics, or a strong technical understanding of products, manufacturing processes, and cost drivers

• Experience with cost reduction, sourcing/procurement, engineering, or a combination of these areas, including identifying and implementing improvement opportunities

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, build strong partnerships, and navigate a complex global matrix organization

• A growth mindset and passion for continuous improvement, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, creativity, and the ability to balance detailed analysis with broader business goals

What You'll Get from Us

This is a high-impact role within Danfoss Power Solutions, where you'll help shape the future cost competitiveness of our CCS portfolio.

Furthermore:

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

Travel: Approximately 30 days per year

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're excited about driving cost optimization, collaborating across functions, and turning opportunities into measurable business results, we'd love to hear from you. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your experience, perspective, and problem-solving mindset could be exactly what we're looking for.

Our Commitment to Transparency

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

jobs.occupation: B2B Sales Development Representative – SaaS | Galten (near Aarhus)
jobs.description:
**🟢 About Mapon

**35,000+ active clients. More than 400,000 connected devices. 150+ partners worldwide. And 200+ colleagues behind it all. Mapon has already built the scale, trust and reach of an established European B2B SaaS and telematics company, and we are still far from finished. Our platform helps businesses manage their vehicles, teams and assets, reduce costs, improve safety, simplify compliance and make smarter decisions. It delivers real value at scale and keeps evolving with the businesses that rely on it.

Those 200+ colleagues work across eight Mapon branches: Latvia, Spain, Estonia, Finland, Denmark, Lithuania, Sweden and Ireland, with our headquarters in Riga, Latvia. Our team reaches beyond those eight branches, bringing together people from even more countries. That mix of local market knowledge, international experience and different perspectives helps us grow one shared product across markets worldwide.

**✅ Why Join Mapon?

**Behind those numbers is a product that never stops improving and a team that keeps moving it forward. That gives Mapon a strong foundation for the next stage of growth: deeper relationships in the markets where we are already present, more businesses to reach and new opportunities to unlock. For Sales, it means a credible story to take to customers, backed by a platform that delivers real value and plenty of potential ahead.

**🇩🇰Working at Mapon Denmark

**At the Mapon Danish branch, you’ll join a local team of 9 colleagues, including 3 people in Sales team. You’ll have your closest teammates nearby, while also working with colleagues across our eight branches and beyond, sharing market insights and helping grow one product across different countries. It’s the best of both worlds: a strong local team and a genuinely international way of working.

**💻 Role Description

**As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll be the first point of contact for many of our future customers. You’ll reach out to companies across different industries to introduce Mapon’s fleet management and asset-tracking solutions. Your mission: generate high-quality leads, book meetings with potential clients, and support the Growth and Sales teams in growing our presence in the Danish market.

A typical week will include researching and identifying potential customers, reaching out through calls, emails and LinkedIn, following up on conversations and building new sales opportunities, giving you plenty of room to sharpen your B2B sales skills and take ownership of your results.

**🚀How Your Onboarding Will Look Like

**Your first months at Mapon will be about getting to know our customers, our product, and what makes a great sales conversation, with regular feedback and support from the team. You’ll connect with businesses facing real, everyday fleet challenges and introduce solutions that can make a meaningful difference to their operations. It’s a chance to strengthen your B2B sales skills, take ownership of your results, and grow your career with an established international SaaS company.

**💼 What You’ll Do

**

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities in the Danish market

• Reach out to potential clients via cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn

• Qualify leads through discovery conversations

• Schedule and book meetings with potential clients for our Sales Manager

• Collaborate with the Growth team to refine messaging and outreach strategies

• Share feedback from prospects to help improve sales approaches and product positioning

• Maintain accurate CRM records and report activities

**✅ What We’re Looking For

**

• Native level Danish and excellent communication skills in English (spoken & written)

• At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer-facing roles (ideally B2B SaaS, but not mandatory)

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented mindset

• Curious and coachable — you’re eager to learn, take feedback well, and want to grow in sales

• Resilient — you’re not afraid of rejection and know how to bounce back with energy

• Tech-savvy and eager to learn new tools (CRM, sales engagement platforms, etc.)

**🌍 Why Mapon?

**💰 Base salary from 27 000 DKK/ Gross (monthly) **+ OTE bonus based on performance

**🌍 Join an international team of 200+ colleagues with global reach and local soul.

🍕 Partly subsided lunch at the office.

🧘♀️ Hybrid work setup – work from home or in a cozy office in Galten (mainly work is organized from the office).

🤖 Access to AI tools and paid plans, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and others if needed, to support your daily work and productivity.

🎉 Social events, team buildings, and a supportive work culture.

💼 Laptop, accessories, and everything you need.

🎂 Extra day off on your birthday.

🧠 Annual training budget.

🕓 Flexible hours to enjoy life outside work.

🪴 Wellness days- take time off when you’re not feeling well, without the need for a sick leave certificate;

🤝 Referral bonus — receive a reward when you refer a candidate who successfully joins our team;

🎓 Mentor bonus — onboarding mentors receive an additional salary bonus when their new colleague reaches the two-month milestone;

👥Join a friendly, supportive team where you'll thrive, with a well-planned onboarding process starting from day one to ensure your success.

**⏰ Our Hiring Process

**

• 
CV review – Your application will be reviewed by HR and the Hiring Manager (Head of SDR).

• 
Pre-recorded interview (Testlify) – Selected candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded interview via Testlify (in video format)to answer questions and test language knowledge, allowing you to answer at a time that suits you best.

• 
Video interview – interview with HR and Hiring Manager (up to 60min).

• 
Video interview – Final interview with the Sales Team Lead of the Denmark branch (up to 60min).

• 
Background check - references.

This is your chance to be part of something meaningful, grow your skills, and make your mark in a dynamic and future-focused company. Apply now and let’s shape the future of telematics – together.

• We provide detailed feedback on interview performance and/or the technical task only to candidates who have reached the final stage of the selection process.

**🧭 Ready to join the adventure? Send us your Resume in English today! 🚀

**Mapon Denmark ApS (Reg. no. 38434640)

jobs.occupation: Oliver Wyman – Senior Consultant- (m/f/d) – Stockholm or Copenhagen
jobs.description:
**Who We Are

**Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

**What You Will Do

**As a Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in shaping client engagements from problem definition through implementation. You will work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

**You will:

**

• Lead workstreams on client engagements, structuring analyses and developing actionable recommendations that support client decision-making.

• Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.

• Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.

• Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.

• Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

**Why join us?

****You can be your best here

**At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

**Create solutions that have impact

**

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

**Develop as a leader

**

• Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.

• Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.

• Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

**Learn and grow without limits

**

• Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.

• Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.

• Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

**Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

**

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

**Experience Rewards That Work For You

**

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

**Who can apply?

**We are looking for top-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems, enjoy developing high-impact content, and are excited to build a long-term career at a leading strategy consulting firm characterized by sustained double-digit growth, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong focus on culture and career sustainability.

**Required Qualifications

**

• 3+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier strategy consulting firm.

• Experience serving clients within Banking and Financial Services, Finance and Risk, Restucturing, Insurance, Logistic, is highly advantageous.

• Undergraduate or advanced degree in STEM, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline from a leading university.

• Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different audiences and seniority levels.

• Demonstrated experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.

• Proven ability to deliver results under pressure while managing multiple priorities.

• Fluent business English and another Scandinavian language

• Willingness to travel internationally as client needs require.

**Nice to have

**

• Data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, or data science capabilities.

• CFA or equivalent professional certification.

• MBA or Master's degree from a top-tier university.

**What we're looking for?

**Successful candidates demonstrate:

• Intellectual curiosity and structured problem solving.

• Strong ownership and accountability.

• Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• An inclusive leadership style and commitment to developing others.

• Adaptability, resilience, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work respectfully across diverse teams and cultures.

**How to apply?

**Please submit your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website.

**What to expect during the interviews process?

**At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business..

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. jobs.occupation: Kitchen Manager Røghus - Full-Time · Flyverbyen, Amager
jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

• 
Overall organization of the kitchen

• 
Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

• 
Staff scheduling

• 
General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

• 
Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

• 
Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

• 
Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

• 
Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Kitchen Manager

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Location: Flyverbyen, Amager

Salary: Based on qualifications

Application deadline: Monday, October 19, 2026

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application to christian@roeghus.dk no later than October 19, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact us at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.
