Do you thrive in a role where you are close to the pulse of the business and work directly with executive management? Are you able to ensure an efficient and structured workday while respecting all business priorities? If so, you now have a unique opportunity to bring your professionalism into play and act as a trusted Executive Assistant to the CEO and the rest of the executive team at Norican in Taastrup.

Your role and responsibilities

As an Executive Assistant, you will occupy a key role as the central focal point, setting the direction for management's administration and creating structure. Working within a dynamic team of executives, you will act as the primary point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders globally.

In this position, execution and discretion are priority areas and are seen as a crucial discipline where high quality is paramount. This means your day-to-day work will offer significant professional variety through a wide range of administrative and coordination tasks. In this role, you will act as a gatekeeper, create clarity, and ensure smooth daily operations for the executive management team

Your most important task is to ensure that executive management's visions are effectively supported. You will do this by:

• Managing and prioritizing the CEO's calendar according to the annual business wheel, with a focus on allocating time for strategic meetings and urgent matters

• Acting as the primary liaison and local ambassador, ensuring seamless communication between the executive management, and all internal and external stakeholders

• Planning and organizing meetings, gathering input, and managing logistics

• Handling global travel logistics for the executive team, including flights, hotels, transportation, visa applications, and travel expense reports

To succeed in the role

To succeed in this role, it is crucial that you can maintain oversight and act as a trusted partner to the executive management team. Your success will be measured by the CEO always being well-prepared, meetings being flawlessly organized, and your ability to intuitively anticipate needs before executive management asks. Therefore, you must be able to communicate clearly, exhibit exceptional discretion with confidential information, and handle stakeholders at all levels. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and remain resilient and calm even when deadlines approach and pressure rises.

We hope that you will bring:

• A minimum of 5–10 years of documented, successful experience as a PA/EA supporting C-level management

• A relevant educational background, such as a BA in Business Administration, or equivalent solid experience

• Excellent communication skills, fluent proficiency in English (written and spoken), and strong IT and MS Office capabilities

• Experience navigating complex global travel logistics and an understanding of cross-cultural differences

• A proactive, highly service-minded, and independent approach with a strong "can-do" attitude

Why you should join Norican?

In this role, you will play a crucial part in enabling the executive management team to succeed in driving Norican’s ambitious agenda and continued growth. You will be close to the heart of the business while becoming part of a professional, informal, and down-to-earth culture, where people work closely together, trust each other, and focus on making things happen. Professionally, you will benefit from a direct reporting line to the CEO and hold a central position that ensures the executive team’s continuous efficiency both locally and globally.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

Ready to learn more and ready to apply?

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. We will process your application confidentially, and it will only be shared with your prior consent. If you have any further questions about the position, feel free to contact our Recruitment Consultant on this role Mille Maegaard-Fast at +45 92 92 08 53.

About Norican

NORICAN. Shaping Industry.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

Can you deliver technology initiatives that create measurable operational value and enable business outcomes? At Orifarm, we are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Product Owner to help shape the digital solutions supporting our global Supply Chain operations

About the job

You will play a central role in bridging Supply Chain and Corporate IT, ensuring our solutions deliver value to the business while supporting operational excellence and future growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT colleagues, vendors, and partners, you will drive improvements, translate business needs into solutions, and help shape the future direction of our ERP landscape.

The role combines elements of product ownership, ERP expertise, demand management, business engagement and continuous improvement. You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, translate them into actionable priorities and ensure solutions are delivered and adopted successfully. As part of this, you will also contribute to a significant ERP transformation initiative, representing Supply Chain requirements and helping ensure continuity between current and future solutions.

Your key responsibilities:

• Own and manage the roadmap, backlog and priorities for Supply Chain-related ERP capabilities and supporting solutions

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain stakeholders to understand business goals, challenges and opportunities

• Translate business and operational requirements into scalable solution designs and delivery priorities

• Function as solution and system owner for relevant Supply Chain platforms and capabilities

• Collaborate with developers, architects, vendors and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of enhancements and projects

• Support incident resolution, governance activities and ongoing optimization efforts

• Contribute to our ERP transformation journey by supporting requirements validation, testing, business readiness and adoption activities

Succes in this role means:

• Supply Chain solutions remain stable, secure, compliant and continuously improving

• Business stakeholders experience IT as a trusted and value-adding partner

• Demand and improvement opportunities are translated into clear priorities and successful deliveries

• Operational excellence and long-term transformation objectives are balanced successfully

• New capabilities are supported by standardized, scalable and efficient solutions across Supply Chain

Who are you?

You enjoy working at the intersection of business and technology, and you understand how digital solutions can enable efficient and scalable Supply Chain operations. You move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational challenges, building strong relationships across both business and IT.

You are a pragmatic and proactive problem solver who can balance competing priorities, challenge existing ways of working constructively, take ownership of outcomes and focus on delivering real business value. Most importantly, you understand that technology is only successful when it is adopted and creates measurable outcomes for the business.

We imagine that you have:

• Experience from roles such as Solutions Lead, Product Owner, ERP Consultant, Functional Lead, Lead Business Analyst, Application Manager or similar

• A strong understanding of Supply Chain processes and the systems supporting them

• Experience working with enterprise ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, IFS, Infor or similar

• Experience managing roadmaps, backlogs and business demand

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience working across business and IT functions

• The ability to translate business requirements into scalable and practical solutions

• Fluent English skills, written and spoken

Who are we?

Group & Compliance Solutions is a central function within IT, responsible for delivering and evolving digital capabilities that support critical business processes across Orifarm. We work closely with functions throughout the organization, including Supply Chain, which is at the heart of Orifarm's business model. Supply Chain’s ability to source, repackage, and distribute pharmaceutical products reliably and compliantly across markets depends on effective processes, strong data foundations, and the right technology solutions, making our work an essential enabler of business success.

You will join a skilled and dedicated ERP team within Group & Compliance Solutions that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed. We offer an informal yet ambitious environment with a strong sense of team spirit, where learning from experience is encouraged and new perspectives are valued. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to influence both solutions and ways of working.

You will be reporting to the Director of Group & Compliance Solutions.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing either a bachelor's or master's degree in Architectural Program or similar.

• Have good problem-solving skills

• Be a creative and technical thinker

• Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

• Sustainability, materials & reuse

• BIM, Revit, design & sketching

• Client consultancy & tendering

• Restoration & building preservation

• Competitions & visualizations

• Descriptions & quality assurance

• Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

**A place to work and so much more

**At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

**Got more questions?

**Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

**Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key.

**We focus on creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equal opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are considered valuable. We also take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes when we put together teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

NOTE

Kindly submit your CV, Cover Letter, and Portfolio. As only two attachment fields are available on the application page, please combine files where needed and upload them accordingly.

We only accept applications from active students who have not already completed an internship within their studies.

The Role

Our Purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

You will be leading a group of engineers while directly contributing to the successful outcomes of the team by supporting excellent engineering practices, working on the team’s roadmap and strategy and enabling rapid delivery of high quality software. You will support your team to hone their engineering skills and grow as individuals in order to meet the capabilities required for the team. Your focus will be on driving engineering initiatives and ensuring the team makes progress towards their goals.

• 
Lead, develop and grow a high performing team through coaching, mentoring and setting a clear direction by connecting the work they do to the Planday Engineering and Product strategic objectives.

•

• 
Help to cultivate a fun, appreciative, rewarding, innovative and results-driven culture that lives and breathes our Planday values.

Engineering & Delivery

Coach and enable your team toward effective and efficient delivery.

Success looks like

AI as a multiplier: You actively explore and adopt AI-assisted development tools and practices, enabling your team to work smarter, reduce repetitive effort, and push the boundaries of what a team can deliver.

Remove barriers: Understand what drives your team's best work, actively clear blockers, and ensure operational hygiene (leave, expenses, processes) is handled smoothly.

What you’ll bring with you

Job Description

Do you want to take senior hands-on technical ownership of how mission-critical data centers are designed, expanded, and handed over for operation?

GlobalConnect is expanding data center capacity across the Nordics and Northern Europe. To support this growth, we are strengthening our Large Projects organization with a Data Center Designer based in Taastrup.

This is a senior specialist role at our highest specialist level. You will act as a technical authority across large data center projects, influence design direction, challenge key technical decisions, and help shape more consistent ways of working across countries.

The role is a hands-on role. You will work directly with layouts, power and cooling concepts, system architecture, technical documentation, supplier designs, commissioning readiness, and operational handover. This is not a technician or installation role, but you should enjoy getting close to the technical solution and being present in the data center environment.

What you need to succeed

• Hands on experience with data center infrastructure or other mission-critical environments, such as energy, pharma, industrial facilities, or similar

• Strong understanding of cooling systems and power infrastructure in mission-critical environments

• Proven hands-on experience with alarm and monitoring systems, including system architecture and integration with critical infrastructure such as power, cooling, and security

• Ability to interpret, review, and challenge engineering drawings, technical documentation, specifications, supplier designs, and system architecture choices

• Fluent English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage

About the role and the team

You will join a small, senior, and specialized team working across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Germany. The team works closely across borders and is building a more consistent pan-Nordic approach to data center design, expansion, and operational readiness.

In Denmark, this role closes an important capability gap. You will bring deep technical design expertise into a setup that already has strong project management capability. You will work closely with Project Managers, Sales, Procurement, external consultants, vendors, customers, and Operations.

A key part of the role is to act as a trusted technical advisor. You will help translate customer needs into technically sound solutions, challenge assumptions when needed, and ensure that design choices support long-term reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.

What you’ll be working on

• Act as technical authority within large data center projects, from early concept through commissioning, acceptance, and handover

• Own and challenge system-level design decisions across power, cooling, controls, alarm and monitoring systems, security, and building interfaces

• Review layouts, airflow concepts, cooling capacity assumptions, power distribution principles, single-line diagrams, and supplier designs

• Develop and review technical requirements, specifications, scopes of supply, risk assessments, and design documentation

• Support FATs, site inspections, commissioning activities, acceptance testing, and operational handover

• Strengthen standardisation, repeatable technical solutions, and design quality across projects and countries

Who we are looking for

You are a senior mechanical technical specialist who enjoys working with complex systems, high expectations, and decisions that have long-term operational impact.

You are confident in your technical judgement and comfortable challenging designs, suppliers, consultants, customers, and internal stakeholders when the solution needs to be improved. You can explain complex technical choices clearly and help others understand the trade-offs between reliability, cost, schedule, scalability, and operational readiness.

You enjoy working close to the physical technical solution. You are comfortable reviewing drawings, questioning assumptions, calculating capacity, discussing design alternatives, and explaining why a solution will work in practice.

To succeed in this role, you should also be motivated by building trust across teams. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Projects, Operations, vendors, and customers, especially where expectations, technical reality, and operational needs must be aligned.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Our recruitment process

• Talent Acquisition Screen

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• Case interview with Hiring Manager and peer/stakeholder

• Final alignment meeting

• References

Practical information

This role is based in Taastrup, Denmark, and requires strong on-site presence in the data center environment. We are only open to applicants already based in Denmark

Due to security clearance requirements, you must be able to document that you have lived and worked in an EU or NATO country for the past 7 years and we are not able to offer work visa support or sponsorship for this role

At GlobalConnect, you will play a key role in building and safeguarding critical digital infrastructure that society depends on every day. You will have real technical influence, work on complex data center projects, and help shape how we design and deliver reliable infrastructure across multiple countries.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

Design the systems that guide satellites in orbit for new ambitious missions

We are seeking an experienced AOCS/GNC Engineer to design, develop, and validate attitude determination, orbit control, and autonomous navigation solutions for small satellite missions. In this role, you will develop guidance and control strategies across diverse and demanding mission profiles — from VLEO drag-dominated regimes to deep-space trajectories and asteroid proximity operations.

You will join our Advanced Missions global team, developing next-generation AOCS/GNC concepts while collaborating closely with GomSpace's established AOCS team in Aalborg — who built and flew the AOCS for the Juventas CubeSat on ESA's Hera mission and are currently developing full 6-DoF GNC for the Llevant (RAMSES) asteroid rendezvous mission.

**

Your Role**

As AOCS/GNC Engineer, you will own the attitude and orbit control design for advanced mission proposals — from requirements definition and algorithm design through high-fidelity simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design and implement AOCS/GNC algorithms for attitude determination, control, and autonomous navigation across diverse mission profiles.

• Develop guidance and orbit-control strategies tailored to SSA, VLEO drag-dominated regimes, and deep-space trajectories.

• Model and simulate spacecraft dynamics, environmental disturbances, and sensor/actuator performance for mission-specific scenarios.

• Validate algorithms through high-fidelity simulations, Monte-Carlo analyses, and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

• Collaborate with systems, propulsion, and mission design teams to define control requirements and ensure end-to-end stability and performance.

**

What Success Looks Like**

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace's AOCS product portfolio (GSW-600 reaction wheels, Auriga/Twinkle star trackers, STIM300 IMU, AOCS Flightcore software).

• Delivering your first AOCS sizing and mode analysis for a mission proposal and setting up a reusable MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment.

• Establishing working relationships with the Aalborg AOCS team and communicating AOCS trade-offs clearly to non-AOCS stakeholders.

Over time, you will be recognised for owning end-to-end AOCS/GNC design for advanced mission proposals, developing and maintaining GNC strategies across multiple mission regimes, and achieving successful Monte-Carlo validation campaigns that demonstrate algorithm robustness.

**

What You Bring**

You are an AOCS/GNC specialist with deep analytical rigour and a passion for solving complex spacecraft dynamics and control challenges across unconventional mission profiles.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Control Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. A PhD focused on GNC, spacecraft dynamics, or autonomous navigation is a strong plus.

• 3–5+ years of experience in AOCS/GNC algorithm design, simulation, and validation for spacecraft missions.

• Experience with attitude determination (gyro-stellar estimators, EKF/UKF), 3-axis control (sliding mode, PD/PID, LQR), and momentum management.

• Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink for spacecraft dynamics modelling and Monte-Carlo analysis.

• Experience with C/C++ implementation of flight algorithms and familiarity with AOCS sensors and actuators (star trackers, IMUs, reaction wheels, magnetorquers, RCS thrusters).

• Exposure to ESA/ECSS project lifecycle and AOCS design reviews (PDR, CDR) is highly valued.

**

Who You Are**

You combine deep mathematical rigour with creative engineering intuition. You are energised by the challenge of designing control solutions for missions that push the boundaries of what nanosatellites can do.

You are known for:

• Analytical depth — AOCS/GNC demands mathematical precision, and you deliver it.

• Creative problem solving — developing novel control strategies for unconventional mission profiles.

• Collaborative communication — translating complex dynamics and control concepts into clear requirements for systems and propulsion teams.

• Self-driven initiative — comfortable with ambiguity in early-phase mission design.

• Execution discipline – ensuring commitments are met in demanding environments.

• Customer focus – ensuring focus on customer’s success.

• True leadership — taking ownership of your domain and driving technical excellence.

**

Why Join Us**

You will play a key role in shaping future space missions at their most decisive stage. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with leading institutional customers, influence mission architectures from the start, and contribute to programs with long-term strategic impact.

**

Join our mission**

jobs.occupation: Associated Project Director/Multidisciplinary Project Manager, COWI/1920
jobs.description:
The Company

COWI is a leading international consultancy within engineering, architecture, energy, and the environment. In close collaboration with clients, COWI co-creates innovative and sustainable solutions that enhance quality of life for current and future generations. With a primary presence in Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, North America, and India, COWI employs approximately 7,500 professionals who bring expertise across a wide range of disciplines.

If you are curious to learn more, we invite you to explore some of COWI’s featured projects at www.cowi.com or view their global portfolio at: Projects around the world (cowi.com)

On behalf of COWI, Best Talent is now seeking an Associate Project Director.

The organisation & the Team

COWI’s Building & Industry Executing Unit in Denmark, consists of approximately 1050 professionals and specialists across building related disciplines.

Within this framework, you will be part of a dedicated Multidisciplinary Project Management team in Lyngby, consisting of approximately 38 committed colleagues. This structure ensures a strong, supportive, and highly professional environment focused on excellence in project delivery.

As part of this strong professional community, you will work alongside dedicated, talented, and ambitious colleagues who are strongly committed to excellence in project leadership and management. Moreover, you will have the opportunity to realize your full potential within an inclusive and supportive professional environment.

Associate Project Director

Exiting Multidisciplinary Building Projects – From Design to Execution

• Strong focus on clients and project delivery

• Thrive in a collaborative and supportive culture

• Shape your own professional development

• Contribute to a more sustainable and livable world

The Challenge

As Associated Project Director for construction projects in Denmark, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management of building projects—from initial planning through to execution. Your role will encompass quality assurance, budget control, contractual and financial oversight, as well as the coordination of timelines and resources.

You will also act as the key liaison with clients and collaborate closely with stakeholders such as public authorities, contractors, and design partners.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading new construction and renovation projects from concept to completion

• Participating in large-scale projects as part of a broader project management team

• Managing complex stakeholder environments, clients, authorities, contractors, and design partners

• Maintain close collaboration with clients to ensure their needs and expectations are consistently met

• Overseeing project scope, schedule, risks, and cost management

• Ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and sustainability across all project stages

• Driving cross-disciplinary collaboration across COWI’s teams and geographies

• Contributing to the professional development of project team members

Why join COWI?

At COWI, your work contributes to shaping a sustainable and liveable world. By combining deep knowledge, curiosity, and courage, COWI develops solutions that address today’s challenges and enable a better tomorrow. COWI has committed to phasing out fossil-based projects and aspires for 100% of its revenue to stem from sustainability-focused initiatives.

COWI values diversity, continuous development, and a sense of belonging. They foster a supportive and enjoyable workplace, knowing that a healthy work-life balance enhances performance both professionally and personally. You will report to the Vice President of the group and be offered a competitive compensation package, aligned with your experience and qualifications.

Your profile & Talent:

You are an experienced Multidisciplinary Project Manager who thrives in collaboration with colleagues, partners, and clients. You foster strong relationships through integrity, accountability, and a proactive mindset. Your background has equipped you to confidently lead medium- to large-scale design projects.

Qualifications and key competencies:

• A relevant academic background in civil engineering, architecture, or a related discipline

• Professional experience in Denmark, with in-depth knowledge of all phases of the Danish building project lifecycle

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex project environments

• A proactive and structured approach to work, with keen attention to detail

• A self-motivated and inspiring personality that promotes teamwork and positive dynamics

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written

Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is a core value at COWI, and inclusion is a strategic priority. The company is committed to fostering a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities for growth. Leaders at COWI are expected to model inclusive behaviour and embrace diverse perspectives as a strength in team formation and decision-making processes. These commitments are not only embedded in COWI’s values—they are part of what the company believes is the right thing to do.

Application

Best Talent is managing the recruitment process and will treat all applications with strict confidentiality.

Please send your application in English, marked “1920/Associated Project Director, COWI”, to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible due to the urgency of this position. For more information about Best Talent, please visit www.besttalent.dk.

Are you passionate about combining deep product development expertise with compliance leadership to shape the next generation of water and climate solutions? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.

As our new Compliance Engineer, you will be driving product design from concept to production readiness while building compliance expertise across the organization, interpreting international standards, and managing relationships with third-party agencies such as VDE and UL. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

What you will be doing

As a key part the Development team, you'll create impact by shaping how Grundfos develops compliant, world-class products by bridging the gap between engineering innovation and global regulatory requirements..

Your main responsibilities include:

What makes you a great fit

•    Proven experience working with third-party certification agencies (e.g., VDE, UL, PFAS) and translating international standards into actionable product requirements

Why you will love working here

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

•    Access to on-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com

About Grundfos

Grundfos is one of the world’s leading water technology companies with more than 19.000 employees in 60+ countries all over the world. Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

Do you want your engineering skills to directly shape how athletes understand and improve their movement? Are you excited by the opportunity of turning noisy, high-dimensional data into clean, actionable biomechanical metrics used by professionals and ambitious amateurs alike?

We are looking for an Algorithm Developer in Mathematical modelling to join our Motion Analysis team. You’ll work at the intersection of deep learning and real-world sports science, taking the raw output of our AI models and building the modelling and post-processing pipelines that make the data real. This is where the engineering meets the athlete.

As a member of our team, you will be responsible for the key step between AI prediction and product output. Our deep learning models produce body key points from video. Your job is to turn those noisy, uncertain estimates into robust skeletal fits and reliable biomechanical metrics that our users can trust and act on.

We believe it takes careful post-processing and modelling to turn raw deep learning predictions into data that is real, reliable, and actionable. You will design and develop custom algorithms that handle outlier detection, optimization, and human body model fitting, often as one integrated modelling approach rather than separate steps. You will be part of an agile, collaborative team, contributing to solutions from prototype to production and helping shape our products. You will join a team of six, with diverse backgrounds spanning deep learning, computer vision, software engineering, and mathematical modelling.

We work in a collaborative environment where team members support each other and share responsibility for moving projects forward. We believe that strong solutions emerge through open dialogue across disciplines. We also value a positive and engaging work environment, where curiosity is encouraged and people can explore problems that interest them alongside supportive colleagues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Designing and implementing mathematical models that fit skeletal structures to noisy key point data, balancing input uncertainty with anatomical constraints.

• 
Developing robust outlier detection and rejection methods that work within the modelling framework, not just as a pre-processing step.

• 
Building and refining optimization pipelines for post-processing deep learning outputs into accurate biomechanical metrics.

• 
Conducting data analysis and statistical validation to understand model performance and propose improvements.

• 
Collaborating closely with our deep learning engineers and software engineers to ensure your models integrate cleanly into the broader product pipeline.

• 
Exploring and evaluating new approaches from research literature, adapting them to our specific problem domain and data characteristics.

Job requirements

• 
A master's degree or PhD in Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related technical field with strong mathematical foundations.

• 
Solid skills in mathematical modelling, you are comfortable formulating real-world problems as optimization, estimation, or fitting problems.

• 
Strong foundations in linear algebra, statistics, and numerical methods.

• 
Experience working with noisy, real-world data,you understand uncertainty and know how to handle it.

• 
Programming skills in Python - Familiarity with C++ is a plus.

• 
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and are driven by making your work matter in a real product, not just in a report.

• 
Communication skills, with the ability to explain mathematical choices to colleagues from different technical backgrounds.

Preferably:

• 
Experience with signal processing methods such as filtering, smoothing, or time-series analysis.

• 
Familiarity with constrained optimization techniques and solvers.

• 
Experience with human body modelling, biomechanics, or motion capture data.

• 
Exposure to deep learning, not necessarily training models, but understanding what they output and why they fail.

• 
A genuine passion for applying mathematical thinking to solve real-world challenges.

• 
An interest in sports like golf, baseball, or others is a bonus!

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer – Manufacturing, Automation & Applied AI
jobs.description:
Hartmann Packaging A/S – Lyngby, Denmark

Would you like to apply Artificial Intelligence where it creates real-world impact in manufacturing?

Hartmann is looking for an AI Engineer to help accelerate the adoption of AI, machine learning, and automation across our global organization. This role will play a key part in transforming how we optimize manufacturing performance, operational processes, and data-driven decision-making through practical AI solutions.

You will join Hartmann’s Data, Analytics & AI team and become part of a growing digital transformation agenda where AI is expected to become a key enabler of operational excellence, process improvement, and future competitiveness.

It a experimentation role and a hands-on engineering position for someone who wants to develop, deploy, and scale AI solutions that create measurable business value in real operational environments.

The Role

As AI Engineer, you will become part of Hartmann’s Data, Analytics & AI team, reporting to the Head of Data, Analytics & AI, Jan Boldt.

You will work closely with stakeholders across Production, Digital Manufacturing, Global Process Excellence, Enterprise Systems, and Business Functions to identify opportunities where AI can simplify work, improve process quality, reduce manual effort, and create measurable business outcomes.

Your primary focus will be on manufacturing and operational excellence, helping Hartmann leverage AI, machine learning and automation to improve production performance, quality, process stability, waste reduction and operational decision-making across our factories.

While the role will also contribute to forecasting, planning and commercial analytics initiatives, the core mission is to unlock value from production and operational data and turn AI into a practical capability within Hartmann’s manufacturing environment.

Beyond developing solutions, you will play a key role in helping colleagues across the organization understand, adopt and utilize AI effectively. Success in this role will therefore not only be measured by the solutions you build, but also by your ability to increase AI awareness, capability and confidence throughout the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled solutions that improve manufacturing performance and operational excellence

• Build machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions based on production and operational data

• Identify opportunities for AI, automation, and machine learning during process design and continuous improvement initiatives

• Develop AI agents, intelligent workflows, and decision-support solutions

• Translate operational challenges and business needs into scalable AI use cases

• Support predictive analytics initiatives related to forecasting, planning, and optimization

• Collaborate closely with Data & Analytics, Global Process Excellence, Digital Manufacturing, and Enterprise Systems teams

• Drive AI adoption through training, workshops, and hands-on support for business users

• Ensure AI solutions are reliable, secure, explainable, and aligned with responsible AI principles

• Contribute to the development of Hartmann’s AI governance, standards, and best practices

We Imagine You Bring

• Experience developing AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics solutions from concept to implementation

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python

• Experience with modern AI technologies including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and automation platforms

• Understanding of machine learning, data engineering, APIs, and cloud-based AI services

• Experience translating business challenges into practical technology solutions

• Strong communication skills and the ability to engage non-technical stakeholders

• A hands-on approach and willingness to move from prototype to production deployment

It is considered an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Manufacturing or industrial environments

• Production data and operational analytics

• Process improvement and operational excellence initiatives

• Predictive maintenance and process optimization

• Databricks and modern cloud data platforms

• Industrial IoT and Digital Manufacturing environments

Personal Profile

You are curious, innovative, and motivated by turning emerging technologies into practical business value.

You enjoy working close to operations and business stakeholders and are energized by solving real-world problems rather than developing technology for its own sake.

You combine strong technical capabilities with a pragmatic mindset and can explain AI opportunities, limitations, and risks in a way that others understand and trust.

You are collaborative, proactive, and comfortable driving initiatives forward in a global organization with diverse stakeholders.

Hartmann Offers

You will join an international company with strong values, high complexity, and a clear strategic focus on digitalization, analytics, and AI as drivers of future growth.

The role offers significant influence on Hartmann’s AI agenda within a company characterized by:

• International manufacturing operations

• Significant investments in AI, analytics, and digitalization

• A strong operational excellence agenda

• High degree of ownership and responsibility

• A unique opportunity to help shape how AI is understood, adopted and applied across a global manufacturing organization with exposure to both manufacturing and commercial AI use cases

• Short decision-making paths and strong visibility across the organization

Location

The position is based at Hartmann’s headquarters in Lyngby, Denmark.

The company offers a flexible hybrid working environment, including one regular work-from-home day per week. The role includes approximately 20 annual travel days and collaboration with colleagues across Hartmann’s international operations.

Contact and Application

In this recruitment process we are assisted by European Search Company. For additional information about the position please contact Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 2080 1638 or Brian Ranvits on +45 2048 0548.

If you see yourself in the position, please send your application by using the apply button below. Note that candidates will be processed as they arrive, until the position is filled, so do not hesitate to submit your application.

About Hartmann Packaging

Founded in 1917, Hartmann is headquartered in Lyngby, Denmark. Hartmann is the world’s leading specialist in moulded fibre egg packaging and a trusted partner in the global food supply chain.

With more than 100 years of experience, we combine deep technology and manufacturing expertise with a strong global presence to design, produce, and deliver innovative moulded fibre products. In doing so, we provide sustainable packaging that helps feed the world – one carton at a time.

Hartmann employs approximately 2,800 employees across Europe, North America, South America, and APAC. Hartmann is part of the THORNICO Group.

Ready to build, not just support?

At DISA Industries, part of the Norican Group, we are looking for a Student Assistant in HR who is ready to take ownership, ask questions, and help us strengthen and develop our HR foundation.

This is not a “fetch‑and‑file” student job. This is a role where you’ll learn, contribute, and grow.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

• A small, dynamic HR setup – locally it will be you and the HR Business Partner, working closely together with real responsibility and short decision paths

• Hands‑on HR from day one – you’ll help build, structure and improve HR processes rather than just support existing ones

• Strong global backing – while the local team is small, we are part of a larger global HR team across the Norican Group

• A business in motion – DISA combines more than a century of industrial heritage with ongoing change, digitalisation and development

• A pragmatic, people‑focused environment where things get done through trust, collaboration and ownership

This role is ideal for you, if you thrive in a setting where you get responsibility, variety and ample of opportunities to learn. At DISA, many people stay for a long time – not because they have to, but because they want to.

Who You Are

You’re about to finish your bachelor’s degree or currently studying your master’s, for example cand.merc.psyk, cand.soc.hrm or a similar relevant programme, and you’re ready to put theory into practice.

You are:

• Proactive, driven and curious, with a strong sense of ownership

• Genuinely interested in HR processes, people data and organisational structures

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer (Linux, Rust, Python, C)
jobs.description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

At the heart of our technology is an embedded Linux–based camera system that records sports matches using multiple sensors. Using our advanced video processing algorithms, these streams are stitched together to present one continuous playfield.

Our AI and cloud teams then process the video using proprietary models that lead the industry in our field, enabling players and coaches to access detailed statistics such as goals, ball possession, passes, and more.

While dedicated teams own most of the video processing and AI development, you will interface closely with both worlds and have the opportunity to gain exposure across these domains.

Most work in this role focuses on Rust- and Python-based user-space Linux applications, Linux platform engineering, and firmware architecture, rather than low-level hardware or driver development. Our firmware stack primarily uses Rust, Python, and C, and fluency in at least two of these languages is preferred.

What You Will Do

• Develop and maintain Rust- and Python-based user-space applications running on Veo’s embedded Linux camera platform.

• Contribute to firmware architecture and Linux platform engineering for our camera system.

• Build and maintain integrations with cloud services, including REST APIs, OpenTelemetry, and AWS S3.

• Implement wireless communication features using BLE and Wi-Fi for connectivity with mobile devices.

• Develop and maintain application-layer protocols, including GATT services, Protobuf-based communication, and data serialization.

• Collaborate closely with AI, video processing, and cloud teams to support the broader camera platform.

• Improve system reliability and observability through diagnostics, state management, and monitoring.

What You Could Bring

• At least 5 years of experience and a background in electrical or software engineering.

• Strong foundation in modern software development practices, architecture, and design patterns.

• Experience building and evolving user-space applications in Rust or Python, with a focus on clean APIs, testability, and maintainability across an embedded device fleet.

• Experience developing software for embedded Linux systems (Yocto), including system services, D-Bus, device trees, state management, and diagnostics.

• Experience integrating embedded systems with cloud services such as REST APIs, OpenTelemetry, and AWS S3, including debugging and operational troubleshooting.

• Experience building applications that integrate BLE and Wi-Fi, including GATT services, connection management, Protobuf-based protocols, and communication with mobile devices.

• Familiarity with MCU development and RTOS environments are a nice to have. While most work happens in Linux user-space, exposure to low-level firmware or peripheral interfacing can be helpful when interacting with MCU firmware.

Environment

• Languages: Rust, Python, C

• Embedded Linux: Yocto / OpenEmbedded / meta-tegra

• RTOS: Zephyr

• Cloud & Observability: AWS S3, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loggly

• Infrastructure: NixOS

• Tooling: GitHub (Actions)

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager within Process Automation at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Does the idea of being part of the largest pharmaceutical projects in Denmark and managing complex Process Automation projects excite you? And do you thrive on defining and executing project strategies in close corporation with highly skilled colleagues? Then you’ll fit right in!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

As a Senior Project Manager within Process Automation, you will be part of our large project portfolio in Kalundborg. You will play an important role in ensuring the successful execution of our deliveries and will be in close contact with both internal and external stakeholders.

As part of your role, you will maintain close dialogue with your team on-site and participate in regular meetings across disciplines, ensuring transparency, efficiency, and execution according to our plans.

The technical focus of this position is Process Automation, working with DCS 800xA and ECS solutions interfacing with new technologies within the Industry 4.0 domain and Manufacturing IT solutions. Our projects cover the entire project lifecycle, from conceptual and basic design phases to on-site testing activities, including FAT, Interface Testing, Wet Testing, SAT, and UAT, culminating in handover to our customers.

Based on your skills and experience, several opportunities are available within our portfolio.

How you might spend your days

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

• 
Executing projects within your area in close collaboration with your team, identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

• 
Focusing on overall project planning, ensuring delivery quality, and planning the necessary resources to maintain schedule and cost targets.

• 
Estimating costs and planning budgets in collaboration with our engineers and specialists.

• 
Managing project scope and ensuring that changes are analysed and agreed upon with stakeholders.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• 
Work across the boundaries and you like to work in a diverse and international environment

• 
Create results through efficient project management and communication, leveraging from your relations to your team and stakeholder

• 
Have a personal commitment, known for your effectiveness and an open management style and know the impotency to win as a team

• 
Are fluent in English both written and spoken

What you bring to the role

To be successful in this role, we expect you to have the following experience and educational background:

• 
An educational background at bachelor's level or a similar relevant technical background.

• 
6–10 years of experience with a proven track record in DCS and ECS/PLC Process Automation projects, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.

• 
Experience with GMP project execution and preferable knowledge with S88 and S95

• 
Experience in executing Process Automation projects in collaboration with other disciplines, such as mechanical and process design, as well as end users.

• 
Experience with on-site commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, and UAT.

• 
Project Management certification, e.g. PMP or PRINCE2, is preferred.

If you do not meet all the requirements, you are still welcome to apply and provide alternative experience that you believe would be valuable in this role.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, it means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Experienced ServiceNow Advisor and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 3,000 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About the team

Deloitte’s ServiceNow department is looking for an experienced Enterprise Service Management Advisor and Solution Architect to join our A-team of ServiceNow advisors. As a Manager in our ServiceNow department, you will serve as a trusted advisor for our clients, guiding them on their digitalization journey. In this role, you will work with industry leading professionals, guiding clients through end-to-end digital transformation initiatives and driving complex enterprise-wide service modernization.

As a trusted advisor, you will play a key role in identifying and pursuing strategic business opportunities while leading the design and implementation of innovative ServiceNow solutions. You will collaborate with clients to transform IT, HR, Finance, Risk, and core business functions into streamlined, service-based organizations. This involves assessing the client’s needs, translating business requirements into tailored technology solutions, and providing strategic and best practice advisory. You will oversee the full project lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution from strategy to deployment, while providing thought leadership and industry insights that shape best practices.

Success in this role requires a deep understanding of enterprise service management, strong leadership in project execution, and the ability to build long-term client relationships based on trust and value creation. By delivering impactful solutions and driving meaningful business outcomes, you will help position Deloitte as the premier partner for digital transformation.

Job Description

ServiceNow is its own department, and you will join a team of incredibly dedicated, ambitious and great colleagues. Our team works closely together on projects across the Nordics, combining the right expertise and competencies to deliver the best solutions for our clients. While we thrive on cross-border collaboration, you will also have a strong local presence in our Copenhagen office, where we emphasize teamwork, community, and a shared commitment to excellence.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Providing strategic advisory for some of the largest ServiceNow clients in Denmark and the Nordics.

• Engaging proactively with clients, advising on solution and problem scoping across the organization to ensure alignment with business objectives.

• Designing comprehensive solutions, including technical design using design thinking methodologies to ensure alignment with ServiceNow’s Enterprise Service Management capabilities and best practices.

• Helping our clients in defining and optimizing Service Management processes to drive efficiency.

• Offering insights and guidance on application development, agile development, software development lifecycle and cloud applications.

• Leading the delivery of solutions and support teams in corrective measures.

• Work closely with Program Leadership to oversee and lead multiple workstreams of technical design- and delivery activities, create and maintain a network of potential clients, and be known as a trusted advisor and participate in consulting sales activities, including writing service proposals.

Qualifications

By joining our team as a Manager, you will become part of and contribute to our shared success. You will build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients to exceed expectations. Key responsibilities and tasks will involve:

You have the following skills and experience:

• A minimum of 5 years of experience working with ServiceNow or other digitalization platforms.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Hands-on experience leading end-to-end transformation projects in areas such as IT, HR, Finance, Risk or core business operations.

• Experience with IT Project Management and have the ability to oversee complex implementations and drive successful outcomes.

• Demonstrated consulting experience or prior experience as a Platform Owner, showcasing your ability to advise and lead clients through transformation initiatives.

• Familiarity with process frameworks such as Lean, TBM, ITIL or other methodologies relevant to your area of expertise.

• A strong technical background with an advanced understanding of key technical principles and best practices.

• Experience or a solid understanding of application development and software lifecycle management.

• Knowledge of technologies using client-server model and understanding of data-modelling, SQL data structures and system integrations.

• You are fluent in written and spoken English, and you should ideally have a high proficiency in Danish or a willingness to learn the language.

• You must have the right to live and work in Denmark.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success**.**

What we offer you:

At Deloitte, we provide an environment where you can grow, innovate, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the ServiceNow field. Joining our team means becoming part of a dynamic and supportive workplace that values both professional and personal development.

• You will work alongside experts in the ServiceNow field, gaining insights and knowledge from top professionals in the field.

• You will experience a culture of continuous growth, where feedback and learning opportunities empower you to advance at your own pace.

• You will enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, allowing you to balance work and personal commitments in a way that suits you the best.

• You will gain access to ServiceNow certifications in the areas that interest you, enhancing your expertise and career prospects.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV and cover letter. In your cover letter, please describe your motivation and answer these following questions:

• ServiceNow Experience: Can you detail your hands-on experience with ServiceNow, including specific modules and functionalities you have worked with? Please provide examples of complex implementations or customizations you have led.

• Project Management Experience: Describe your project management experience, if possible in the context of ServiceNow projects. How have you managed multiple stakeholders and ensured project success?

We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: As soon as possible.

Please do not hesitate to contact Timothy Edward Intennimeo, Consultant at tintennimeo@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Are you an experienced project professional who excels at building structure, driving consistency, and elevating project execution?

To support our growth and expanding portfolio of projects, we are strengthening our focus on the Project Management Office (PMO). You’ll get a key role in developing, maintain, train, and educate on the processes, methodology, and tool chain used in project execution.

Your Role

As PMO Lead, you will report to the Head of Projects & Delivery. You will become responsible for all aspects of our best-practice project execution and will be deeply involved in improving and developing our methodologies.

The PMO standardizes project practices, supports project managers and project teams, and represents a highly operational function.

The PMO ensures alignment with business goals by supporting Business Management and provides oversight across the project portfolio. The PMO spans governance, methodology, reporting, process development, and process control. The PMO leads the development of methodologies used during the scale-up of the organization – and may potentially evolve into the competence center for Project Management.

Your tasks include:

• Governance & Standards: Define, maintain, and continuously improve PM methodologies, templates, and best practices, ensuring compliance with processes, quality standards, and stage-gate governance.

• Project Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor project performance across scope, schedule, budget, and risks, and consolidate insights into portfolio dashboards and KPIs for leadership decision-making.

• Resource & Capacity Support: Support resource allocation and forecasting with Team Leads and Project Managers, identify bottlenecks, and help optimize utilization across the project portfolio.

• Support & Enablement: Enable Project Managers through coaching, training, and hands-on support with documentation, planning, tools, and evaluation of new project opportunities.

• Risk, Issue & Change Management: Support structured identification and handling of risks, issues, and changes, including escalation processes and decision forums.

• PMO Development: Drive continuous improvement of PMO methodologies and capabilities to support faster, more scalable, and predictable project delivery aligned with business growth.

The PMO Lead role is highly central to harmonizing and further professionalizing our project execution capability. Running activities according to standards, ensuring quality in execution, and ensuring predictability and repeatability will be key elements of our success. This work will happen in close collaboration with the Engineering Excellence Manager. Furthermore, the PMO Lead will act as the deputy to the Head of Projects & Delivery when required.

Short- and Long-Term Success

In the first 6–12 months, success means:

• Establishing clear structure and ownership of PMO processes and methodologies

• Delivering consistent, high-quality reporting and portfolio visibility

• Building trust and strong collaboration with project managers and key stakeholders

Longer term, you’ll take ownership of maturing the PMO into a scalable capability that supports faster, more predictable project execution, while acting as a competence center for project management across the organization.

What You Bring

You’re an experienced project professional with a strong knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management methodologies, and governance frameworks. You have the ability to design, implement, and continuously improve processes, standards, and tools. You have a strategic and analytical mindset that makes it possible to align project execution with business objectives.

You likely:

• Have 3+ years of PMO or similar experience

• Have 5+ years of project management experience

• Preferably, have a technical background as an engineer or equivalent higher education

• Balance supportive guidance with governance and control responsibilities

• Have the experience to drive change and ensure adoption of new processes and ways of working

Who You Are

You’re not just defining processes - you ensure they are used, understood, and create value. You take ownership of execution and help teams succeed through clarity, structure, and support.

You bring:

• Strong organizational awareness and ability to manage cross-functional complexity

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills

• Continuous improvement mindset focused on efficiency, quality, and predictable delivery

• Capability to coach and develop project managers and build organizational competence

• True leadership: you take ownership of the PMO function and act with integrity

Why Join Us?

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science, and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

JOIN OUR MISSION

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: John Larsen, Head of Integrated Satellites. E-mail: jlar@gomspace.com

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Do you enjoy working across technical, commercial, and project domains to shape competitive and executable solutions? To strengthen our work with bids and proposals, we are looking for a Project Capture Manager who will assume a pivotal role in delivering winning proposals.

Your Role

The Project Capture Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end development of customer proposals, ensuring alignment between technical, commercial, legal, and business stakeholders. The role bridges technical solution design, program planning, cost estimation, and commercial governance to deliver high-quality, competitive, and compliant proposals.

Your tasks include:

• Proposal Coordination & Governance: Coordinate and synchronize proposal activities across technical teams, Sales, and Business Management, acting as the central point of contact and remain engaged through to contract signature, working with Legal & Contract Managers to ensure that technical solutions, assumptions, schedules, and resource commitments are robust, realistic, and executable, challenging them where required.
