• Business Alignment: Align proposal activities with bid strategies and business priorities, ensuring support for commercial objectives, risk appetite, and long-term goals.

• Cost, Price & Estimation: Lead and support estimation activities, validating scope, assumptions, and risks, and ensuring a solid and traceable foundation for cost and pricing in collaboration with Sales and Business Management.

• Process & Standardization: Drive standardization and continuous improvement of proposal processes, templates, tools, and methodologies in collaboration with PMO and Capture teams.

• Proposal Capability Development: Strengthen proposal practices and methodologies to improve quality, efficiency, scalability, and alignment with organizational growth.

The Project Capture Manager is a highly central and important role in delivering professional and competitive proposals and is therefore key to the successful capture of new projects. You’ll work closely with:

• Engineering Capture Manager

• Sales Managers, Business Development, and Solution Managers

• Legal & Contract Managers

• PMO & Project Management

• Senior Business Management

Short- and Long-Term Success

In the first 6–12 months, success means:

• Delivering structured, high‑quality proposals aligned with customer and business requirements

• Establishing strong collaboration across engineering, sales, and business stakeholders

• Creating clear and reliable project plans, cost estimates, and proposal content

Longer term, you’ll take ownership of maturing proposal capabilities across the organization, improving consistency and competitiveness, and contributing directly to winning complex projects and driving business growth.

What You Bring

You are a structured and commercially aware professional with a balanced approach to competitiveness, risk, and execution quality, supported by expertise in cost estimation, pricing, and risk assessment. You have a demonstrated ability to coordinate and align technical, commercial, legal, and business stakeholders, and to lead structured end-to-end bid processes covering timelines, deliverables, and dependencies.

You likely:

• Have a technical background (e.g., engineering or equivalent) combined with a business or commercial education, enabling a strong commercial mindset and solid technical and project understanding.

• Have solid experience in project or program management, including planning, governance, and execution.

• Ideally, have proven experience in proposal, bid, or capture management within complex, cross-functional environments, including development of high-quality, competitive, and compliant proposals.

• Can contribute to proposal content such as execution plans, schedules, and risk frameworks.

• Have experience with process standardization and continuous improvement, ideally in collaboration with a PMO.

Who You Are

You’re not just coordinating proposals - you are the person who makes the proposals coherent, competitive, and executable. You understand the importance of alignment, quality, and realism in securing new business.

You bring:

• Strong negotiation, customer communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a high attention to detail and quality.

• Helpfulness: You support stakeholders and ensure alignment across teams

As our Offset Business Development Director, you will take ownership of driving our growth in the offset segment by identifying, developing, and securing key opportunities and partnerships. You will build a global network of defense primes and governmental stakeholders, helping them meet their offset obligations using GomSpace’s portfolio of innovative products and solutions.

This is a role where strategic insight, relationship-building, and execution come together to create real impact in complex and dynamic markets.

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead, and coordinate business development activities related to offsets, acting as the go-to expert internally and externally. You will translate national offset policies and political objectives into actionable business strategies and drive collaboration across internal teams to align resources and priorities.

Your tasks will include:

• Leading the development and implementation of offset and industrial cooperation strategies that support long-term growth.

• Building and maintaining strong relationships with defense primes, governments, institutions, and political stakeholders in target markets.

• Translating national policies and political targets into meaningful offset projects that gain governmental traction.

• Developing and executing capture strategies for RFPs and offset financing aligned with GomSpace’s commercial goals.

We are looking for a results-oriented, strategic thinker who thrives in complex defense environments and can navigate diverse stakeholder landscapes with diplomacy and influence.

You will bring:

• Proven experience in defense or space business development, especially with offsets and government procurement processes.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with a strong customer and value proposition focus.

• An established network within defense primes and governmental organizations, ideally across multiple regions.

• Sufficient technical understanding to align customer needs with GomSpace’s portfolio of solutions.

Are you ready to leverage your expertise to grow GomSpace’s business and strengthen our position as a partner of choice in the global defense ecosystem? We’d love to hear from you.

As Offset Business Development Director, you’ll not only grow our business – you’ll shape the way GomSpace engages with the world’s most strategic players. You’ll operate on a high-impact level, developing offset strategies that fuel technological advancement and build sovereign capabilities across key markets.

We offer an international, mission-driven environment where innovation, purpose, and execution go hand in hand. You’ll collaborate with experts across the company – from BD and engineering to solutions and strategy – to create offset offerings that deliver real, measurable impact.

*This role is based out of our Copenhagen HQ office and requires fluent French, with strong English skills*

As an Account Executive for the French Mid-Market, you’ll join our team at the heart of the action, right on our home turf in Copenhagen. You'll be literally at the centre of where the fun happens, with a unique opportunity to drive change and see the direct impact of your work on our business growth.

You’ll be responsible for winning new mid-market customers in France and managing the full sales cycle, from identifying and prospecting potential customers through to discovery, demonstration, negotiation and closing. You will join our French Mid-Market team, working closely with both Account Executives and Account Managers.

This is an outbound-led role. You will be expected to generate a substantial share of your own pipeline through consistent and targeted outreach. Your prospecting efforts will be complemented by meetings generated by our BDR team and qualified inbound leads.

You’ll engage with senior decision-makers, uncover complex business needs and build compelling business cases that demonstrate the commercial value of Trustpilot. We’re not just selling SaaS. You’ll help established French businesses use trust and transparency to strengthen their brands, improve customer acquisition and accelerate growth.

What you’ll be doing:

• Drive new business across the French Mid-Market, from prospecting to close.

• Own and exceed a monthly revenue target through consistent pipeline creation and strong deal execution.

• Generate a substantial share of your pipeline through proactive and personalised outbound prospecting across phone, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

• Manage opportunities created through your own outreach, BDR-booked meetings and qualified inbound leads.

• Identify and engage key decision-makers, including C-level stakeholders, across multiple industries.

• Run structured discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s priorities, challenges, commercial objectives and decision-making process.

• Build compelling business cases and deliver tailored product demonstrations that clearly connect Trustpilot’s solutions to the prospect’s needs.

• Navigate more complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders, commercial negotiations and higher-value solutions.

• Use your initiative and commercial judgement to prioritise opportunities and manage your sales funnel effectively.

• Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.

• Develop your capabilities for continued growth within Mid-Market and Enterprise SaaS sales.

Who you are:

• Fluent in French, with strong English skills.

• 3 years of experienced in full-cycle B2B sales, including outbound prospecting, qualification, discovery, demonstration, negotiation and closing.

• Proven track record in SaaS or Tech sales, with consistent quota achievement.

• Comfortable generating your own opportunities and maintaining a high level of outbound activity.

• Experienced in selling higher-value solutions to mid-market businesses and managing several stakeholders throughout the sales process.

• Confident in engaging with senior and C-level decision-makers and adapting your approach to the French business environment.

• Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into clear commercial value.

• Able to manage a varied pipeline while prioritising the opportunities most likely to progress and close.

• Competitive, resilient and motivated by achieving and exceeding targets.

• A proactive self-starter with the ambition to grow a career in Mid-Market and Enterprise SaaS sales.

• Knowledge of e-commerce, digital marketing or online reputation management is a plus.

What's in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

The Opportunity

Join Clobotics as a Sparrow Robot Operator and take part in robotic wind turbine blade repair operations at onshore and offshore locations worldwide. This hands-on role combines robotics, field operations, technical maintenance, and close coordination with wind industry teams.

The position is based in Esbjerg, Denmark.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct safe and efficient Sparrow robotic repair operations on wind turbines in accordance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and industry best practices.

• Remain calm under pressure, communicate clearly with team members, and follow operational checklists diligently.

• Perform regular maintenance checks, calibrations, and equipment troubleshooting to maintain system functionality and minimize downtime.

• Follow Clobotics safety protocols and risk-assessment procedures to mitigate potential hazards and maintain a safe working environment.

• Collaborate closely with vessel crews, client technicians, and control-room teams to support clear communication and effective use of working time.

• Maintain accurate records of daily progress and other required operational documentation.

• Keep up with industry best practices and emerging trends, pursuing opportunities for training and professional development.

Qualifications & Experience

• Relevant occupational certificates and training in line with our Occupational Training Matrix, along with any required client- or turbine-specific certifications.

• Clear written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Experience working offshore on crew transfer vessels or other support vessels, with technical or process equipment, or at onshore or offshore wind park sites is preferred.

• Good physical fitness for physically demanding work, a strong commitment to safety, and excellent attention to detail.

• Strong problem-solving skills, sound technical competence, and the ability to thrive as part of a team.

What We Offer

• A global working environment at a leading company in the automation and digitalization of wind turbine blade maintenance.

• Supportive colleagues, room for personal development, and a relaxed atmosphere with a winning mentality.

• A unique opportunity to work with advanced robotic technology in a growing company.

• Professional development and further training within the wind turbine service and robotics sector.

About Clobotics Wind Services

Clobotics is a global market leader in onshore and offshore wind turbine blade maintenance. We provide wind turbine operators and manufacturers with a full-scope service offering based on groundbreaking technology developed in-house, including robotics, autonomous drones, cloud processing, web portals, apps, and material technology.

Our EMEA operation is based in Esbjerg, Denmark, with sister companies in Seattle, Shanghai, and Singapore. The Danish team manages EMEA operations and develops projects designed for the European market.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials.

As a Senior Manager, Global Clinical Drug Supply, you will play a pivot role supporting the development and execution of clinical drug demand forecasts and supply plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery of clinical development products across Genmab’s pipeline. Your responsibilities will include managing the demand planning and supply planning of clinical supplies. This role will partner closely with cross-functional clinical development and CMC teams to maintain accurate forecasts, support supply strategy execution, and contribute to the operational success of clinical programs. The Senior Manager will apply strong analytical, communication, and planning skills to ensure reliable clinical supply while contributing to continuous process improvement across GCDS.

As a Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring efficient delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage Genmab clinical trials worldwide.

The ideal candidate possesses an understanding of cGMP and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality work, demonstrating a proactive approach and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure the best outcome for patients.

This position is hybrid and requires you to be in the office 60% of the time.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning & Forecasting

• Support the development, maintenance, and updates of clinical drug demand forecasts across assigned studies and programs.

• Collaborate with, CTT, and Finance to collect inputs and ensure forecasts reflect current enrollment trends, protocol changes, and assumptions.

• Manage the demand planning discussions as part of the Clinical Project Supply Team (CPST) and support forecasting activities within the CSIOP process.

• Identify potential demand risks and escalate issues in a timely manner, recommending mitigation actions where appropriate.

• Prepare demand plan summaries, enrollment updates, and cost forecasts to support program planning and operational reviews.

Supply Strategy & Execution

• Coordinate clinical supply–related planning activities, ensuring alignment between forecasted needs, study timelines, and supply availability.

• Support the execution of clinical supply chain sourcing strategies using third-party providers, in collaboration with Clinical Operations and Supply Leads.

• Contribute to communication of GCDS Planning Strategy within Global Clinical Teams, ensuring supply planning assumptions are clearly understood.

• Track supply readiness and highlight risks or gaps that could affect clinical trial continuity.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management

• Support Supplier Relationship Management activities by tracking supplier performance metrics and helping identify improvement opportunities.

• Build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional partners (Clinical Operations, CTT, CDM, Regulatory, CMC, QA, and Finance) to enable timely and accurate supply planning.

Budget & Cost Optimization

• Support budget development activities by preparing supply planning inputs and cost forecasts aligned with program needs.

• Monitor budget performance and identify variances, working with senior team members to implement cost-effective solutions.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

• Provide planning updates and forecasting insights to support governance forums (IRC, CTT, Asset Meetings).

• Ensure consistent use of supply chain processes, tools, and systems by adhering to established standards and contributing feedback for enhancements.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on advancing forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and collaboration across GCDS.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

• Ensure demand planning and supply–related activities comply with GxP, regulatory standards, and Genmab quality expectations.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation for demand forecasts, planning assumptions, and supply updates.

• Support identification and resolution of compliance gaps and contribute to corrective and preventive actions as needed

• Adhere to the Genmab Quality Management System

Qualifications

•    Minimum 8+ years of experience in clinical drug supply forecasting, supply planning, and demand planning

•    Demonstrated stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.

•    Experience working with vendors and CMOs for clinical trial supplies will be an advantage.

•    Solid knowledge of GDP and GMP. Knowledge of GCP will be an advantage.

•    Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

•    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

•    Highly organized with a structured, process-oriented mindset that supports continuous improvement.

•    Ability to prioritize effectively while maintaining a high level of quality and compliance.

•    Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work both independently and within global teams.

•    Results-driven and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success.

The Team

Job description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications

• 
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing

• 
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners

• 
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications

• 
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)

• 
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage

• 
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team

• 
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)

• 
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective

• 
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job requirements

The Ideal Candidate

• 
Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)

• 
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture

• 
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.

• 
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)

• 
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks

• 
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting

• 
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

• 
Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry

• 
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems

• 
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

• 
A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices

• 
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football

• 
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities

• 
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain

• 
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged

• 
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales

• 
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Cabin Crew Opportunities at SAS

Join SAS Cabin Crew – Opportunities Across Scandinavia

SAS is expanding—connecting people, cultures, and destinations like never before, and we invite you to be part of the journey.

We are now recruiting Cabin Crew - Air Hosts/ Hostesses on different base locations across Scandinavia and also Air Stewards in Copenhagen.

• Copenhagen

• Stockholm

• Oslo

• Bergen

By joining SAS, you will become part of a passionate team dedicated to safety, service, and creating memorable travel experiences for our customers every day.

As Cabin Crew at SAS, you will meet people from all around the world while ensuring onboard safety, delivering excellent service, and representing one of Scandinavia’s leading airlines. Our Air Steward opportunities also include additional responsibilities connected to onboard dining and premium service delivery for candidates with strong hospitality and food & beverage backgrounds.

Whether you already have Cabin Crew experience or are looking for a new career beyond the ordinary, this is your opportunity to take off with SAS.

Minimum Requirements

To apply, you must:

• Be at least 18 years old ( 20 years old for Norway base location)

• Have completed high school education or equivalent

• Be between 160 cm and 190 cm tall (without shoes)

• Have a minimum of 2 years’ experience in a customer-facing role

• Be fluent in English, both spoken and written

• Have strong swimming skills

• Hold a valid EU passport allowing free travel worldwide

• Be able to work irregular hours, including weekends and public holidays

• Meet local residency and commuting requirements for your selected base location

• Be able to comply with SAS uniform regulations

The successful candidate

Experience from hospitality, sales, food & beverage service, restaurants, hotels, catering, or events is considered an advantage.

For some specialist onboard service opportunities, candidates with hospitality, culinary, wine, or premium service backgrounds may be especially relevant.

Previous Cabin Crew experience is considered an advantage but is not required for all positions.

Additional requirements for experienced Cabin Crew:

• Valid EASA Attestation and Medical

• Minimum one year of continuous experience as Senior Cabin Crew within the past five years

Security & Medical Requirements

• Employment requires an approved Security Assessment, including a security interview, 5-year background check, reference checks, and an exhaustive police certificate/clean record.

• Successful completion of the training course and meeting all company requirements for Cabin Crew employment.

• Good physical and mental health, as well as good vision (+/- 0.7 with or without correction). Candidates must be able to obtain medical approval according to EASA regulations. To read more about medical certification for Cabin Crew, click here: www.trafikstyrelsen.dk/arbejdsomraader/luftfart/flyvemedicin/-for-piloter-kabinepersonale-samt-flyveledere

• Employment also requires successful completion of drug and alcohol tests (blood and urine samples).

• Our premises and work are located within airport security restricted areas; therefore, candidates must be approved by the relevant aviation authorities.

• All steps above must be successfully completed before commencing Cabin Crew training.

We are looking for candidates who are:

• Strong team players with a positive and professional attitude

• Passionate about service, food, and guest experience

• Structured, punctual, and able to stay ahead in a busy environment

• Calm under pressure with strong problem-solving skills

• Comfortable taking responsibility and guiding others when needed

Our Culture at SAS

At Scandinavian Airlines, we focus on caring for people, delivering exceptional experiences for travelers, and advancing the transition toward more sustainable aviation. This is guided by our iCARE framework, reflecting our commitment to Inspiration, Collaboration, Accountability, Recognition, and Execution in everything we do.

As a future team member, you can expect to be part of a collaborative environment where shared goals drive performance, contributions are recognized, and successes are celebrated. We place strong emphasis on safe, sustainable, and punctual operations while actively working to reduce environmental impact and transform for the future.

Recruitment takes place based on operational needs. Upcoming training courses are planned for fall 2026 and spring 2027.

• You are robust, thorough and reliable in planning and taking action

• You are excellent at analyzing and evaluating complex issues and handling such complexity diligently

COWI AS A WORKPLACE – WE OFFER

jobs.description:
About Us

We are a pioneering materials discovery company headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark. Our mission is to accelerate the design and discovery of advanced, sustainable materials by leveraging cutting-edge simulation tools and self-driving labs.

We are dedicated to bridging the gap between scientific breakthroughs and practical, real-world applications. Join our dynamic, international, and diverse team where collaboration and innovation are at the heart of innovating for a sustainable future, one material at a time.

Role Overview

We are seeking an ambitious AI Scientist to take the lead in developing and deploying a state-of-the-art generative model for inorganic materials.

This is a high-impact role where your work will directly contribute to our core materials design pipeline, enabling the accelerated design of in-demand materials. You will have the unique opportunity to see the models you develop move from concept to real-world industrial application.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Develop and deploy advanced generative models, focusing on state-of-the-art techniques such as autoregressive, diffusion- and flow-based ML models.

• 
Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of materials scientists, computer scientists, and scientific software developers.

• 
Solve complex, real-world problems in materials design, drastically speeding up the discovery process.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

We are looking for candidates who demonstrate proven capability in generative AI and a passion for scientific applications.

• 
Generative Modeling Expertise: A demonstrated experience in generative modeling within academic or industrial settings, particularly with advanced methods like autoregressive, diffusion-, or flow-based models.

• 
Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in Computer Science, Python and deep learning frameworks.

• 
Scientific Application: Experience applying generative models to scientific domains, preferably in materials science.

• 
Communication: Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex technical information clearly and concisely to diverse teams.

• 
Drive & Detail: A strong self-starter mentality with strong attention to detail and eager to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and technical setting.

Preferred Skills:

These qualifications are a strong plus, demonstrating your readiness for the role:

• 
Advanced Degree: Ph.D. in Computer Science, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or a related field.

• 
Publication Record: A strong publication record showcasing the design and implementation of novel generative models.

• 
Computational Materials Science: Experience with computational materials science methods, such as DFT (Density Functional Theory) and MD (Molecular Dynamics).

• 
Domain Familiarity: Familiarity with common experimental techniques for materials synthesis and characterization.

What We Offer

• 
High-Growth Environment: A unique opportunity to be part of one of the most promising start-ups in materials discovery on an ambitious path to achieve unicorn status.

• 
Impactful Mission: Involvement in solving some of the world’s most complex challenges, directly supporting a greener and more sustainable future.

Culture: A welcoming, diverse, and entrepreneurial workplace located in vibrant Copenhagen, Denmark.

Work Style: A vibrant atmosphere with a flat hierarchy, open collaboration, and active idea-sharing.

• 
Fuel: Free coffee, snacks, and even a massage chair to power your creative energy! 😉

2+ years of experience in customer success

Excellent communication skills and strong ability to build trust – we value long-term customer relationships

Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, London and Zurich.

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026 – Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU), Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

Our Business Development & Portfolio Management area has an ambitious strategy and we are looking for someone with a generic-pharma mindset or experience to drive the transformation and make sure we execute according to our plans, roadmaps and business goals within the area and along the value chain

About the job

This role is best suited for someone who knows how a generic pharma business operates. Compared with an originator company, we work with a broad portfolio, lean teams and short decision paths, and value comes from pragmatic, commercially minded execution.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive the transformation in the Business Development & Portfolio Management area from process changes to new ways of working

• Identify program impacts and design adoption measures together with functional leads

• Track adoption and take corrective action when change is not landing as planned

• Own the communication plan that keeps the organization informed and engaged

• Own the strategy execution roadmap for the Business Development & Portfolio Management area, ensuring alignment with Orifarm’s overall strategy and business goals

• Translate priorities into concrete program briefs, project charters, milestones and benefit maps

• Follow up on progress against plans and goals – with a single, transparent view of status, risks, dependencies and benefit realization

• Drive cross-functional coordination along the value chain – Portfolio, Regulatory Affairs, Business Development, Commercial and Operations – and ensure timely resolution of blockers

• Run the governance rhythm: program boards, track reviews and reporting to the Executive Management Group

You will report directly to our Chief Business Development & Portfolio Strategy Officer. You will present strategy updates and projects to our Executive Management Group and hold an explicit mandate to drive execution across the organization.

Who are you

We are looking for someone with significant experience driving transformations or programs in complex organizations, and a track record of making sure plans are executed and business goals are delivered.

Additionally, you will need to have experience from a generic or off-patent pharma business – across areas such as portfolio, business development, regulatory or commercial operations and you know how it differs from an originator company: broad portfolios, lean organizations, tight margins and pragmatic decision-making. Experience from a comparable commercial healthcare environment is also relevant.

You communicate clearly with executives, build alignment across functions, markets and cultures, and are comfortable challenging when progress stalls. You also ensure the right level of structure and governance for a regulated environment without building heavier processes than the business needs

Lastly, you have strong analytical skills, hold complexity across several concurrent workstreams and master program management methods and tools. A certification such as PRINCE2, MSP or PMI-PgMP is an advantage.

Who are we?

The Business Development & Portfolio Management area covers Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs and Pharmacovigilance. You will partner closely with Strategy, the Strategy & PPMO Office, People & Culture and other corporate functions.

What we offer

• A role at the center of strategic decision-making, with direct access to the C-level and the Executive Management Group

• A clear mandate to drive execution across the organization

• An entrepreneurial culture that celebrates can-do attitudes, smarts and hearts, and a strong feedback culture that supports your development

• Flexibility and a strong commitment to work-life balance in an international setting with opportunities for growth

• A bonus scheme that includes every employee when we have good results

• A great canteen, massage service at our Odense office and social events throughout the year

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Job location

Odense, Denmark. You will work from our Odense office 2–3 days a week to be close to the majority of your stakeholders. We welcome candidates based outside Denmark who can commit to this whether by commuting or relocating (relocation support and expenses will be covered by Orifarm).

Application deadline

As soon as possible.

READY TO JOIN OUR FAMILY?

Boldlight, a leading Danish e-commerce multi-brand, is seeking an experienced Videographer who possesses expertise in creating captivating videos that convert on social media ads. As a Videographer and Social Media Ads Expert, you will play a crucial role in enhancing our brand’s online presence and driving engagement with our target audience.

Responsibilities:

• Conceptualize, plan, and execute creative video campaigns that align with the brand’s objectives and target audience.

• Collaborate with the marketing team to develop effective strategies for social media ad campaigns.

• Produce high-quality videos, including product showcases, promotional videos, tutorials, and lifestyle content, optimized for various social media platforms.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest trends, techniques, and best practices in video production and social media advertising.

• Conduct thorough research and analysis to identify target audience preferences, interests, and behaviors.

• Optimize video content for maximum engagement and conversions, ensuring the videos adhere to the brand’s guidelines and standards.

• Work closely with the post-production team to edit and enhance videos, adding visual effects, motion graphics, and music where necessary.

• Monitor and analyze the performance of video campaigns, making data-driven decisions to optimize future content.

• Collaborate with influencers, models, and other talent to create compelling video content.

• Maintain and organize video equipment, ensuring its functionality and availability for shoots.

Requirements:

• A strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in video production, particularly in the context of social media advertising.

• Proven experience in producing videos for social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

• Proficiency in using industry-standard video editing software, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar tools.

• Deep understanding of social media advertising platforms, their formats, targeting options, and analytics.

• Knowledge of Danish e-commerce and multi-brand marketing trends is highly desirable.

• Excellent storytelling and visual communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

• Creative thinking and a passion for exploring innovative approaches in video production and social media advertising.

• Strong organisational and time management skills.

What you get:

• Top-notch Equipment: At Boldlight, we understand the importance of having the best tools for the job. As a full-time videographer, you will have access to state-of-the-art equipment and resources to ensure the highest quality of your work.

• Free Food and Drinks at the Office: We believe in fostering a positive and energizing work environment. To support our team’s well-being, we provide complimentary meals and beverages, allowing you to focus on your creative pursuits without worrying about daily sustenance.

• Yearly Paid Holiday Trip for Teambuilding: Building strong relationships and fostering a cohesive team is important to us. That’s why we organize a one-week paid holiday trip every year for teambuilding purposes. Last year, we enjoyed a fantastic trip to Marbella, and we are excited to plan the next adventure for our team.

• Personal Team and Work-Life Balance: At Boldlight, we value the personal well-being and happiness of our team members. We encourage a healthy work-life balance and foster a close-knit team dynamic. You’ll have the opportunity to build strong relationships with your colleagues, whether it’s sharing meals together or engaging in activities outside of work.

• Competitive Salary with Bonus Options: We believe in recognizing and rewarding your hard work and dedication. Along with a competitive salary, we offer bonus opportunities based on performance and results. Your contributions will be acknowledged and incentivized as part of our commitment to your professional growth and success.

If you are a creative and skilled Videographer with a passion for producing videos that drive results on social media platforms, then we want to hear from you! Join our dynamic team at Bold Light and contribute to our mission of delivering an exceptional e-commerce experience to Danish customers.

To apply, please submit your resume, portfolio, and any relevant links to previous work showcasing your expertise in video production and social media advertising.

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.

The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note:  You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)

• Knife work in high-volume pork production

• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield

• Following hygiene and safety procedures

• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning

• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends

• Good knife skills

• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant

• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment

• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift

Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.

If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift

32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application

If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Head of International Staffing, Andrei Maierean, at +45 61 63 07 19 or Staffing Consultant, Damian Bukowski, at +45 73 32 37 53 on weekdays between 08:00 and 16:00.

JKS conducts interviews on an ongoing basis, and the positions may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Arbeiten Sie in Dänemark als Fleischer – attraktives Gehalt, Flexibilität und stabile Arbeitsbedingungen

Für unseren Kunden Danish Crown, eines der größten Lebensmittelunternehmen Europas, suchen wir erfahrene Schweinefleischer für das Ausbeinen von Schultern (Vorderteile) in einem Schlachthof in Blans, Dänemark.

Arbeiten in Dänemark bedeutet klare Beschäftigungsbedingungen auf Grundlage von Tarifverträgen, Rentenregelungen, bezahlten Urlaub und stabile Arbeitsverhältnisse. Bei Danish Crown werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Arbeitsumfelds mit Kollegen aus vielen verschiedenen Ländern.

Die Arbeit basiert auf klaren Werten. Sicherheit steht an erster Stelle. Mitarbeitende sollen jederzeit sicher arbeiten können und jeden Tag sicher nach Hause zurückkehren.

Danish Crown legt zudem großen Wert auf das Wohlbefinden und die Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden. Die Beschäftigten sollen sich bei ihrer Arbeit wohlfühlen, ihre Rolle in der Produktion verstehen und erkennen, wie ihr Beitrag Wert für das Unternehmen schafft.

Die Unternehmenskultur basiert auf Teamarbeit, Verantwortung und gegenseitigem Respekt. Kollegen unterstützen sich gegenseitig und alle werden fair behandelt.

Bitte beachten Sie: Sie werden vom ersten Arbeitstag an direkt bei Danish Crown angestellt.

Arbeitsaufgaben

• Ausbeinen von Schweineschultern (Vorderteile)

• Messertätigkeiten in der Schweineproduktion mit hohem Durchsatz

• Sicherstellung korrekter Zuschnitte und optimaler Fleischausbeute

• Einhaltung von Hygiene und Sicherheitsvorschriften

• Unterstützung bei weiteren Aufgaben im Zerlegebereich bei Bedarf

Anforderungen

• Erfahrung im Ausbeinen

• Vorzugsweise Erfahrung mit Schweineschultern oder Vorderteilen

• Gute Messerfertigkeiten

• Erfahrung aus einem Schlachthof oder fleischverarbeitenden Betrieb

• Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen Produktionsumfeld zu arbeiten

• Körperlich fit und zuverlässig

Kandidaten müssen in der Lage sein, vom ersten Arbeitstag an selbstständig ausbeinen zu können.

Gehalt und Arbeitsbedingungen

• Stundenlohn gemäß Tarifvertrag: 176,10 DKK plus flexible Zusatzleistungen von 12,20 Prozent = 197,58 DKK pro Stunde

• Nach einer kurzen Einarbeitungsphase erfolgt der Wechsel zur Akkordarbeit, wodurch der Stundenlohn deutlich steigen kann

• Möglichkeit eines höheren Einkommens je nach Funktion und Leistung

• Flexible Zusatzleistungen, entweder als zusätzliche Vergütung oder zusätzliche Freizeit

• Kantine vorhanden

• Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und Entwicklung

Zusätzlich bieten wir

• Administrative Unterstützung bei CPR-Nummer, Steuerkarte, Krankenversicherung und mehr

• Hilfe bei der Unterkunft in der Nähe des Arbeitsplatzes

• Unterstützung in mehreren Sprachen, darunter Englisch, Dänisch, Rumänisch, Polnisch und weitere

• Einführung in die dänische Arbeits- und Lebenskultur

Arbeitszeiten

Tagschicht

Montag bis Freitag

40 Stunden pro Woche

Abendschicht

Zusätzlich erhalten Mitarbeitende in der Abendschicht Zuschläge für viele ihrer Arbeitsstunden.

Bewerbung

Wenn Sie an der Stelle interessiert sind, füllen Sie bitte das Bewerbungsformular aus und fügen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf so schnell wie möglich bei.

Bei Fragen zur Position können Sie sich gerne an den Head of International Staffing, Andrei Maierean, unter +45 61 63 07 19 oder an den Staffing Consultant, Damian Bukowski, unter +45 73 32 37 53 wenden. Erreichbar werktags zwischen 08:00 und 16:00 Uhr.

JKS führt laufend Vorstellungsgespräche durch, und die Stellen können bereits vor Ablauf der Bewerbungsfrist besetzt werden.

jobs.description:
System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)

Vacancy description

System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)

Shape the backbone of the energy transition

Are you passionate about building reliable, future-ready energy systems?

Do you enjoy working at the intersection of electrical engineering, system integration, and real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Serve as the overall system‑responsible owner for the AC Skid, covering electrical/functional architecture, safety, quality, and lifecycle performance.

Lead supplier selection, qualification, and governance for the mechanical Skid design, ensuring alignment with system requirements, standards, and cost targets.

Own the technical selection and specification of:

• MV transformer

• RMU

• PCS (in house designed converter integration and interfaces

Ensure correct electrical and functional integration of all subsystems:

• MV transformer – RMU – PCS

• Grounding/earthing

• Cooling and auxiliary power

• Cabling, interlocks, protections, and monitoring

Review and validate supplier designs for the mechanical skid

Ensure compliance with relevant standards:

• MV equipment (IEC/ANSI)

• Transformer and switchgear safety

• Environmental, mechanical, and fire safety

Review supplier documentation, test results, FAT reports, and qualification data.

Drive quality and cost optimization, ensuring a price‑competitive and high‑quality AC Skid product for the BESS platform.

Support customer clarification and quotation phases, ensuring:

• Technical feasibility

• Clear interpretation of customer requirements

• Alignment between project needs and AC Skid capabilities

Collaborate cross‑functionally with electrical, mechanical, controls, product, procurement, and quality teams to ensure seamless AC Skid integration.

Our requirements

Must‑haves:

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Energy Engineering, or similar.

Strong understanding of:

• MV transformers, RMUs, switchgear, and MV safety

• Grid‑connected PCS/power converters

• MV protection, grounding/earthing, and interlocking

• Cooling and auxiliary systems

Experience working with suppliers on:

• Detailed mechanical design reviews

• Documentation review and compliance checks

• Quality and cost evaluations

Ability to support technical clarifications during pre‑sales and quotation phases.

Nice‑to‑haves:

Experience with AC Skids, E‑houses, containerized MV designs, or BESS systems.

Knowledge of grid code requirements for MV‑connected BESS or hybrid power plants.

Familiarity with DFMEA, FAT processes, and utility compliance documentation.

Background in system engineering or product ownership roles.

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Ready to Grow Your Impact?

If you’re excited by this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now! Send us your resume in English and help us build the energy systems of tomorrow.

Interviews will be scheduled on an ongoing basis.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

Vacancy description

System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)

Shape the backbone of the energy transition

Are you passionate about building reliable, future-ready energy systems?

Do you enjoy working at the intersection of electrical engineering, system integration, and real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Serve as the overall system‑responsible owner for the AC Skid, covering electrical/functional architecture, safety, quality, and lifecycle performance.

Lead supplier selection, qualification, and governance for the mechanical Skid design, ensuring alignment with system requirements, standards, and cost targets.

Own the technical selection and specification of:

• MV transformer

• RMU

• PCS (in house designed converter integration and interfaces

Ensure correct electrical and functional integration of all subsystems:

• MV transformer – RMU – PCS

• Grounding/earthing

• Cooling and auxiliary power

• Cabling, interlocks, protections, and monitoring

Review and validate supplier designs for the mechanical skid

Ensure compliance with relevant standards:

• MV equipment (IEC/ANSI)

• Transformer and switchgear safety

• Environmental, mechanical, and fire safety

Review supplier documentation, test results, FAT reports, and qualification data.

Drive quality and cost optimization, ensuring a price‑competitive and high‑quality AC Skid product for the BESS platform.

Support customer clarification and quotation phases, ensuring:

• Technical feasibility

• Clear interpretation of customer requirements

• Alignment between project needs and AC Skid capabilities

Collaborate cross‑functionally with electrical, mechanical, controls, product, procurement, and quality teams to ensure seamless AC Skid integration.

Our requirements

Must‑haves:

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Energy Engineering, or similar.

Strong understanding of:

• MV transformers, RMUs, switchgear, and MV safety

• Grid‑connected PCS/power converters

• MV protection, grounding/earthing, and interlocking

• Cooling and auxiliary systems

Experience working with suppliers on:

• Detailed mechanical design reviews

• Documentation review and compliance checks

• Quality and cost evaluations

Ability to support technical clarifications during pre‑sales and quotation phases.

Nice‑to‑haves:

Experience with AC Skids, E‑houses, containerized MV designs, or BESS systems.

Knowledge of grid code requirements for MV‑connected BESS or hybrid power plants.

Familiarity with DFMEA, FAT processes, and utility compliance documentation.

Background in system engineering or product ownership roles.

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Ready to Grow Your Impact?

If you’re excited by this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now! Send us your resume in English and help us build the energy systems of tomorrow.

Interviews will be scheduled on an ongoing basis.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

Vacancy description

System Manager, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)

Own the system. Shape the solution. Enable the energy transition.

Are you motivated by bringing complex energy systems together into one seamless, high-performing solution?

Do you enjoy working across technologies, teams, and disciplines to deliver real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Act as the overall system‑responsible owner of the entire BESS solution/product.

Define and maintain the system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of:

• PCS (Power Conversion System)

• Battery DC Block

• AC Skid

• EMS & Hybrid Power Plant Controller (HPPC)

• Grid interconnection & compliance

Ensure subsystem interfaces are clearly defined, robust, and fully aligned across electrical, control, mechanical, and communication domains.

Collaborate closely with other System Managers to deliver a high‑quality, reliable, safe, and easy‑to-install BESS platform.

Support customer-facing project phases, including:

• Understanding customer technical and functional requirements

• System sizing and configuration

• Defining or selecting product variants and architectures

• Clarifying integration, performance, and compliance aspects

Ensure the BESS platform meets all relevant standards and certifiable requirements for the targeted European and global markets.

Drive product-level requirement definition, functional specifications, technical governance, and change management.

Contribute to product roadmap development, ensuring alignment with market trends, grid requirements, and future hybrid power plant needs.

Support cost‑optimization, manufacturability, and quality initiatives to ensure a price-competitive product.

Maintain system documentation, design rules, product configuration guidelines, and compliance packages.

Our requirements

Must‑haves:

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Controls Engineering, or a related field.

Strong understanding of grid‑scale BESS architecture and system integration.

Experience working with multiple subsystems such as PCS, battery containers, AC Skids, and EMS/plant controllers.

Ability to define system requirements, specify subsystem interfaces, and validate system integration.

Understanding of grid interconnection requirements, certifiable standards, and BESS compliance guidelines.

Experience with customer technical discussions, system sizing, and solution definition.

Nice‑to‑haves:

Experience in hybrid power plant solutions (BESS + PV + WTG).

Familiarity with European grid codes (ENTSO‑E, national TSO/DSO requirements).

Background in product ownership, system engineering, or platform leadership.

Experience with industry certification processes for electrical or power systems.

Knowledge of thermal, mechanical, or communication aspects of BESS solutions.

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Operations team, working primarily with Azure, AWS and partially in GCP. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that all engineers think about automation and streamlining first.

Your Role & Impact We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We want to build a modern, strong and scalable platform for our many subsidiaries(120+ companies) and we need the right people to do that.

You will be doing hands-on work on our many platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities • Operate and optimize Egmont’s multi-cloud environments

• Automate routine and repetitive tasks and streamline operations.

• Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring in our tools – We use Datadog

• Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standard and detect drift

• Drive modernization initiatives to reduce manual work and promote automation

• Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

• Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications) We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Desired Skills

• Experience from previous cloud engineering, operations or DevOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (GCP is also a plus)

• Scripting skills in any popular language

• Experience with IaC tools, any apply but we use Terraform

• Good understanding of networking

• Experience working with modern observability tools like Datadog

• Knows how to setup, configure and operate server based infrastructure, running both Linux and Windows

• Working with source control in GitHub or similar providers

• Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s rethinking how cloud operations are done.

Why Egmont? At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

Logistics & How to Apply

• Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1120 Copenhagen K, Denmark

• Application deadline: November 14, 2026

• Interviews: Will be scheduled from week 47.

Please send your application as soon as possible — we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English.

To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Sabine Lübcke (Senior IT Manager, Cloud & Network) at sabine.lubcke@egmont.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.
